Ready to prove who's the fastest here? Join now and show your max potential! 🚀

title: Bubble Pop Fairyland
description:
Bubble Pop Fairyland is an exciting bubble shooter game that’s very highly addictive!
Aim, shoot & pop all the color bubbles using epic blasters to clear the board and win coins!

Bubble Pop Fairyland is a fun and relaxing puzzle game designed to keep your mind sharp at any age.
It also is a perfect brain training and fast solution making game
You will have hours of fun shooting & matching the same colored bubbles!
With thousands of challenging & addictive unique levels, you simply won’t put it down!

title: Escape School Duel
description:
Escape School Duel is a fast, funny, and tense escape challenge set inside a school that does not want to let you leave. Play solo to chase your best time, or go 2 player and turn every hallway into a race for freedom. One moment you are dodging traps, the next you are trying to slip past the principal in a long corridor or outsmart a teacher waiting near the classroom. Every section has its own danger, so learning the school layout is part of the strategy.

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you have to do?
A: It's a fast-paced school escape game. Outrun crazy teachers and coaches to escape the school as quickly as possible.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: The game starts with the player in class when they suddenly get the idea to break out of school.

Q: What are the game's unique features? What makes it stand out?
A: High-quality graphics, unexpected traps, various skins, a two-player mode, and the ability to set new high scores.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: Various types of traps and well-designed locations. The mechanics are simple and the objectives are clear.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses, and how do they differ?
A: Yes, bosses try to block your path. For example, a coach will try to stop you from running through the gym.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main plot?
A: Yes. Once you escape the school, there are mini-games available in the yard.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on?
A: There are two currencies: tickets and money. You can use them to buy new skins.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you change the character's appearance?
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins and even a pet for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them?
A: Yes, there is a time-based leaderboard. Try to escape school faster than anyone else\!

Q: Should the game be played with sound?
A: The music complements the atmosphere well, but it is not required to complete the game

title: The Tall Man
description:
The Tall Man is a horror game where you explore darkness, searching for clues with only a weak light to guide you. But something is watching, always, just out of sight.

In this first-person horror survival game, the player navigates a dark, desolate forest at night with the primary objective of collecting nine mysterious pages scattered across the environment before a supernatural entity arrives. Movement is cautious and tense, utilizing a flashlight with a depleting battery to illuminate looming pine trees, abandoned structures, and rusted vehicles. The core gameplay loop focuses on exploration and stealth, where success depends on finding all collectibles while managing limited light sources to avoid the looming threat. The visual style is rooted in a gritty, realistic 3D aesthetic featuring a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and cold grays, creating a chilling atmosphere punctured only by the harsh yellow glow of the flashlight. A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees and foggy patches, evoking a sense of isolation and vulnerability. The protagonist appears as a generic human figure in a pinkish sleeve, seen only via their hand clutching the light. The emotional tone is high-tension and creepy, targeting teens and adult fans of the urban legend horror genre who enjoy skill-heavy survival mechanics and jumpscares. Progression is measured by the increasing number of pages found, which heightens the difficulty and atmospheric soundscapes as the player nears the final objective.

title: Obby: Mini-Games VS 1000
description:
Become the best out of 1,000 players and win the grand prize in the thrilling new Squid Game!
Extreme challenges await you, where only the strongest survive. Here are some of them:

🔨 Savage Hammers – Dodge them before they smash you!

➕ Math Spikes – Solve equations quickly and correctly, or lose!

🟥 Falling Tiles – Don’t stand too long — the tile might collapse beneath you!

🧱 Building Madness – Dodge brick blocks building up in front of you! Climb fast or get trapped!

🎵 Dancing Tiles – The music stopped? Stand on the right color — or it’s game over!

⛰️ Deadly Climb – Reach the top of the mountain while dodging massive rolling balls!

Can you survive and prove you're number one out of a thousand?

title: Catch a Fish Obby
description:
Catch a Fish Obby is a chaotic collector raider set in a bright OBBY world full of Fish and Brainrot Fish characters. Build a money making base with your favorite sea creatures, sneak into rival bases to steal their fish, and protect your own tank from greedy bots and other players. You can play solo or share the same device in 2 Player mode. Every fish you own generates coins while you move around the map. Use those coins to unlock stronger and rarer characters, then return to the obby track and steal more from everyone else.


Run through the obby, collect and buy new fish characters for your base.
Each fish generates coins over time according to its rarity tier.
Spend coins on stronger fish or save for high end draws.
Sneak into other bases and steal their best fish while defending your own!
Use events and ticket machines to roll for Mythic and Omega fish.

title: Solar Smash
description:
Solar Smash is a fun game that allows you to fully embrace cosmic power and create or destroy planets as you wish. You can choose from a variety of different weapons and use them to destroy planets and moons. Additionally, you can create your own planetary systems and customize them as you wish.

Solar Smash is also an opportunity to unleash your creativity and create worlds or destroy them in your hands. You can tear apart planets, cause supernovas and create black holes that consume everything in their path. The game has intuitive controls that are suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

Overall, Solar Smash is an addictive game that allows you to harness cosmic power and create or destroy planets at will. If you love physics simulators and space, then this game is definitely for you!

title: Obby: Mini-Games
description:
Obby: Mini-Games - play against other players and win Cups! Triumph in each mode and stand on the golden winner's pedestal!

title: Sudoku
description:
The playing field is a grid with 9x9 cells, divided into smaller grids with a side of 3 cells. Thus, the entire playing field consists of 81 cells. At the beginning of the game, there are already some numbers in them (from 1 to 9). The player is required to fill in the free cells with numbers from 1 to 9 so that in each row, in each column and in each small 3 ×3 square, each digit would occur only once.
There are multiple levels of difficulty you can choose. Beware of mistakes you can make.

In this game you will plunge into the exciting world of mining adventures!

- Become the mayor of your village: upgrade your village. Discover new opportunities and bargain with the residents!

- Variety of islands: be the discoverer of new islands! Each island opens up new opportunities for your exciting adventure!

- Upgrade your character: Upgrade your character's skills, making him faster, luckier and stronger.

- Competitive spirit: Get resources and sell them to become the richest player in this game!

And can you become the best in this game? Embark on an exciting adventure with your favorite characters!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: Mining adventures in the style of Minecraft. Players need to unlock islands and gather resources.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: A well-developed game in the style of Minecraft, with an achievement system, plenty of tools for resource gathering, and character progression.

Q: Are there any currencies and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features gold as currency, which can be used to upgrade better tools for resource gathering, exchange resources, level up characters, and unlock islands.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: References to the Minecraft world.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does character progression work? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Gather more resources to sell and earn coins, which can be used to level up characters and tools. After unlocking an island, players can place statues and upgrade them to earn passive income.

Economy & Customization

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers skins for your avatar, which is displayed in the corner.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

Q: Are there achievement systems? What are they and what can be obtained for them?

A: The game features achievements that can be obtained during gameplay. For example, for a certain number of blocks destroyed or for unlocking the first island.

title: Your Obby Parkour
description:
Enter a thrilling world of non-stop challenges! Run, jump, dodge, and conquer in the ultimate parkour platformer! 
Survive crazy levels — from burning lava and icy slides to water traps and mysterious portals. Watch out for trampolines, spinning traps, and tons of hidden paths!

Play with friends and travel through fun regions — from simple to brutally hard! Discover the hidden little dragon, collect trophies, and unlock secret shortcuts and bonus zones!

Be careful of:
Deadly skeletons
Lava-filled volcanoes
Slippery ice paths
Horror mazes where it's easy to get lost!

Ready to be a true parkour master? Find the fastest paths, conquer extreme stages, and show the world your skills!

Perfect for fans of obby-style maps, parkour games, secrets, adventures, and multiplayer fun!

title: Cube Snake 2048
description: A great Cube Snake 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Arrows Out!
description:
Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board. One correct move can open the way forward, while a single mistake can trigger a chain reaction that costs you a heart.

As you progress, the game evolves into a full arrow maze escape experience featuring twisting paths, looping routes, and increasingly complex layouts. Some stages feel like isolated arrow-filled arenas where every direction represents either danger or opportunity, turning each decision into a tense test of planning and precision.

The core mechanic revolves around tapping arrows out in the correct order. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, and with only three hearts available, every move matters. Make three mistakes and the attempt ends immediately, pushing you to think carefully before each tap. To complete a level, you must clear all arrows before time runs out, creating a high-pressure challenge that tests both focus and reaction speed.

Gameplay blends intuitive tap and swipe controls with advanced puzzle mechanics, encouraging players to adapt their strategy as new movement patterns and hazards appear. Certain levels demand quick thinking and precise timing, rewarding players who can stay calm under pressure.

More than a simple arrow puzzle, Arrow Escape is a layered challenge of strategy, speed, and skill. Whether you’re navigating a dense arrow maze, solving a tight exit puzzle, or racing against the clock in a last-second escape, every level pushes your problem-solving abilities to the limit.

title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of car crashes with the Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator. Perfect for those who love realistic car destruction and high-speed racing, this free online game is accessible on both mobile and PC. Prepare for an entertaining experience filled with destruction physics!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD — movement, right mouse button to click buttons, ZX — left and right turn signals. Mouse wheel — zoom in/out camera, left mouse button — rotate camera.
Mobile: Tap the buttons. Left/right buttons, accelerate forward, reverse.

Key Features:
• Realistic controls: The game features highly accurate controls, along with vehicle destructibility. Watch as cars crumple, tear apart, and explode into pieces!
• Create your own levels: If the basic maps aren't enough for you, create your own — you decide what will be on your map and how it will look!
• Choose your car: Pick the car you like and hit the road! Wonder how long your journey will be.

Game Modes:
• Classic mode: A classic mode where you can play on 8 ready-made maps and test the cars!
• Map Editor: A separate large world where you can create your own maps as your heart desires. Come up with your own challenges and obstacles or just create something unique.

Vehicles / Cars:
• Caro: A powerful muscle car. It will impress you with its speed and power. See how it withstands obstacles in its path!
• Flash: The futuristic electric car! Powerful and fast enough. Watch how it takes a hit!
• Syper: A sports car designed specifically for speed. Street racing is its forte, but how will it perform on the map? Find out!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Test the cars' durability by completing challenges, or create your own! It's your sandbox where you can play as you wish! Choose a car and go racing on the map! You can complete challenges or immediately destroy your car on the first obstacle! Watch as cars turn into heaps of metal, or try to keep them intact. The choice is yours!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: This is your sandbox where you set the rules. Destroy cars and enjoy watching them explode, or try to keep them whole!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: Realistic controls and driving physics allow for realistic scenarios. You can turn on the turn signal, honk, and even get out of the car or drive from a first-person perspective, witnessing all the chaos from inside! A wide selection of maps lets you play out numerous scenarios!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: There are 8 maps in the game, each differing in challenges and content. But if that's not enough, you can create your own map in the map editor! You're not limited in possible scenarios!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new cars and test their durability! See how many challenges they can withstand.

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Paint the cars in your desired color and see how they perform on the map!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most cars in the game are available from the start. Begin your journey with the car you like!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory, but it can enhance the emotional experience!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it entail?
A: At the beginning of the game, you'll be taught how to control the car, and from the first seconds, you'll understand what to do!

title: Robby: Climb and Jump Tower
description:
Do you want to conquer the tallest tower? In this game you can do it! 🏗️

Climb higher and higher, using powerful wings to accelerate! The higher you go, the more coins you collect! 💰

And if you buy funny pets, they will help you collect even more coins! 🐰🐱🐢

Game Features:

Steep wings for fast ascent 🚀
Cute pets to help
Steep towers
Bright graphics and a cheerful atmosphere

Conquer the peaks with us! 🎮✨

title: Sprunki Action Playground: Ragdoll Sandbox
description: Action 2D sandbox with physics, where battles, destruction, construction and complete freedom of action await you!

title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game
description:
Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

Endless Nail Customization: Choose from a variety of colors, patterns, and nail styles.
Creative Nail Art Tools: Use professional tools to create the most stunning nail art.
Fun Challenges: Each customer has a unique style request — can you satisfy them all?
Salon Upgrades: Upgrade your nail salon with trendy decor, tools, and accessories.

title: Gym Boss
description:
💪 "Gym Boss" – a casual game where you start with basic equipment and gradually become a true champion!

🔥 Game Features:
✔ Strength Training – from simple push-ups to heavy barbells!
✔ Players Rivals – compete for the title of the best!
✔ Ring Bosses – defeat them all!
✔ Simple Mechanics – perfect for mobile & PC!

🎯 Can you become the ultimate Gym Boss? Test yourself now!

title: Cozy Coloring
description:
Discover a world of vibrant colors and calm creativity with our color-by-number game. Choose beautiful pictures, find the right colors, and fill in each image step by step. It’s a simple and enjoyable way to relax, take your mind off daily worries, and build your own collection of colorful artworks.

The game offers pictures for every mood and age: cute images for kids, beautiful illustrations for adults, animals, flowers, nature, food, patterns, mandalas, and much more. Each coloring page is divided into numbered areas — simply choose a color and tap the matching sections.

The game is perfect for a short break, relaxing after school or work, a peaceful evening, or family time. You don’t need any drawing skills — everyone can create a beautiful finished picture.

There is also a creative mode where you can color each image in your own style!

Color by number, create beautiful images, and enjoy calm creativity anytime.

title: Domino Battle
description: Dominoes are back better than ever. You can choose your preferred style of game where it doesn't matter whether you choose Draw or Block. The level of fun is always the same!

title: Knit Loop: Yarn Jam Puzzle
description:
Knit Loop: Yarn Jam Puzzle is a cozy puzzle game about yarn, threads and knitting. Sort colorful wool, untangle thread loops and complete relaxing levels with satisfying 3D physics.

Enjoy a calm yarn sort puzzle with a soft handmade look: bright yarn, cute knitted details, smooth controls and simple rules. Move the threads, free blocked pieces and find the right order to finish each level.

This game is great for fans of wool sort, yarn jam, knit puzzle, sorting games, logic puzzles and relaxing brain games. Each level becomes more interesting with new combinations, more yarn and trickier tangled patterns.

Play for free, train your attention and enjoy a warm knitting atmosphere. Yarn sorting is perfect for a short break, cozy relaxation and a pleasant brain workout.

title: Tidy Up - Satisfeel ASMR
description:
Tidy Up: Satisfeel ASMR game✨ brings you a moment to clean your soul, clear your mess, and help you overcome your stress. It's time to let your mind free and pampered. Just relax with the simple gameplay with various minigames and organize puzzles.

Features of Tidy Up: Satisfeel ASMR game:
🌿Easy gameplay: clean, sort, fill, or drag, drop, touch, slide, and draw... with one finger you can enjoy all the satisfying minigames and have a satislife!

title: English Checkers Online Multiplayer
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
Cooking City
description:
If you have always wanted to become a top chef in a crazy culinary world, it’s time to dive into the cooking fever! 🔥🍳

Head back to the kitchen and prepare delicious dishes for hungry customers 🍔🌭🍟 Show off your impressive cooking skills and use smart time management to overcome challenging tasks ⏳💪

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of excitement and fun: cook in different kitchens, cafes, and restaurants, serve visitors, and master new recipes 🍲🏪 A wide variety of challenging levels and exciting tasks are waiting for you! 🎯  

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: It's a cooking and restaurant simulator. Players need to prepare and serve guests as quickly as possible.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: Various dishes, the ability to upgrade the kitchen, and unlocking new establishments.

Q: Are there any currencies and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has 2 currencies: coins and diamonds. Both currencies can be used to upgrade the kitchen and purchase enhancements.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. Players can buy diamonds or booster packs. Donations speed up game progress.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game features a simple yet captivating gameplay mechanic.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?

A: The music complements the game, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

title: My Pet Care Salon: Obby Dress-Up 3D
description:
Welcome to a cute pet care salon!
In this casual simulation game, you run your own animal care salon. Wash your pets, take care of them, decorate them, and train them so they become happier and healthier.

Complete simple tasks, upgrade your salon, and unlock new features. Every pet needs attention and care. The game offers relaxing gameplay, a cozy atmosphere, and lots of adorable moments with lovely pets.

Perfect for players who love animals and calm casual games.

title: PoppyTile
description:
Join travelling through PoppyTile village with challenges in both match-3 and mahjong genres!
Meet the charming girl Poppy who will be by your side during the throughout your journey!

Match 3 identical tiles to gradually clear the board. Progress further across the map with increasingly difficult levels.

Use boosters to complete levels as quickly and comfortably as possible.

Classic boosters:
- Add an extra slot, 
- Cancel the last action, 
- Mix tiles on the board
- Use an idea!

How far can you go?

See you in PoppyTile!

title: Cube Trap
description:
The room looks simple. Five steps to the door you want, level floor, no enemies. You start walking — and the floor drops out from under you.

A 3D platformer that lies to your face. The platform slides away at the exact instant you jump. The ceiling comes down the moment you stand still. The controls flip to mirror mode halfway down a corridor. Gravity turns over, and the sky becomes the floor. And the door you were heading for sidesteps two paces and slams shut.

Nothing here is random: every dirty trick fires the same way every single time. The first time it kills you; the second time it doesn't. Death is instant and costs you nothing — the little cube guy bursts into parts and half a second later he's standing at the start again. Losing is impossible. The only thing you can do is fail to catch on.

title: Safari Merge
description:
Safari Merge is a bite-sized merge puzzle: grass sprouts onto the board, and you drag matching creatures together to combine them into the next animal up the chain. Keep the board from filling up, chain merges for combo bonuses, and unlock all 18 creatures. Each new animal comes with a real fact about how it fits into the natural world!

 -  18 creatures to discover, ordered along a real food chain
 -  A genuine animal fact with every new tier you reach
 -  Combo system that rewards fast, focused merging
 -  Three difficulties, from easy to hard
 -  Earn gems to unlock backgrounds and board tiles
 -  Plays in your browser. Mouse or touch, phone or desktop

title: Block Bloom
description:
Block Bloom is a colorful puzzle-shooter about smart timing and sharper planning.

A conveyor belt carries a stream of colored blocks across the board. Below it sits your grid of shooters — each one loaded with a color and a limited number of shots. Tap a shooter to send it into a firing slot, and it will automatically blast every matching block that rolls past.

The catch: you only have a handful of slots. Send in the wrong shooter and it sits there, clogging a slot with nothing to shoot. Fill every slot with dead weight and the board jams — game over. Clear the whole conveyor and the level is yours.

title: Connect Associations
description:
A set of words hides several meaningful connections. Find four words that share a theme and merge them step by step into one group. Correct matches reveal categories, while later levels introduce fresh word sets and ice obstacles.

The relaxed pace gives you time to consider every move. Hints can keep the solution moving when a connection is especially tricky. Complete levels, earn coins, and watch your overall progress grow.

title: Never by Color!
description:
The Japanese room has drowned in a mountain of colorful parts. Bring back its calm!

Scoop up a handful of parts onto your tray and sort them into boxes. There's one rule, and it's ironclad: sort by SHAPE — never by color! Cubes with cubes, plates with plates, and let the red trap box stay empty.

No timers, no losing. Just you, a mountain of parts, and the pursuit of perfect order. The most meditative tidying of your life.

title: Petdoku: Cozy Puzzle Games
description:
Get ready for an exciting challenge with a thrilling twist on two classic games! Dive into a captivating puzzle that merges the strategic thinking of Minesweeper with the number-crunching fun of Sudoku, all while uncovering the hidden map of your dog's favorite territory.
Can you solve it and reveal where your furry friend's adventures lie?

title: Catch It! Santa the Toy Rescuer
description:
Casual game about catching items rolling in from four directions.
Help Santa save the toys from falling! Toys are rolling in from four directions, move the basket quickly to catch each one before it falls. 
Miss three toys, and the game is over.
The more toys you catch, the more points you earn.

title: Sort Puzzle
Dragon Annihilation
description: These dragons from hell, under the witch's spell, are going to destroy the village you dwell! The only way to repel, is to show them the power of your shell!

title: Up Jelly! Up!
description:
A quality physics arcade game where little jelly substances keep drowning over and over again. Only you can protect them!

The game offers a visually appealing look and simple controls, making it accessible to players of all ages and experience levels.

Jump higher, survive longer and never give up!

title: Smash and Break
description:
Smash and Break — a juicy voxel destruction sandbox where you can blow anything to pieces!

100 objects are waiting their turn: a mouth-watering burger, a birthday cake, a gaming PC, a helicopter, a piano, a fish tank, and even a capybara. Every object is built from thousands of voxel cubes and breaks apart for real: chunks chip off and tumble down, liquid pours out through the holes, fire spreads across anything flammable, and glass bursts into a spray of shards.

No timers, no penalties, no game overs. Just you, a pile of objects, and total freedom to destroy. The perfect stress reliever!

title: The long way home
description:
Your ship is gone. You are a very long way from Earth, with a suit, a tank of fuel, and the air in your lungs.

The Long Way Home is a game about thrust being precious and drift being free. Every burn spends fuel you may never replace, so the fastest route is rarely the straight one. Swing past a planet and let its gravity throw you onward for nothing, and keep the fuel for the moment you actually need it.

Between you and home: abandoned supply stations, each holding one decisive resupply. Sealed containers you can crack open if you have the patience. Debris fields that will shred you at speed and let you pass at a crawl.

VESTA, the assistance unit strapped to your chest, talks you through it. She is a machine and says so, and she will tell you when your heading is wrong.

Get to Earth before the oxygen runs out. Then do it again, carrying cargo.

title: Sway - Tower Builder
description:
Sway is a relaxing one-tap tower builder. It's simple, no need to remember thousands of rules and combinations.

Simply stack blocks high, keep them steady and comete with other players!

title: Starweave Make Constellations
description: Starweave is a breathtaking, meditative puzzle game where you restore balance to the universe one strand of light at a time. Guided by ancient celestial dust, your journey begins with a single spark. Draw glowing pathways between pulsing star nodes to weave intricate constellations. Whether you are looking to sharpen your mind with elegant geometric puzzles or simply wash away stress of the day with soothing ambient soundscapes.

title: Field of Blooms
description:
Your garden dried out. But you can save it!
Sweep the watering can across the field and dry sprouts open in a line behind your cursor. Then the fertilizer turns them into fat golden heads, then the basket collects the lot. Cash in what you gathered, buy a wider spray and a longer timer, and go back for more. Harvest the whole map and the season starts over, permanently richer!

title: Merge Royal 2048
description:
Merge Royale – The Ultimate 2048 Card Puzzle Adventure!
Welcome to Merge Royale, the most addictive fusion of Solitaire strategy and 2048 merging fun! Test your logic, speed, and focus as you combine matching cards to reach the highest numbers and Levels. If you enjoy relaxing yet challenging merge puzzle games, this one’s for you. Match cards with the same numbers, merge them to create higher values, and keep progressing to unlock stunning visuals and satisfying combos.

title: Microgic 89
description:
MICROGIC 89 is a retro tile puzzle set inside a 1980s microchip. You play BYTE, a
courier who has to collect every data chip on the board, unlock the socket they open,
and reach the exit before the timer runs out.

22 hand-built levels, each one testing a different machine: sliding ice floors, force
belts, teleport pads, cloning machines, trap doors, live bombs and patrolling bugs.
Nothing on the board is decoration - if a gadget is there, you have to use it.

Play it flat in the classic top-down view or flip to 3D at any time. A full level
editor is built in, so you can draw your own maps and play the ones other players
have published.

title: Cavern of Gears
description: Cavern of Gears is a 2D action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. Fight through gear-driven caverns with a growing arsenal of weapons, uncover the fate of the workers who vanished below, and face down the powers that took their place.

title: Carrom Club
description: Super Carrom — the classic tabletop game, reimagined for your browser. Flick your striker to pot coins, sink the queen, and outplay a opponent. Place your bets, build your coin stash, and climb from casual games to high-stakes tables. Smooth physics, satisfying shots, and quick matches you can play anywhere — on desktop or mobile.

title: Brainrot Courier
description:
Brainrot Courier is an exciting skateboard adventure in which your goal is to collect the most legendary Brainrots! Ride on colorful platforms, jump over dangerous chasms, perform risky maneuvers to reach rare characters scattered around the world.



The further you go, the more unique and valuable Brainrots you can find. From popular characters to ultra—rare legends, each find brings you closer to becoming the best Brainroot collector.



Features



* Dynamic platform gameplay on a skateboard

* Collect dozens of unique and fun Brainrots

* Jump over chasms and overcome difficult obstacles

* Smooth and responsive skateboard controls

* Unlock rare and legendary Brainrots

* Collect the greatest collection of Brainrots

* Fast and addictive gaming sessions

* Suitable for players of all ages

title: Bubble Merge 2d
description: Bubble Merge is a relaxing physics-based puzzle game where you combine matching bubbles to create new items and complete each level’s objectives. Plan your moves carefully, use helpful power-ups, and discover new combinations as the challenges become more difficult.

title: EVADE
description: A high-speed chase game where you deliver packages across a city while the police hunt you down. Lose them, make the drop, and move on to the next job.

title: Fishing: Catch the Moment!
description: A relaxing 3D fishing game with atmospheric locations, changing weather and time of day. Cast your line, master the fishing mini-game, discover rare fish, upgrade your tackle and unlock new fishing spots. Build your collection and catch the heaviest trophy!

title: Flufflings: Pocket Pets
description:
Take care of stray kittens and create a cozy home and yard for them!

🧸 Buy toys and decorations: Make your space even more appealing to the cats.
🍲 Attract cats with food: The more food and toys, the more fluffy guests you'll get!
😊 Earn coins: The happier a cat is when it leaves, the more rewards it will leave behind.
🏠 Adopt kittens: Put a collar on a cat to make it stay forever.
🔍 Learn about the cats: Hold a cat to see its characteristics.
🍽️ Fill the bowls: Simply drop food or water into the bowl.
🎾 Play with the cats: Drag and release the ball to play.
🚪 Control the flow of visitors: Click the gate to stop new cats from visiting.

title: Nitro Ball
description:
Nitro Ball is a fast-paced car soccer game played entirely in your browser. Drive a boost-powered car, launch off the walls, and smash a giant ball into your opponent's goal. Jump, flip, and fly through the air to pull off saves and score from anywhere on the pitch.

Pick your mode: play a quick match against AI opponents in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3, fight through a knockout tournament, or switch to Hockey mode where the ball is swapped for a heavy puck that slides across the ice. For a different kind of challenge, take on the Challenge Maps — timed obstacle courses that test your aerial control and precision driving, with your best times saved for every course.

Customise your ride with a garage full of cars, wheels, decals, boost trails, toppers and over 250 antenna flags. Free Play mode lets you practice in an arena solo with no opponents.

title: Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent
description:
👋 Welcome to "Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent" — a fast-paced 3D parkour testing your speed and reactions!

Your main goal is to descend through generated platforms as low as possible while dodging moving obstacles. One wrong move and you fall straight into the abyss! The lower you fall, the faster you go: with every platform passed, your speed constantly increases, turning the parkour into a wild rush.

✨ Game Features:
🗺️ New levels: cover the distance and unlock new exciting stages!
🚀 Dynamic acceleration: reach crazy speeds and test your reflexes.
🤑 Coin collection: pick up gold coins right on the platforms as you drop.
🛍️ Cool shop: buy pets, viral memes (Six-Seven, Ballerina Capuchina, Tralalero, and more), and stylish accessories — from glasses and capes to the legendary Dominus!

🏆 Ready to become the ultimate fall champion? Jump in and show what you've got!

title: Pocket Tyrant
description: Pocket Tyrant is a charming one-joystick action-strategy conquest game where you lead a tiny goblin warlord and his growing horde across seven islands. Gather resources, recruit goblins, upgrade your tools and weapons, then raid 27 kingdoms on the road to the Black Citadel. Combat is instantly readable—your army is a number, theirs is a number, and every clash is visible subtraction. There are no menus or attack buttons: simply walk into the world to harvest, build, fight, and turn cheerful pastel villages into crooked goblin strongholds. The choice is always yours: attack now, or grow stronger first.

title: Potion Kitchen
description: Potion Kitchen is a cosy crafting puzzle about running a potion shop at the edge of the market. Guests arrive with orders — one needs a potion of warmth, another a good night's sleep, and some speak in riddles and expect you to work it out. Mix ingredients in the cauldron, brew, and serve before your guest gives up. The recipe book starts empty: all 19 recipes are unlocked by brewing alone, and every one of them can be reasoned out rather than guessed, because the ingredients of a potion share one element.

title: Ragdoll Fighter
description:
Ragdoll Fighter is a fast, funny 2D physics fighting game where every punch, swing, and stumble is driven by ragdoll physics. Drag your fighter around the arena, build up momentum, and slam into your enemies with fists or weapons until their health hits zero — with satisfying slow-motion on every big hit.

Battle through a campaign of hand-crafted levels, take on multiple foes at once, or test your survival skills in Endless Mode against never-ending waves. Earn coins from powerful hits and combos, then unlock a roster of wild characters — a robot, a ninja, a boxer, a spartan, a pirate, an alien, and more — each with its own attack, defense, and control stats. Collect daily rewards, chase 3-star level clears, and become the last ragdoll standing.

Progression & extras:

Unlock characters in the Character Select screen using coins earned in battle — each has different Attack / Defense / Complexity ratings.
Earn coins from weapon hits, combos, daily login rewards, and optional reward videos.
Daily rewards grow bigger the more days you play in a row.
Options: toggle music and sound, and set your preferred control side.

Features:

Hilarious, unpredictable ragdoll physics combat
Campaign levels with a 3-star rating system
Endless survival mode with escalating difficulty
8 unlockable fighters, each with unique stats and weapons
Intuitive one-finger drag controls — easy to learn, tricky to master
Satisfying slow-motion impacts and combo rewards
Plays great in portrait on desktop and mobile browsers

Win the fight:

Level mode: Defeat every opponent to clear the level. Finish fast and keep your health high to earn up to 3 stars. Clear levels to unlock the next ones.

Endless mode: Survive as long as you can — each kill restores a little health and enemies keep getting tougher. Your score is your kill count.

Don't give up: If you fall, you can watch a short video to revive and jump right back into the fight (once per run).
Manage your health: Keep an eye on the HP bar. When it empties, the round is over.

title: Rustlings online
description:
Rustlings online brings survival gameplay to your browser, without a steep learning curve.

Land on an island, gather resources, and build your own base - from simple wood walls to fortified metal strongholds. Craft tools, weapons, and gear to survive on your own or with a crew.

Team up with up to 3 players, defend your territory from other players and hostile creatures, trade, and grow stronger. Day turns to night, and danger rises with the dark - stay alert.

Rustlings online delivers the thrill of surviving and building without spending dozens of hours mastering complex systems - just open your browser and play, no install needed.

title: SHADOW NODE
description:
Welcome to Shadow Node – the ultimate hacker idle experience.

You are an elite hacker on a mission to infiltrate global networks, breach high-security servers, and mine valuable data fragments. Your ultimate goal? The legendary Shadow Node—a network so secretive it is only spoken of in whispers on the deepest dark web forums.

Are you ready to bring the digital world to its knees?

FEATURES
Progressive Hacking Network
Work your way up from simple local networks to complex government databases. Every successful hack brings you closer to the top of the digital food chain.

Idle Gameplay: Your Botnet Never Sleeps
Progress even while you’re offline. Your scripts automatically gather data fragments while you're away. Return to collect massive rewards—perfect for hackers on the go.

Deep Upgrade System
Invest in cutting-edge hacking tools, AI assistants, massive botnets, and quantum processors. Optimize your mining rate with hundreds of unique upgrades.

Strategic Prestige System
Perform a strategic reset to unlock permanent bonuses and multipliers. Plan your ascension carefully to exponentially increase your earning potential.

Milestones & Achievements
Complete challenging objectives to unlock legendary Dark Matter upgrades that fundamentally transform your gameplay.

Immersive Cyberpunk Atmosphere
Experience an atmospheric soundtrack and a dark aesthetic designed to pull you deep into the world of cybercrime.

HIGHLIGHTS
Offline Progression: Your mining operations run 24/7.
Fully Customizable: Tweak visual effects, haptic feedback, and choose from multiple languages.
Mobile Optimized: Smooth gameplay and intuitive touch controls.

Leave no trace. Download Shadow Node now and begin your ascent to hacker stardom!

title: Neon Maze
description: Neon maze is a vibrant neon logic puzzle where every move counts. Untangle the maze, clear the arrows, and play now!

title: Flying Robot Transform Car Games
description:
Transform into a powerful Wolf Robot and battle enemy machines in an open-world futuristic city. Switch between a robot, car, bike, helicopter, jet, and tank to complete action-packed missions, defeat enemies, and save the city from destruction.

Complete exciting missions across the city to earn coins and unlock powerful upgrades for your robot hero. Use special attacks, missiles, and unique transformation abilities to overcome challenging enemies and bosses. Whether you prefer exploring freely, flying above the city, or jumping straight into intense battles, every mission offers new action and rewards to discover.

Game Modes: 
Choose between exciting Mission Mode and Free Mode.

Mission Mode
Complete challenging objectives, battle enemy robots, destroy targets, and protect the city from dangerous attacks. Test your combat skills, use powerful transformations, and overcome increasingly difficult missions to become the ultimate robot hero.

Free Mode
Explore the open world at your own pace and enjoy complete freedom across the futuristic city. Transform into different vehicles and robots, collect rewards, fly through the skies, and discover everything the city has to offer.

title: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat
description: Ever wanted to experience life as a mischievous cat? In Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat, you take on the role of a playful yet naughty kitty, causing absolute mayhem inside Grandma’s house—all from a first-person perspective! This exciting 3D simulation game lets you see through the eyes of a troublemaking feline as you knock over furniture, scratch walls, and do everything in your power to drive Grandma crazy! Are you ready to embrace the chaos? 😼

title: Soccer Legends 2026
description: Soccer Legends 2026 is a fast-paced arcade soccer game where you can play solo or challenge your friends in exciting 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Choose from a variety of unique players, each with special abilities like powerful superkicks or teleportation, and use them to outplay your opponents. Compete in tournaments, master your timing and strategy, and score incredible goals to become the ultimate soccer champion

title: Tile Valley
description:
Tile Valley is an engaging and fun tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong. It’s designed to challenge your brain while providing a relaxing experience. Dive into casual puzzles with no time or space constraints, and explore hundreds of challenging levels. Your goal is to find and collect 3 identical tiles. You win when all tiles are removed from the stack. You lose if you fill all 7 empty tile slots on your board.

Features:
- Variety of Styles: Discover different themes, including food, sweets and shapes.
- Challenging Levels: Inspired by Mahjong, the game offers levels where you collect three matching tiles to win.
- Helpful Hints: Use hints to overcome tricky levels.
- Brain Training: Sharpen your mind while enjoying the game.

Give it a try and immerse yourself in the world of Tile Valley!

title: 2 Minute Football QB Legend
description: 2 Minute Football QB Legend focuses on the best parts of football - strategy, completing passes and scoring TD's! We make it as easy as possible -- just start passing with a single tap on the screen. There are no complicated control schemes, only pure touchdown bliss! Play live offense and match up against simulated opponents to win your way to the World Championship!

title: Your Obby Size
description:
Parkour and size control with secrets and surprises! Jump, run, and reach new heights in this thrilling game! Avoid lava and conquer challenges from easy to extreme!
Collect enough trophies to unlock secret paths, access new locations, and get unique character skins!
Beware of monsters guarding certain areas!
Find shortcuts to the top! Show everyone you're a true parkour master!

title: Word Solitaire
description:
Word Solitaire is not just another word game - it’s a unique and addictive word puzzle that blends the challenge of a card game with clever word associations. Match words by meaning, discover hidden connections, and test your brain like never before. Start playing today and see how many associations you can master!

This is a fresh take on solitaire card games, combining classic mechanics with modern word puzzles. It’s a new kind of cards game that challenges your vocabulary, logic, and strategy in equal measure.

title: My Arcade Center
description:
My Arcade Center is an addictive idle arcade tycoon and management simulator where you build, expand, and run your very own arcade business. Start with a small game room and turn it into a thriving arcade empire by placing machines, upgrading equipment, and attracting more customers.

Manage your arcade efficiently by collecting earnings, unlocking new areas, and optimizing your layout to maximize profit. Keep your machines running smoothly, serve customers quickly, and maintain a clean environment to boost satisfaction and income.

As you progress, unlock a wide variety of arcade machines, expand your space, and discover new strategies to grow faster. Each upgrade increases your revenue and helps you become the ultimate arcade tycoon.

Whether you enjoy idle games, simulation games, or business management experiences, My Arcade Center offers a satisfying progression system, simple controls, and relaxing gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.

Play now and build the best arcade center in this fun and rewarding idle management game!

• Day–Night loop: earn by day, upgrade by night.
• 9 maps to progress.
• Unlock and place machines anytime.
• Hire staff and use coin bots.
• Handle freeloaders, vandals, and misbehaving customers.
• Optimize layouts and expand your arcade.

title: Escape Tsunami for Brainrots
description:
Run fast and collect Brainrots! 🏃
Run from the tsunamis when they appear! 🌊
Survive and collect as many Brainrots as possible! ⚡
Upgrade your Brainrots! 💸
Upgrade your base! 🏗️

Controls:
Desktop — WASD: move, left and right mouse buttons — control the camera, E — interact, Space — jump.  
Mobile — virtual stick — move, jump button — jump, tap for action on buttons.

Key Features:
• Steal brainrots!: For diamonds, you can steal brainrots from other players!  
• Buy VIP shelters: Purchase VIP shelters to hide from the incoming wave faster!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Coins.: Upgrade your character's speed and your base with coins!  
• Diamonds.: A valuable currency that you can use to buy character skins, special brainrots, or even steal brainrots from other players! You can watch an ad right now to get your first diamonds.

Enemies / Bosses:
• Blue waves.: They move slower. You have more time to run further!  
• Green waves.: You better hurry, they are faster and won't wait long for you to grab your brainrot.  
• Red waves.: Run as fast as you can!!! It rushes faster than all, and you have little time!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Try to steal the most valuable brainrots before the wave catches you. You need to hurry!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: If you manage to grab a more expensive brainrot and go further — consider it a victory! Become richer than other players and you can make it onto the leaderboard of the wealthiest players!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: Different waves and the chance to run further! Each wave moves at a different speed, so you need to choose the best time to start. The further you go, the more expensive the brainrots, but the cost of mistakes increases. Those who are willing to take risks can gain much more!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: There is one large level in the game. You need to go further while dodging waves. The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return. The cost of mistakes increases, but the rewards will not leave you indifferent.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: Steal the most expensive brainrots! They will bring you more coins, and you can upgrade your speed and run further!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: Earn more money — you can upgrade your base and place more brainrots. More brainrots mean more money!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?  
A: Upgrade your speed and run further for more valuable brainrots! Buy VIP. You will need VIP shelters to avoid waves. Upgrade your base and place more brainrots. And if you don't want to run for a brainrot, steal it from other players for diamonds!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: You can buy skins for your character. Running further and getting richer is better with style!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there leaderboards and how do they work?  
A: Yes! Earn more gold and make it onto the list of the wealthiest players! You can also make it onto the list of the highest income.

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is clear from the first minutes, you can play in a way that is comfortable for you.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: From the first minutes, you will immediately understand what you need to do. Convenient markers will help you not get lost.

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise. Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items from simple tools to complex machines. Watch your island grow with every step.
Features
Relaxing, meditative gameplay
30+ recipes to discover and craft
Expand your island tile by tile
Calm atmosphere and sense of progress
Start building your dream island today!

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: You need to gather and craft resources to unlock new parts of the island and explore in search of even more materials.

Q: Does the game have a storyline?
A: There isn't a formal plot, but the objective is clear: expand your territory, gather resources, and explore the island.

Q: What is the game's standout feature? What will keep players engaged?
A: It features built-in mini-games, high-quality graphics, and a variety of different quests.

Q: Are there any particularly engaging elements, such as weapons, vehicles, locations, or skills?
A: The main draws are the new territories to discover, clear objectives, and simple, intuitive gameplay mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What's the best way to level up quickly?
A: You level up your character and abilities by gathering resources and upgrading your capabilities.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Currency is used to unlock new technologies and upgrade your character's stats.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar incentives to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, logging in every day grants bonuses such as items or earned currency.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on for immersion, or is the game playable without it?
A: The music is a great addition to the atmosphere, but it isn't required to progress through the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What kind of rewards can you earn?
A: There are special rewards for daily logins as well as milestones based on total playtime."

title: Brawl Simulator 3D
description:
You asked — we did it!⭐
The best 3D Brawl Stars simulator in history! 😉

💥REAL 3D BATTLES: Destroy enemies, level up, and show everyone what players are worth!

🎁LOTS OF PRIZES: Open regular boxes, trophy boxes, and Starr Drops to catch all brawlers!

😍BEAUTIFUL GRAPHICS: Check out brawlers in detail and enjoy their charm!

🔥DIFFERENT MODES: Many game modes will keep players entertained!

💅FULL CUSTOMIZATION: Get rare avatars and unique skins to stand out from the crowd!

What are players waiting for? Jump into the world of Brawl Stars with friends now! ❤️

title: Kendel 7 Days 7 Styles
description: In 7 Days 7 Styles, you’re dressing for fun: from sunrise to sunset, there’s looks to be spun; beach day or brunch, gym or the mall, style it your way and wow them all!

title: Pocket Universe
description:
Pocket Universe is an adventure game where players build and expand their own tiny world.

1. Gather resources (wood, stone, metal, crystals) and use them to unlock new lands.

2. Discover diverse biomes: lush meadows, frozen tundras, volcanic regions, and more.

3. Upgrade your tools to harvest rare materials.

4. Face enemies — monsters, golems, and wild creatures guarding unexplored areas.

5. Step by step, your little world will grow into a whole universe.

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Fashion Week 2025
description: Get ready to rule the runway in Fashion Week 2025! Style 5 stunning models in high-fashion looks for the most glamorous fashion event of the year! From Chanel-inspired elegance to punk rock rebellion, create jaw-dropping outfits across five unique themes. Mix and match couture dresses, bold accessories, and trendy hairstyles to make every model shine! Are you ready to become the ultimate fashion stylist? Play now and slay the runway!

title: Mom Life Simulator Baby Care
description:
Mom Life Simulator Baby Care Games lets you experience the daily life of a caring virtual mom in a fun and realistic family simulation. Complete exciting household tasks, prepare meals, clean the house, take care of your kids, shop for groceries, and spend quality time with your happy family. Every level brings new challenges and rewarding activities that make family life fun and engaging.

Explore multiple game modes and a wide variety of missions, including cooking, home management, parenting, shopping, pet care, family outings, and special events. Enjoy smooth controls, colourful 3D environments, realistic animations, and immersive sound effects as you progress through dozens of exciting levels.

Features
-Multiple game modes with unique family life challenges
-Dozens of fun levels and household missions
-Cook meals, clean, shop, and manage your home
-Take care of children and complete parenting tasks
-Beautiful 3D environments and smooth gameplay
-Easy controls with realistic family life simulation
-Fun activities, family outings, and daily routine missions
-Suitable for players who enjoy simulation and family games

Become the perfect virtual mom and experience the joys and responsibilities of family life in this entertaining anime mother simulator.

title: K-Pop Demon Hunter Fashion
description:
Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Demon Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes.

Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

Whether you want a chic idol aesthetic or a powerful warrior vibe, this game lets you experiment with endless combinations. Perfect for fans of K-Pop, fantasy fashion, and creative dress up games.

title: Build Your Zombie Horde
description: Your ZOMBIES await! Summon the undead horde, defeat enemies, collect resources, upgrade your army and conquer lands! A fun and simple strategy autobattler!

title: Kick a Lucky Block: Tsunami Waves
description:
Kick a Block: Lucky Football is a fun and fast-paced game where your goal is simple — kick the lucky block as far as possible! 😎🍀
Every kick gives you a chance to roll a unique brainrot and test your luck.

Once you land, you turn into a brainrot and must escape a massive tsunami that you triggered yourself! 🌊
The farther you kick, the bigger the rewards — but also the greater the danger.

Collect brainrots and place them on your plot to generate income. 👷
Buy weights and train your legs to kick farther and stronger! 💪

The game blends randomness, progression, and action into an exciting gameplay loop perfect for quick sessions.
Thanks for playing! Like and favorite if you enjoy the game! 🤩

title: Field Master
description: Field Master is a casual farming simulator that puts you behind the wheel of powerful agricultural machines. Experience the full farming cycle as you plow vast fields with your tractor, sow seeds with precision seeders, and carefully nurture your crops as they grow. When harvest season arrives, take control of massive combines to reap the rewards of your hard work. From soil preparation to harvest, every step is in your hands, making Field Master the perfect blend of relaxation and realism for farming enthusiasts and casual players alike.

title: Bridge Builder
description:
Become a design engineer who will have to improvise and, above all, adapt to the task at hand. Use different materials to build structures that can support the weight of the vehicle.

Game Features:

- Excellent physics - a real simulator
- Challenging levels in four different locations
- Challenging puzzles requiring the use of thinking and logic
- Built-in hint system will help you develop your skills

title: Dragon Hunter
description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.

Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Idle RPG with character leveling. You need to level up your character with random skills and defeat various enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: A simple and straightforward storyline, standard for this type of game.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it hook players?
A: There are few similar quality RPGs, interesting leveling up system, and a variety of enemies.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: Yes, they are much stronger than regular enemies.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on leveling up skills.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to defeat enemies and open chests.

Economy & Customization

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Mini-games, lots of weapons, and armor.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can buy armor and weapons.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to come back?
A: Yes, spins, leveling up.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is preferable to play with sound for a pleasant atmosphere in the game.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: Yes, there is chest opening.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, there is a journal of tasks and achievements.

title: Ninja vs Ragdolls: Sharp Knife Throw!
description:
🌟 Dive into the thrilling world of ninja adventures with unique physics in "Ninja vs Ragdolls: Sharp Knife Throw!"! Become a master of knife throwing, battling ragdoll-stickmen on chaotic levels. Solve puzzles and destroy everything around on diverse stages. Use ninja skills and precision to hit your targets! Ready to become a knife-throwing legend? Try it now! ⚔️

🥋 Inspired by popular hits like "Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break, Destroy!" and "Boxing Playground: Punch Hard!", this game offers a fun experience. Feel like a sharp thrower, toss knives with samurai accuracy, and compete with others. A free online game that brings exciting gameplay and hours of fun! 🎯

🔥 Features:
- Easy controls: throw knives with a tap on mobile or a mouse click on PC.
- Stunning 3D graphics and ragdoll physics.
- Fun and engaging gameplay.
- Leaderboards to compete with other players.
- Play online on any device.

title: Tall io
description: Tall.io is an engaging and addictive browser-based HTML5 game that combines elements of growth strategy and battle-arena action. Players control a &stickman& character in a dynamic arena where they must &grow taller& by collecting &bricks& and &rainbow orbs&, ultimately enhancing their size and strength. This &multiplayer& game invites players to compete on various islands, using their &stickman& avatars to fight for dominance. The game stands out for its vibrant graphics, seamless &online gameplay experience&, and thrilling competition.

title: Far Island: Tactical Warfare
description:
A tropical island awaits where every piece of land is a battlefield. This is a third-person tactical action game with an open world. Your goal is to capture enemy bases and hold them under enemy pressure.

Master a diverse arsenal: assault rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns, grenades, and special equipment. Each weapon affects your combat style. In the store, you can purchase and upgrade equipment using resources earned in battles.

The island impresses with its variety: tropical beaches, palm groves, and fortified bases with unique architecture. Each base requires an individual approach. Act strategically – combine attacks and use the terrain.

A dynamic capture and defense system, thoughtful weapon balance, and large-scale battles await you. For fans of the Far Cry series and tactical shooters, this is the perfect project combining strategy and action.

title: Rooftop Run
description:
Rooftop Run – Race Across the City! 🏃‍♂️💨

Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

Controls:
Desktop: Hold the right mouse button and direct your movement.
Mobile: Use your finger to direct your movement.

Key Features:
• Only Forward: Run forward and only forward! Don't stop. You control only the direction of movement; everything else happens automatically. But don't think this will make it easy — you'll need to make decisions on the fly!
• Don't Get Caught by Enemies: They will try to grab you. Be faster and smarter!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: A true dynamic parkour experience! Run, jump from rooftop to rooftop, dive through skyscraper windows, roll, slide under obstacles, and run along walls! And of course, try not to get caught by enemies!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Try not to fall and avoid getting caught by enemies who will try to stop you!

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?
A: Insane dynamics! You run at high speed across rooftops, leap over obstacles, smash windows, roll, and at certain moments, you'll catch a stunning shot!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: Levels follow one after another, each presenting different obstacles in a variety of variations!

Q: Does the difficulty change?
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the previous one. You'll need to test your reflexes!

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization options?
A: Collect coins scattered throughout the levels to unlock various customization elements.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory; play however you feel comfortable. However, turning it on will help you immerse yourself better in the dynamics.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?
A: At the start, you'll be shown everything essential. You'll immediately understand what to do.

title: Italian Brainrot Hunting 3D
description:
Italian Brainrot meme animals hunting! Choose a weapon and go ahead - a real meme hunt in a 3D! Italian meme animals are on their guard - don't scare them off!

Start hunting Italian Brainrot meme animals!

🐻 Italian animals can get scared and run away if you get too close or miss! Show your stealth skills and be careful!

🎯 Hunt Italian Brainrot animals in 3D and complete all levels!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Please, leave your ideas for new levels!

title: Crosswords: Big Collection
description:
Crosswords: Big Collection is a classic crossword game for anyone who loves to think. You get over 800 levels with more than 30,000 unique clues, a daily crossword that refreshes every day, and a collectible items system with quests and rewards.

The game is translated into six languages: Russian, English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian. Choose your theme — soft green or dark brown — to match your mood. The interface adapts to any screen: play on PC or smartphone with the same comfort and clarity.

Progress saves automatically. Every solved word earns you points that push you up the leaderboard. Come back to unfinished puzzles, unlock collection items, and compete with players worldwide.

title: Baby Brainrots - Multiplayer with Friends!
description:
An online game where you can find cute Baby Brenrots. Travel to different islands and play with other players.
Make new friends.
Discover all the islands and find all the Brenrots!
Real online for free!
Play with friends!

title: Save The Pets: Draw to Save
description:
Watch out! The cute dog is in danger.

The evil bees are here to sting him, and it’s your job to protect the dog! Draw a line to block the bees and keep him safe. This is not just any puzzle game—it’s the ultimate save dog rescue game, where your creativity and quick thinking will be put to the test.

But the challenge doesn’t stop at the bees. The dog must also avoid lava, water, spikes, and bombs. Can you step up and master the art of save the doge? Whether it’s outsmarting swarms or battling obstacles, this is your chance to shine in the clash of doge vs bee!

title: Kick Lucky Block For Brainrot
description:
Throw lucky blocks, train your strength, and collect all the brainrots! Bring on the cheesy weather and enjoy the cheesy brainrots!

Smash rare blocks, collect funny brain creatures, and bring them back to your base. But be careful — every powerful kick can trigger a huge tsunami wave! Run, jump, and survive before the water catches you.

Upgrade your strength, train your legs, buy new weights, and become strong enough to kick blocks even farther. The farther you launch them, the better rewards you can discover!

Features:

- Kick mystery blocks and discover rare rewards
- Survive giant tsunami waves
- Collect brain creatures and place them on your base
- Upgrade your power, speed, and training equipment
- Unlock stronger kicks and reach new areas

title: Wonder Goal: Fun Football Kick
description:
Roll the ball towards the goal with a crazy kick soccer frenzy! Dodge the soccer stars to hit the super goal. Dribble your way towards your soccer strike & win the trophy. Are you ready for a crazy kick soccer game? 🤪

Have fun while becoming a soccer superstar using just a finger. You are just one crazy kick away from becoming a soccer star. Play a joyful crazy kick game to rule the football arena. 🥅

⚽ BUT how to become a soccer superstar? ⚽

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description:
Rolling Balls Sea Race - Play Online
Narrow tracks. Deep water. One wrong move and you're gone. Rolling Balls Sea Race is a fast-paced obstacle racing game built on Unity physics — roll to the finish, grab every coin, don't fall. Simple premise. Brutal execution.

How to Play Rolling Balls Sea Race
Pick a mode. Roll to the finish line without hitting the water. Collect coins along the track to unlock new balls, tail tracks, and sky packages. Race solo or go head-to-head against a second player on the same keyboard. Dozens of levels. One goal: cross that line first.

Controlling Your Ball
Single player uses W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys — your pick. Two-player mode splits the keyboard: Player 1 gets W, A, S, D, Player 2 gets the Arrow Keys. Controls snap tight. Physics do the rest. Edge too close? Into the water you go. These are Physics Games in the truest sense — momentum matters, every turn carries weight.

Coins, Unlocks, Progression
Every coin on the track counts. Grab enough and the unlock shop opens up — new ball skins, tail tracks, and sky packages waiting behind coin gates. No shortcuts here. Grind the levels, hit the coins, build your collection. Addictive rhythm. If the low-poly 3D style and coin-collecting loop pull you in, Golf Orbit runs a similar rewarding loop — skill pays off in currency every run.

Pro Tips for Staying Dry
Slow down on sharp corners — speed kills on elevated tracks. Hug the inside of turns. Don't chase coins near the edges early on; survive first, collect second. In 2-player mode, bump your opponent on wide sections — legal, chaotic, effective. Physics-curious players who love testing boundaries might also enjoy Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! for that same unpredictable engine energy. And if pure sandbox destruction scratches that itch, Melon Sandbox delivers zero rules and maximum chaos.

Key Features
Dual modes: Solo race or split-screen 2-player on one keyboard — instant couch competition.
Low-poly 3D visuals: Clean, lag-free look. Runs smooth on desktop and mobile browsers alike.
Coin unlocks: New balls, tail tracks, sky packages — all earned in-run, no paywalls.
Dozens of levels: Elevated tracks over water, realistic nature backdrops, escalating difficulty.
Unity engine: Real physics on every roll. Momentum, gravity, edge pressure — all calculated live.
Cross-platform: desktop browser, iOS, Android. No downloads. Click and play.

A terrifying multiplayer horror where players must survive side by side in a dark forest. Each night, a mystical deer-monster comes out to hunt, its footsteps and roar echoing in the darkness. You have a limited time — 99 days — to save the lost boys and escape the forest.

At your disposal is a workbench where you can craft weapons, flashlights, and supplies to protect yourself and survive. Cook food using a cauldron. Explore the forest, gather resources, build shelters, and do everything you can to make it through another night. But remember — the monster never sleeps, and with each passing night, it becomes more dangerous.

Game Features:
-Atmospheric multiplayer horror.
-Cooperative survival against the deer-monster.
-Crafting weapons, flashlights, and supplies.
-Goal: save the boys and escape the forest.
-Unlock new character classes.

*After surviving in the forest, only the money you’ve found and earned is saved — to unlock new characters — along with your achievements.

title: Escape from Wave for Brainrots
description:
Welcome to the game "Escape from Wave for Brainrots"! 🌊🧠

A giant tsunami is already coming — and only you can save the Brainrots! Grab them, run away from the wave and get them to the base before it's too late. The faster you act, the more chances you have to save the rarest and most valuable brainrots.

Boost your speed to take the brainrots further and faster.
🧠 Find rare Brainrots — from ordinary to truly legendary.
🏠 Deliver them to the base, expand the collection and become a real savior.

Each new brainroot is a step towards progress, new opportunities and even more action. Test your reaction, strategy and speed — because the tsunami is not waiting!

Can you save all the brainrots and become the main hero of the base?
Run, rescue and collect the rarest ones before the wave catches up with you! 🌊🔥

title: Idle Airport Tycoon
description: Idle Airport Tycoon is a casual simulation game that puts you in charge of building and managing your very own bustling airport. Start with a humble airstrip and turn it into a world-class travel hub—move over Atlanta airport; we're looking to be the busiest airport in the world now! Upgrade everything from planes to terminals, unlock new revenue streams, and watch your profits soar! Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the ultimate airport tycoon?

title: Dummies Football 2026
description:
Get ready for an exciting football challenge with Dummies Football 2026, where you take command of a dummy representing your favorite national team. Immerse yourself in this captivating football game as you strive to score as many goals as possible before the final whistle. Choose from 32 national teams inspired by FIFA and engage in thrilling matches that will test your skills and strategies!

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on the buttons, drag the character.
Mobile: Tap the buttons, drag your finger.

Key Features:
• Dynamic matches: Drag your football player in different directions and try to hit the ball. Both the ball and the player can soar above the field and fall from great heights, perform flips, and score goals in the most unimaginable ways!
• Wide selection of countries: Play as your favorite team, switch them after or before the championship, and engage in unique matches!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go for the football cup! Choose the country you want to play for and participate in the football championship. Progress through the stages and claim the cup!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Score more goals than your opponent within the allotted time while controlling your player.

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?
A: You can control your player's movements! Drag him in different directions and try to hit the ball to score against the opponent! You also have a wide selection of countries to play for.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The championship consists of 8 stages. You will face different countries as opponents at each stage. Win and advance to the finals!

Q: Does the difficulty change?
A: With each new stage, losing a match becomes more perilous. If you lose, you will have to start the cup battle over! So prepare for the matches and win!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?
A: Buy a freeze! A powerful bonus that gives you an advantage. You can freeze your opponent for a while. Use this to score as many goals as possible!

Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Win matches and earn coins. You can use them to unlock skins for the ball!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: All countries are available to choose from right from the start! Play as whoever you want!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not required, but it enhances your immersion in the atmosphere of the football match!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: The game is intuitive from the first minutes! Drag the character and score more goals! You'll quickly understand what to do.

Game tips
To enhance your gameplay, focus on quick movements to outwit your opponent while choosing the right timing to kick the ball. Use feints to confuse the rival dummy and create scoring opportunities. Practicing your shooting and positioning will also help you rack up those goals!


Controls
Mouse, Touch
