- "Meteor" breaks through the fruits to the bottom of glass
- "Bomb" explodes small fruits and gives X10 points
- "Grow" increases all identical fruits by one
- "Magnet" allows you to pull the interfering fruit out of the thicket
- "Microscope" temporarily reduces all fruits to micro sizes
- "Tornado" shakes the glass

Spin the wheel of fortune, get daily rewards, and buy upgrades in the store. Realistic physics, beautiful animations, and pleasant music create a cozy atmosphere. Start your adventure in the «Merge Fruit Characters - Fruit Kingdom» right now!

title: Sticker Art Book Puzzle
description:
Dive into the delightful world of Sticker Art Book Puzzle, where imagination meets puzzle-solving in a fun and engaging experience. This innovative app is the ultimate blend of adult coloring, art games, and brain-teasing challenges. This unique app offers a calming and colorful escape, combining the joy of coloring with the thrill of solving puzzles.

Say goodbye to traditional coloring books and hello to the Sticker Book Puzzle. Instead of using pencils, you'll fill intricate designs with vibrant stickers. It's a fresh take on adult coloring; every sticker is a stroke of creativity. Choose from a rich range of colors and match them with stickers to complete stunning artwork. Relax and unwind with Sticker Book Puzzle's calm gameplay.

Sticker Book Puzzle isn't just a coloring book; it's a brain teaser, too! Solve puzzles by strategically placing stickers to match the patterns and unlock the complete picture. Flex your mind and boost your IQ skills!

title: Sprunki Adventure 3
description:
🎮 Welcome to the exciting world of "Sprunki Adventure 3"! 🏞️

Embark on an exciting adventure with Sprunki! Explore colorful locations, meet unique characters, and complete fun quests. Each character can give you a special task, and completing it will earn rewards and bring you closer to uncovering the mystery.

title: Epic Empire: Tower Defense
description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic tower defense strategy game where you must defend your kingdom from waves of goblins, ogres, and epic bosses. Control three heroes simultaneously, build defensive towers, and empower them with runes and pets. Explore diverse worlds—from icy kingdoms to underground tunnels—and prove your skill in tournaments.

Well-thought-out leveling, a variety of modes, and large-scale battles make the game an excellent choice for fans of tactics, base defense, and PvE challenges.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: It is a Tower Defense game where you need to free the kingdom and level up your heroes.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, but the objective is crystal clear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers a wide variety of enemies, heroes, and related mechanics.

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?
A: Yes, bosses are much stronger than regular mobs and pose a serious challenge to the player.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game features gold for in-game sessions and rubies for character upgrades.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: To level up, you need to replay levels multiple times, increasing the difficulty and rewards. Leveling up unlocks new skills and abilities.

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Yes, there are references to fantasy worlds, a variety of enemies, and mechanics.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to come back?
A: Yes, there are not only rewards but also special challenge levels.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: The music in the game is not mandatory, but it enhances the atmosphere.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: There are at least 30 levels in the game, including daily challenges.

description:
Realistic Car Crash King is an extreme crash-test simulator where every collision, rollover, and high-speed impact turns into spectacular destruction. Choose from sports cars, SUVs, trucks, off-road vehicles, and more, then explore a variety of maps including mountain roads, mega ramps, crash-test arenas, obstacle tracks, and open-world sandbox locations. Drop cars from cliffs, crash into traffic, destroy AI vehicles, and find out how much damage each machine can survive.

With realistic physics, detachable parts, dynamic damage, and real-time metal deformation, every crash feels unique and satisfying. Create your own destruction scenarios, perform massive crash tests, and enjoy total freedom to wreck different cars across diverse maps.

title: Stealth robbery of a house together

The house is carefully guarded: guards are patrolling, and if you get in their line of sight, run! Use the abilities

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Difference
description:
Italian Brainrot: Find the Difference is a fast, funny, and bizarre puzzle game where absurdity meets sharp-eyed fun. Each of the 30 levels features two nearly identical images—but with small, sneaky changes hidden in plain sight.

Designed especially for kids, this game brings together cartoon chaos and visual brain-training in a way that’s goofy, creative, and totally unforgettable. You’re not just spotting differences—you’re diving into a wild universe full of absurd characters and hilarious scenes.

🧠 How It Works
30 handcrafted levels with detailed, funny illustrations
Each level has 5 differences to find
No timers, no pressure—perfect for kids and families
Play directly in-browser on mobile or desktop
🎭 Key Characters in the Italian Brainrot Universe
Tralalero Tralala
A three-legged shark always rocking bright Nike sneakers. Whether he's leaping through chaos or fighting with Bombardino Crocodilo, he's full of attitude and absurd energy.

Bombardino Crocodilo
A crocodile-headed creature with the body of a WWII bomber plane. He drops more confusion than bombs and makes every level feel like a fever dream.

Tung Tung
A living, walking wooden drum (inspired by Indonesian bedug) with a baseball bat. While sometimes mistaken as Italian Brainrot, he’s a crossover character who adds international flair to the madness.

Ballerina Cappuccina
A graceful dancer with a cappuccino cup for a head. She pirouettes through scenes of total nonsense, highlighting the game’s charming chaos

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Difference
description:
Italian Brainrot: Find the Difference is a fast, funny, and bizarre puzzle game where absurdity meets sharp-eyed fun. Each of the 30 levels features two nearly identical images—but with small, sneaky changes hidden in plain sight.

Designed especially for kids, this game brings together cartoon chaos and visual brain-training in a way that’s goofy, creative, and totally unforgettable. You’re not just spotting differences—you’re diving into a wild universe full of absurd characters and hilarious scenes.

🧠 How It Works
30 handcrafted levels with detailed, funny illustrations
Each level has 5 differences to find
No timers, no pressure—perfect for kids and families
Play directly in-browser on mobile or desktop

A three-legged shark always rocking bright Nike sneakers. Whether he's leaping through chaos or fighting with Bombardino Crocodilo, he's full of attitude and absurd energy.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Nuts Bolts Sort
description:
Looking for a game that is both challenging and relaxing? Look no further than "Nuts And Bolts Sort" - the ultimate brain training challenge that doubles as a stress-relieving escape.

The objective of this game is to sort bolts and nuts by type. While the gameplay mechanics are simple, the difficulty increases as you progress through the levels, and you'll need to rely on your brainpower to remember which bolts and nuts belong together.

With beautiful graphics, soothing sound effects, and ASMR elements, "Nuts And Bolts Sort" will keep you engaged and relaxed for hours. And if you're looking for a way to unwind after a stressful day, this game is the perfect way to do it.

title: Squad Assembler: Merge
description:
Assemble a cool squad and see who wins! Combine items to improve the fighters' equipment! Combine weapons and armor, buy loot boxes with new weapons! You can create cool, unique characters, each of which will have certain skills! Buy parts for your fighters, change their arms, torso, head! Create real cyborgs to defeat the enemy! Merge armor and weapons, increase the levels and characteristics of items. Hire cool heroes who will help you in tough battles. Defeat powerful bosses, look for treasure chests, capture enemy outposts!
Game features: 
- Unique gameplay that combines merge, strategy, fighting and sandbox! 
- Combine items, weapons and armor 
- Multifunctional character editor, you can assemble a unique character that will only be in your squad! 
- A variety of different weapons, from bats and knives to grenade launchers, flamethrowers and plasma guns! Collect your fighters and win!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Idle merge game where you need to create a squad from different components and progress through levels to defeat enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, but the objective is clear: gather a squad and defeat enemies.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?
A: An interesting mechanic of collecting and upgrading the squad in parts.

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?
A: Yes, bosses are very tough, requiring a strong squad to defeat. Players also have heroes at their disposal.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on chests from which parts for squad members are obtained.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: Open chests, get squad member parts, combine them, and level up the squad.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does donating speed up game progress?
A: Yes, they allow speeding up squad gathering and significantly strengthening it.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are references to action franchises (the very first hero is Shredder from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles).

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, the entire game is built around squad customization.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?
A: No.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: Yes, but it's not mandatory.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: Mini-game based on merging and squad collection.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (skip if unclear)
A: Yes, it is indicated in the UI.

Q: Are there achievement systems? What are they, and what can you get them for?
A: No.

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Aliens Hunter
description: You are an alien hunter and your mission is to use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards. Each round has different aliens hiding in different locations. You have to accurately choose, aim and shoot to complete the level mission.

title: Marble Color Sort
description:
Get ready for the most satisfying color sorting puzzle! 🌟

Welcome to Marble Color Sort, a vibrant, 3D brain teaser where physics meets fast-paced puzzle logic! Your mission is simple but challenging: sort every colorful marble from the top trays into their matching boxes at the bottom.

title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
description: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is an Android game developed by Bravestars Games. This free game allows users to create stunning photos and fabulous videos featuring their own personalized dolls.

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home!
This colorful parking puzzle will give you an exciting adventure and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of spaces, so plan your moves in advance to unravel this chaotic traffic jam!

Game features:
🚌 Simple gameplay: Move buses and cars, sort them by color and free up the parking lot.
🎮 Challenging puzzles: Levels of varying difficulty are suitable for all ages and experience levels.
🎨 Bright design: Colorful levels will help you relax and enjoy the process.

title: King Dungeon
description:
Dive into the dungeon, extract resources and build a mine. Fight against dwarves and orcs in the war for power.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: The goal is to find and rescue our queen. To do this, players need to explore, craft, mine, build, and survive in the dungeon.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Yes, at the very beginning of the game, the cave collapses on the king, and he must find the queen.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: Variety of crafting, survival and defense, mine construction, resource gathering, atmospheric locations.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: Explore more areas in the dungeon, craft more advanced tools to speed up resource gathering. Watching ads can also provide additional resources.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game has coins as currency. They are spent on crafting special resources or items for progression.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does making a donation speed up game progress?
A: There is a purchase in the game to disable ads.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Music complements the game well, but it is not necessary for progression.

title: Obby: Defend your base from 67
description:
Obby: Defend your base from 67 is a fast-paced survival and base defense game with zombie waves, auto shooting, weapons, skins, towers, soldiers, chests and farming. Build your defense, open loot chests, upgrade your base and survive against the meme enemy 67 / six seven!

Your base is under attack. Zombies are coming wave after wave, and the danger keeps growing. Use auto shooting, collect resources, unlock powerful weapons, hire soldiers, upgrade towers and protect your base as long as you can.

🧟 ZOMBIE WAVES AND BASE DEFENSE

Fight against waves of zombies and stop them before they destroy your base. Each wave becomes harder, so you need stronger weapons, better towers and more soldiers to survive.

🔫 MANY WEAPONS

Unlock different weapons and improve your firepower. Find rare guns, upgrade your attack and destroy zombie crowds faster. The stronger your weapon, the better your chances against 67.

🎁 CHESTS AND RANDOM LOOT

Open chests and get random rewards. You can find weapons, rare items and useful upgrades. Collect powerful loot and become stronger after every run.

🛡️ SOLDIERS, TOWERS AND UPGRADES

Hire soldiers, upgrade towers and create a strong defense line. Combine weapons, helpers and base upgrades to survive bigger zombie waves.

🌾 FARM AND RESOURCES

Hire farmers, collect crops and earn extra resources. Use your farm to grow faster, buy upgrades and prepare your base for the next attack.

👕 SKINS AND CUSTOMIZATION

Unlock skins and customize your hero. Collect rare looks, upgrade your style and stand out in the Obby world.

⚡ GAME FEATURES
Obby-style base defense adventure
Zombie waves and survival gameplay
Meme enemy 67 / six seven
Auto shooting action
Many weapons to unlock
Loot chests with random rewards
Soldiers, towers and base upgrades
Farmers, crops and resources
Skins and customization
Simple controls and fast gameplay sessions
Action, adventure and survival in one game

Can you defend your base, survive all zombie waves and stop 67?
Play Obby: Defend your base from 67 now and become the ultimate base defender!

title: Wild Hunting Clash
description: Challenge yourself and hunt beautiful animals in stunningly luscious woods. The calming sounds of the forest and lovely graphics will capture your heart. Feel like a true hunter in the unconquered wilderness!

title: Bad Cat Prankster - Mom's Return
description:
Play as the naughtiest cat in town in Bad Cat Prankster - Mom's Return! Step into the paws of a mischievous feline and turn an ordinary house into your personal playground. Scratch furniture, knock objects off shelves, climb onto rooftops, and create hilarious chaos before Mom catches you.
Explore every corner of the house, complete funny prank missions, and use your cat instincts to outsmart humans. But be careful Mom is always watching, and you'll need to stay sneaky to avoid getting caught. Hide, escape, and continue your playful adventures while causing maximum mischief.
From making a mess in the living room to performing tricky stunts around the house, every level offers new challenges and exciting opportunities for feline fun. Can you become the ultimate prankster cat and survive Mom's return?

Features
-Play as a mischievous and playful cat.
-Perform hilarious pranks and create chaos around the house.
-Scratch furniture, knock down objects, and explore freely.
-Complete fun and challenging prank missions.
-Hide and escape before Mom catches you.
-Explore detailed home environments filled with interactive objects.
-Smooth controls and entertaining gameplay.
-Enjoy funny animations and immersive sound effects.

Get ready for endless laughter and adventures in Bad Cat Prankster - Mom's Return!

title: Find The Pets
description:
Find The Pets is an exciting 3D adventure game where your mission is to track down 150 adorable, hilarious, and sometimes elusive pets hiding across imaginative maps. From meme-famous cats like Floppa to other quirky and delightful creatures, every discovery adds fun and charm to your journey. Explore diverse worlds, overcome tricky obstacles, and make the most of powerful boosts to complete your collection. Are you ready for the ultimate pet-finding challenge?
Features
150 unique pets to discover, including popular meme animals and whimsical creatures
6 distinct maps set in different themed worlds, each offering unique designs and challenges
Special boosts such as fast running, super jump, and radar to help you locate pets more efficiently
Engaging Obby gameplay with tricky routes and hidden secrets to uncover
Beautiful 3D graphics that bring each map and character to life
Exciting achievements and tasks to complete as you progress


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a 3D platformer where you need to search for and collect pets.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: A variety of pets and interesting locations.

Q: What are some engaging elements of the content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A variety of interesting and diverse locations and pets, sounds from Roblox.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Yes, the music is pleasant but it does not affect anything other than the player's mood.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: 8 large biomes.

Q: Are there achievement systems? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: For discovering new pets.

title: Sprunki Craft - Sandbox 3D
description:
🌟 Discover the World of Sprunki! 🌟

Dive into a unique adventure game where you can create and fight! Build your own world from blocks, creating amazing landscapes and exciting locations.

🛡️ Fight with other Sprunki! Develop your skills and enhance your character's abilities to win intense battles. Each Sprunki is unique, and only you decide how to upgrade and develop them.

🆕 Don't miss the opportunity to open and buy new Sprunki, each of which has its own features and unique abilities. Create a team that will lead you to victory!

🏆 Become a leader! Compete with players from all over the world and climb the leaderboard, proving that you are the best in this amazing world of Sprunki!

Join us and become the Master of Sprunki! We are waiting for you in the game! 🎮

title: Escape Strange Girl’s House 2
description:
You play as a private detective searching for a missing person who disappeared a month ago. The investigation leads you to an isolated house that hides a dark and twisted secret. Inside lives a strange girl — and the things she does are beyond imagination.

Explore every room, collect items, combine them, and use them in the right places to progress. Each clue brings you closer to uncovering the truth about the missing person and the terrifying story behind this house.

This is a classic first-person point and click adventure with atmospheric music, logical puzzles, and a dark, mysterious story. Every sound and every object matters. Will you uncover the secret and escape before it’s too late?

title: War Groups
description:
In War Groups, you will find yourself in the epic world of the Zone, where your goal is to capture all sectors and destroy enemies. Choose your group, be it stalkers, bandits, military or sectarians, and collect artifacts to strengthen your army. Trade equipment, form alliances and start wars to achieve power in the Zone. Improve your strategy to win!

Explore the huge Zone, consisting of more than 15 sectors full of anomalies, mutants and enemies. Capture territories, destroy competitors and become the master of the Zone. Form alliances, start wars and collect artifacts to achieve your goal.

Features of the game:

- More than 10 unique groups to choose from.
- Capture the entire Zone and destroy enemies.
- A huge map of 15+ sectors filled with anomalies and mutants.
- Trade equipment and artifacts.
- Wars and alliances with other players to achieve the goal.

title: Merge Combo
description: Merge Combo is a captivating puzzle game that allows you to merge similar blocks for points and combos. Playable online for free, it offers a mix of relaxation and challenge as you stack cubes to achieve higher scores, appealing to logic puzzle enthusiasts across all devices.

title: Dinosaur Shifting Run
description:
Imagine sprinting across a scorching desert as a human adventurer, then transforming into a mighty dinosaur to smash through obstacles in a lush jungle! Unlike other runner games, Dinosaur Shifting Run offers unique challenges in every level, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

Dinosaur Shifting Run is packed with features that guarantee an epic adventure!
- Easy Gameplay: Master the art of Dinosaur Shifting Run with simple taps and laughs all the way to the finish line!
- Dinosaurs Galore: Have a variety of amazing dinos, each with awesome abilities, to keep the fun fresh!
- Ever-changing Levels: Conquer tons of thrilling levels with unique challenges – you'll never get bored!
- Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in vibrant environments brought to life with eye-catching graphics – prepare to be wowed!

title: Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!
description:
«Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!» is a casual puzzle game with physics and action destruction, where the challenge is to break a ragdoll stickman and plunge into a ragdoll simulator!

Dive into a world of chaotic destruction and fun with the game «Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!». Throw your stickman and smash it to pieces. The game in the best traditions of Ragdoll physics will give you hours of fun, where every hit and every fall turns into a show of destruction! Ready to cope with the challenges?

Complete all the tests, smash and break!

title: The MachinEGG
description:
Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing idle clicker game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Grow your farm, automate production, and see if you can earn enough to retire.

Buy chickens, feed them, collect their eggs, and take them to market. As your farm grows, unlock automation systems to streamline every step of the process and maximize your profits.

There's a normal mode and a speedrun mode to help you reach the top. Two replayable handicap challenges will change everything, and finally, there's an endless mode if you're still craving more chickens.

And please… treat the chickens well.

title: Bingo Mania
description:
A casual bingo progression game. Complete Kitchen Quest levels to gather ingredients, cook recipes from cupcakes to a grand feast, and unlock Bingo Battles at level 25 where you can play against other players in the game!

In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — numbers are called, you daub matching cells, and complete patterns (lines, corners, themed shapes) to win. Every victory earns ingredients and recipe progress through stages: gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve.

Cook your way through five kitchen tiers: cupcake, pizza, burger, cake, and a grand feast. Serve your first dish in just 5 levels, then tackle longer recipes as difficulty ramps up with more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles.

At level 25, unlock Bingo Battles — timed head-to-head duels against rival chefs. Outscore them before time runs out in ranked Trophy Duels or casual practice matches. There’s also a Chef Battles ladder gauntlet, daily tasks, leagues, and seasonal rewards.

Portrait-first mobile design makes it easy to play on the go.

title: Master of 3 Tiles
description: Master of 3 Tiles is a thrilling online puzzle game. Match identical tiles in sets of three to clear the board. Each level increases in difficulty, enhancing your strategic skills. No downloads or registration needed, it’s accessible on desktop and mobile for short or long gaming sessions.

title: Dinosaur Park Jurassic Dino World
description: Welcome to the dino world, where you play as a wild dinosaur and survive in the jungle while playing Dinosaur Simulator Jurassic game. You have to hunt, collect food, and use your survival skills dinosaur game. Fight with giant dinosaurs and wild carnivorous on a mysterious island by playing the wild dinos simulator. Raise your crazy dino family in dinosaur world and hunt wild animals like wild crocodiles, furious lions, and giant elephants in wild dinosaur simulator games.

title: Heroes of the Dungeons: Match-3 RPG
description:
Collect legendary heroes, defeat invading monsters, and rebuild a fallen kingdom — one match at a time!
A mysterious gate has unleashed evil creatures across the land, cutting the realm off from the outside world. As the Master of Hunters, you’re the last hope. Match gems to unleash powerful attacks, trigger epic combos, and use hero skills at the perfect moment. Loot treasures from battles, upgrade shops in your castle, and bring prosperity back to the kingdom!
Core: A unique match-3 RPG experience where players strategically match colored gems to trigger distinct in-game actions, such as performing an attack on an enemy or healing the party.
Loop: Player progression centers around extensive character development. Players must clear stages, defeat powerful bosses, and unlock chests to earn tokens, which are then used to upgrade character attributes like maximum health, attack power, and healing efficiency.
Start: The game features a streamlined onboarding tutorial, ensuring high accessibility and a low barrier to entry, providing players with an immediately engaging and enjoyable experience from the outset.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a high-quality Stylized / Cartoon art direction.
Key Feature: A narrative-driven experience offering deep complexity, a rich cast of characters, and highly varied gameplay mechanics, focusing on the core gem-matching combat system where different colored gems trigger diverse tactical outcomes like attacks, ensuring deep replayability.

title: 2048 Merge Blocks
description:
Merge Puzzle - 2048 Blocks

Dive into the ultimate number merge puzzle game! Merge Puzzle combines the addictive gameplay of 2048 with innovative tap-to-merge mechanics for a fresh brain-teasing experience.

Connect and merge matching number tiles to create higher values. The more tiles you connect, the bigger your score! Start with simple 2s and 4s, then work your way up to massive numbers like 2048, 8192, and beyond.

KEY FEATURES:

Addictive Merge Gameplay
Tap matching tiles to merge them into higher numbers. Connect tiles horizontally, vertically, and diagonally for maximum combinations. Create chain reactions and watch your score skyrocket!

40+ Challenging Levels
Progress through four unique collections - Beginner, Intermediate, Expert, and Master. Each collection offers 10 handcrafted puzzles with increasing difficulty. Can you complete them all?

Daily Challenges
Test your skills with a new puzzle every day! Compete against players worldwide on the daily leaderboard and prove you're the best puzzle solver.

Endless Mode
Play without limits in endless mode. How high can you score? Challenge yourself to reach new milestones and unlock achievements.

Power-Ups & Boosters
Use strategic power-ups to overcome tough situations:
- Undo: Take back your last move
- Hammer: Remove any tile from the board
- Shuffle: Rearrange all tiles for new opportunities

Global Leaderboards
Compete with players around the world. Climb the rankings and become the ultimate merge puzzle champion!

Quest System
Complete daily and lifetime quests to earn coins and unlock rewards. Track your progress and achievements as you master the game.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE MERGE PUZZLE:

- Easy to learn, challenging to master
- No time pressure - play at your own pace
- Beautiful graphics and smooth animations
- Relaxing yet engaging gameplay
- Works offline - play anywhere, anytime
- Regular updates with new content

Perfect for puzzle lovers, number game enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys brain training games. Whether you have a few minutes or a few hours, Merge Puzzle delivers satisfying gameplay every session.

title: Miner, Dig It All
description:
Your drill has one tank of fuel. See how deep the pit lets you get!

Drag to lay a line of dynamite, fire it, then hold the drill to grind the shattered rock away. Clear the layer and it collapses under you, straight into a richer one. On the surface, sell the ore and buy a harder bit, wider blasts and a robot crew, then dive again. Ten layers down sits the lava core: crack it and the whole pit starts over, permanently richer!

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description:
GT Cars Mega Ramps is an exciting driving car game that puts you behind the wheel of fully customizable super-sport cars, featuring heart-stopping mega ramps, vibrant giant bosses, and intense head-to-head races. Experience a one-of-a-kind adventure as you launch yourself off towering ramps, execute daring stunts, and outmaneuver colossal bosses in electrifying showdowns. With stylized cars and thrilling gameplay, you’ll race to conquer the ultimate title of driver extraordinaire.

How to Play GT Cars Mega Ramps
GT Cars Mega Ramps offers three exhilarating game modes: Face to Face, Mega Ramps, and Color Lands. Choose between single-player and two-player options, allowing for competitive racing fun with customizable exotic super-sport cars that you can tweak to your liking. Adjust the color panel, window tint, wheel designs, and light colors to make your vehicle truly unique.

In Face to Face mode, you and your opponent race side by side, but don’t let the simplicity fool you. This isn’t just a regular race; if one car crashes, the debris can take you down at full speed, resulting in an instant game over. Stay alert and swerve wisely, or you risk tumbling off the cliff's edge!

Color Lands presents a vibrant challenge as you navigate through roads resembling colorful Lego blocks. Obstacles lurk at every turn, and if you’re not careful, slowing down could send you spiraling into an abyss.

Mega Ramps is the ultimate test of your driving skills, packed with high-speed thrills and perilous obstacles. Dodge enormous rolling balls threatening to crush you and navigate walls made of crates and geometric shapes flying at you from all directions. It’s a wild ride that requires quick reflexes and sharp focus—so buckle up and prepare for an unforgettable experience!

title: Spider Evolution
description: Spider Evolution is a thrilling arcade game that lets you evolve from a tiny spider into a powerful creature. Engage in exciting gameplay as you outwit opponents and enhance your skills. Enjoy this free online experience without downloads, and take control of the spider realm from your computer.

title: Jump And Run For Brainrot
description:
Run and Jump for Brainrot is a fast-paced game where your goal is to collect Brainrot memes and grow stronger.

Jump across platforms to gather Brainrot, bring it back to your base, and power up. Level up to jump higher and reach even more challenging areas.

title: Flag Coloring Puzzle
description: A fun and educational flag coloring puzzle game. Test your memory and geography knowledge to correctly color hundreds of national flags in a clean, vibrant cartoon-style interface.

title: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island
description: Dive into the exciting adventure of Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island, where pirates and treasures await. Help a brave heroine uncover her father''s hidden fortune while outsmarting relentless foes, all set against stunning visuals and captivating animations.

title: BMG Crash Test
description:
BMG Crash Test🚗🚧

This is a realistic simulator where you can test various cars - from standard sedans to modern sports cars - on extreme tracks with dangerous hammers, springboards and other obstacles💥🚧.

Test her cars for strength using rotating hammers, powerful presses and crazy jumps! Participate in crash tests and set new records! Choose your favorite cars and enjoy destroying them!

title: Paper Princess - Doll Dress Up
description:
🎉 Welcome to Princess Dream Castle. Create enchanting looks & live a fantasy princess life in Paper Princess - Doll Dress Up. Mix outfits, accessories, and crowns to style your royal character for a magical adventure. Immerse yourself in a fairy tales world where you can enjoy interactive activities with a dose of fun!

Paper Princess - Doll Dress Up Feature:
✨ Various fabulous outfits and items to blow your mind
✨ Prepare the princess for various occasions
✨ Stunning scenes and engage in interactive activities
✨ Choose from elegant gowns to sparkling accessories
✨ Customize your princess's appearance
✨ Play with friends on the same device

Let’s craft regal outfits, adapt styles, and make your princess the epitome of elegance and charm. Paper Princess - Doll Dress Up provides a fun and relaxing way to spend time, offering an enjoyable escape from daily routines.
Core: A character creation and dress-up simulator that offers deep creative expression within the Dollhouse genre.
Loop: Players engage in a core customization loop, managing and dressing their doll characters using an extensive inventory of apparel and hairstyles, with no external progression system needed.
Start: Highly accessible with intuitive controls, the core loop is immediately engaging, focused on the satisfying process of styling and customization.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a bright, inviting aesthetic utilizing Stylized/Cartoon visuals and a clean Flat Design approach.
Key Feature: Offers exceptional creative freedom via a massive catalog of outfits and an interactive dollhouse sandbox where players can pose characters and manipulate objects (e.g., tucking dolls into bed).

title: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway
description: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway is a stealth-based adventure where you help a determined kid outsmart strict parents and break free from his locked home. Navigate shadowy halls, avoid detection, and use clever tricks to carry out your great escape. You’ve made a promise—now it’s up to you to keep it and reach your friends outside.FeaturesStealth mode: Hide, sneak, and avoid meeting your parents.Horror atmosphere: Beware of every unexpected sound, creak and rustle, peer into the dark corridors of the old house.Interactive house: Explore every corner of the house, and become a real detective.Realistic sounds: Listen to footsteps and rustles to predict the movements of parents.

title: Draw Bridge - Brain Game
description:
Draw Bridge - Brain Game is an exciting and challenging brain game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car!
Core: A highly engaging physics-based puzzle runner where players must dynamically construct bridges to guide their vehicle across challenging environments.
Loop: Player progression is centered on horizontal customization. Successfully clearing unique levels rewards players with soft currency, which can be spent on acquiring new vehicle cosmetics, skins, and dynamic exhaust animations. There is no vertical stat progression, emphasizing skill-based puzzle-solving and aesthetic collection.

title: Fortress Clash
description:
Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload.

Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save.

Changes:
- storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string).
- The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup.
- Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level.
- Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost.

Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.

It is EASY! But getting Harder!

Goods Sort 3D: Matching Game offers a free sorting challenge with diverse items and intuitive gameplay. You have ample time to complete each level.

Ideal for those who love organizing and relaxing, our free game provides hours of fun. Whether you're into fill the fridge 3D, triple match 3D puzzle games, or free games for adults, etc., Get Sorted Now with thousands of happy players!

In this triple match 3D game, Goods Sort 3D combines goods sorting, closet sorting, stuff sorting, and 3D match games into an addictive and fun experience.

If you've played A Little to the Left or Fill the Fridge 3D, you'll enjoy this sorting game. Become an organization master by sorting snacks, beverages, and fruits in free matching games. Enjoy the fun of matching pairs and supermarket games while unlocking items with cuter designs and better colours. Dive into Goods Match 3D and sort puzzles in this exciting free match-3 game!

title: My resale. Cases and sales
description:
Think getting rich on reselling is easy? Think getting rich on reselling is easy? Then welcome to "My Resale. Cases and sales" — a simulator where you can turn dollars into a fortune 🤑

Open cases and catch your luck: anything can drop — from a ballpoint pen to a cool cars. Put your loot up for sale, haggle with buyers, and learn to sense prices. The buyers here are all different: chatterboxes, the impatient, thrifty tricksters, and even trolls who are a pleasure to teach a lesson.

Short on cash? Go "to work" — click the computer and level up your income. Claim daily gifts and build a collection of a hundred items!

Climb the leaderboards among collectors, tycoons, and top sellers. Can you become the king of resale? Let's find out!

title: Word Search: Offline Puzzle
description:
Swipe across the letters to find hidden words in the grid — a cozy word search and word puzzle you can play offline, with no internet.

As you clear levels you climb an evolution ladder: atom, molecule, cell, fish, dinosaur, human… all the way to mind.

How to play: a grid of letters and a list of words. Drag your finger to spell each word. In this word find the letters can bend around corners, not just run in straight lines, so it's a fresh twist on the classic word search.

Features:
• Hundreds of hand-crafted levels, from easy to hard
• Fully offline — no wifi, no internet needed
• Big, clear letters and a calm pace — great for adults and kids
• Hints when a word just won't appear
• No timer, no stress — play at your own pace

If you love word games, crosswords, word find and brain teasers, this is a perfect daily brain training: it sharpens focus and grows your vocabulary while you relax on the couch, on the bus or in a waiting room.

Enjoy the game!

title: Primal Druid - Kingdom of Animals
description:
As a Primal Druid, your mission is to capture, train, and command an army of creatures — from fierce battle cats and hybrid monsters to legendary mythical dragons. Strengthen your squad, complete thrilling quests, and survive in a dangerous open world filled with challenges.
 
Gameplay Highlights: 
• Tame Creatures: Battle wild animals and beasts to turn them into loyal minions. Summon powerful allies like an alpha wolf or build an unstoppable army of pocket-sized critters.
• Level Up Your Squad: Collect rare materials and craft powerful artifacts to upgrade your creatures’ abilities and dominate the battlefield.
• Explore & Survive: Forage for resources, face aquatic monsters, and uncover hidden secrets in the untamed wilderness.
• Quests & Challenges: Complete exciting missions, unlock rewards, and test your skills against the dangers of the wild.

title: Block Blast
description: Dive into this popular and free puzzle game designed to stretch your brain and entertain you during your free time. Your mission is simple yet thrilling: match and remove as many blocks as possible from the board.

title: Block Blast
description: Dive into this popular and free puzzle game designed to stretch your brain and entertain you during your free time. Your mission is simple yet thrilling: match and remove as many blocks as possible from the board.

title: Cook Soups: 3 in a Bowl
description:
✨ What awaits you:
🥘 125 real recipes — borscht, shchi, fish soup, solyanka, kharcho, tom yum and dozens of other soups from around the world. All recipes are real!
📖 Discover new dishes — complete levels and fill up your recipe book. How many soups can you cook?
🏆 Compete with others — climb the leaderboard by the number of soups cooked and become the best chef!
👨‍🍳 Change your look — choose avatars, backgrounds and beautiful pots to your taste.
No rush, no stress — just the warm atmosphere of a home kitchen. Brew some tea, relax and cook the perfect soup!

title: Scary Rooms: Idle Horror
description:
Horror Room: Scary Hotel Tycoon" is a simulator of the owner of a theme park, where visitors come to experience thrills. The player will have to develop his establishment, improving the rooms of fear, buying new decorations and equipment, as well as hiring actors and staff. The goal of the game is to scare as many visitors as possible and make their stay in the park unforgettable.

Scare all your customers!
Buy new creepy rooms!
Monitor the condition of the rooms, clean, repair the equipment.
Buy cool decorations in the Horror style!
Hire scary actors, choose the most popular and famous Horror characters.
Come up with new ways to scare customers.
Track reviews of your establishment!

Earn even more money for the ability to scare! Become the coolest owner of the Horror Room!

FEATURES:
• Interesting scenarios of panic rooms!
• A large variety of actors!
• The ability to decorate the establishment!
• Opportunity to clean, repair, rescue frightened clients!

title: School Of Basketball
description: It is the basketball arcade game in which you must try to score baskets in all the different game modes available. A basketball school opens its doors for enthusiasts like you. Do you know where to aim the ball so that you always hit the basket? Do you know any secret strategies? You have a limited number of balls and every time you miss, you also miss one ball. However, if you never miss, on the contrary, sometimes the ball will be added. How many points will you score?

title: Animals vs Zombies
description:
Your beloved animals have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to rescue them and teach those alien bullies a lesson. Tame and befriend a wide variety of creatures, evolve them to defeat stronger enemies, and unlock rare resources to help your companions grow even more powerful. From familiar cats and dogs to unique representatives of wild fauna, every animal brings something special to your adventure. Build your ultimate team and discover just how incredible your animal allies can become!
Explore new territories—from sunny beaches and peaceful parks to bustling city squares and mysterious forests—each filled with new creatures waiting to be saved.

Game features:

Animal evolution! Your companions can transform into powerful and unique defenders, each with their own abilities.
A huge variety of animals! Befriend everything from common cats and dogs to rare and exotic wildlife.
Engaging story and quests! Uncover the mystery of the island and complete exciting challenges.
Countless alien enemies! Encounter a wide range of funny and dangerous opponents.
Epic Alien Bosses! Face powerful bosses—you’re not alone in this world!
A vast game world! Explore diverse locations full of secrets and new animals to discover.

title: Flippee Ball
description:
A HYBRID ARCADE GAME OF PINBALL & BASKETBALL

-Flip the flippers and try to hit the ball into the basket.  
-Play against the CPU or another player on the same device.  
-Perfect your technique in the Academy - 100 increasingly challenging "assists" for you to try to score from.

title: Hotel Manager Simulator
description: Take a small new hotel under your care. Serve your guests, give them food and shelter, and get likes in return. Grow you business and become the owner of the biggest hotel in the world!

title: Robby Mini Games
description:
In this game you can spend time in different fun modes. We have a cool lobby where you can play soccer, go through a light round and have fun on the swing.

There are more than 20 different mini-games in the game, in which you have to play with rivals or by yourself.

Earn coins, collect game gifts and buy accessories for your character.

title: Escape Tsunami Save Brainrot
description: An incredible threat is looming over the city — a giant wave created by alien technologies is rapidly approaching! Only you can save the unique Brainroth creatures before they are overwhelmed by an alien tsunami. Grab them, rush away from the impending disaster and manage to deliver them to a safe zone. Upgrade your mobility — increase your speed, agility and endurance to get further away from the wave and save more creatures. 🧠 Search and collect — from the most common to the legendary brainrots, each of which has unique features and value. 🏠 Create a rescue base — take brainrots to the shelter, replenish the collection, unlock new abilities and upgrade the shelter. Become a master of escape — use strategy, quick reactions and ingenuity to outrun the alien threat. Can you outrun the UFO tsunami, save all the brainrots and become the legend of the base? Run, collect and survive — the challenge has already begun! 🛸🔥

title: Wiggle Escape: Snake Puzzle
description:
Wiggle Escape: Snake Puzzle is a smart snake puzzle game. Tap snakes in order, untangle shapes, solve hundreds of levels, or create your own in sandbox mode.
Wiggle Escape: Snake Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic game where you untangle tangled snakes shaped like fun emoji figures. At the start of each level, snakes form a complex structure, and your goal is to tap them in the correct order to slowly free and untangle the entire shape.

The rules are simple, but the puzzles require careful thinking, attention, and planning. Only snakes that are not blocked can move, so every tap matters. As you progress, levels become more complex with longer snakes, tighter knots, and trickier formations. The main game mode offers a huge number of handcrafted levels designed to challenge both casual players and puzzle fans.

A standout feature is the sandbox mode. Here you can freely choose shapes, experiment with mechanics, or even draw and design your own levels from scratch. Test your ideas, create unique puzzles, and enjoy endless replayability.

title: Space Rovers
description: Strap in and get ready to conquer the Red Planet in Space Rovers — a physics-based rover builder and cargo delivery game where your engineering skills are the key to survival. Design unique vehicles, transport goods across unforgiving Martian landscapes, and experience the thrill of interplanetary logistics like never before.

title: Ludo Legend
description: Play a game of Ludo! Everyones favourite board game! Play alone or with your friends on one device! Just pass it on! Colorful design and easy mechanics will keep you playing for hours!

title: My Bakery
description:
Build your confectionery empire in Family Bakery. Bake delicious treats, serve guests, and decorate your café in this cozy simulator designed for everyone.
Have you ever dreamed of running your own café? This bakery game gives you the opportunity. Your task is to bake pastries and satisfy customers to grow your business.
Why You Should Play
Simple and Engaging Mechanics: Customers arrive, you bake pastries, and serve them quickly.
Pleasant Atmosphere: A vibrant and warm design creates a relaxing mood.
Constant Progression: Unlock new recipes and expand your dining area.
Perfect for Relaxation: Easy-to-learn gameplay makes it a great game to unwind and relieve stress.

title: Underwater Survival: Deep Dive
description:
In this immersive underwater survival simulator, you find themselves stranded on an alien ocean planet, faced with the daunting task of escaping its treacherous depths. If you like Subnautica, you will like this game too. As they embark on this gripping adventure game, they must don their scuba gear, hone their fishing skills, and gather vital resources to evade the lurking underwater monsters and secure their passage to freedom. With each encounter, you must strategize, adapt, and overcome the challenges presented by this unforgiving aquatic world in order to emerge victorious and ultimately conquer the game.

Explore the ocean-covered underwater world, but keep an eye on your oxygen levels and beware of threats lurking in the darkness. As you delve deeper into the depths of this enigmatic ocean planet, your survival skills will be put to the ultimate test. Armed with your trusty scuba gear, you must navigate through the underwater labyrinth, gather resources, and outmaneuver the lurking monsters to secure your chance of escape

title: Frost Land - Snow Survival
description: Frost Land - Snow Survival is a strategic base-building game where you battle the harsh cold to stay alive. You’ll wield a flamethrower to melt snow, uncover hidden resources, and expand your shelter. Every choice matters—manage supplies wisely and decide which frozen zones to explore as you carve out survival in a relentless winter.In the strategic realm of a winter survival game, a devastating catastrophe has plunged the world into an endless winter. Embodying the last surviving hero, you venture forth, armed with a formidable flamethrower. Battle against relentless winter weather, confront fearsome beasts, and forge alliances with fellow survivors you rescue.With immersive exploration, strategic resource management, and a thrilling quest for survival, Frost Land – Snow Survival offers an addictive and adrenaline-pumping gameplay experience that will keep you hooked in the snow game for hours on end.Features🗺️ Epic Exploration: Brace yourself for an immersive winter survival journey through a visually stunning snowy world, where uncovering hidden resources with your badass flamethrower will keep you on the edge of your seat.⚔️ Strategy Resource Mastery: It's all about strategic thinking and resource management in a base-building game. Carefully decide when and where to melt that icy snow to unveil precious resources. It ensures your winter survival and dominance in this unforgiving realm.🏰 Base-Building Awesomeness: Customize and upgrade your base. Show off your creativity and build a base that strikes fear into the hearts of your rivals.❄️ Weather Challenges and Beast Battles: Brace yourself for intense weather conditions like blizzards and freezing winds that will test your winter survival skills.🎯 Quests and Triumphs: Embark on thrilling quests and conquer objectives that shower you with epic rewards and unlock new adventures. Prove yourself as a true hero of the winter survival game and make your mark in this frozen game.

title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
description:
🎀 Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

👗 Endless Outfit Choices

Explore a wardrobe full of stunning clothes and accessories tailored to each event. Whether it’s a spooky Halloween costume or a dazzling Christmas outfit, you’ll find the perfect look for Anna.

✨ Fairy Tale Vibes

With its adorable art style and enchanting themes, this game makes every moment feel like you’re styling a fairy princess. Every outfit you create adds a touch of magic to Anna’s story.

title: Ladder to Brainhot: Climb Obby
description:
"Ladder to Brainhot: Climb Obby" — a fun game about Brainhots!  

🐢 What are Brainhots? 
They're tiny, adorable, and incredibly fun creatures just waiting for you to climb to the top and... snatch them!  
A variety of different obby locations, each with its own unique boss! 
A huge collection of Brainhots — every single one can be stolen! Your very own base where you can upgrade and sell Brainhots!  

🎁 Daily Motivation: 
Log in every day to receive generous gifts! 
Daily bonuses will help you upgrade your base faster and boost your speed for even bolder Brainhot raids.  

Why should you play this obby?
Addictive gameplay where quick thinking and cunning go hand in hand. 
An enormous collection of Brainhots to steal. 
Economy and progression — a deep meta-game beyond the obby. 

Ready to test your climbing skills and become the greatest Brainhot thief? Jump into the game right now and start your climb!

title: Swing Obby for Brainrots
description: Swing Obby for Brainrots  in this game, you need to ride and enhance your Obby to rescue the Brainrots. Join in and start playing!

title: Dunkin Beanz

🎮 Get ready to Dunk, Upgrade, and Unbox your way to victory! 🏀🔥

title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
description: Dive into the thrilling realm of Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll, where strategy and chaos collide. Use various powerful bazookas to defeat enemies and destroy bases. Make smart choices in ammo to enjoy the chaos and lead Stick Boy to victory, available for free online on phones and computers.

title: Merge Home Ball 2048
description:
Drop, merge, and decorate in Merge Home Ball 3D — a satisfying 3D puzzle adventure that combines classic 2048 ball merging with cozy home renovation gameplay!

Shoot colorful numbered balls into the board, merge matching balls to create bigger numbers, trigger huge combos, and earn stars to unlock beautiful furniture and stylish decorations. Transform old dusty rooms into dream homes while mastering addictive physics-based merging mechanics.

Plan your shots carefully, chain massive merges, and enjoy smooth 3D visuals, relaxing gameplay, and rewarding home makeover progression. Every successful combo helps you renovate new areas and design the perfect home!

Features
Addictive 2048-style 3D ball merging
Physics-based puzzle gameplay
Home renovation and decoration system
Beautiful room transformation progression
Satisfying combo and chain reactions
Relaxing casual gameplay
Colorful 3D graphics and smooth animations
Easy to learn, hard to master

Can you build the ultimate dream house through merging skills?

title: Frogtastic Marble Adventure
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Frogtastic Marble Adventure, a free online puzzle game that tests your strategy and quick thinking. Stop colorful marbles from progressing along their paths by matching and clearing them. Play on any device for countless hours of fun!

title: Plants vs Brainrots 2D
description:
🌱 Plants vs Brainrots 2D is a fast-paced action game inspired by the classic “Plants vs Zombies”, but with a completely different and chaotic twist.

Brainrots appear in waves and fly across the screen. They don’t attack plants directly - their main threat is their huge amount of health. Your goal is to place plants wisely, upgrade them, and deal maximum damage to take down the toughest enemies.

🧠 The game features common, rare, and legendary Brainrots.
🎯 Your main objective is to defeat 3 legendary Brainrots with massive health pools.
🌿 Plants attack automatically, each with unique damage types and characteristics.
⚡ Simple controls, colorful visuals, and dynamic gameplay make the game perfect for both short and long sessions.

💻 Playable on PC, with smooth controls and optimized performance.

🔥 Plants vs Brainrots 2D combines strategy, action, and meme-style chaos. Jump in and see if you can defeat the legendary Brainrots!

title: 2 Player Games Mini Games
description:
2 Player Games offers fast mini-games on one screen: tennis, air hockey, curling, billiards and more. Quick rules and score-based matches.
Is a collection of dynamic mini-games designed for local multiplayer on a single device. The pack includes tennis, air hockey, tic-tac-toe, curling, billiards and several other quick competitive modes. Each match is score-based, and the controls are optimized so two players can comfortably compete on one screen. A smart AI opponent is available for solo play, making it possible to practice or enjoy the game without a second player. The mini-games feature short rounds, intuitive mechanics and increasing difficulty, offering both quick duels and longer competitive sessions.
With diverse gameplay styles, straightforward rules and clean visuals, 2 Player Games delivers an engaging and accessible multiplayer experience suitable for all skill levels.

title: Block Master Gem Puzzle
description: Block Master Gem Puzzle is a fun and addictive 8x8 block puzzle game with exciting game modes. Enjoy endless relaxing gameplay in Classic mode, collect diamonds and beat challenging levels in Diamond Quest, or clear every block within limited moves in Clear the Board mode. Easy to play but hard to master, this gem-style puzzle features smooth controls, satisfying effects, and brain-training challenges for all ages. Play anytime, anywhere!

title: Obby: Extreme Cart Ride
description:
🚀 Jumps, speed, and nonstop forward momentum — there’s no time to slow down!

Get ready for a wild ride across challenging tracks where every section demands precision and quick reactions. Accelerate, overcome dangerous segments, dodge traps, and try not to fly off the track. Every mistake can cost you the victory — and that’s exactly what makes each run so exciting.

As you progress, the tracks become more difficult and the obstacles more unpredictable. Test your control skills, learn to feel the speed, and prove that you can reach the finish line even in the most extreme conditions.

  What awaits you:
	•	Unique tracks with unexpected turns
	•	A constant sense of speed and risk
	•	Spectacular falls and fun physics
	•	New ways to complete each level
	•	Bright emotions in every run

 Easy to learn, challenging to master.
Do you have what it takes to overcome every challenge and reach the end?

Simple word game where match 3 falling mechanics meet word game.
