Select letter make words and see the falling block.

title: SKATE: +1 Speed
description:
🛹 This is a world of insane speed and skate parkour! Get a +1 speed boost while skateboarding, navigate challenging obstacle courses, and become the fastest player!

Gain speed with every passing second, jump over traps, avoid dangers, and complete thrilling parkour levels. The further you go, the faster you get! Unlock new skateboards with unique boosts and upgrade your character to set incredible records.

The game features vibrant tracks, challenging trials, fast-paced gameplay, and a constant sense of progress. Can you clear all the obstacles at top speed?

Game Features:

🛹 Skateboards with different speeds and boosts
⚡ Constantly increasing speed
🏁 Parkour with traps and obstacles
🔥 Simple and engaging controls
💨 Fast-paced and dynamic levels
🎁 Rewards and new upgrades
🌈 Vibrant style and a fun atmosphere
🏆 Set speed records

Jump, accelerate, and become a true skate park master!
Come on in!

title: Drive & Crash Sandbox
description:
Realistic High-Speed Car Crash Simulator
Launch vehicles down massive slopes and crash them into destructible obstacles! Experience thrilling high-speed collisions and realistic crash physics like never before.

Crash cars. Break parts. Feel the impact.
Choose from a variety of vehicles and watch as they crumble and break apart with ultra-realistic physics and damage simulation.

Features:
-  Online multiplayer mode!
- Realistic car deformation physics
- Stunning 3D graphics
- Authentic driving controls
- Detailed vehicle damage system
 -Multiple vehicles to choose from

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle is a captivating online game that tests your strategic thinking by fitting screws and nuts to topple wooden blocks. Accessible on multiple platforms, this trending title offers a fun and engaging puzzle experience for those looking for a new play-to-earn option.

title: Arrows Escape
description:
Welcome to Arrows Escape, a minimalist puzzle game that challenges your logic, planning, and spatial thinking. Your goal is simple: extract each arrow without causing a collision.

🧠 Features:

- Challenging logic puzzles that test your planning skills
- Thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing complexity
- Clean, minimalist design that lets you focus on the puzzle
- Relaxing, no-pressure gameplay – no timers, just your brain
- Hint system to help when you're stuck

title: Penalty Challenge
description: Penalty Challenge is a thrilling online sports game that allows you to play as a striker or goalkeeper. Compete for free against AI or global players, earn points, and rise in rankings. Choose from top European clubs or national teams, showcasing your talent in an electrifying atmosphere.

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground
description:
🎯 Ready for some fun action with ragdoll stickmen? The game "Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground" will hook you from the first level! Become a sharpshooter, control a rotating gun and destroy funny yellow mobs in a bright casual 3D shooter.

This simple playground shooter is inspired by the popular games "Playground Man! Ragdoll Show!" and "Melon Playground". Here you will find everything you need for a fun action: ragdoll physics, stickmen, different guns and interesting levels. Click "Play" and show your sniper skills!

🔥 Game Features 🔥
Simple one-tap controls: just shoot at the right moment
Bright 3D graphics with funny ragdoll physics and funny jelly stickmen
Exciting gameplay: use items on levels to effectively destroy enemies
Play online from your mobile or PC without downloading.
Various weapons: from a pistol to powerful guns.

title: Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design
description:
«Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design» is a bright dress-up and interior design game where everyone can show creativity. Six popular heroes are waiting for you: Cappuccino Assassino, Ballerina Cappuccina, Bombardiro Crocodilo, Orcalero, Chimpanzini Bananini and Tralalelo Tralalata. Each character is unique, and you can create their own style: choose outfits, hats and accessories, mix looks and invent fashionable combinations.

Then move on to interior design! Decorate rooms with furniture, hang paintings, add cozy details and create spaces to your taste. There are no limits or restrictions — only your imagination and freedom of expression.

If you enjoy creative games like Toca Boca, where you can dress up characters and design rooms, «Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design» is the perfect choice. Experiment, create stories and bring your ideas to life!

title: Car Wash DIY
description:
Clean, Repair, and Shine in the Car Wash DIY Game!

Jump into a satisfying world of car maintenance where you can wash, clean, and repair vehicles with easy-to-play, relaxing tasks. Whether you're scrubbing off dirt, fixing scratches, filling fuel, or adding the perfect shine, this game offers calming, enjoyable gameplay for everyone.

With easy controls and simple mechanics, anyone can dive into the fun. Whether you’re a casual player or looking for a relaxing escape, our game provides a perfect balance of creativity and stress relief, designed to keep you engaged for hours.

title: Sky Golf
description: Sky Golf is a physics-based puzzle game where your objective is to guide a golf ball from a starting point to the hole. The golf ball rests on a complex structure made entirely of flat, interconnected platforms. Your primary mechanism for moving the ball is to rotate the entire platform structure either clockwise or anti-clockwise by set increments. When you rotate the platforms, gravity acts on the ball, causing it to roll across the flat surfaces. You must strategically time and execute these rotations to change the angle of the platforms, build momentum, and perfectly direct the ball across gaps and around obstacles until it safely drops into the goal. Each level challenges your spatial reasoning to find the precise sequence of rotations required for success.

title: Roller for Brainrots
description: Roller For Brainrots - this is a game where you collect different Brainrots while rollerskating. Come on in and play!

title: We not survive
description: We Not Survive is a thrilling tower defense game in a zombie-infested, post-apocalyptic setting. As the sole defender, protect your base from relentless foes by playing online for free. Upgrade weapons and resources, unlock skills, and prepare for intense battles against waves of undead. Are you ready to survive?

title: Jewel Magic
description: Magic jewels are here and all you have to do to get them is to match them together. Try to collect as many points as possible,  win in different levels, have fun and relax at the same time.

title: Magic Circus - Match 3
description:
Magic Circus Three in a Row is an exciting game with many levels and different attachments!
Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of the circus and overcome many obstacles and thugs. Complete the levels and collect treasures and crystals 3 in a row!
Game Features:
Large beautiful crystals - Three in a row the game is great for adult players!
There are a huge number of levels and several different sets of levels - to complete, to master animals, and a new set with unique obstacles!
Get bonuses and gold for completing levels!
Lots of crystals, power-ups and obstacles!
No time limits, lives, or attempts - play as much as you want!
A special mysterious world awaits you, which everyone dreams of looking through the doors. The atmosphere of the game will capture you from the first minute!
The magic has already begun!

title: Color by Numbers. Anti-stress Drawings.
description:
Color by numbers is creativity and relaxation for the whole family. Our app helps you escape from worries and immerse yourself in the world of colors. This is art therapy available online and on Android.

The collection features anti-stress drawings that relieve tension. Each illustration is divided into numbered fragments — just pick the right color. The drawing process is captivating: you assemble a puzzle, but instead of pieces, you use colors.

The app is suitable for both children and adults. For kids, it's a way to learn colors and numbers, develop motor skills. For adults — an opportunity to relax and engage in creativity. No skills required.

The collection includes various genres: from pixel art to complex compositions. Color animals, flowers, mandalas, landscapes. Drawing by numbers develops attentiveness and sense of color.

The app works on Android and in a web browser. Save your works, share with friends. Coloring brings joy and harmony. Try it: choose a picture and create

title: Zombie Rage: Merge 3D
description:
Grandpa is eager for adventure again! Survive in a harsh zombie world. This time, Grandpa has to save the world from evil zombies. Zombies can drive and shoot! And Grandpa can destroy evil spirits! Fight the most dangerous mutants. Buy cool guns, find unique attachments, assemble your own unique gun and go into battle! Many locations, go through the whole world, from hot deserts to sea battles! 
Features: 
- Unique weapon assembly system. You can create a unique gun, install a barrel, butt, replace the handle, put a cool sight, install a silencer or compensator. 
- Many different enemies: zombie motorcyclists, shooters, Giants, zombies on jeeps, motorcycles. Dangerous bosses: Train with zombies, helicopters, Jeeps, Drones, etc. 
- Stylized graphics! 
- Cool special effects and sounds! 
- Realistic physics and spectacular destruction! Grandpa to battle!

title: Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft
description:
Become a dungeon keeper, control stickmen, mine ore, develop a Cult and hold power in this exciting 3D simulator! Develop the Cult, manage resources and expand the boundaries of your underground Universe!

⛏ Resource extraction - send followers for ore and minerals.
🏛 Cult development - maintain loyalty at a high level.
👀 Captivating 3D graphics - fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of darkness.
⚒ Dungeon upgrade - build, improve and strengthen your base.
💰 Economic strategy – distribute the spoils and increase wealth.

title: Bubble Foxy
description:
Welcome to a colorful Bubble Shooter adventure! Join the adorable fox on a journey through magical worlds filled with cute animal bubbles, exciting puzzles, and fun challenges.

Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear the board, create powerful combos, and overcome tricky obstacles. Explore beautiful locations, unlock new stages, and enjoy relaxing gameplay suitable for players of all ages.

Game Features:
• Hundreds of exciting levels.
• Easy one-touch controls.
• Bright 3D graphics and adorable characters.
• Smooth animations and satisfying effects.
• Daily rewards and fun challenges.
• Play offline anytime.

Whether you're looking to relax or test your puzzle-solving skills, Bubble Shooter offers endless fun for everyone!

title: Bubble Tower
description:
Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game.
You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis.
Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower.
There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc.
Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things.
The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.

title: Fun fishing
description:
Welcome to Fun Fishing — a fun and addictive fishing game about catching fish, upgrading your gear, and selling your catch! Catch rare fish, sell your haul, upgrade your fishing rods, and explore different locations.
🌊 What awaits you:
🎣 Simple and enjoyable fishing
🐟 Many types of fish — from common to rare
💵 Sell fish and earn money
🚤 Boats and new areas to explore
⬆️ Gear upgrades and progression
😄 Relaxing yet addictive atmosphere

title: Game Factory
description:
A full-featured game development studio right on your device!

Choose from 6 genres — platformer, clicker, shooter, match-3, runner, or tower defense — and create unique games from scratch. Draw pixel sprites, customize levels, pick music, and share your creations with friends!

Create, test, publish, and earn coins for your games. Upgrade your studio, unlock new genres and sprite packs!

title: Find the Vampire
description:
Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

In this game, vampires disguise themselves as ordinary people, animals and even objects. Use unique exterminator kits and detectors to expose the hidden enemies. Unlock new areas, complete various levels and defeat the Vampire Lord to save the citizens.

KEY FEATURES:
- Vampire Exterminator Kits: Get new tools to fight the bloodsuckers.
- Search Among Us: Vampires can be anyone - from neighbors to trees.
- Rescue Citizens: Free people from vampire isolation.
- New Locations: Complete levels in different areas of the city.
- Vampire Tactics: Vampires become more cunning with each level.
- Story Levels: Each location reveals a unique story.

title: Machine Eater
description: Create blocks using the resources you collect, expand your ship, and strategically place structures with different features on the blocks you create before selecting your enemy on the radar. Use your strategy skills to eliminate the enemies you detect on the radar. The structures you collect from enemies will add depth to your strategy.

title: Shop Cashier Simulator 3D
description:
Become a pro cashier in this fun and realistic supermarket & shop simulator!

Step into the bustling retail kingdom with Shop Cashier Simulator 3D, where you take on the role of a professional cashier in your very own supermarket. This realistic simulation game puts you behind the cash register, where precision and speed are key to keeping customers happy and your business booming.

title: Screw Puzzle
description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Wood Screw Puzzle, the ultimate wood nuts and bolts puzzle game that will challenge your mind and delight your senses. This isn't just another screw sort game; it's an immersive experience where you'll unravel intricate arrangements of wood screws, nuts and bolts, and other fascinating fasteners, proving your screw master skills along the way.

Unscrew, Unwind, and Unleash Your Inner Puzzle Master:

Each level of Wood Screw Puzzle presents a unique challenge, a mesmerizing tapestry of wood screws and nuts and bolts intertwined in a complex dance. Your task is to carefully analyze the arrangement, strategize your moves, and skillfully manipulate the screw pins and fasteners to screw out each piece and free them from their wooden embrace. It's a test of your logic, spatial reasoning, and dexterity, all wrapped up in a visually stunning and tactilely satisfying wood nuts and bolts puzzle game.

title: Sand Sorting Challenge
description: Tap, pour, and organize vibrant sand into beautiful bottles. This easy-to-play game adds a fresh twist to classic color sorting puzzles, combining soothing gameplay with a fun challenge that will test your focus and strategy. Can you fill every bottle with the right color and master the art of color sand sorting?

title: Break a Lucky Block!
description:
Break lucky blocks, unlock rare rewards, collect brainrots, escape the guards, and bring everything back to your plot in this simulator just like in Roblox!

What's inside the Lucky Blocks? 🧊

Break lucky blocks before you get caught! ⛏️

Grab the brainrots that spawn! ✨

Bring them back to your plot!

title: Smash & Speed
description:
Smash & Speed: Joyride Destruction Arena!

Get ready for high‑octane fun in Smash & Speed! Explore three thrilling environments where you can race, jump, and smash cars to your heart’s content.

Key Features:

Customization — paint, decals, and body kits to personalize your ride.

Tune‑Up Tools — adjust wheels and suspension for bouncy or blistering runs.

Destruction Zones — interactive presses, ramps, and traps in every map.

Realistic Crashes — watch parts fly and wheels spin in slow‑mo chaos.

Dynamic Traffic — encounter moving vehicles and create epic pile‑ups.

Race, crash, and create your own challenges in this ultimate playground of fun and destruction! Smash & Speed — where every crash is a celebration.

title: Hexa Master
description: Hexa Master is an addictive puzzle game that brings together color matching and hexagonal sorting for a truly satisfying challenge. Each move tests your ability to merge layers wisely. Are you ready to become a true Hexa Master?

title: +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode
description:
Welcome to +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode.

Every step makes you faster!

Complete obstacles to earn wins!

Rebirth to gain bonuses!

Upgrade your steps!

Buy new trails!

Climb to the top of the leaderboard!

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It's an arcade game focused on obby and speed. You need to run to increase your speed and raise your level.

Q: What is the game's hook? What will keep players engaged?

A: A unique obstacle course, a rebirth system, leaderboards, and high-quality block graphics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the leveling system work? What's the best way to progress quickly?

A: The more you run, the higher your speed becomes, allowing you to travel further and earn more trophies.

Q: Is the total number of levels known? How many are there?

A: There are 5 different levels.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?

A: The game features two currencies: trophies and steps. Trophies are earned by reaching the end of one of the five levels, while steps can be purchased in the shop or earned through training.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does paying speed up progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy boosters, skins (colored trails for your character), treadmills to increase running speed, and instant experience (steps).

Q: Is customization available? Can you adjust the hero's appearance, use a level editor, tune vehicles, etc.?

A: Yes, you can purchase a colored trail that follows your character while running.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are there?

A: There are two leaderboards: one for the number of trophies collected and another for time spent in prison.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or will it be difficult to progress without it?

A: The music complements the game well, but it is not required to complete the levels.

title: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac
description:
Train your brain with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac! 
Match mahjong tiles, solve relaxing puzzles, and enjoy classic gameplay on the go.

Unwind and challenge your mind with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac, a timeless puzzle game that blends strategy, focus, and relaxation. 
Match beautifully designed tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a calming gameplay experience anytime, anywhere.
Perfect for both beginners and seasoned players, Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac offers intuitive controls, elegant visuals, and satisfying puzzles that keep you coming back for more.

title: Build a Road
description:
Build your Obby! How big can you make it? 🏗️🔥
• Buy blocks, walls, ramps, lava, and more to BUILD your obby! 🧱✨
• Play your obby to EARN money! 💰🎮
• Upgrade your plot to build EVEN BIGGER obbies! 📈🏢

title: Car Battle
description: Car Battle is an adrenaline-fueled driving brawler where your war vehicle doubles as both weapon and armor. Take on foes in solo campaigns or challenge friends in intense two-player duels, with each fight spanning five action-packed stages. Upgrade your car, refine your tactics, and unlock unique avatars to personalize your fighter as the battles grow more challenging.

title: Be like a Lucky Block
description:
Enter the chaotic world of Life of a Happy Block, where you become a fast-moving Lucky Block trying to survive an endless chase. Bosses are always behind you, but not all of them bring the same outcome. Your goal is to avoid weaker bosses while staying in the run long enough to meet stronger ones.
You control a rapidly moving Happy Block, making quick decisions to dodge danger and extend your run. Getting caught too early ends everything, but being caught by the right boss can transform your Lucky Block into a rare and powerful secret form.
Each run is a balance between risk and timing. The longer your Happy Block survives, the better your chances of unlocking unique transformations. Simple controls make it easy to start, but mastering the flow takes skill and focus.
How far can your Lucky Block go, and what will it become?

title: Color Sort Puzzle Milk Tea Sorting
description:
Color Sort Puzzle: Water Sorting is a fun and addictive liquid sorting puzzle game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills.

Your goal is simple: sort the colored water into separate bottles until each bottle contains only one color. But don’t be fooled — as levels progress, the puzzles become more complex and require careful planning!

💡 Why you’ll love it:

Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay
Smooth and satisfying pouring animations
Relaxing visuals with vibrant colors
No time limits — play at your own pace
Hundreds of challenging levels
Perfect brain training and stress relief

Whether you want to relax or test your logic skills, this game offers the perfect balance of challenge and calm.

Can you solve all the levels and become a sorting master?

title: Robby: Build Bridge To Brainrots
description:
Collect wood!  

Build a bridge to reach the brainrots! 🌉

Improve the collection and storage of wood! ⚡

Get to new islands and collect more cool brainrots!

title: Archer Ragdoll
Archer Ragdoll
Desolate Isle: Survival
description: Survive and escape from a mysterious island in this open-world survival adventure game. Gather resources, craft tools, build your base, and explore new areas with unique materials and challenges. Complete quests to unlock new territories and uncover the secrets of the island. Perfect for fans of survival, exploration, and crafting games.

title: Solitaire Tripeaks
description: Explore the mysteries of the Deep Sea with Solitaire TriPeaks, the classic solitaire card game which allows you to train your brain with different solitaire puzzles.

title: Pretty Tidy - ASMR Organizing
description: Welcome to Pretty Tidy! 🌸✨ Step into a world of calm and relaxation with Pretty Tidy, a satisfying game designed to comfort your soul. Clean up, organize, and sort in the most magical way, turning messy spaces into perfectly tidy ones. This cozy mini-game is your hidden escape, helping you de-stress, calm your mind, and bring inner peace. Whether you love organizing or need a soothing experience, this game is perfect for you!

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the exciting world of Mystical Blade 3D, a thrilling simulation game inspired by B-Blades. Create custom B-Blades by mixing different elements, blades, and rings. Enjoy crafting and competition with this free game accessible on your phone or computer.

title: Draw Action
description:
Draw lines and defeat enemies effortlessly! The game is best suited for those who want to let off steam and relax now.

Various attack schemes are available to you, depending on which pattern you draw. The enemy is making a desperate attack on you. Can you win without taking damage?

title: Jiffy
description:
How fast can you react in a world full of obstacles and enemies? In Jiffy, a retro-style, fast-paced action platformer, every jump counts—literally! Leap over obstacles, break through destructible blocks, and unleash powerful shots by double-tapping jump to take down foes. With over 25 levels, challenging bosses, and endless and battle modes, the action never stops. Ready to put your skills to the test?

Your goal is to reach the end of the level while overcoming obstacles and defeating enemies.

Desktop Controls:

Move: WASD or Arrow Keys

Jump: Spacebar

Shoot: Press Spacebar more than once

Mobile Controls:

Move, Jump: On-screen buttons.

Shoot: Tap the jump button more than once

Time your jumps carefully, break through obstacles, and take down enemies with precision. Good luck!

title: Footchinko
description: Challenge your rivals in the most famous soccer international tournaments. Are you skillful enough to fulfil your trophy case through the +90 levels of the game?

title: Tower Defense
description: A horde of horrible monsters is attacking your kingdom, build your towers fast and survive all the waves. If arrows or stones are not enough, use elements to your advantage and slay them all.

title: Eggy Car
description: Eggy Car is a simple yet challenging physics-based casual driving game where the goal is to drive as far as possible without letting the egg in your car fall off and crack! Controls are minimal, but finding the right balance between braking and accelerating is crucial, especially when navigating hills. Buckle up and get ready for the (hopefully not) bumpy ride.

title: Check Wednesday Phone!
description:
Check Wednesday Phone! creepy-cute game inspired by the Netflix series. Read messages, solve mysteries, explore Nevermore’s secrets and play gothic mini‑games.

Enter Wednesday Addams' digital world in this dark, twisted game. Check emails from Nevermore students, change your gothic phone theme, play eerie mini‑games, and explore her secret-filled dorm. Earn coins doing tasks Wednesday would probably mock — but you’ll need them to unlock the next mystery.

title: Color Cube Puzzle
description:
Color Cube Puzzle is a relaxing logic puzzle where you need to plan every move and position shapes correctly on the board.
Move shapes to the cube conveyors. If the cube color matches the shape color, the shape starts filling with cubes. When a shape is completely filled, it disappears from the level.
Your goal is to fill all shapes and clear the level.

There are no timers, no bombs and no rush — you can take your time and think through every move. It is impossible to lose, you can always try a different solution.

As you progress, new mechanics, obstacles and puzzle elements will appear. You can also use three boosters to help you complete difficult levels.
The game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing but thoughtful puzzle games.

title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
description:
Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! 🌟

What Makes Shape Transforming: Shifting Run Exciting:
🏃‍♂️ Thrilling Transformations: Seamlessly morph into different characters to tackle the challenges of each terrain. Each transformation is a new experience!
🏃‍♂️ Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a game with beautifully rendered environments and characters, making every run a visually stunning journey.
🏃‍♂️ Hilarious Animations and Fun Sound Effects: Enjoy the game's playful side with funny animations and entertaining sound effects that add to the overall enjoyment.
🏃‍♂️ Fast-Paced Gameplay: The game's rapid pace demands quick reflexes and decision-making, providing an exhilarating challenge for players of all skill levels.
🏃‍♂️ Engaging for Everyone: Whether you’re a seasoned gamer or just looking for an exciting new game to play, Shape Transforming: Shifting Run is accessible and enjoyable for all.

title: Cut Grass for Brainrots
description:
Welcome to Grass Cutter for seeking Brainrots! 🌱
Slice through thick grass and uncover hidden Brainrots! ✂️
Swing your weapon, clear the field, and unlock new areas to explore! 🌿
Upgrade your damage to handle tougher grass with ease! 
Collect Brainrots to increase your income and progress faster! 
Rebirth to gain powerful boosts and expand your attack range! 🔁
Don’t forget to like the game and join the group to stay updated on future content! 👍

title: Build and Fly Obby
description:
Build a plane from random parts — and see if it can actually fly.

You are a mad inventor creating strange, funny and sometimes brilliant flying machines.
Every build is an experiment: some planes wobble, some spin, and some surprisingly soar perfectly.

Fly forward, dodge obstacles, collect coins and bonuses, pass through rings and gates.
The farther you fly, the more parts you unlock — and the crazier your planes become.

Game features:
🛠️ Free plane building
✈️ Unique physics — every design flies differently
🌍 Multiple biomes and locations
💥 Funny crashes and spectacular flights
🏆 Records and progression

Experiment. Crash. Improve.
The test is never over.

title: Homo Evolution
description: Welcome to Homo Evolution, an enchanting journey where you can create your own little universe and unravel the mysteries of human evolution. This free online game lets you merge two individuals to birth a new, more modern life form, populating the planet with a wide array of creatures—from simple animals to diverse and unpredictable personalities. Whether you're on the phone or computer, this captivating gameplay invites you to shape the world in four unique ways, from the BEGINNING with animal evolution, to the BREAD civilization, witnessing the transformation from natural to modified products.

title: Drag Racing Club
description: Enter the thrilling world of street drag racing in this unique game. Start as an unknown outsider and race your way to the top. Prove everyone that you're the best racer in the city. To achieve that, you will have to buy or win great cars from your opponents. Then tune them up into powerful racing machines. Drive on!

title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
description: «Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break, and Destroy!» - a casual puzzle game with logical challenges, realistic physics, and action-packed destruction in a doll simulator!

title: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match
description:
You are the 3rd son of the great king of a magical land. Your parents send you to a faraway land to establish a new kingdom and prove that you are the most capable of their children!

In the game you collect resource hexes. There are 6 resources in total: food, water, stone, wood, diamonds and metal. When you collect enough resources, you can build a new building. Unlock all the buildings, create a beautiful magical kingdom!

title: LAST NIGHT!
description:
A Story Line Game about a YOUTUBER struggling to get GOLD PLAY BUTTON but there are something strange happens to his PC and want to take a Survey?

  ●  3 Different Endings.
  ●  Storyline.
  ●  High Quality Gameplay.
  ●  Playtime:   30  - 60 mins! ( Maximum ).

title: Big Boom! Building Smash!
description:
💣 Ready to dive into a world of chaos and mayhem? If you’ve enjoyed games like Captain TNT and Noob Demolisher, then our game is about to become your new favorite! Blast buildings, smash through obstacles, and create total havoc on every level! You’ll face hundreds of crazy missions where every move could lead to epic explosions and complete destruction! 🧨

⚙️ What’s in Store:
- Thrilling levels with unique challenges and missions
- Realistic 3D graphics and dynamic effects
- Play online on any device – from your phone to your PC
- Leaderboards where you can compete with others and prove you’re the ultimate demolisher

🚀 Play solo or with friends, blow up everything in sight, and have a blast with all the destruction!

title: Geometry: Black Ball
description:
Geometry: Black Ball is an exciting arcade game based on the legendary Geometry Dash. In this game, you have to control the ball and overcome various obstacles using the unique mechanics of gravity change.

The game includes 10 levels of varying difficulty, each of which is an exciting challenge and requires the player to have quick reactions and precise movements. The further you advance, the more difficult the obstacles become, adding an additional challenge to the game.

In addition, Geometry: Black Ball has a shop where the player can purchase various skins for his ball. You can choose from a variety of stylish and creative skins to give your ball a unique look and enhance the feel of the game.

Get ready for an exciting adventure that will test your dexterity and reaction!

title: CatDoku
description: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle with cute cats! Place the fluffy heroes on the board following three simple rules: one cat per row and column, one cat per color, and no cats in adjacent cells. Easy rules — but the further you go, the trickier the levels get.

title: Toy Soccer Cup
description: Toy Soccer Cup is a fast, pick-up-and-play table football game where you flick toy players to smash the ball into the net. Battle through tournaments and world leagues, customize your team with kits, balls and pitches, and challenge real players in 1v1 online matches. Easy to learn, hard to put down!

title: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game
description: Is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

title: Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description:
Step into the addictive world of Snaptaire: Jigsaw Solitaire brainteasers - the ultimate fantasy jigsaw puzzle games that challenges your brain and tests your skills.
Slide colorful cards and uncover stunning HD jigsaw graphics on mobile. 
Whether you're looking for fantasy jigsaw puzzles for free, a smooth slide puzzle game for the Christmas countdown, or engaging Christmas games, this jigsolitaire game has it all.

title: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle
description: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle offers a fun brain challenge where you strategically unscrew pieces to solve puzzles. Enjoy this free online game without downloads, perfect for fans of strategy and logical thinking, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment.

title: Merge 2048
description:
Merge 2048 is a fun and addictive merging game where your goal is to combine matching numbered blocks to reach higher values—can you unlock the elusive 2048 block?

Choose between two exciting modes:
 Classic 2048 and Shape Mode for a refreshing twist in gameplay.

As you drop blocks, plan your merges carefully to avoid filling up the container.
Feeling stuck? Use the powerful TNT Block to clear unwanted tiles and create space.

The game features clean visuals, smooth controls, and a satisfying progression that keeps you hooked.
Track your score, unlock cool titles, and see how far you can go without hitting the red line.
Perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—Merge 2048 is simple to pick up, but hard to master!

title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
description:
Immerse yourself in madness and fun as a mischievous cat who decided to turn grandma's cozy house into a field of chaos! 🐱 Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem. 
Explore rooms stuffed with interactive objects and watch as grandma's patience melts with each of your pranks. How far will you go before she explodes with anger? 

🐾 Game features:
🐟 Destructible objects and interactive environment
😂 Funny and unpredictable reactions of grandma
😼 Endless opportunities for mischief
🎮 Easy to learn, but addictive gameplay

title: Boxing Stars
description: Rise from the box underground to the championship and become a boxing star. Improve your skills with rewards to compete in better tournaments.

title: TNT Sandbox
description:
"TNT Sandbox" is an obby-style block sandbox where your main goal is to blow everything up with TNT.

Earn rewards for explosions and building, buy powerful TNT, and enjoy the destruction!

The game features spreading fire: ignite not only TNT, but trees too!

Explore a randomly generated world with caves and bodies of water, but don't forget to blow it all up!

title: Dream Home
description:
A cozy 3D builder where you design and furnish your very own house from scratch. Raise walls and floors, paint them any color, hang wallpaper, lay flooring, arrange furniture, and decorate the yard: from flower beds and a campfire to a pool and a fountain.

Finished a room? Step inside! First-person walk mode lets you stroll through your house, climb the stairs, and see the result with your own eyes, by day and by night.

Want more than a sandbox? Fill client orders: build to the brief, get graded on your work, earn experience, and level up. A special challenge order is available every day. As you level up, new plots unlock — so you can work on several houses at once.

title: Cat Box Merge
description:
Cat Box Merge is a cozy casual game about cats, boxes, and merging. Open boxes, discover adorable cats, and combine identical ones to get new, rarer pets. Place cats on beds: they will help you and gradually bring new boxes for further progress.

Collect cats, unlock new stages of progression, and move through different cozy worlds, each with its own mood, design, and unique characters. The further you progress, the more opportunities appear: new cats, pleasant rewards, boosts, and a constant feeling of growth.

The game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing clickers, merge mechanics, collecting, and a cute atmosphere. Play at your own pace, upgrade your collection, and unlock more and more fluffy heroes.

title: Build a Rollercoaster: Simulator
description:
Create and ride awesome roller coasters!
🛤 Buy tracks and build your own rides. Get rare tracks and create the longest roller coasters! Ride and travel along your tracks!

title: Ride a Bike for Brainrots
description:
Welcome to Obby Ride a Bike For Brainrots! 🚴
Speed through obstacle courses while keeping your balance! ⚡
Jump across crazy obby stages filled with tricky challenges! 🤾‍♂️
Be careful — one mistake and you’ll fall into the void! 💀
Collect Brainrots to boost your income and progress faster! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and grow stronger! 🏗️
Keep riding, improving, and conquer every obby stage! 🚀

title: Obby Toilet Line
description:
Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn.

This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. To advance to the next spot, you must collect the required amount first. And there’s pressure, because sometimes the character behind you can act fast and push you back one place, making it even more important to keep earning and climbing.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you have to wait in line for the toilet and then enter the magical VIP world of idle games.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline, but the task is crystal clear. Wait in line, enter the VIP zone, and collect as many bonuses as possible for leveling up.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?
A: The game has an unusual setting with a large number of mini-games.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Currencies can be spent on character customization and leveling up to progress through the toilet queue faster.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: By entering the VIP zone, you can speed up the queue progression.

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are numerous customization options and many references to popular culture.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change everything about the character.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: The game has pleasant sound, but it is not necessary for progression.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, "match three" puzzles within a strategy game.
A: There are many additional games within the VIP zone.

title: Falling Dummy
description:
Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible!

Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings!

Control the flight of the dummy, direct its body to the floor level, concrete structures, construction cranes and other construction objects to break even more bones of the dummy!

Game features:

- Relaxing gameplay
- Bright stylized 3D graphics
- Interesting levels
- Cool skins

title: Stack Sort
description:
Dive into the colorful and satisfying world of Stack Sort! Welcome to Stack Sort: Build Color Stacks, the ultimate brain-teasing puzzle game designed to relax your mind and test your logic. Your mission is simple but highly addictive: bring order to the colorful chaos! You will start with a grid of mixed-up blocks, and it is up to you to carefully shift and sort them until every single color has its own dedicated stack.

With vibrant 3D graphics, smooth animations, and incredibly satisfying gameplay, Stack Sort is the perfect way to unwind after a long day or give your brain a quick workout. As you progress, the puzzles get trickier, requiring clever strategies and sharp spatial awareness. Can you master the art of the perfect sort?

title: Balls: Ricochet!
description:
Balls: Ricochet! - an arcade shooting game. The project pays tribute to the memory of old retro gaming. If you consider yourself a true connoisseur of games, you should play this game and immerse yourself in nostalgia. The game will delight you:
-Authentic gameplay
-Correct ball physics
-Good visual design
The exciting, addictive gameplay will immerse you in the pursuit of the best score for a long time. The concept, developed in the early 80s, still works perfectly. Start playing and beat your friend's score! 
Also pay attention to the following parts of the "Balls", have a nice game!

title: Super Car Soccer Arena
description:
Super Car Soccer Arena unleashes high-speed action where powerful sports cars replace traditional soccer players! Jump into the arena, boost across the field, and smash the giant ball into your opponent’s goal. Master drifting, aerial flips, and explosive turbo moves to outplay rivals in this thrilling car-soccer showdown. With fast matches, smooth controls, and dynamic arenas, every game feels intense and unpredictable. Score goals, unlock new cars, and become the ultimate champion in this extreme fusion of racing and football. Start your engines and dominate the arena!

Race into the arena, smash the ball toward the goal, and outscore the enemy team before time is up. Use nitro, drift, and dominate the match!

title: Connecting Flowers: Garden Merge
description:
Playing "Connecting Flowers: Garden Merge" is an enjoyable and calming experience where you compete with other players by discovering new and beautiful flowers. When two identical flowers collide, they merge into a new fragrant flower, bringing joy to you and the surrounding bees.
Additionally, you earn points with each flower. Try to connect as many flowers as possible and claim the top spot among the nectar providers for the bees :)

title: Potato Shooter

title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
description:
Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything. Every tap changes your altitude, every obstacle tests your timing and every mode challenges your mastery in different ways.

With five full game modes, multiplayer support, deep customization and endless replayability, Geometry Vibes X Arrow is designed for players who enjoy precise control, fast reactions and competitive challenges. Whether you are playing solo or competing against three friends on the same device, the game always feels fresh and pushes players toward improvement run after run.

What is the goal in Geometry Vibes X Arrow?
The main objective is to reach the portal without hitting any obstacle. Every game mode builds on this core idea with different variations and challenges.

How does Classic Mode differ from Spam Mode?
Classic Mode features handcrafted levels with fixed structures and increasing difficulty. Spam Mode is a survival challenge where the walls slowly close in. Players compare their longest survival times and try to extend their record on every attempt.

Is there local multiplayer?
Yes. You can play with 2 3 or 4 players on the same device. Each player uses separate keys. The race based competitive gameplay makes these modes fast and chaotic.

What can I do in Endless Mode?
Endless Mode is all about distance. The arrow accelerates and the level stretches infinitely. Your goal is to travel as far as possible before crashing. It is ideal for players who enjoy reaction based gameplay.

How difficult is Challenge Mode?
Challenge Mode contains five stages designed specifically for advanced players. These levels require strong timing, compact movements and consistent precision. Even small mistakes can end the run quickly.

What customization options are available?
You can unlock and equip arrow skins, trails and color combinations. With twenty four skins, sixteen trails and twenty four total color options, players can create many unique visual styles.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Geometry Dash is a game where you need to progress through levels while avoiding obstacles.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers a variety of modes and challenges, being difficult and engaging.

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Coins, which can be spent on customization.

Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game itself is extremely popular and hooks players with its difficulty and challenges.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change the player's shape and colors, with many skins available.


Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?
A: Yes, there are challenges.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: You can play without sound, but the music is designed and set up to make the player vibe to the max during the gaming session.


Multiplayer

Q: Can you play with friends?
A: Yes, but only offline on the same computer.

title: Dogfight
description: Dogfight is a thrilling air combat game where you control a battle plane in intense aerial battles. Perform maneuvers like looping, rolling, and turning as you engage in dynamic dogfights. Experience the rush of real air battles and showcase your piloting skills.

title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
description:
Explore a large sea world where fishing is the core of the adventure 🌊🎣
Sail across the sea, travel between islands, and fish in many different locations. This online fishing game lets you catch fish, brainrots, and mysterious creatures while exploring a living ocean world filled with secrets 🏝️
Use your boat to move between islands and search for the best fishing spots 🚤

Each island offers different fish, sea creatures, and brainrots. Some fish are common, while others are rare and hidden in specific areas. Exploration plays a key role, encouraging players to travel, sail, and fish across the sea 🌊

Whether you want a quick challenge or a calm card session, 4 in 1 Solitaire offers endless fun for every card game fan.

title: Capy Cafe
description:
Capy Cafe is a cozy idle-management game where you run an adorable café as a hard-working capybara barista. Harvest fresh strawberries and tea leaves, brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, and blend creamy smoothies — then serve them to a steady stream of happy customers.

There are no buttons to fumble with: just waddle up to a station and your capy gets to work automatically. Reinvest your earnings to unlock new drinks and stations, and hire helper capybaras to keep every corner of the cafe humming while you expand. What starts as a tiny tea stand grows into a bustling boba empire — one cup at a time.

Simple one-thumb controls, satisfying progression, and the most relaxing café this side of the riverbank. Genre: casual idle tycoon / shop-management sim.

title: Block Party: Obby, Robby, Mini games!
description:
🏆 Compete with other players and earn cups and coins for every victory! Use your coins to unlock new skins or upgrade your character.

🧩 Face a variety of situations that will test your dexterity, ingenuity, and ability to choose the right path.

title: Zombie Check: Survival Shelter
description:
Zombie Check: Survival Shelter is a tense quarantine inspection simulator set during a zombie outbreak.

Survivors arrive one by one. Your job is to inspect their bodies, scan for symptoms and decide their fate:
send to camp, quarantine, or eliminate.

Symptoms can be hidden, suspicious, or evolve over time. One wrong decision can kill an innocent person or infect the entire camp.

Use the scanner, examine bodies, unlock weapons and make choices under pressure.
Each day brings new people, higher risks and tougher decisions.

Will you survive long enough to reach the bunker and save humanity?
"Core: A high-stakes social deduction and resource management game set during a global zombie epidemic, where players must identify and neutralize infected individuals to secure the survival of the human race in an underground bunker.
Loop: Progression is driven by successful identification and correct processing of incoming individuals. Flawless daily performance (correctly determining the infected from the healthy) is rewarded with in-game currency, fostering a cycle of precision and reward.
Start: A comprehensive tutorial module ensures immediate accessibility and full comprehension of the core mechanics. The high-stakes premise—total responsibility for humanity's future—provides a powerful, immediate retention hook.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a stylized, cartoon art direction.
Key Feature: A genre-defining blend of deduction mechanics, demanding constant vigilance from players to prevent a single missed symptom from compromising the entire bunker and ending humanity."

title: Slope 3D
description:
Slope 3D sends you down a steep neon track where quick reactions and precise movement decide how long your run will last. Guide the rolling ball through narrow platforms, sharp turns, sudden drops, and dangerous red obstacles while the speed continues to increase. The controls are simple to learn, but staying on the course becomes harder with every passing second.

Game Overview
Your objective in Slope 3D is to keep the ball on the track for as long as possible and achieve the highest score. The ball rolls forward automatically, leaving you responsible for steering it away from barriers, gaps, and the edges of the platform.

The slope changes constantly as you progress. Wide paths can quickly become narrow lanes, while sudden turns and uneven platforms force you to adjust your position without losing control. Red blocks are especially dangerous because touching one ends the current run immediately.

Speed is one of the biggest challenges. The farther you travel, the faster the ball moves, giving you less time to react to what appears ahead. A small steering mistake that seems harmless early in the run can send the ball off the track once the pace increases.

Key Features
- Fast-paced 3D endless runner gameplay
- Futuristic neon environment
- Simple left-and-right steering controls
- Increasing speed and difficulty
- Narrow tracks, sharp turns, and sudden gaps
- Dangerous red obstacles to avoid
- Score-based progression with no fixed finish line
- Keyboard controls for desktop players 
- Swipe and tilt controls for mobile devices
- Quick rounds designed for repeated high-score attempts

Tips for Beginners
- Use short taps instead of holding a direction for too long.
- Try to keep the ball near the center of the track.
- Look ahead rather than focusing only on the ball.
- Begin steering before reaching sharp turns.
- Avoid unnecessary movement on narrow platforms.

Advanced Tips
- Plan your position based on the next section of the course.
- Use gentle corrections when the ball reaches higher speeds.
- Enter narrow paths from the center whenever possible.
- Move early when several obstacles appear close together.
- Stay calm after sudden drops and regain control gradually.

Common Mistakes
- Making large steering movements at high speed.
- Waiting until the last moment to avoid an obstacle.
- Staying too close to the edge of the platform.
- Watching the current position instead of the upcoming track.
- Trying to correct one mistake with another sudden turn.

Slope 3D game turns a simple steering mechanic into a demanding test of focus, balance, and reflexes. Its endless course means every run offers another opportunity to travel farther and improve your score. Stay centered, react smoothly, and see how long you can survive as the neon slope becomes faster and more difficult.

title: Geometry Dash: Infinity

Immerse yourself in the calm but tense atmosphere of the desert.

Can you help Mike survive the unforgiving sands and find his way back to safety?

title: Escape Strange Girl’s House
description:
Escape Strange Girl’s House is a dark point-and-click adventure available on both web and Android.

You wake up in a locked, unfamiliar house. The windows are sealed, the doors are bolted, and it doesn’t take long to realize you’re not here by choice — you’ve been kidnapped. The only way forward is to explore, uncover clues, and piece together who lives here… and why they’ve trapped you.

Every object can hide a secret: a sofa may conceal something beneath its cushions, a flowerpot may hold a key, or a book on the shelf may reveal disturbing truths about the strange girl who owns this place. Interacting with the environment unlocks new paths, changes the protagonist’s perception, and pushes the story into darker territory.

As in every classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll collect items and use them in clever ways to solve puzzles, repair devices, and access new rooms. A simple glass of water, a sharp knife, or a roll of tape could be the difference between staying trapped forever and finding your way to freedom.

The narrative unfolds gradually, shifting from calm exploration to mounting dread. What begins as a harmless search of a living room turns into a chilling discovery of obsessions, sinister secrets, and unsettling mannequins that seem far too lifelike.

Your ultimate goal is clear: escape the house before it’s too late. But as you progress, you’ll uncover more about the girl’s twisted hobbies — and the terrifying fate that might await you if you fail.

Will you outsmart her and unlock the final door to freedom, or become just another part of her dark collection?

🔧 Upgrade Your Gear

title: Game of Warrior
description:
Game of Warriors is a Strategy TD (Tower Defense) game with a unique style in its genre. Set in a magical world you will have to upgrade your defenses and mighty soldiers to survive and siege enemy territories to conquer them.

The rival alliance of the evil kingdoms has pushed what remains of the human civilization to a corner of the world, isolated and forgotten, plunged into misery and trying to survive harshly.

Ready the horses, hire your warriors and prepare the spears for battle, the war horn will sound again and our titans will destroy the enemy walls and towers.

The age of dark empires have come to an end, it's time to recover what rightfully belongs to us, it's time for revolt, war and revenge!

Features:

- Tower Defense (TD) and Strategy game style.
- 1500+ defensive waves.
- 100+ territories to conquer.
- 30+ soldiers to upgrade.
- 1000+ building upgrades.
- 4 different races to conquer (Goblins, Skeletons, Worgens and Orcs).

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game. You need to upgrade your soldiers, fortress, and attack other territories, turning them into your colonies.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game that can hook players?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game with over 30 soldiers to upgrade, over 1000 building upgrades, 4 different races to defeat (goblins, skeletons, worgens, and orcs), and a unique upgrade tree.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?

A: Yes, every 10 waves you face a well-organized army of bosses that are more challenging than regular units.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has currencies: gold and diamonds. You can use them to upgrade towers, warriors, attack lands, improve weapons, and more.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Earn coins by defeating enemies and collecting coins from colonies we have conquered. Use these coins to level up your warriors and structures.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases where you can buy diamonds. These diamonds can be used to purchase numerous upgrades. Donations speed up game progress.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

Hexa puzzle, sorting puzzle, merge game, brain training game, color sort, relaxing puzzle, offline puzzle game, stack sort, merge hexa, logic puzzle, calming games, ASMR puzzle, stress relief game.

description:
Sky Balls 3D is an exhilarating two-player casual sports game where you test your reactions and reflexes by guiding a ball on a narrow track thousands of meters in the sky, sometimes with guardrails... and sometimes not. You aim to keep the ball on track and avoid obstacles, traps, and gaps. While high in the sky, you not only have to avoid falling, but the real challenge is to do so while collecting coins and keys to unlock new ball skins and sky-boxes. Enjoy simple controls, stunning 3D graphics, and a choice of 1-player or 2-player modes across hundreds of challenging levels.

How to Play Sky Balls 3D
Let's say that Sky Balls 3D seems easier than it looks, and in the first few rounds, it's actually possible to coast through to the end without finding that perfect balance to avoid getting cast off the edge of the path. But once the obstacles start appearing, you will be forced to play tactically, so don't get too used to coasting.

There are multiple obstacles to look out for, like no guardrails, narrowing roads, curves, and excessive incline speed, not to mention road barriers, which you need to avoid or slightly navigate around.

Collect coins
Collect coins along the way for game upgrades, which include new sceneries, landscapes, and views.

Two players are better than one.
If you thought playing the game on your own was exhilarating, have a go at the 2-player gameplay with a friend. The game gets even more exciting as you try to focus on the speed and stability of your rolling ball while desperately trying not to look at how your opponent is doing. The game is fast-paced, and one moment where you lack focus may just throw you off, literally, off the board.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to win levels by defeating enemies and completing all waves. This earns you gold that can be spent on tower upgrades and new purchases.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does paying accelerate game progress?
A: No.

Retention & Engagement

A: No.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game stands out with its excellent design and music.

Q: Is there any customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: No.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to return?
A: No.

A: It is preferable to play with sound because it enhances the experience.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, "match-three" puzzles within a strategy game.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)

In this game, you need to tap on unlocked fill cubes or boxes only. When you tap a cube or box, it falls into the crusher. The crusher breaks it and generates colorful balls. 🎮 Welcome to Sprunki in Backrooms! 🟨🚪

title: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat!
description:
Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat is a relaxing yet captivating puzzle game where you need to skillfully control your snake 🐍 to overcome challenging levels. 🍎

Guide the snake to eat apples 🍏 to make its body grow longer. Your goal is to make the snake long enough to reach the teleportation gate 🔮. But be careful: every move needs careful planning 🧠 to avoid getting stuck.

title: Mr Shooter
description:
Mr Shooter, a Balloon popping desert plant on a mission... A mission to pop all the Balloons in the world!
The objective is simple: Pop all the Balloons to win!
Unlock and select new powerful cards as you progress through the game. With hundreds of creative and varied levels, this game will keep you entertained for hours.

title: Find a Pair 3D
description: 🔎🔍Welcome to the game "Find a Pair 3D". In this game, the player is tasked with finding two identical items from a pile of objects and merging them. For every successfully merged pair, the player earns one star. As the player progresses through levels, new and increasingly diverse items appear, making the game more challenging. The goal is to merge as many pairs as possible to accumulate stars. Additionally, the game features a leaderboard where players can compare their scores and compete for the top position. The higher the level, the more difficult the item combinations become, adding excitement and complexity to the gameplay.

title: Block Blast Mania
description:
In Block Blast Mania , your mission is simple: try to place colorful blocks of various shapes on the game board in such a way that complete rows are formed. A fully filled row or column without any gaps will disappear from the board, making room for new blocks. The more rows you destroy at once, the more points you'll earn.
There are two game modes. In the classic mode, the game will continue until there’s no space left on the board to place one of the three shapes. In the level-based mode, you need to complete objectives such as collecting pigs.
Boosters help you get through the levels.

title: Cooking Shawarma Idle Game
description:
We are providing a stunning and engaging gameplay experience that delivers a real simulation of running a shawarma business. From managing different shawarma and fast-food items to handling customers in real time, every moment feels like you are operating your own busy food stall. Upgrade your kitchen, speed up your service, and take your shawarma shop to the next level as you grow your culinary empire.

Your journey begins with a small shawarma stand, humble yet full of potential. As the Shawarma Restaurant Master, you will dive deep into the art of making perfect shawarma—from choosing the best meat cuts to marinating them with the ideal blend of spices. Every step matters, and every decision affects the final taste and customer satisfaction.

Enhance your slicing knife, lavash station, and cooking speed to boost profits and keep customers happy. Add ketchup, mayo, fries, pickles, and many other extras to customize each order based on customer demands.


Have you ever dreamed of cooking delicious dishes from around the world and exploring different cultures? All of that becomes possible in Our Shawarma Game!

title: 3D Dots
description:
3D Dots is a relaxing connect-the-dots puzzle that happens in real 3D space. Every level starts as a cloud of numbered dots floating in the air — link them with the right lines and a hidden object comes to life.

The number on each dot tells you how many lines it needs, so there is no guessing, only clean logic. Unlike flat dot-to-dot games, the puzzle has depth: orbit the camera to look at the figure from any side and find connections you could not see before.

title: Prison Architect: Cage Break Tycoon
description:
At the beginning of the game you will be given an empty prison, which is not able to hold even ordinary prisoners, and there are also Bosses! They are especially dangerous!

But it is in your power to make your prison better!
- Build new cameras
- Strengthen the doors
- Add surveillance cameras
- Hire security guards!
- Don't forget about improvements!

You can also upgrade your chief overseer
- Make it faster
- Improve his weapons
- Carry more prisoners at the same time

Once you have brought order to one prison, try doing the same in others!

The game will be interesting for players of all ages. Everyone will find something interesting for themselves!

This is an exciting trip for one person. The fate of the prisoners is in your hands.
Great power goes hand in hand with great responsibility.
Don't let me down =)!

title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the Huntrix girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!

title: Sorting Cute Animals
description:
A new sorting game with cute animals!

A relaxing game in which you need to arrange the animals in the cells. You have to place them next to each other to connect three identical ones.

"Sorting Cute Animals" is a simple and relaxing game for all ages and any gender!

title: Collect Brainrot Egg
description:
Collect Brainrot Egg takes the classic collect Brainrot loop and flips it into an egg-hatching economy race. Play in 1 Player or 2 Player mode, buy mystery eggs from the center conveyor, carry them back to your base, and wait for them to hatch into random Brainrot characters! The better your lineup, the faster you generate coins, and the sooner you can afford the rarest eggs.

Egg Rarities (Lowest → Highest)
Basic, Rare, Super Rare, Void, Prismatic, SlyFox, Angel, Bonedragon, Hypertech, Firestorm, Diamond!
High-tier eggs appear much less often, but they can hatch into much more valuable Brainrots.

Core Gameplay:
Eggs spawn randomly on the conveyor. If you have enough money, buy an egg and bring it to your base. After the egg’s hatch timer finishes, your Brainrot appears and starts producing coins. Build your income step by step, then jump into higher tiers to chase the best pulls.

Of course, it’s not just farming. Defend your base from thieves by keeping it closed, or catch the rival mid-steal and hit them to save your Eggs and Brainrots. Feeling bold? You can also raid other bases and steal their loot.

title: Railway Traffic Jam! Untangle the Trains!
description:
Do you like simple and challenging puzzles with cars and trains? Do you love mobile bestsellers like “Traffic Escape” and “Parking Escape”? Then this game is definitely for you!

⭐Main features⭐

- Colorful and pleasant graphics will create a relaxing atmosphere!
- Various levels and increasing difficulty will not let you get bored in the process!

title: Car Escape
description:
Car Escape - an exhilarating and thrilling traffic escape game that prepares you for every pulse-pounding adventure. Every step counts, and every action can spell the difference between freedom and gridlock. Can you maneuver your car out of the traffic jam and break free?

Start the engine, press the accelerator, and prepare to escape the chaotic and congested streets. But don't be afraid; with your quick reflexes and sharp intellect, you'll soon master the art of navigating through traffic.

title: 3D Chess - Arcane Edition
description:
Step into a mystical enchanted garden and play chess like never before.

3D Chess - Arcane Edition brings the classic strategy game to life with stunning 3D visuals, hand-crafted copper and gold pieces, and an immersive fairytale atmosphere. Challenge spirits across three difficulty levels — from casual fun to a serious test of skill.
Whether you're a beginner learning the game or a seasoned player looking for a quick match, this beautifully crafted chess experience is designed to captivate and challenge.

Available in 21 languages.

title: Mine Block Party: World of Minigames
description:
In this game you will plunge into the exciting world of mini-games!

- Competitive spirit: for every victory you receive cups and coins, which you can spend on buying new skins or improving your character. Fight for the championship and become the most skilled player!

- Variety of skins: the ability to choose any skin, which includes characters from popular games, cartoons, as well as famous YouTubers. Let your character look the way you want!

- Variety of modes: the possibility to choose one of three modes, in one of which you will have to try your luck and choose the right path, and in the other you will have to show your dexterity and wit!

- Character upgrade: upgrade your character’s skills, making him faster and more agile in battles. Each victory brings not only pleasure, but also the opportunity to improve your hero.

Can you become the best in this game? Embark on an exciting adventure with your favorite characters!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: Mini-games with block-style gameplay similar to Minecraft.

Q: What is the game's unique feature? How can it hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of games, unique skins, character progression, and rewards like cups and coins for each victory.

Q: Are there any currencies and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features coins and diamonds as currencies, which can be spent on skins and character upgrades.

Q: What is the leveling up process like? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to earn more money for purchasing upgrades by playing more and winning!

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game makes references to the world of Minecraft.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers various skins for customization.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for progression.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.

A: The entire game is a collection of mini-games.

title: Blockadventure io
description:
🌍 Welcome to BlockAdventure!

Dive into the thrilling world of BlockAdventure, a Minecraft-inspired online multiplayer experience packed with parkour challenges, obby adventures, and endless fun! Explore blocky worlds, compete with other players, and push your skills to the limit. Whether you’re jumping across floating platforms or racing through tricky maps, there’s always something exciting to do.

title: Animal Care Tycoon
description:
Welcome to Animal Care Tycoon 🐾🏥, where the city depends on you and adorable animals need your care 💖

Build and manage your own idle animal hospital, starting from a small treatment room and turning it into the biggest veterinary center in the city 🏙️💰 Heal fluffy patients, earn coins, unlock powerful medicine, and upgrade modern equipment to save animals faster and better ⚕️✨

Become the ultimate pet doctor 🐶🐱 Treat cats, dogs, sheep, and even exotic animals like zebras 🦓 Every patient arrives with a unique problem such as colds, viruses, fractures, and more 🤒🦴 Unlock advanced tools, discover new treatments, and make sure every animal gets the love it deserves 💊❤️

Hire professional vet doctors and skilled staff to keep your hospital running smoothly 👩‍⚕️👨‍⚕️ The more rooms you unlock, the more animals you can help, and the more gold you earn 🪙🚀 Managing a growing animal hospital is a real challenge, but true animal lovers will enjoy every moment 🐾

title: Cooking Letters - Word Search
description:

title: Sling Kong
