title: Food Tower Defense
description: 🍔 Welcome to Food Tower Defense – The Tastiest Tower Defense Ever! 🍕🍟 Prepare your appetite and sharpen your strategy because Food Tower Defense is here to serve you the most delicious tower defense experience ever! 🍴😋 In this mouth-watering adventure, your mission is simple but savory: defend your kitchen kingdom 🍽️ from waves of hungry invaders determined to steal your scrumptious stash of food! As the head chef and master tactician 👨‍🍳🧠, it’s your job to build, upgrade, and strategically position an army of powerful food towers — each with its own unique flavor and attack style! From explosive burgers to slippery bananas, every tower brings something special to the table. 🍔🍌💥 🎯 Your Mission: Protect the Feast! The hungry hordes are coming! 😱 Waves of greedy food thieves, ravenous creatures, and snack-hungry monsters are marching toward your kitchen. You’ll need to plan your defenses carefully, combining different food towers to maximize power and coverage. Experiment with combos 🍕+🍟+🍗 to find your perfect recipe for victory! Each battle is a blend of strategy, timing, and chaos — and every victory tastes even sweeter when you pull it off perfectly! 🍰🏆 ⚙️ Key Features and Tasty Towers 🍴 🍔 Burger Mortar – Launch explosive burgers that deal massive splash damage 💥. Huge range, huge flavor, huge BOOM! 🔥 BBQ Burst – Spray sizzling BBQ bits at high speed! Medium range, rapid rate, and a mouthful of firepower! 🔥 🍟 Fries Shooter – Rapid-fire french fries that rain down on enemies like crispy golden bullets ⚡🍟. 🌭 HotDog Sniper – Precision hotdog shots with high pierce damage! Snipe enemies from afar 🎯🌭. 🍪 Cookie Roll – Rolling cookie boulders crush everything in their path 🍪💨. Perfect for crowd control! 🦃 Turkey Wall – Summon a mighty turkey barrier 🧱🦃 that halts invaders while dealing damage over time. 🍕 Pizza 360° – Spin and fire pizza slices in every direction 🍕🍕🍕! Great for when enemies surround you! 🧀 Nachos Spread – Unleash a V-shot of nachos 🔺🧀 for rapid mid-range coverage. Cheesy and deadly! 🍅 Ketchup Laser – Continuous ketchup beam that burns enemies with spicy precision 🔴💫. 🍌 Banana Slip – Toss banana peels to make enemies slip, slow down, and even crash into each other 😆🍌. 🏰 Classic Mode: Defend your base from endless waves of food raiders! 💡 Strategy Meets Flavor Mix and match towers to discover powerful combo effects — like BBQ + Fries = Sizzling Combo Bonus! 🔥🍟 Upgrade your towers, unlock rare recipes, and customize your defense style. Whether you prefer long-range sniping or all-out sauce mayhem, there’s a perfect build for every chef-defender! 👩‍🍳⚔️ 🎨 Visuals & Atmosphere Enjoy colorful, cartoon-style graphics 🍭, smooth animations, and deliciously detailed food towers that look good enough to eat (but don’t, please 😅). Every battle is a feast for your eyes — from gooey cheese explosions 🧀💥 to rivers of ketchup lasers 🍅⚡. Earn coins 💰, gather ingredients 🥕, and upgrade your towers to unlock legendary recipes and secret sauces! 🎮 Why You’ll Love Food Tower Defense ✔️ Addictive tower defense gameplay with a tasty twist 🍕 ✔️ Over 10 unique food towers, each with upgrade paths and combos ✔️ Vibrant, food-filled worlds and creative enemy designs 🍩👾 ✔️ Fun sound effects and sizzling action! 🔊 Ready to defend your kitchen from the hungry hordes? 👊🍔 Build your defenses, cook up chaos, and serve defeat to your enemies in Food Tower Defense — the most flavorful tower defense game ever made! 🌶️🎮

title: Draw And Save The Stickman
description: Draw And Save The Stickman is a fun and addictive puzzle game where your creativity is the key to victory! Draw lines, shapes, and barriers to protect the stickman from dangerous traps, falling rocks, sharp spikes, enemies, and unexpected obstacles. Every level presents a unique challenge that tests your logic, imagination, and problem-solving skills. Think carefully before drawing because every line matters. Use your drawing skills wisely to create the perfect defense and keep the stickman safe. As you progress, puzzles become more challenging, requiring smarter strategies and more creative solutions.

title: Stack Ball 3D
description: Break through countless platforms with the ball, but avoid hitting black spots or you'll lose. Try to hit as many platforms as you can to gain speedboost and become unstoppable

title: Chef Tycoon
description:
Chef Tycoon, a free chef game online where you manage your own restaurant, prepare delicious dishes, and serve customers under time pressure. This cooking tycoon experience blends fast-paced food preparation with smart business upgrades, turning every shift into a rewarding management challenge.

Start with a small setup, serve efficiently, earn profits, and grow your culinary empire step by step. As your restaurant expands, smarter decisions and better workflow management become the key to long-term success.

title: Supermarket Empire
description: Supermarket Empire is a simulation game where you become the master of your own retail kingdom! Take charge of managing and growing your supermarket as you aim to build a thriving empire. Earn money and expand your store by offering a wide range of products that cater to the needs of your customers!

title: Yatzy
description: Yatzy is the ultimate classic dice game that brings endless fun and excitement! Experience the thrill of rolling five dice to score the best combinations and outsmart your opponents. Whether you're a casual player or a Yatzy master, this game is perfect for you! Similar to games like Yacht and Yahtzee, Yatzy combines elements of strategy and luck, making it both challenging and entertaining. Whether aiming for a 🎲 Full House, a 📏 Straight, or the elusive 🏆 Yatzy (five of a kind), each roll offers a new opportunity to outscore your opponents.

title: Merge number up
description:
Number Click Merge is a simple yet highly addictive number puzzle game that challenges your logic and observation skills.

Tap on groups of the same number to merge them into a higher number! The more blocks you merge in one move, the more points you earn. As numbers grow, the board becomes more strategic — plan carefully to keep the combos going!

title: 4 Clues 1 Word
description:
Think you’re a master of language? Put your lateral thinking to the test with 4 Clues 1 Word, the word puzzle game that goes beyond the surface. Most games ask you to find a simple object; we ask you to find the hidden connection between worlds.

Whether it’s the Stock in a financial market, a pot of Stock on a stove, or the Stock in a warehouse—your job is to find the one word that rules them all. Featuring stunning, high-definition photography and curated levels ranging from "Casual" to "Mind-Bending," 4 Clues 1 Word is designed for the curious, the clever, and the linguistically brave.

It’s not just a game; it’s a workout for your synapses. Can you see the pattern?

title: Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!
description:
Welcome to "Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!" - an exciting action game with a sword, where you fight against an army of monsters! Get ready for an epic battle and test your agility and blade skill. Survive in the monsters' lair and become a real sword master!

🎮 A game inspired by popular projects such as "War of the Knights: Sword Arena Battle 3D", "Sword Master: Slash Enemies!" and "Swing Sword: Slash Enemies into Pieces!" Here you will find a mix of the themes of "poppy playtime", "rainbow friends", "hagi wagi", "repo" and the atmosphere of the "Dendy World"!

⚔️ Game Features:
- Simple and clear controls
- Stylish 3D graphics in retro dandy and repo style
- Exciting gameplay with chopping enemies
- Various levels and enemy characters
- A large selection of sword skins
- A leaderboard where you can compete with friends

⚡ Ready to join the fight? Then take your sword and start the battle with monsters!

title: Stick Doors and Island
description:
Stranded on a deserted island... or trapped in a locked room – what escape route will you choose?
In this escape game, you're given multiple options to break free – but not all of them will lead to success. Some are clever, some are risky, and others... might just lead to failure.

Find all the successful ways to escape – whether you're solving puzzles in a room or surviving on an island.
Test your logic, think outside the box, and uncover the one true path to freedom.

Will you make it out? Good luck – your escape begins now.

title: Cannon Balls
description: Try to be the master of destruction, heat up the buildings neatly and show no mercy! In 'Cannon Balls 3D' it depends on how skillfully you place the shots so that the structures collapse as efficiently as possible. Watch your ammo, because it's limited. But don't worry. There will also come a time when you will bring the cannon to the edge of functionality. Especially when the great bombs are used. So what are you waiting for?

title: Maths Puzzle
description: Maths Puzzle is a fun and engaging logic-based game that challenges your mathematical skills and problem-solving abilities. With a variety of puzzles that range in difficulty, this game is perfect for anyone looking to improve their mental agility and enjoy a fun, educational experience. Your task is to solve mathematical equations by figuring out the missing numbers, symbols, or operations in order to make both sides of the equation equal. The puzzles come with increasing complexity, so you’ll need both strategy and quick thinking to succeed.

title: Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco!
description:
🎵 The game "Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco!" offers a unique combination of cute cat meows and exciting pop music rhythms. Play along to a variety of popular tunes, including worldwide hits, and enjoy gorgeous visuals and kawaii design!

⭐ Main Features ⭐
- A large selection of popular hits!
- Remixes of popular tracks with a fun "meow"!
- Easy one-touch screen control!

title: Animal Hospital
description:
There's a queue of patients outside the reception window — but after midnight, it isn't only sick animals that come to town.

Some of them are only pretending to be a cat, a dog, or a rabbit: an extra eye, the wrong coat color, a smile that's a little too human, a shadow that shouldn't be there, a voice that's subtly wrong.

Your job is to tell a real patient from an anomaly using nothing but a photo and their paperwork. Let your own kind in and heal them; keep the others off the threshold. Every animal you admit has to be led to a ward and treated through mini-games — and in between, you'll need to run the generator, check the cages, and keep an eye on the security cameras. All of it without losing your mind, and without looking where you shouldn't.

Every shift gets darker, the anomalies grow more numerous, and something that was only pretending to be a patient begins to roam the clinic's corridors. Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Will you live to see the dawn?

title: Police Car Simulator Game Criminal Case
description: Step into the world of law enforcement with the Police Game. The Ultimate Cop Simulator, the ultimate combination of police parking, racing, open-world exploration, and crime-fighting missions. Experience the life of a real officer from learning in the police training academy to chasing down dangerous criminals in the streets. This is not just a police simulator, it’s a full city experience that gives you freedom, control, and thrill in every mode.

title: Water Sort Master: Color Puzzle

⚔️ Survival and Defense:
Gather weapons, avoid traps, and seek shelter.

title: Car Sales Empire Simulator
description:
Step into the dynamic realm of Car Sales Empire Simulator, where you can build a successful automotive business. Master car trading and repairs, hone your strategy, and enjoy smooth gameplay on any device while fostering your enterprise and enjoying thrilling negotiations.

Controls:
Desktop: WASD, arrow keys, click mouse to select an option, C to crouch.  
Mobile: built-in joystick, tap to select an option.

Game Modes:
• Graphics: Low: A less resource-intensive mode for the device, with fewer details, nuances, and volume in light-shadow rendering.  
• Graphics: High: A deeper contrast of light and shadow, more details, and greater load on the device.

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Buy cars and upgrade them to sell later. The higher the sales, the more opportunities arise. It's a great chance to showcase creativity by choosing designs and tuning, improve your online driving skills by maneuvering cars through the city without accidents, and develop the best sales strategy to expand your dealership.

Mechanics & Progression

A: As you play, more opportunities arise to purchase more expensive cars and parts. There’s always a chance to find a true rare gem of the automotive industry.

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Lower the price when buying to maximize your profit from deals.

Economy & Customization

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily quests / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Complete quests and earn rewards in the form of in-game dollars to buy the most interesting cars faster.

title: TRAFFIC JAM ESCAPE 3D
description:
Clear the roads in Traffic Jam Escape 3D! Solve challenging traffic puzzles, free cars from gridlock, and master the art of strategic driving.

Get ready to play Traffic Jam Escape 3D, the addictive mobile traffic puzzle game where you control chaotic city streets and free cars from gridlock! Every second counts - one smart move can clear the road, one mistake can block it forever. Are you skilled enough to guide every car out of the jam?

In Traffic Jam Escape 3D, your goal is simple but challenging: tap cars, follow the arrows, and plan their path to freedom. Avoid collisions, dodge obstacles, and keep traffic moving smoothly. With each level, timing and strategy become even more important - one wrong move could create a crash and block the way.

Every stage offers a brand-new challenge. You’ll need to think ahead, plan the order of moves, and figure out the best escape route for each vehicle. From narrow alleys to busy intersections, the puzzles get tougher and more exciting as you progress.

Featuring a wide variety of vehicles - from tiny cars to large trucks - you’ll need to adapt your strategy to guide each one safely out of the mess. The more you play, the sharper your skills become as you conquer increasingly complex traffic jams.

Key Features of Traffic Jam Escape 3D:
Challenging traffic jam escape puzzles at every level
Intuitive tap-and-guide controls for all ages
Dynamic gameplay with busy intersections, narrow roads, and tricky obstacles
Dozens of levels with increasing difficulty to keep you hooked
Vibrant graphics and realistic sound effects for an immersive experience
Traffic Jam Escape isn’t just about clearing the streets—it’s about mastering the art of smart maneuvering. Dodge oncoming traffic, weave through tight spaces, and avoid obstacles at every turn. With dozens of levels to conquer, the game offers a constant challenge and endless fun.

Whether you’re solving quick car escape puzzles on the go or tackling more complex jam-packed streets at home, Traffic Jam Escape 3D delivers nonstop excitement and tests your problem-solving skills.

Ready to test your reflexes and strategic thinking? Take the driver’s seat in Traffic Jam Escape 3D today and see if you can clear the roads and guide every car to safety. Play now and experience the thrill of escaping the traffic jams!

title: Snake Wiggle Master!

Looking for a fun snake maze game that’s easy to start but keeps you thinking?

In Snake Wiggle Master!, you guide a snake through clever mazes where one smart move can open the whole path.

Move your snake through tight corridors, plan the right order, and race against the clock. ⏰ The challenge comes from thinking fast but smart. Some paths look safe at first, but one wrong move can block the maze completely. Choose carefully, move efficiently, and clear the level before time runs out. ✨

title: Basket Sport Stars
description:
Basket Sport Stars brings fast, playful basketball matches to colorful courts filled with unpredictable moments. Choose a character, challenge a computer-controlled rival, or share the keyboard with a friend in local 2-player mode. Move into position, time your jump, aim carefully, and score as many baskets as possible before the final buzzer.

Every match is short enough to start quickly but competitive enough to demand focus. A well-timed shot can put you ahead, while a successful attack may force your opponent to lose possession. With different characters, changing arenas, several game modes, and useful power-ups, no two matches feel exactly the same.

Choose Your Game Mode
Quick Match sends you straight into a 90-second basketball battle. The player with the most points when time runs out wins. It is the best mode for learning the basics or enjoying a fast match without a longer commitment.

Tournament Mode places you into a competitive bracket against several opponents. Win each round, adapt to different characters and courts, and continue advancing until you reach the final match.

Practice Mode gives you room to learn movement, shooting, and attack timing. Use it to test jump shots, understand the aiming guide, and become more comfortable with the controls before entering harder matches.

2 Player Mode lets two players compete locally on the same keyboard. Challenge a friend, fight for possession, and find out who can score more baskets before the buzzer.

Master the Shooting System
Jump to reach the ball, then hold the shooting control to aim toward the opposing basket. A dotted trajectory line shows where the ball is expected to travel. Watch the line closely and release at the right moment for a more accurate attempt.

The aiming indicator briefly turns green when the shot has a strong chance of reaching the hoop. This window does not stay open for long, so successful shooting depends on quick reactions and controlled timing rather than pressing the button as fast as possible.

Attack and Take Possession
Basketball is not only about shooting. When your opponent controls the ball, move close and use the attack button to weaken their grip. After enough successful hits, the rival drops the ball and gives you a chance to take possession.

Attacking without a plan can leave your basket unprotected. Try to pressure the opponent when they are preparing a shot or moving into a dangerous position, then return quickly before they recover.

Collect and Use Gift Boxes
A flying gift box may appear during a match. Jump to collect it and save the reward for the right opportunity. Activating the gift launches a rocket across the court that can stun the opposing player and interrupt their attack.

The rocket can also become a threat when your rival uses one. Watch its direction and jump over it to avoid being stunned. A well-timed gift can change the score, especially during the final seconds of a close match.

Key Features
- Fast arcade-style basketball matches
- Single-player and local 2-player gameplay
- Quick Match, Tournament, Practice, and 2 Player modes
- Competitive 90-second rounds
- Different characters and colorful basketball courts
- Timing-based aiming and shooting system
- Attacks that can force opponents to drop the ball
- Gift boxes with special rocket power-ups
- Simple keyboard controls for both players
- Short matches designed for repeated play

Tips for Beginners
- Start in Practice Mode to learn how long to hold the shooting button.
- Release the ball when the aiming guide gives you a clear trajectory.
- Stay between your opponent and the basket when defending.
- Do not attack constantly; wait until you are close enough to connect.
- Collect gift boxes whenever the court is safe.
- Keep watching the timer during close matches.

Advanced Tips
- Use short jumps to control possession instead of always attempting a shot.
- Attack just before the opponent releases the ball to disrupt their timing.
- Save a rocket gift for a dangerous attack or the final seconds of the match.
- Change your shooting position so the opponent cannot predict every attempt.
- After stealing the ball, create space before aiming at the basket.
- In tournaments, adjust your strategy to each opponent instead of repeating the same moves.

Common Mistakes
- Releasing every shot before the aiming line is properly aligned.
- Standing too close to the opponent while trying to aim.
- Ignoring defense after taking an early lead.
- Using gift rewards immediately without checking the rival's position.
- Chasing the ball and leaving the basket completely open.
- Forgetting that the match can be decided in the final few seconds.

Become the Court Star
Basket Sport Stars combines accessible controls with quick competitive matches, accurate shooting, defensive attacks, and unexpected power-ups. Practice your timing, choose the right moment to challenge your opponent, and work your way through the tournament. Whether you compete against the CPU or face a friend on the same keyboard, every match offers another chance to become the star of the court.

title: Pop The Band

Pop the Band is a satisfying 3D puzzle game where colorful rubber bands are wrapped tight around delicious snacks — eggs, donuts, burgers, watermelons and 40+ more! Your job: pop them all off, one by one.

But there's a catch — a band can only snap free when nothing is crossing over it. Study the tangle, spin the snack around, and pop the bands in the right order. Tap wrong three times and the puzzle resets, so look before you snap!

FEATURES

🍩 48 tasty 3D puzzles that get trickier as you go — from 3 bands to a 10-band mega-tangle
✂️ Bands cut right where you tap and flop off with real rubbery physics

Easy to pick up, tough to put down — how far can you untangle? Pop every band!

title: OIL RIG Driller
description: Drill Tycoon is a top-down idle tycoon set in a sun-baked desert oil field. Sink your rigs, haul the crude to the refinery, stack the barrels in your yard and sell them to the trucks rolling in on the loading road. Reinvest every dollar: faster rigs, a bigger depot, and a hired crew that keeps drilling while you are offline. Unlock gas, gold and finally diamonds, each with its own rig, plant and price. What sets it apart from the usual idle game: your crew works to real demand instead of just the nearest target, and your rigs wear down and need maintenance, so the field never quite runs itself.

title: Warrior Bee Apocalypse
description:
Warrior Bee Apocalypse is an action and upgrade game.
The warrior bee faces hordes of enemy insects to survive.
Collecting diamonds to improve your items and skills.

title: Capybara Let's Go: Zombie Rush
description:
Welcome to a relaxing casual game that combines merge gameplay and strategic auto battles!
Start your journey with a group of adorable pets. Drag and place them on the battlefield, and merge two pets of the same level to get stronger upgraded ones. You can refresh the pet pool to get new companions and plan your layout carefully to make the most of limited space.
Once your team is ready, start the battle! All pets will attack enemies automatically. As you clear foes, your team will level up and unlock random powerful skills, including damage boost, critical strike, healing and area attacks. Choose skills wisely to build your unique team.
Advance through dozens of regular stages, challenge tough Boss levels and explore surprise bonus stages for rich rewards. Collect more styles of cute pets, raise and star them up to unlock greater power.
Easy to pick up, fun to master! Experience endless joy with pet merging, strategic layout and exciting battles right now!

title: Money cutter idle
description: Money Maker Idle is a satisfying idle game where you grow your cash flow by merging money, unlocking higher bills, and expanding your earnings row by row. Start small, combine bills, and watch your money maker evolve into a fast-moving wealth machine. Every merge brings stronger value, every upgrade pushes your income further, and every tap helps speed up your path from basic cash to massive fortune.

title: PLAYMUSIC
description:
PlayMusic turns your favorite songs into a living, reactive game world where every beat shapes the action. Dodge obstacles, collect gems, and stay alive as the rhythm intensifies around you. Run, jump, fly, drift, and shoot your way through dynamic environments that pulse with the music. Stay in the zone, keep the groove alive, and master the rhythm to survive.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It is a collection of runners with a lot of licensed music that is constantly updated. Each runner features one super popular track.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, just enjoy your favorite music while playing the runner.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The huge library of licensed music. A vast variety of runners and music games.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: There are no bosses, but the game's difficulty adapts to the music and player's skill.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are no currencies, everything is available from the start.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: There is no leveling up, only the player's skill grows.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?
A: There are no in-game purchases, everything is available from the start with soft monetization through ads.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are leaderboards, you need to complete runner-songs and earn points.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A wide range of licensed and popular music.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Each song-game has its own hero.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Regular updates to games and songs.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Playing with sound is a must, it's the game's unique feature. There is a lot of good and licensed music.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: A huge variety of musical and rhythm games.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (skip if unclear)
A: The number of levels constantly increases.

title: Daddy Escape
description:
Get ready for an Epic Puzzle adventure like no other! Daddy Escape - Pull the Pin is here to challenge your wits, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Help Daddy make his daring escape by pulling the right pins and overcoming a series of mind-bending obstacles.

Who is Daddy? Well, he's not your ordinary dad! Daddy is an adventurous and fearless explorer who always finds himself in tricky situations. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to guide Daddy through a maze of perilous traps, ingenious contraptions, and devious puzzles. Can you lead Daddy to safety?

title: Draw Bridge: Puzzle Challenge
StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction
description:
Experience the ultimate car destruction mayhem! 

In "StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction", you have complete freedom in a vast open world environment. Wreck cars in spectacular ways – watch parts fly off, witness realistic damage, and see wheels go flying in epic crashes.

Key Features:
- Advanced car customization options
- Full exterior customization
- Wheel and suspension tuning
- Destruction tools galore
- Interactive press and ramp areas
- Dynamic traffic simulation
- Realistic damage physics

Explore, destroy, and create your own challenges in this ultimate car destruction playground!

title: Rune Reactor
description:
Rune Reactor is a spell-building auto-battler where every rune changes your magic. Draft elemental and modifier runes,
combine them into powerful spells, and survive increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Collect gold and Arcane Dust,
discover rare combinations, defeat bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades for future runs.

title: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing
description:
Immerse yourself in Ragdoll boxing chaos and fun with Obby!

This is a unique simulator that combines ragdoll physics and crazy fights! Here you control not just a fighter, but a real rag doll, who will have to go through trials in the arena, in training and in improvised fights. Funny animation, unpredictable behavior and collision physics turn every fight into an exciting spectacle.

Create your own character, explore locations and prove who is the best boxer among Obby fighters. Control punches, dodge and hit with precise calculation - or just enjoy the chaotic fun, watching your characters fly around the arena.

🔑 Key features of the game:
🥊 Ragdoll physics - every hit is unpredictable
🎮 Simple controls with deep gameplay
🧍 Character customization
🧠 Elements of strategy and reaction
😂 Fun and unexpected situations in every fight
🌍 Various locations and arenas for battles

title: Poker Clicker
description: Unlock upgrades and rare cards to collect, with over 60+ achievements to get in this idle clicker game about racking up chips by playing cards.

title: Kingdom Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in this epic online tower defense strategy game! Command warriors, cast spells, and battle fantasy monsters. Build your army and lead the conquest - action and adventure await!

title: Kingdom Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in this epic online tower defense strategy game! Command warriors, cast spells, and battle fantasy monsters. Build your army and lead the conquest - action and adventure await!

title: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description:
Liquid Puzzle is a color game to fill each glass with one colored water to complete each level. Start sorting colored water!
Rearrange the contents of the glasses so that each ends up filled with only one color. Sorting must follow logical constraints you typically can only pour into a glass if the colors match at the top and there’s enough room

title: Find Brainrot Obby
description:
This is an obby game about exploration, strange places, and unexpected discoveries.
Brainrots are hidden everywhere — on rooftops, under platforms, behind walls, and in the most unexpected spots.

There is no right path here.
If something looks strange, it probably hides something.

Explore the world, beat the obbies, discover secrets, and collect all Brainrots.
Can you see all the absurdity this world has to offer?

title: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang
description:
Meet Kalulu — your new favorite mukbang streamer! Make delicious desserts, host ASMR streams, and win over your viewers' hearts!

🍓 Create crunchy Tanghulu
Skewer juicy berries, dip them in sugar syrup, and enjoy the perfect crunch! Experiment with strawberries, grapes, and other treats to create the most beautiful Tanghulu.

🧋 Make refreshing Boba Tea
Mix aromatic tea, add tapioca pearls, and create drinks that will delight your audience!

🎥 Host ASMR Mukbang streams
Go live and watch Kalulu eat the dishes you prepared! The relaxing eating sounds will help attract more viewers. Fulfill their requests and receive donations!

🎨 Customize everything around you
Create the perfect streaming space: choose wallpapers for the room, change the desk, and pick out stylish outfits for Kalulu. Make your studio look cozy and vibrant!

Join the relaxing world of mukbang with the cute Kalulu!

title: Jim's World: Adventure Games
description:
Jim's World gives you the chance to step back in time to your childhood with the legendary challenge in the adventure game: Princess Rescue. The World of this Game - a totally new old-school running game, contains well-designed levels, various enemies, super bosses, simple gameplay, excellent graphics, and soothing music and sounds.
Jim's World has been nothing and empty since the Princess got kidnapped into the jungle. But then, the adventure begins!
Your task is to help Jim run through the mysterious jungle, jump over the obstacles and super evil monsters, and save the beautiful Princess at the adventure's final destination

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you''ll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Pickaxe Crusher Idle
description:
Dive into the thrilling world of underground mines in Pickaxe Crusher Idle. Play as a daring miner with a bouncing pickaxe, dashing left and right to explore deeper and deeper into the caves.
Collect resources, unlock new tools such as axes, arrows, swords, and more, and upgrade your skills to become a true master of mining.
Use talents and upgrades to accelerate your progress, unlock achievements, and advance through the prestige system. Each descent into the depths brings new opportunities, challenges, and valuable treasures.
Are you ready to venture into the abyss and become a mining legend?

title: Obby +1 Power!
description:
In the game, you enter the exciting world of fitness and bodybuilding! Start your journey to muscular glory from scratch by clicking to perform exercises and build up your muscles. Use your skills and strategies to become the strongest bodybuilder in the game!

The gameplay of the game is simple and exciting. Your task is to click the mouse to complete the exercises and upgrade your character. The more you click, the more experience and resources you gain to improve your stats and win competitions.

Join us and prove that you deserve to be the strongest bodybuilder in this exciting world of fitness and competition!

title: Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!
description:
⚔️ Welcome to "Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!" - a fun 3D physics arena where ragdoll opponents fight in funny fights! Push, throw and knock enemies off the platform to be the only one left standing. This battle royale is a real epic action with falls, collisions and pushes!

🔥 Inspired by the popular hits "Epic Sword Fight! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!" and "Balance Duel: Physics Action", this game combines simple mechanics, playground dynamics, and a lot of fun!

♥️ Don't forget to leave a review and share your impressions to help us improve the game!

Game features:
- Beautiful and pleasant 3D graphics
- Simple one-finger control
- Fun short levels in the style of shorts and reels
- Funny ragdoll physics
- Online leaderboard
- The game is available online for free on PC and mobile devices

🎯 Become a legend of the ragdoll arena - throw off all enemies and become a winner!

title: Tile Farm Story
description:
The game "Tile Farm Story" is an exciting and challenging adventure that you won't be able to put down!
This chip collecting game will allow you to take a fresh look at the traditional rules of mahjong and test your Puzzle Master skills!

Hundreds of exciting levels, a rich history of the Stone sisters and colorful places that you will visit will help you relax and at the same time train your brain by solving many puzzles presented in the game. You won't notice how time flies!

Game Features:
- diverse and colorful locations in the most amazing corners of the world
- hundreds of exciting levels based on the mechanics of collecting chips
- many useful boosters to help you progress
- a rich plot with surprising twists and turns
- many unique animals with bright characters and funny animations
- an opportunity to train your thinking skills and relax in the company of an exciting game that combines mahjong traditions and new mechanics

title: Block Shooter: Shoot the Blocks!
description:
Destroy blocks with an ever-growing arsenal of powerful weapons. Earn coins, unlock new guns, and upgrade them to deal even more damage.

Level up each weapon with unique upgrade cards. Once it reaches Level 10, it keeps firing automatically while you use to another weapon.

Build the ultimate arsenal and destroy blocks faster than ever.

title: Summer Shore Hustle
description:
Earn some money in this summer to relax in next coming summer!!

What to do ?
You run out of the money this summer so you decided to run a shop on the beach to earn some money! so that you can relax in the upcoming summer :)

How to Play ?
Play in game tutorial to find it out :)


Note from Developer:
Nothing :) (hope you liked the game)

Team Members:
JADU : Programmer and Developer 
Rahul : Artist and designer

title: Donut Art: Puzzle Diamond Game
description:
Welcome to sweet food puzzle sorting games adventure where colorful donut sort bring pictures to life! In diamond art puzzle, every level invites you to brilliant food sort puzzle tasty donut numbers by color match pair and place them in the right spot to reveal beautiful pixel-style artwork. The more food diamond paint match you arrange, the more the hidden picture appears piece by piece to maintan donut flow.

The gameplay is simple and satisfying. A shelf filled with mixed brilliant food waits to be organized. Move donuts of the same color together, clear space, and complete the pattern to finish the artwork. Each correct placement slowly reveals charming scenes, cute characters, and delightful designs made entirely from donut diamond sorting.

Hundreds of creative pictures are waiting to be completed. From playful treats to fun shapes and bright patterns, every puzzle feels rewarding as the image forms from your donut sort puzzle. New artwork keeps the experience fresh and exciting.

Food sorting game like diamond art blends relaxing puzzle solving with color match pair creativity. The early puzzles feel smooth and enjoyable, while later challenges encourage smart diamond sorting and careful planning. Watching a vibrant number of donut flow picture appear from a shelf of scattered pieces creates a calming and satisfying donut sort food diamond paint.

Sort the donuts, reveal the art, and enjoy a delightful food journey full of color and sweetnes sorting games

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description:
Hyper Cars Ramp Crash is a 3D driving stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. Perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great-looking cars. There are seven different super-sport car models in the garage, waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt mode, and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-players. You can also drive freely in Free Style mode. Have fun with these fantastic-looking cars!

Features
Realistic car crash physics (Cars get crushed and smashed)
Customize option for cars
1 Player Mode and 2 Players Mode available
Realistic car interior camera
Drive freely and perform stunts in Free Style mode
Crazy Fall Break mode!
Side Road, Forest, Ocean, Desert Stunt Modes
Race against time with Time Trial mode
Unique damage machines in modes


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: A racing game with juicy gameplay.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline, but the goals and tasks in the game are clear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: Stunning graphics, cool cars, lots of diverse challenges and game modes.

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Yes, two currencies, spent on customization.

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Gorgeous cars, well-designed and constructed tracks.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change the car beyond recognition.

Economy & Customization

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Sound is not mandatory, but the music is luxurious, and the car sounds are fantastic.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Does the game happen in real-time or asynchronously?
A: In real-time.

Multiplayer

Q: Can you play with friends?
A: Local multiplayer.

Q: What is the room size, how many players play simultaneously?
A: Local multiplayer for 2 players.

title: Rift of Hell - Demons War
description: Rift of Hell - Demons War is a fast-paced action game where players face off against waves of demons in a hellish setting. Equip powerful weapons and upgrade your abilities while collecting gold to survive intense battles. Play online for free and conquer the darkness!

title: Happy Glass - Draw to Fill
description: Happy Glass: Draw to Fill is a creative and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to fill a happy glass with water — but there's a twist! You must draw lines and shapes to guide the water flow into the glass. Think strategically, draw creatively, and use physics to your advantage as you solve increasingly challenging levels. The game features colorful visuals, satisfying animations, and a joyful glass that smiles only when full. Whether you're a fan of brain teasers or just love doodling your way through clever puzzles, this game is sure to entertain and test your ingenuity.

title: Draw path to home
description:
«Draw path to home» is a casual puzzle game in which you need to help your characters get to the house by drawing lines! Gather a collection of heroes (Nubik, Huggy Wuggy, Rainbow Friends, Cat Juan and others).

Waiting for you in the game:
🍿 Fun and entertaining process with different difficulty levels
🎁 Lots of bonuses and gifts
🎭 Lively and interesting characters
🎵 Nice and atmospheric music
🐱‍👤 Unique Enemies

Learn to draw lines creatively, develop logic and develop your brain!

title: Monster Makeup 3D
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Monster Makeup 3D, where you can creatively disguise monsters as humans to hide them from prying eyes. Use various tools to change their features seamlessly, but be cautious—one mistake could backfire! Enjoy this free online game on any device.

title: Animal Transform Race
description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Escape Police for Brainrots
description:
Run from the police, collect Brainrots, and gradually improve your speed.
Run across the map, avoid obstacles, and don’t get caught by the police.
The farther you run, the higher your progress becomes and the better your Brainrots get.
Unlock new possibilities, expand your Brainrot base, and try to run as far as possible!

title: Block Builder Jam
description:
Block Builder Jam is a new puzzle game that will test your logical thinking and creativity! 
This game will captivate you with its unique gameplay, which makes full use of physics simulation.

title: Summer Rider 3D
description:
Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and competitive players.

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what are the main objectives?
A: It's an arcade game where you surf and have to overcome various obstacles on your board.

Q: Is there a story or narrative arc?
A: There is no storyline; the objective is to avoid crashing your surfboard while navigating around rocks, waterfalls, and a lot of dangerous obstacles.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? What makes it appealing to players?
A: The game stands out because there are few similar surfing games. It features good graphics, enjoyable music, and many surfboard skins.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The very relaxing, summer-themed location.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available, and what are they used for (e.g., common - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game has one currency, ""Sea Stars,"" which can be used to purchase different surfboards.

Q: Is there any customization in the game? Can the character's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc., be adjusted?
A: Yes, you can buy clothes and different surfboard skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without sound make it difficult to progress?
A: The music is a nice addition for the atmosphere but is not essential for completing the levels

title: Color Brawls
description: Color Brawls is a thrilling online game where you compete using bright colors to defeat rivals. Play instantly on any device without downloads or sign-ups. Enjoy this fast-paced adventure anywhere, featuring various locations and unique challenges, perfect for those looking for a fun and engaging experience.

title: Ragdoll Fury
description:
You don't play a hero — you ARE the WEAPON! Grip the hilt, swing fast and tear through hordes of dummies. Every hit is driven by real ragdoll physics, sending enemies flying across the arena. Wield an arsenal of 15 blades and guns across five classes — from Knife and Katana to Sawn-off, Machine Gun and Grenade Launcher — with a premium Laser Blade and Minigun to unlock with gems. Many pack their own special move: ground slam, spin, dash, blade throw.

Each wave hits harder: armored robots, kamikaze bombers, shield bots
and towering bosses, while special waves throw hordes and gold rushes
at you. After every wave pick one of three roguelite upgrades — damage, crit, burn, freeze, chain explosions, knockback and dozens more. Chain the elements into combos (shatter, wildfire, detonation), and at wave 10 trigger your weapon's EVOLUTION. Ring out enemies, keep your combo alive and climb the leaderboard.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Join the ultimate puzzle challenge in Cube Drop Puzzle

Test your strategic thinking in this addictive game where you must drag and drop furniture-shaped blocks to match colors with their corresponding stick figures. Plan your moves carefully as you navigate limited space and increasingly complex levels. With its vibrant visuals and easy-to-learn mechanics, Cube Drop offers endless hours of brain-teasing fun!

Key Features:

Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Combine the best of block puzzles and color-matching games.
Challenging Levels: Navigate tricky layouts and test your problem-solving skills.
Intuitive Controls: Simply drag and drop to play!
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful graphics that bring each puzzle to life.
Progressive Difficulty: Start easy and work your way up to more challenging levels.
Ready to drop into the fun? Download Cube Drop Puzzle and start solving today!

title: Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish
description: This game is a physics-based puzzle experience that reimagines the bubble shooter genre. Built around a rotating hexagonal structure, each level challenges players to adapt to changing angles, motion, and gravity. With an ocean-themed visual style and a light narrative about a crab rescuing a clownfish, the game delivers a fresh combination of strategy, physics, and immersive design.

title: Zombie Derby 2
description: Zombie Derby 2 is a fast and fun driving game with zombies everywhere. Get in your car, run over the undead, and try to survive as long as you can. Use your fuel wisely - if you run out, the zombies will catch you. Collect upgrades, unlock new cars, and use nitro boosts to jump over hills and smash through big groups of zombies.

title: A deadly car crash
description:
Try this deadly descent—only 1% of people have ever made it.

Immerse yourself in a thrilling world of destruction and speed!
This game lets you control cars that crash with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can fly off with a powerful impact!

Create unique cars by changing the body color, parts, and adjusting the size and placement of the wheels. Meet other cars racing along the roads and compete in spectacular crashes. Enjoy crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action!

Realistic car destruction
Customization: color, wheels, and style
Vast open world
Unique crash test areas
Destroy, build, and race—create your own chaos on the road!

title: Tower Colour Crash
description:
Crash the Tower! Only the best crashers will be able to destroy all
towers in this 3D physics game. Try to let all towers collapse with
the amount of given balls. But you will only destroy the shapes
with the same colour as you ball. Use the powerful earthquake or
shotgun power ups, to create huge chain reactions, which will
lead into the towers destruction. Beautiful designed levels and
shapes will await you, so don’t waste any second and become
the greatest tower crasher of ‘em all!

title: Cats Block Puzzle
description:
Just drag and drop cats onto the puzzle board and see if you can make them all fit perfectly! 🧩 Each puzzle has its own unique shape and gets more challenging as you play, which will make your brain think differently. With every puzzle you solve, it gets more challenging. Will you be able to fit all the kitties? 😼

As you master each puzzle, you can collect adorable new cats to personalize your gameplay!

PUZZLE CATS FEATURES:

  PLAY WITH CUTE CATS
- Enjoy a variety of adorable cats like cute cats, fat cats, and even some angry cats! 😺
- Try to fit all the cats in the puzzle without upsetting them!

FUN BLOCK PUZZLES
- Challenge yourself with engaging block puzzles, but now with cute cats instead of regular blocks! 🐾
- Arrange the blocks to fit the board and move to the next level!

COLLECT NEW CATS
- Solve puzzles and level up 🎉
- Collect new cats as you progress in levels!
- Dress up your cats with cute costumes!

TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
- Improve your thinking and spatial reasoning with these shape-based puzzles 🧠
- Puzzles become tougher as you advance, keeping the challenge fresh!

title: Obby Sprunki: Pet World
description:
Obby Sprunki: Pet World is an epic adventure where each pet is more than a companion. They are the key to unlocking legendary kingdoms filled with secrets, challenges, and hidden treasures. Journey through ever-changing environments, forge deep bonds with your pets, and uncover the ancient forces that shape the world.

Features
- Dynamic challenges with traps, puzzles, and obstacles that change every playthrough
- Mythic progression as pets grow stronger and wiser, the more you journey together
- Solo mastery with levels that test your skill, creativity, and connection with your pets
- Mystical synergy by combining pet abilities to burn, freeze, and summon powerful winds
- Timeless mysteries waiting to be uncovered through ancient scripts and celestial puzzles

title: Funny Rescue Pet
description: Lica and Purry had an accident! Lica's house is on fire, and Purry is soak wet when she played inside the wall. How can it happen? Rescue them immediately and also give them some makeover!

title: CubeGate
description:
Puzzle-platformer inspired by portal-style test chambers. Move through clean sci-fi rooms, pick up glowing cubes and place them on pressure plates to power doors, bridges, and elevators. Every room is a mini-logic task: sometimes one cube isn’t enough, sometimes the order matters, and sometimes you’ll have to jump first, then power the gate.

Use your movement and your head: combine precise jumps with smart cube placement, watch where the cables go, and follow the energy lines to the exit. Short levels, clear goals, instant restarts — perfect for quick sessions.
Can you activate every gate and escape the chamber?

title: Darling Doll: DIY Paper Doll
description:
• Characters: We offer a large selection of famous model characters to choose from (from famous princesses to anime females).
• Experiment with different dress styles, haircuts, expressions, and skin tones.
• A wide range of accessories for your character!
• Customize your dolls with over 1000 pieces, and build your anime character, your avatar.

title: Ball Bounce: Try It
description: Ball Bounce is a casual game that is very fun and challenging. Your task is to guide the ball which continues to bounce towards the portal while passing through obstacles

title: Block Blast jewel puzzle
description:
Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle - Think Fast. Stack Smart. Rule the Leaderboard! Dive into Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle, the ultimate block puzzle game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling competition. Easy to play, hard to master - and impossible to stop playing! 
Game Features: 
Classic Mode: Relax and clear blocks endlessly at your own pace. 
Timer Mode: Race against time — think fast before the clock runs out! 
Level Mode: Conquer challenging stages that test your logic and precision. Smooth & Colorful Gameplay: Drag, drop, and fit blocks with satisfying visuals. 
Global Leaderboard: Compete with players worldwide — climb the ranks and prove your puzzle skills! 
 Perfect for All Ages: Simple mechanics, deep strategy — pure fun for everyone. If you love Tetris, Block Blast, or brain-training puzzle games, this one’s for you. Start stacking, clearing, and claiming your spot at the top today!

title: Nubiks build a defense vs zombies
description:
Nubiks build a defense vs zombies - This is a game for two players, or for playing solo and competing against other players. A whole world awaits! 15+ different modes within a single game, dozens of skins and blocks.
Team up with a friend or play alone. There are both co-op and single-player modes. Play in survival mode or sandbox. Do whatever you want in this game!

title: Squid Game
description:
In this game you will find the fun of all the games. We have collected the best and combined them into one whole. You will have to play all the popular games from the "Squid Game". However, remember: there should only be one winner left in the end.

All games are carefully recreated based on the original games. You will fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of each of them, enjoying all the game modes.

title: Shape Transform Race
description:
Shape Transform Race is a fun racing game that can be played in reaction-based 1 and 2 player game modes. You can play the game against bots or against your friend. Always be the fastest by choosing the right vehicle for the terrain! You can unlock new vehicles and characters with the coins you earn from the races.

Shape Transform Race Features:
Shape Transformation: Transform your character according to the terrain and proceed without slowing down.
Various Tracks: Each with different difficulties, fun and full of surprises.
Fast and Dynamic Gameplay: Determine your strategy, overcome obstacles with the right transformations.
Fun Competition: Race against your friends or artificial intelligence!

title: Slide Block Jam
description:
Slide Block Jam: The Ultimate Puzzle Adventure

Unleash your puzzle-solving skills in Slide Block Jam, the ultimate block puzzle game that will challenge your mind and keep you hooked for hours! In this captivating and strategically engaging game, your goal is simple: move colorful blocks to their matching colored doors to clear the way. However, each level introduces new obstacles and challenges, requiring you to think carefully and plan your moves to master every puzzle.

Endless Puzzles, Limitless Fun
Prepare yourself for puzzles designed to test both your logic and strategic thinking. As you progress, the levels become increasingly intricate and creative, keeping you engaged with new challenges at every turn. Whether you're sliding blocks to clear space or navigating through tough barriers, the thrill of solving each puzzle intensifies.

title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
description:
⚽ Welcome to “Obby Football Soccer 3D”!

An exciting multiplayer where real-time matches with other players await you! 🎮

Features:
⚡ Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends 👥 or random opponents.
🥅 Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero!
🌀 Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
🎨 Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium 🏟️.

👑 Go from rookie to champion! Prove that you are the best player ⚽ in the world of football and sport! 🚀

Build your team, compete in matches, score penalties, and enjoy dynamic online soccer! 🎉

title: Satisroom - Perfectly Organized
description:
Our game features relaxing mini-games for sorting, cleaning, packing and organizing - perfect for a break from everyday life.

You'll have to put things in perfect order in a variety of levels, from organizing cosmetics and furniture to packing and cooking. All this is accompanied by a pleasant ASMR-atmosphere, creating an effect of complete peace.

New levels are waiting for you every week to keep enjoying the process and develop your organizing skill.

title: MFPS:Military Combat
description:
Engage in gunfights, survive the chaos, eliminate rivals and rise as champion of the battlefield .
                                                                                                                                                                            '

title: Bubble Shooter Mega
description: Bubble Shooter Mega is an exhilarating bubble-popping arcade puzzle game featuring vibrant clusters of red, yellow, and blue bubbles in a sleek dark interface, where players aim and shoot from dual next-bubble previews (16 shots remaining) to match 3+ colors for explosive chain reactions, clearing encroaching walls to meet trophy score goals (1100), collect gems and stars (1/3), and unleash powerful boosters in addictive, high-stakes levels.

title: Obby: King of the Hill
description:
👑 Welcome to “Obby: King of the Hill”!

A fun online obby game where everyone races to reach the top and become the true King of the Hill!

Game features:
🌀 Exciting obby challenges — run, jump, and overcome tricky obstacles.
👊 Fun player interactions — bump into rivals and knock them off the mountain.
👑 King of the Hill mode — reach the top and try to hold your position.
🎭 Funny falls and chaotic moments — every match is full of surprises.
🎨 Bright 3D graphics and simple, easy-to-learn gameplay.

🚀 Climb higher, compete with other players, and prove that you deserve the crown!

Are you ready to reach the top and stay there? 🏔️👑

title: Obby The Legendary Dragon
description:
An exciting and addictive pet catching simulator for pokemon lovers. Travel through different roblox worlds and a lot of leveling heroes in one place!

Collect health, upgrade your hero to explore the most amazing worlds of this game. Catch pets in battles, hatch them from cases and eggs, buy and exchange them to get the strongest helpers and friends. Earn money and upgrade your Obby character with the help of ranks and titles.

title: Obby Pet Simulator X
description: Dive into the exciting world of Obby Pet Simulator X, where you collect unique pets. Open eggs to summon rare creatures, break obstacles, and upgrade your skills. Enjoy this mesmerizing experience online for free on your mobile device or computer.

title: Rings Untie
description:
Rings Untie is a simple but addictive Ring puzzle game.
Do you want to train your brain?
Do you love colorful games with easy gameplay with fun rotate the circle puzzle games?

Both kids and adults can enjoy Rotate the Rings - a game in which you use your finger to rotate the circle to dissolve the puzzle. Save the lovely moments with your beloved people while playing this game!
This puzzle game includes various types of colorful rings: D rings, S rings, C lock rings, Ring lock... and different obstacles. A lot of exciting puzzle levels in the game are there for you to explore. If you like mini-games like Rescue the Dog, Rescue the woman and Save the Girl... this is another fun game for you.

title: Obby: Parkour with Ragdoll
description:
🏃 Complete challenging parkour maps, collect rewards, and push opponents into the abyss!

🌋 MAP 1 — LAVA
An easy parkour course for beginners, but be careful — one wrong move and you'll fall into the lava!

⚙️ MAP 2 — EXTREME
The toughest challenges:
🔄 Rotating obstacles
🟨 Disappearing platforms
⬅️➡️ Moving blocks
😱 Only the best players can reach the finish!

Slippery surfaces, dangerous jumps, and a true ice parkour experience!

💥 GAME FEATURES:
👊 Push other players
💫 Knock out opponents with ragdoll physics
🏆 Earn rewards for knocking players off the map
😂 Create epic falls and hilarious moments

💎 Crystals
