Jump in and see for yourself!

title: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter
description: Experience wild ragdoll physics and hilarious shooting action in Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter! Unlock weapons, conquer fun challenges, and send ragdolls flying in this addictive, stress-relieving online shooter game.

title: OrbaDrone - Robot Escape
description:
ℹ️About
You’re an Orb-shaped drone with the ability to repel and attract objects, awakened in a strange cave-like structure in a post-apocalypse scenario. Discover strange materials with unusual properties and use them to navigate in this dangerous and mysterious place.

🌟Features
● 50 levels to complete
● 3 types of difficulties
● 4 mini-games
● Customize the drone with skins that have different abilities
● 2D physics mechanics
● 2D light effects and environments
● Control customization to choose your preference

title: Brainrots Merge
description:
An engaging merge-clicker autobattler.

Combine characters to get a new one, periodically battle other players, and unlock all brainrots!

title: Break The Car Completely
description:
"Break The Car Completely" is a unique crash test simulator that challenges your extreme driving skills. The main task is simple: to reach the finish line, overcoming dangerous obstacles.

However, the key difficulty lies in the fact that the entire track is literally littered with various obstacles. Any collision, even the smallest one, will instantly destroy your car, so the only survival strategy is extremely careful and calculated movement. This is a test for those who value precision and control over the situation.

This driving simulator was created especially for fans of exciting BeamNG walkthroughs, because the game contains tracks styled after similar well-known routes. Now you have the opportunity to go through them on your phone or computer.

The developers have implemented destructible cars and realistic motion physics simulation, which makes every ride unpredictable and exciting. Despite the sophisticated physics and high-quality graphics, the game is not demanding on the resources of your device and gives you an authentic experience of real driving, even on weak or old gadgets.

title: Frontline Commando Shooting: Gun Games
description: Welcome to the world of gun shooting games. Get ready to step into the world of intense gun battles, thrilling missions, and heart-pounding survival challenges in the most complete first-person shooter game. Choose from an enormous collection of authentic, modern firearms and futuristic experimental guns. Pistols, assault rifles, SMGs, sniper rifles, shotguns, heavy machine guns every weapon feels unique and powerful.

title: Obby: Battle Arena
description: Exciting third-person shooter with beautiful graphics, where exciting battles, cool guns, and a real battle arena await you!

title: Room Makeover: Design And Aesthetic
description:
Welcome to the world of cozy interior design! Each level presents a new room filled with boxes of furniture and decor. Unpack everything and place each item where it belongs to transform an empty space into a stylish retreat.

Choose from a variety of design styles: soft pastels, modern elegance, bohemian chic, or trendy aesthetics. Every room is a fresh challenge for your sense of taste and creativity.

No timers, no pressure. Just a calm, meditative experience of bringing beauty and order to every corner. Mix colors, experiment with arrangements, and enjoy the satisfying results.

Perfect for anyone who loves organizing, interior design, or simply wants to unwind with a feel-good game. Create your dream room now!

title: Art Master Puzzle
Zombie Hunter: Survival
description: Fight and thrive in the endless onslaught of zombies. Upgrade your gear and weapons and keep up with stronger enemies. Your main goal in this grim world is survival.

title: Space Rolling Balls Race
description:
Game Title: 🌌 Space Rolling Balls Race 🌠
Product Description:
Get ready for an exciting 3D adventure in Space Rolling Balls Race, a fun, addictive, and fast-paced rolling ball game set in outer space! 🌍✨
Control your rolling ball through thrilling cosmic tracks filled with obstacles, traps, jumps, and moving platforms. With simple fingertip controls, smooth physics-based gameplay, and catchy background music, every level will test your reflexes, timing, and focus!
🚀 Features:


🎯 Easy to play, hard to master rolling ball gameplay


🌠 Challenging 3D levels with cool space environments


⚡ Smooth controls and realistic physics


🎵 Addictive sound effects and rhythm-based fun


🪐 Suitable for all ages — perfect casual game for everyone


💫 If you love ball games, rolling games, parkour challenges, or reflex-based runners, Space Rolling Balls Race is the ultimate game for you!
Roll, dodge, and race your way through space to become the ultimate ball racing master! 🏆

title: Kinder Garden
description:
Imagine yourself as a kindergarten teacher. Change diapers, feed and put the little ones to bed.
Only you can create an atmosphere of warmth, care and love that will make the kindergarten an ideal place for the growth and development of children.
Are you ready to become a teacher?

title: Mine Obby: +1 Dig Power per Hit
description:
🧱 Blocky Adventure
Dive into a blocky world of mines, obby challenges, and upgrades! Break blocks, pass obstacles, and grow stronger with every hit.

⚒️ +1 Dig Power per Hit
Every hit increases your digging power. The more you hit, the faster you break stone, ore, and tough layers of the ground.

💎 Resources and Rewards
Collect resources, unlock new depths, and earn rewards for your progress. Each stage becomes more exciting and challenging.

🎒 Skins and Pickaxes
Change your hero’s look, unlock new skins, choose pickaxes, and create your own style in the blocky world.

🚀 Dig Deeper and Deeper
Upgrade your hero, set new records, and see how far you can go!

title: Supermarket Manager
description:
Try your hand as a Supermarket Manager! Develop your store by purchasing shelves for products, which you will need to stock yourself at the beginning. Earn profits by serving customers and invest your earnings to hire staff like stockers and cashiers.
Boost the prestige of your supermarket by improving the quality of the products you sell. Then, invest in more expensive shelves and fill them with a wider variety of goods. Start earning maximum profits from serving each customer and build the supermarket of your dreams!

title: Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob
description:
Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob is your arena of chaos!

In the game, you can:

💥 Arrange epic explosions.

🤸‍♂️ Experiment with funny character physics: throw him, hurl him from a height, launch him into flight and watch him comically deform.

🧱 Destroy buildings and experiment with the environment.

🤲 Interactive objects — saws cut, dynamite explodes, and everything around affects each other, creating chain reactions.

🖼 Colorful voxel graphics make destruction spectacular, and detailed physics turn every action into a fun experiment. This is a game where destruction is an art, and every scene becomes your personal laboratory of fun.

title: Slice & Soar
description:
Are you ready to soar through the skies and slice everything in your path?

With the Slice & Soar, you can slice through objects in the air and collect as many points as possible. But it's not just about slicing - you'll need to use your strategic skills to avoid obstacles and master the art of timing to emerge victorious.

Challenge yourself with new levels and obstacles that will put your cutting skills to the test. Beat the competition to become the ultimate Slice & Soar champion.

With its addictive gameplay and easy-to-use interface, Slice & Soar is the perfect game for players of all ages. And with the option to play online or offline, you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere.

title: Color Dots Challenge
description:
Color Dots is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you'll
Place each dot into its matching slot aim for precision
Enjoy an experience that’s both easy to learn and fun to play, making it ideal for quick breaks or longer sessions.

title: Brainrot Tower Defense
description: Single-player browser-based tower defense game with progressive waves, tower upgrades, resource collection, and optional meta-progression features.

title: Adventure Crazy Ramp Bike Stunt Game
description:
Get ready to ride like a pro in Adventure Bike Ramp Game – Crazy Stunt Game, the most thrilling bike stunt simulator of 2025! Perform impossible jumps, flip through mega ramps, and race at extreme speeds in this action-packed motorcycle stunt game. A perfect blend of adventure, racing, and stunt challenges – built for players who love adrenaline!

Choose your favorite stunt bike, upgrade engines, unlock crazy tracks, and show your racing skills in this mega ramp stunt game. Jump over obstacles, dodge traps, and complete missions to become the ultimate stunt master. The realistic physics, 3D graphics, and smooth controls offer an unforgettable extreme bike riding experience.

Ride through sky-high ramps, compete in stunt challenges, and prove you’re the best stunt rider! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a hardcore bike stunt lover, this game brings nonstop entertainment.

title: Obby: Theme Park World
description:
Dive into a vibrant water park full of exciting rides and slides! Explore an open world, run around the park, discover hidden areas, and collect stars to unlock new zones and features.

Ride thrilling slides, try different routes, and improve your results. The more stars you collect, the faster you unlock new attractions and levels. The game combines free exploration with simple and engaging gameplay.

Perfect for fans of obby games, parkour, and relaxing gameplay with collection mechanics. Unlock new areas, explore the world, and enjoy speed and movement!

title: Box Magician
description: Box Magician is a charming Halloween-themed physics puzzle game where you help a young witch collect her magical treasure. Tap to remove crates, shift the structure, and guide the treasure chest safely into her hands. Each object reacts differently — some explode, some roll, and others change the balance — making every level a fun challenge of timing, logic, and strategy. With cute Halloween visuals, smooth animations, and progressively smarter puzzles, Box Magician delivers a delightful and engaging gameplay experience for all puzzle lovers.

title: Dont Get Crashed by 67
description: 👶💥 Dodge the sudden charges of 67, time your movements perfectly, and reach the finish before you get crushed. Every second counts when 67 is right behind you. There’s no room for mistakes — one wrong move and it’s over. Speed and reaction are everything. This game is perfect for all Roblox fans who love intense gameplay, challenges, and adrenaline.

title: SHADOW FORGE
description: Shadow Forge is a dark-fantasy Tower Defense × Action-RPG hybrid. Build and upgrade 10 unique towers while you command the Forge Master hero — dodge, cast 4 skills, and crush endless waves of shadow creatures across 8 maps and 20 waves with epic bosses. Level up to unlock powerful boons.

title: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up
description:
In the game Hair and Beauty, you can experiment with the latest trends in hairdressing and fashion:

💇‍♀️ **Create stunning looks**
Offer your clients a variety of hairstyles, from trendy cuts to elegant updos.
🎨 **Express yourself with makeup**
Choose from a wide range of makeup products and styles to complete your clients' looks.
👗 **Dress to impress**
Select from hundreds of outfits and accessories to help your clients look their best.
💎 **Unlock new possibilities**
Earn rewards as you progress through the game and expand your salon's offerings.
📸 **Capture the moment**
Take photos of your clients before and after their transformations to share with your friends and the world!

title: Dino funny digging
description:
An exciting archaeological simulator! 🦖
Dig for fossils, collect tyrannosaurs, triceratops, stegosaurs and other ancient creatures, and explore a variety of locations.🏜️ 
Realistic collection of dinosaur skeletons!

title: Knife Tower
description: Race up a colorful tower, throw knives into every block, and reach the top before your rival. Time each shot around the bouncing ball, build combos with precise hits, collect coins, unlock new knives, and upgrade your speed, combo range, and income.

title: Find The Dog
description: Get ready for some lighthearted fun! Explore whimsical black-and-white scenes filled with charming details and see how many cleverly hidden pups you can find. Each dog is playfully tucked away in different settings — from cozy parks to bustling streets — just waiting to be spotted. There's no rush, just relax and enjoy the search!

title: Obby: Mine Crasher
description:
🔨  Obby: Mine Crasher
Hit the anvils with a hammer, gain power and smash the stone walls! For each destroyed block, you get cups (trophies). Spend them on pets, which enhance the impact on the anvils: the more powerful the satellite, the faster the walls break down and further you go through the obby levels.
Hitting the anvil → improving strength
🔹 Walls to splinters → Cups to pocket
🔹 Cups → pets → even more power
Are you ready to become the ultimate dungeon destroyer? Come in and start smashing! 🔥


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you need to hit the anvils, increase your strength, and break walls.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline, but the goal is to level up, become stronger, earn the best pets, many trophies, and power.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?
A: The pleasant visual style of the game, daily rewards, a wheel of fortune, pets, and a lot of progression.

Q: Are there bosses and how are they different?
A: Instead of bosses, there are walls that become more challenging with each broken wall.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The key currency is trophies, which can be used to spin a pet box, buy character skins, and unlock new areas. Strength can be used to unlock weapon skins.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to hit the anvil and increase your strength. The higher the character's strength, the higher the attack power, and the faster the walls break.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?
A: Yes, there are VIP statuses that significantly speed up progress. There is an option to disable ads. There is a doubling of strength.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can fully customize everything about your character, including weapons.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards for broken walls and regenerations of all time. You can access them by breaking walls and progressing in the game to activate regeneration.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are many skins and pleasant graphics.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Yes, there are rewards for time spent in the game.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse yourself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties with gameplay without sound?
A: The music is pleasant and complements the gameplay.

title: Squid Game Tower Defense
description:
Squid Game Tower Defense battle against Squid Game characters in the towers. Complete challenges, defeat enemies, and become the victor in this thrilling fight!

Welcome to Squid Game Tower Defense — a unique and thrilling game where you will battle against characters from the famous Squid Game show. Unlike traditional Tower Defense games, your task here is not to defend towers but to attack and fight enemies that reside within them.

Each tower is not just a structure; it's a place where dangerous characters are waiting for battle. You'll engage in a series of exciting fights, defeating enemies at every level and overcoming various challenges. The game features characters well-known to all fans of the show, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics.

Complete levels, improve your combat skills, gather valuable resources, and unlock new opportunities for your battles. Make sure that your strategic abilities help you defeat even the toughest enemies standing in your way. Enjoy fast-paced combat, challenging missions, and an atmosphere that immerses you into the world of Squid Game.

title: Pixel Tetris
description: Pixel Blocks is a compact arcade puzzle about clean lines, fast restarts, and readable pixel effects. Play classic score attack, try physical falling cells, build sand bridges, escape the rising hazard, defuse hot bombs, unlock visual skins, and challenge a bot in Bot Duel. Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard and earn 15, 30, or 45 bonus coins when the bot tops out first.

title: Home Rush
description:
Save as many children as possible by solving all the drawing puzzles! The game is suitable for those who want to relax!
Bring the crying poor kids back to their loving families. Help mom and dad find their child and get home. The controls are very simple - draw a line from the parent to the baby. Careful avoidance of obstacles and choosing the optimal route will allow you to get to the baby and save him.

If you have any comments on the game, you can leave a review. Thank you so much for your participation, dear player!

title: Slides And Climbs
description: Slides And Climbs is a laid-back online game based on the traditional English board game of the same name, which served as an inspiration for the American version known as Chutes and Ladders. This beloved classic board game can be played for free in single-player mode or with friends locally. Roll the dice and navigate your way to the finish line. Let’s hope you avoid landing on a snake!

title: Leap and Avoid 2
description:
The new legendary adventure of the white ball!

This time there are even more caves and even more laboratory levels. New mechanics, great sound and a nice visual design are all in the new "Leap and Avoid 2" game!

The innovation is coins and secret passages. There are secret paths leading to coins all over the world. Collect coins to get nice bonuses in the form of an acceleration of the ball and shield for one touch with hazards!

The more coins you collect, the higher your place in the leaderboard will be. Compete with your friends and find all the hidden coins!

title: Fruit Chopper
description:
Grand fruit slasher is out!

Gameplay is zero hassle. Time your throws carefully and try to slash multiple fruits at once to get bonus score! Be nimble and accurate - DO NOT MISS!

You'll get one cocktail per every level completed. After you get 4 cocktails, you will get free spin of fortune wheel! RARE COCKTAILS = BETTER REWARDS!

Can you reach level 100?

title: Fruit Fusion
description:
Welcome to Fruit Fusion, the ultimate fruit-merging puzzle experience!
Drop and combine cherries, lemons, oranges, tomatoes, melons, coconuts, pumpkins, and watermelons to create bigger, juicier fruits. Keep merging to unlock massive combos and earn record-breaking points!

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel is an exciting free-to-play strategy game set in the 17th century. Command a team of diverse soldiers, issuing orders and making vital choices during intense battles. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it’s ideal for fans of historical tactics.

title: Tank 1944
description:
Tanks 1944 is an exciting game about realistic tanks.
battles. Choose a tank, learn how to fight, develop your own
game strategy and tactics. The game features:
- Realistic physics.
- Great graphics, shadow objects, grass physics.
- Extended gameplay of tank battles.
Ready to start the fight? Then choose a tank and go to victory!

title: Black Friday Dress Up Selfie
description: Shop the best looks in Black Friday Dress Up Selfie! Help your fashionista choose outfits from her wishlist, cozy fall fits, warm winter layers, sparkly holiday glam, and dark-academia vibes. Mix tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, and accessories to create the perfect selfie-ready style. A fun, fast way to solve every “What should I wear?” moment!

title: Obby All Games: Dash or Die
description:
Welcome to a colorful world of obby parkour packed with exciting maps, fun mini-games, and challenging obstacles!

Run across giant platforms, jump over gaps, dodge traps, and try to reach the finish line. Every map offers a new adventure: conquer colorful rainbow courses, escape from rising lava, explore a giant obstacle map, or test your skills in an awesome bike parkour challenge!

Speed, skill, and perfect timing are the keys to victory. Some obstacles may look easy, but one wrong jump can send you back for another try!

The game features:

🌈 Colorful rainbow obstacle courses
🔥 An exciting escape from rising lava
🚲 Challenging parkour on a bike
🏃 Giant maps filled with platforms and traps
⭐ Fun obby challenges with different difficulty levels

Choose your favorite map, overcome every obstacle, and prove that you are a true obby parkour master!

title: DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part
description:
DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part is a DOP game that will help you have fun testing your IQ. The game is a DOP puzzle game where each level is a funny story.

Enjoy the charming design in a bright cartoon style and charming animation.

The game is simple, however, there are several challenging puzzles among the puzzles. Test your brain and have fun!

Features of the game:

🧠 Pleasant brain training
🔍 Solving puzzles by dragging objects
🧩 More than 50 puzzles
🤩 Fun and creative animation

title: Snake Out
description:
Embark on a colorful puzzle adventure in Snake Out! 
Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, Snake Out offers a captivating experience that's fun, challenging, and endlessly rewarding. Can you master the art of Snake Out and escape every level?

title: Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies!
description:
⚔️ Welcome to the thrilling game "Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies!" Destroy everything in your path using knives, sabers, lightsabers, and other weapons. Immerse yourself in a world of dynamic battles where you slice enemies into tiny pieces and become a true samurai!

🗡️ In this free 3D game, you will find many exciting levels, challenging enemies, and a variety of melee weapons.

🎮 If you enjoy games like Swing Blade or "Slash the Enemies to Pieces!", this game will bring you lots of fun. Feel the thrill of slicing enemies in slow motion.

⭐ Game Features:

- Numerous levels with unique challenges to keep you engaged

- A variety of weapons: sabers, knives, blades, and even lightsabers like in Star Wars

- Stunning slow-motion effects during strikes for extra enjoyment

- Simple and intuitive controls to quickly get you into the action

title: Chroma Trek
description: Immerse yourself in Chroma Trek, a breathtaking neon platformer that dazzles with vibrant visuals and innovative gameplay. Each level is a unique masterpiece, offering diverse challenges that keep you engaged and on your toes. The core mechanic of color-switching lets you seamlessly pass through various types of obstacles, adding depth and excitement to every moment. As you navigate through dynamic environments, you'll be uplifted by motivational messages from the creator, encouraging you to push forward and conquer the journey to the Finish Crystal!

title: Hot Rods Arena Stars
description:
Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive!

Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents.

Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast.

Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind!

Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory.

Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!

title: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro!
description:
Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! — a fun snowy adventure where you play solo or with a friend, leveling up your tree to make it the coolest in the world! Collect rare toys, play mini-games, and show everyone your tree is the top 🎄❄️

❄️ What’s waiting for you:
• Play solo or co-op on one device 🤝
• Toy collection — from common to ultra-rare, decorate and upgrade your tree 💎
• Crafting — combine items to make legendary decorations 🔧✨
• Mini-games — earn coins, boosts, and rewards 🎮
• Snow battles — throw snowballs and have fun ☃️💥
• Huge tree — level it up and make it even cooler 🎄🔥
• Leaderboard — the more epic your tree and collection, the higher you climb 🏆
• Daily bonuses — gifts and freebies every day 🎁

Collect toys, craft the best decorations, and turn your tree into a legendary snowy world icon ❄️👑
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about, and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D game where you grow and decorate your own Christmas tree by playing various mini-games. You earn ""gifts"" as currency, and the larger your tree grows, the more rewards you receive.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Not exactly, but the premise is that you need to save Christmas and help Santa.

Q: What is the game's unique hook? What will draw players in?
A: It features Minecraft references, a wide variety of mini-games and rewards, high-quality graphics, and a local co-op mode to play with a friend on one screen. There is also a wheel of fortune, character skins, and a crafting system for Christmas ornaments.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: Minecraft-inspired references and themes.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? How can players level up faster?
A: Play mini-games to earn ""Bucks,"" then use them to upgrade and grow your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main gameplay?
A: Yes, there are many mini-games, including catching falling Bucks while dodging bombs, delivering gifts and coal to houses, throwing snowballs at targets, and defending sweets from zombies.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: There is an in-game currency called ""Bucks"" used to water the tree, upgrade ornaments for earning boosts, and level up mini-games. There is also a ""Gifts"" currency used to purchase more Christmas tree decorations.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and does it affect progression?
A: Yes, you can purchase various ""Bucks"" packs as well as character skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, your rank is determined by how much and how quickly you earn from your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar retention mechanics?
A: Yes, there is a reward system that grants prizes for every 5 minutes of playtime.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on, or can the game be completed without it?
A: It is not required, but playing with sound adds significantly to the festive atmosphere.

title: Hide the Monster: Choose Pose
description: Hide the Monster: Choose Pose is a fun online puzzle game where you assist cute monsters in escaping danger. Enjoy challenging levels that test your logic under pressure, with escalating difficulty as you find the best positions for the monsters to remain hidden.

title: Picture Jam Factory
description:
If you enjoy block puzzle, color jam, this picture factory-themed experience adds a fresh and satisfying twist to classic puzzles.

Picture Jam Factory – Build, Pack & Ship the Art!

Welcome to Picture Jam Factory!

Factory Puzzle Flow
Each level feels like a production task: organize blocks efficiently, avoid jams, and keep the factory running smoothly. Every correct move brings you closer to finishing the picture and sending it off the conveyor belt.

Perfect for Daily Play
- Hundreds of picture block puzzles to process
- New picture designs and factory orders added regularly
- Great for short breaks, commutes, or relaxing evenings
- Calm visuals, smooth animations, and satisfying factory effects

It’s easy to start, rewarding to master, and incredibly satisfying to watch each finished picture get packed and shipped.Step into the factory, clear the jams, and keep the picture line moving.

"Core: An aesthetically pleasing and highly engaging casual puzzle experience that captures player attention immediately.
Loop: Players engage in a satisfying progression loop by solving accessible, non-complex puzzles to advance through multiple levels.
Start: Instant player engagement is ensured through an intuitive control scheme and a compelling, enjoyable initial experience that serves as a strong hook.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: A highly marketable and contemporary Stylized / Cartoon art direction.
Key Feature: A core focus on mental challenge, delivering a rewarding experience for players seeking an intellectual workout."

title: Race On Cars in Moscow
description:
Race On Cars in Moscow — Racing, Tuning and Records!

Description:
Immerse yourself in a crazy race where the strategy of checkers meets the adrenaline of speed! Drive your car in the traffic, avoid collisions and break through to new records. 💥

🌟 What awaits you:

Checkers Racing: think through every maneuver, just like in the classic game!

Deep tuning: lower the body, change the wheels, repaint the car or turn the "dorestyling" into a top sports car!

Competitive mode: fight with players in multiplayer races and take a place in the TOP league!

Earn and upgrade: unlock powerful cars, upgrade them and dominate the roads!

Endless Drive: A survival mode where your goal is to drive as far as possible in the chaos of city traffic!

Become the king of asphalt — download the game and prove that your driving style is invincible! 🚗💨

title: SCP-173: Foundation Escape
description:
Step into the role of SCP-173 and break free from the Foundation’s control in a tense stealth experience built around a deadly rule: you can MOVE only when no one is LOOKING at you. Hide in the shadows, avoid patrols, and choose the perfect moment to dash through dark corridors where every mistake leads to capture.

Plan your route carefully, use cover and darkness to your advantage, and upgrade stealth abilities to gain the upper hand over security forces. Every second matters: one glance freezes you in place, one wrong move triggers a relentless chase.

title: Obby: Build an ASMR Keyboard Tycoon
description:
Obby: Build an ASMR Keyboard Tycoon is a fun Roblox-style simulator where you build your own ASMR keyboard and turn it into a massive money-making machine. Every key press earns cash, and your goal is to create the most profitable and satisfying keyboard possible!

Build, Upgrade, Earn!

Upgrade your typing speed, increase the money earned from every key press, and unlock new keyboard colors, designs, and effects. Hire workers to generate income automatically, even while you're busy exploring.

Compete against other players on the global leaderboard and become the richest ASMR keyboard owner. The better your upgrades, the faster your income grows—and the closer you get to the top!

Features
🎹 Build and customize your ASMR keyboard
💰 Upgrade typing speed and earnings
👷 Hire workers for automatic income
🏆 Compete on the global leaderboard
✨ Relaxing ASMR atmosphere with satisfying visuals
🚀 Become the ultimate keyboard tycoon!

title: TENKYU BALL
description: TENKYU BALL is a 3D casual ball-rolling puzzle game where you must guide a ball through tilting stages to reach the goal. The environment is minimalistic, and the challenge comes from balancing control vs risk. As you tilt the stage more, the ball moves faster, but there’s danger: if you tilt too much, the ball may fall off and you'll fail the level.

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Dudes, this is a very short strategic card battle game that blends tactical gameplay with quirky humor and vibrant creativity. Build powerful armies, summon creatures, cast spells, and construct buildings across unique terrains in epic turn-based battles. What sets this game apart is its dynamic terrain system—each battlefield zone corresponds to specific card types, favoring attackers, healers, defenders, or versatile "special units" that can be placed anywhere! With customizable decks and deep strategic options, players must outwit their opponents to claim victory. Unlock new cards, upgrade your favorites heroes, and dominate the battlefield in this thrilling clash of wits and strategy. Let's go. In and out. After all, this is Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure!

title: Save the Noob
description: Save the Noob is an engaging puzzle game that invites players to creatively rescue Noob from threats using a magical line. Accessible online for free across devices, it boasts numerous challenging levels that offer fun and strategic gameplay, perfect for passing the time.

title: Parkour World
description:
Welcome to Parkour World, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. 
-Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. 
-While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles.
-Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!

title: 99 Nights In The Forest - Survival Simulator
description:
99 Nights In The Forest - Survival Simulator - Go on outings, get food and resources, fight monsters and find the missing children!

What is in the game:

3 locations filled with both peaceful creatures and hostile ones! And also chests and resources!

The ability to save children by destroying secret bosses!

The skin merchant's store, where you can buy various upgrades!

The ability to earn achievements. For each achievement, you will receive DIAMONDS.

title: Yoga Master - Flex Running
description:
Yoga is a great way to improve your quality of life. It is also a great way to entertain yourself in this game: Yoga Master.

Yoga Master is an addictive 3D running game with different levels that will challenge even the fastest reflex.

Move your character to adjust the pose and dodge the incoming obstacles while picking some money on the way. But beware! Sometimes this stack of cash is a trap.

title: Diamond Painting by Number
description: Diamond Painting by Number is a coloring game in which you can draw, color and create diamonds by numbers. Diamond painting includes many of gorgeous diamond drawings by numbers in coloring books.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle - Anime
description:
Welcome to the world of Jigsaw Puzzle - Anime - classic anime-themed puzzles! This game offers the perfect combination of relaxation, entertainment and brain training.

Anime puzzles provides you with several free and premium puzzles with anime motifs. You can even create your own puzzles using images and photos of your family to make the game even more special.

Each piece of our puzzles is unique and carefully crafted to ensure an enjoyable time for everyone who loves puzzles. You will be delighted by the variety and beauty of the anime pictures you can collect.

title: Parking Dash
description: Parking Dash is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges players to think ahead. Place arrow tiles to create the perfect route, guide the car to the garage, and solve increasingly challenging parking puzzles.

title: Winter Vacation Beach Games
description:
Experience the ultimate family vacation adventure in Family Simulator Beach Games! Pack your bags, gather your family, and set off on an exciting holiday filled with beach fun, off road driving, camping, and thrilling family activities.

Enjoy an unforgettable family trip as you explore beautiful beaches, snowy mountains, and scenic picnic spots. Drive powerful 4x4 jeeps through challenging off road tracks, organize family picnics, and create lasting memories with your virtual family.

Take part in exciting holiday activities including beach races, camping adventures, sightseeing, and outdoor games. Spend quality time with your virtual mom, dad, siblings, and friends while completing engaging missions and exploring breath taking environments.

Whether you're relaxing by the beach, driving through mountain roads, or enjoying a family campfire, every moment is packed with fun and adventure.

Game Features

* Enjoy an exciting virtual family vacation adventure.
* Explore beautiful beaches, mountains, parks, and camping locations.
* Drive powerful 4x4 off road jeeps across challenging terrains.
* Complete fun family missions and exciting holiday activities.
* Experience beach parties, camping, picnics, and outdoor adventures.
* Play mini activities including races, exploration, and sightseeing.
* Unlock new rewards and complete challenging objectives.
* Stunning 3D environments with realistic animations and sound effects.
* Smooth controls and immersive gameplay for all ages.

Create unforgettable memories with your virtual family and enjoy the perfect holiday adventure in Family Simulator Beach Games!

title: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker
description: Join Sigma Boy in a beat-driven journey through diverse landscapes from deserts to space in this free online clicker game. Each tap earns points for upgrades, enhancing his skills as you tackle various challenges across devices. Embrace the rhythm and guide Sigma Boy to success!

title: Bricks Buster
description: Bricks Buster is a fun and addictive arcade game! Aim, shoot, and break bricks to clear levels. Use power-ups, plan your shots, and enjoy endless brick-breaking action!

title: Sumo Fury
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Sumo Fury, where you can acquire powerful wrestlers with superior stats and challenge rivals globally. Show your mastery in combat, earn in-game currency through victories, and unlock stronger fighters to dominate the arena. Achieve glory and wealth with each victory, the excitement of Sumo Fury is sure to captivate you!

title: Italian Brainrot Difference
description:
Put your observation skills to the test in Italian Brainrot Difference! Immerse yourself in vibrant, whimsically illustrated scenes bursting with Italian charm, and uncover the sneaky, often hilarious differences between two images.
Every level is packed with unexpected twists, clever visual gags, and delightful details designed to challenge even the keenest eyes. Think you can spot them all before the clock runs out? Dive in and prove your sharpness!

title: Stickman Clicker
description: Stickman Clicker is a clicker game where you help a stickman become a billionaire. Tap to earn money, invest in upgrades, and unlock stylish accessories. Customize your stickman and achieve milestones by unlocking various achievements. How wealthy can you get?

title: King Simulator
description: In this game, you will become a brave explorer and embark on a journey to conquer the fantasy world.Every step is fraught with challenges, and every city holds secrets. Pick up your weapons, use your wisdom and courage to unlock new territories and unveil the mysteries behind the cities. Join this thrilling adventure and become a legendary hero who conquers the world!

title: Onet Puzzle - Tile Match Game
description: Onet Puzzle is a tile-matching game to play and relax in the free time. It offers 20+ elaborate themes and music for much fun! With memory of your brain and concentration of your mind, you search pairs, connect to eliminate them during the given time. Higher level you get more challenging it is, but various tools and treasure box are there for help! Enjoy it now!

title: Snake to Eat
description:
Snake to Eat is an exciting and relaxing puzzle game that will test your strategic thinking and planning skills! 🐍🍎

Guide your snake 🐍 through simple yet tricky puzzles 🧩 as you eat apples 🍏 to grow longer. Your goal is to make the snake long enough to reach the teleportation portal 🔮. Every apple you eat adds a new piece to your snake, and with each move, you’ll need to carefully plan your path 🧠 to ensure your snake grows and reaches the portal.

title: Crazy Flying Car
description:
Control a car with wings, make dangerous flights over the abyss and overtake your rivals!
You need to get to the finish line first. To do this, you can simply drive along the track, pushing your opponents, or take a risk and fly off the track, going into flight in the hope of shortening the path by air. To take a risk or to rely on maneuvers - it's up to you!
Play and fly right now!

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description:
Welcome to Fruitsland – a unique amusement park where fun awaits at every turn! Colorful carousels, exciting rides, and entertainers dressed as fruits – apples, bananas, watermelons, and oranges – fill the park. Children’s laughter fills the air, as school groups with teachers and families with kids flock to enjoy the day. Everything seems perfect, but not all is as it seems... One careless step, and you fall through an old hatch, landing in a spooky, long-abandoned part of the park hidden underground.

Before you lies a chilling, forgotten underground park where strange scientific experiments were once conducted. Only remnants of these experiments remain now, with crumbling rides and deserted game rooms that carry no joy. An eerie silence surrounds you, broken only by the sounds of old machinery and the shuffling of mysterious creatures. The first location is themed around apples – at first, it seems harmless, but soon you realize you’re trapped. As you study the remnants of the scientists’ journals, you uncover their plans to bring fruit to life, fruit that would entertain visitors around the clock. The sinister plan of the park’s owner aimed to turn fruits into real entertainers, capable of anything to amuse guests.

Your mission now is to escape from this underground horror. Every step brings new puzzles, challenging tasks, and deadly monsters that lurk around every corner, the results of failed experiments. Surviving here won’t be easy: these animated fruits have come to life, and now they’re hunting you. Every corner is a new survival test filled with horror, fear, and adrenaline. Choose your path wisely, solve puzzles to find your way out, and avoid deadly traps and monsters that only look like harmless fruits.

The first monster you will encounter is a blind apple, a nightmare resembling a zombie. It aimlessly roams the empty sections of the park, filling everyone who sees it with dread.

The second section is dedicated to the banana. This is the second colorful monster brought to life by horrifying experiments. Seeing it makes you feel as if something is invading your mind.

The third section of the underground park is dedicated to the Pomegranate — a sinister fruit with two large eyes. These roaming eyes not only track unwelcome guests but also attack them. They emerge from their sockets and move independently, chasing their target across the area.

Can you escape from this park and see the sunlight again? Will you find a way to break free from the gloomy underground? This horror game is for those ready for survival, monster hunts, immersion in fear, and adrenaline! Complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat monsters, and find freedom while uncovering the mysteries of Fruitsland.

Download this game to dive into the fruit garden… if you dare!

title: Cat Rescue
description:
The newest save cat game is here! Rescue the poor kitty from all the obstacles in his way. Draw a simple line to protect the cat from the evil bees that will try everything to sting him.

Cat Rescue is the best way to train your brain. Draws a line, a circle, a star, anything you like, the sky is the limit. Each level will require a different solution. It takes the sharpest of minds to complete every challenge and protect the kitty and his nap.

title: Grill Match: Sort Food
description:
🔥 Welcome to Grill Match: Sort Food - the most mouth-watering sorting puzzle on a sizzling BBQ grill!

Sort juicy steaks, tasty burgers, shrimp, fresh veggies, and tons of other delicious foods right on a hot grill. Match 3 identical items, clear the grill, and complete relaxing yet challenging levels packed with tasty chaos!

Put your logic and reflexes to the test as you organize grilled food in the perfect order. Every level brings new ingredients, tricky combinations, and oh-so-satisfying match moments. Easy to learn - hard to master!

✨ Game Features:

🔥 Fun and addictive food sorting gameplay
🥩 Match 3 grilled foods to clear the board
🌽 Juicy BBQ visuals and a relaxing atmosphere
🍤 Hundreds of satisfying puzzle levels
⚡ Easy controls and smooth gameplay
🏆 Perfect for fans of cozy sorting & puzzle games
🍖 New foods, new challenges in every level

🍔 Can you become the ultimate Grill Master and sort every dish to perfection? Fire up the grill, sharpen your senses, and start matching now!

title: Build Your Dream Car
description: Build your dream car, upgrade engines and nitro, win intense drag races, and dominate the streets with perfect shifting skills.

title: A Long Way Home
description: A Long Way Home is a chilling survival horror game that plunges you into the role of a lost wanderer, desperately trying to find their way back home. Stranded in an eerie, ever-changing landscape, you must navigate through shadowy corridors and odd places while being relentlessly pursued by strange, otherworldly creatures. As reality begins to unravel, you'll encounter haunting visions and unsettling experiences that blur the line between fear and madness. Will you uncover the truth behind your nightmarish journey or succumb to the horrors lurking in the dark? Prepare for a gripping tale of survival, mystery, and terror in A Long Way Home.

title: Stickman Escape - Plane and Ship
description:
Prove to everyone that you are a rich man! Only those players who have money can make a purchase in this game. The continuation of the game about escaping from the ship is paid.
In this game you need to find all the successful options for escaping from the plane and the ship. You will face difficulties on the way, enemies, a choice of items, a choice of actions and monsters. You will play as the character Stick.

title: Flippin Coins
description:
Welcome to Flippin' Coins - The Ultimate Coin Merging Adventure!
Ever wondered what it's like to flip your way to fortune? Flippin' Coins combines the thrill of chance with the satisfaction of strategic merging in this wildly addictive idle game!
How It Works:

TAP to flip any coin on the board - hit that sweet 75% win rate and watch the cash roll in! 💸
DRAG to merge - Combine two matching coins to unlock the next tier. Tier 1 becomes Tier 2, Tier 2 becomes Tier 3... how high can you go?
BUY strategically - Spend your earnings on new coins to accelerate your progress
UNLOCK new tiers - Each new tier brings BIGGER rewards and jaw-dropping visuals!

Features That'll Keep You Flipping:

🎲 Risk & Reward - Every flip is a gamble, but the odds are with you!
🔄 Satisfying Merges - Watch coins combine with juicy animations
📈 Progressive Gameplay - From pennies to MILLIONS
🎨 Colorful Visuals - Each tier has its own unique look
🎵 Addictive Audio - Coin clinks never sounded so good
💎 Rare Tiers - Unlock legendary coins worth THOUSANDS
🏆 Achievements - Master the art of the flip
☁️ Cloud Save - Play on any device, never lose progress

Perfect For:

✅ Quick gaming sessions (flip during coffee breaks!)
✅ Long gaming sessions (you won't be able to stop!)
✅ Casual players who love merge games
✅ Strategy fans who enjoy optimizing
✅ Anyone who's ever flipped a coin and felt that RUSH

The Ultimate Question:
Can you unlock all 20+ tiers? Can you become the ultimate Flippin' Coins champion? There's only one way to find out...

title: Block Puzzle King
description: Block Puzzle King is a classic elimination game. Its adorable graphics prevent eye strain, and varied level difficulties keep it engaging. The game maintains freshness while offering abundant props for players to strategically use.

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description: Crazy Motorcycle is an exciting racing game that allows players to race motorcycles in the sky, available on various devices without downloads. Featuring vibrant graphics and thrilling gameplay, it caters to both beginners and experienced racers, providing a captivating experience for all.

title: Obby: Sword Hero Adventure
description:
Obby: Sword Hero Adventure is an exciting game where you’ll master your sword skills. Increase your attack power, obtain and use rarer swords. Build a collection of the best companions, defeat enemies, fight bosses, and explore all the game worlds in search of adventure!

• Increase your attack power
• Collect rare swords!
• Earn trophies and skill points!
• Recruit companions!
• Upgrade your hero’s abilities!
• Unlock all game worlds!

title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
description:
This is a game that features racing, destruction, and car customization in an open world! Break cars, jump off ramps, and create your own style!
Immerse yourself in an adrenaline-pumping world of destruction and speed!
 This is a game where you control cars that break down with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can all fly off with a powerful impact! Explore a vast open world filled with ramps, presses, and other tools for epic destruction.

 Create unique cars by changing the color of the body, details, and adjusting the size and alignment of the wheels. Meet other cars speeding along the roads and compete with them in spectacular crashes. Crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action await you!
Realistic car destruction
 Tuning: color, wheels, and style
 Huge open world
 Unique crash test sites
 Destroy, build, and race - create your own chaos on the road!

title: Dinosaur Game
description:
Dino Dash is a fast, fun, and action-packed endless runner game that sends players racing through a colorful prehistoric world. Take control of a brave little dinosaur and dash across ancient landscapes filled with danger, surprises, and exciting challenges. Your goal is simple: run as far as possible, avoid every obstacle in your path, and keep your adventure going for as long as you can.

As the speed increases, your reflexes will be put to the test. Jump over hazards, dodge tricky barriers, and react quickly as the world rushes past you. Every run feels fresh as you try to beat your best distance, collect more coins, and master the timing needed to survive longer. The easy-to-learn controls make Dino Dash perfect for quick casual play, while the increasing difficulty keeps the game exciting for players who love chasing high scores.

title: Airplane Factory - Tycoon
description: Build and expand your own aviation empire in Airplane Factory - Tycoon ! Start small by producing lightweight planes, and gradually scale up to manufacturing giant airliners and advanced fighter jets. Manage production lines, upgrade your factory facilities, enhance your manager’s skills, and unlock new types of aircraft to boost your profits. Strategically grow your business to become the ultimate aircraft manufacturer!

title: Cryptograms: Secret Text
description:
Cryptograms: Secret Text -  is a puzzle game where you decipher encrypted phrases, gradually uncovering letters and piecing together the full meaning.

Choose a theme to match your mood: love and relationships, wisdom and philosophy, movies and TV shows, motivation and literature – and progress through levels one by one.

Progress and Rewards:

Earn coins for completing levels, which can be used to access hints.

title: Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal
description:
Welcome to Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal

A fast-paced action game that blends grappling traversal, skill-based movement, and idle tycoon progression into one addictive experience. Swing, aim, and launch your harpoon to reach Brainrots, collect them, and build your empire.

This is more than just a runner. Brainrot Hook Obby is a dynamic movement game with long-term progression, competitive mechanics, and satisfying upgrades.


🪝 Traverse with Your Harpoon

Master movement using a harpoon system. Aim, hook, and fly across the map.

🪝 Grapple from point to point across the level
🏃 Fast-paced movement with jumps and swings
⚡️ Skill-based traversal and timing

title: Puppetman: Ragdoll Puzzle
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Puppetman: Ragdoll Puzzle, an engaging game that tests your cleverness and quick reactions. Navigate Poly through challenging levels with clever tactics to avoid crashes. With 15 progressively difficult stages, it offers an exciting challenge, whether on mobile or desktop.

title: Knock Down
description:
The most fun and simple Knock Down - Bottle Hit in the market!

Knock Down game - Bottle Hit is to knock down all bottles using slingshot and ball.
It has many unique and interesting gameplay levels.

Where you have to knock down slingshot all the bottles using your logical and aiming skills to complete a level.
If you throw all ball without fall down bottles will level failed.

title: Deorbit - Space Survivors
description:
Deorbit is a fast-paced top-down space survivor shooter. You command a lone starship stranded in hostile sectors, and wave after wave of enemy swarms close in from every direction. Your weapons fire automatically — your job is to fly, dodge, and stay alive as the horde grows.
Vacuum up glowing XP orbs to level up mid-run, then choose from a hand of upgrade cards to shape your build on the fly — more firepower, drones, shields, and devastating new abilities. Crack open chests that drop into the battlefield for extra loot, push through 10 escalating phases per sector, and brace for massive boss encounters that can turn the tide.
Every run earns gold. Spend it back at your hangar to permanently upgrade your ship, unlock new vessels, and gear up before diving back in. Claim daily rewards, chase new records, and see how deep into the sectors you can survive. No two runs play the same.
Think you can beat your best score? Suit up, Commander.
Tips
Grab XP orbs to level up, then pick the upgrade cards that fit your build.
Open chests for bonus drones, cells, and items during a run.
Spend gold in the hangar between runs to make your ship permanently stronger.
Survive to face the sector boss — beating it pushes you deeper.

title: Air Assault: Ship Defense
description:
Man a twin AA gun on a WW2 destroyer and shoot down waves of diving planes before they sink your ship. Air Assault puts you in the splinter tub of a wartime destroyer — twin barrels, open ocean, and enemy aircraft diving straight at your deck. Aim with the crosshair, manage gun heat, and cut down fighters before they reach the hull.

Stages ramp up fast: denser swarms, faster dives, bombers and armored blimps on high flyovers, and kamikazes that don’t turn away. Planes shoot back. Bombs fall. One bad miss and the ship goes down.

Upgrade your mount between runs, climb the stages, and hold the line as the sky fills with incoming fire. Simple controls, sharp 3D action — pure anti-aircraft mayhem in the middle of the Pacific.

title: Gibbets Bow Master
description:
Try your best in a bow shooting game! Cut the ropes with an arrow, avoiding shooting at the victims. You should hurry: their breath is about to end! This stupid bow games always keeps you on your toes. And don’t forget: your chivalry can make some coin!

Always dreamed about a lifesaver career? Gibbets Bow Master - archery target shooting games will give you the opportunity!
Shoot the ropes, but avoid hitting the stickman in our bow games.
Earn achievements.
Beat the scores and become the champion archer.

title: Dice Puzzle
description: Dice Puzzle is a puzzle game where your task is to strategically place numbered cubes on the board, aiming to merge three adjacent cubes with the same number. As they combine, their value increases. Carefully select cubes with different points, considering their placement to match with others effectively. Be mindful, as cubes may appear individually or in pairs. Merge three or more dice horizontally or vertically to create higher-valued cubes. Utilize the storage space wisely to save cubes for later use. Test your puzzle-solving skills in this engaging dice-merging game!

title: Pool Float Party
description: The best friends Blondie and Marie decided to have a pool party. What kind of party is there without cocktails? Let's make a refreshing mojito from soda, lemon, lime and mint leaves together. While Blondie is making cocktails, Marie is cleaning up the area next to the pool. Help the girls with creating a unique design for the party. Now that everything is ready, you can take care of yourself. Make up for each of the girls and choose the right outfit. Choose from a variety of swimsuits and pareos. Blondie prefers pink shades, while Marie loves the combination of red and black colors and the polka dot pattern. Don't forget to add stylish accessories to your look and choose an original-shaped inflatable raft for girls.

title: Run The Electricity
description:
Run The Electricity is a unique puzzle game that combines simplicity and benefits for your mind. It is designed to give relaxation, help to cope with stress and improve concentration.

Instead of intense gameplay and a race against time, a calm process awaits you here: you just need to connect lines, lamps and energy sources in a closed circuit to turn on the light.

Minimalistic design, smooth animation and soothing music create an atmosphere of complete tranquility comparable to yoga. This is not just a game, but a means to meditate and combat anxiety. You can play it at home, on the road, or at work to distract yourself and restore your mental balance.

Smart puzzles train logic and imagination, and simple mechanics allow you to have fun from the first seconds. Discover a world of light, harmony and tranquility!

title: Bike Stunt Game
description: Bike Stunt Game is a thrilling 2.5D arcade racer where you perform insane tricks on a motorbike. Choose from three modes – Time Trial (beat the clock), Trick Challenge (earn style points), or Survival (avoid crashes at all costs). With a unique side-scrolling perspective that blends 2D gameplay with 3D depth, you'll navigate ramps, loops, and obstacles across a handful of hand-crafted levels. What makes it unique? The 2.5D view gives you depth perception for landing perfect jumps while keeping simple side-scroller controls. Unlock new bikes as you master each level. Works flawlessly on desktop and mobile browsers.

title: Train Master
description: Dive into the exhilarating world of Train Master, an engaging puzzle game where strategy is key. Your goal: gather passengers without accidents. Start with a basic train, maneuver through complex paths, and collect coins to upgrade. Test your skills as the top conductor in this free game on mobile and PC!

title: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG
description: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG is a clicker where you assemble a team of heroes and send them into an endless battle against monsters. Level up your heroes, unlock artifacts, use powerful skills and push through hundreds of zones. Progress continues even while you're away - come back and collect your rewards!

title: Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge - Horror Escape
description:
Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge – Horror Escape is the chilling sequel to the cult classic point-and-click horror game.
After managing to escape once, Grandma has found you again — and this time, she’s locked you in an even darker, more twisted place.
Explore eerie rooms, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover cursed objects and grotesque clues.
Use your logic and courage to find tools, unlock hidden paths, and perform a disturbing ritual to escape.
Every item has a purpose, every detail tells a story — and Grandma is always watching.
Will you manage to escape again, or will you become her next ritual offering?
Perfect for fans of horror, escape rooms, and point-and-click adventures.

title: Stickman Gun Rush
description:
Build the ultimate stickman weapon and blast your way to victory in Stickman Gun Rush!

Enjoy smooth controls, easy gameplay, and realistic effects that make this 3D sniper game feel real.

title: Towers 505
description:
Demonstrate your strategy of indestructible defense by erecting towers to stop the hordes of monsters trying to break through your line; not only strength is important here, but also intelligence, because each wave of monsters requires new tactics, improvements and the perfect location of towers.
This browser-based tower defense game features a classic 2D top-down perspective with stylized cartoon art. Players defend a winding orange path by strategically placing various defense turrets, such as wooden crossbow towers and stone fortifications, to stop waves of approaching monsters emerging from a dark purple abyss. The core gameplay loop involves spending earned gold coins to build and upgrade structures, periodically clicking to activate magical spells like fireballs and frost blasts to slow down or destroy enemies. Progression is level-based, with ten locked stages visible on the level selection screen. The visual style is bright and vibrant, dominated by a green grassy field, stone walls, and brown autumnal trees, all rendered with thick outlines and flat colors. The UI is comprehensive, displaying a gold coin counter, a kill tally with a skull icon, a health heart indicating ten lives, and an bottom bar with available building or spell buttons. Defensive gameplay is punctuated by varied enemy types including ground-based green slugs and fast-moving white flying monsters. The tone is casual and accessible for all ages, though strategic depth increases with environmental challenges like rain that buffs enemy strength. Losing all ten lives results in a failure screen, prompting the player to retry the stage or return to the main menu.

title: LumberJack Simulator 3D
description:
Lumberjack Simulator 3D is a relaxing economic game where you build a logging operation from the ground up. Start with nothing but an axe and grow your humble camp into a thriving wooden empire.

Chop trees, collect logs and haul them to the warehouse. Spend your coins on upgrades, unlock a tablet to manage incoming orders, and hire helpers — lumberjacks who chop for you and collectors who gather logs automatically.

Build houses for your workers and expand your base by placing buildings wherever you like. Accept deals from buyers, negotiate with business partners, and keep your warehouse stocked — the more logs you deliver, the more you earn.

A dynamic day-night cycle, a living world and full control over your progress make every session feel fresh. Adjust music, controls and language to your liking and get to work.

title: Place It Right

Fantastic antistress relaxing game!

Super fun connecting dots color match game free!

The best way to have a great time right now is to play one of the super cool combinations of emoji games and connect dots games! So what are you waiting for? Download “Pop Them! Emoji Puzzle Game” now and start connecting dots and crushing 'em all! Enjoy endless hours of free relaxing games and discover the joys of matching games. Play the ultimate color connect emoji game!

Develop your camp and fight the invaders!

In your battle camp you can upgrade your troops, buy military equipment, and improve your weapons.
Buy jeeps, tanks, hire squads of fighters!

Next, boldly lead your blue troops into battle!

Go through all locations, defeat all opponents!

- Several locations
- A large number of upgrades
- Different types of equipment
- Interesting enemies
- Several types of bosses!


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you need to gather troops and attack the enemy camp.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

The better you plan your moves and use the bonuses, the higher your score will be. It’s a fun mix of speed, strategy, and fishing skills!

A camel has appeared in the city and is looking for adventures! In the game, you will have to help the camel find animals, chat with people, and explore the city. 
Look for hidden machines, guns, cannons, and grenades to destroy buildings and create chaos. Drive cars, operate a helicopter, and even saddle a turtle or a cow for unforgettable adventures.

But the road to riches is dangerous. Hostile raccoons regularly raid your base. Buy tougher weapons, upgrade your stats, and keep your paw on the trigger to protect your conveyor belts and warehouse.

• Vibrant world with signature humor

Take control of your steel battle tank and race across the battlefields, destroying enemies with powerful shots. Collect rewards from defeated opponents, upgrade armor and weapons, unlock new unique tanks and challenge increasingly dangerous opponents. Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

Q: What is the standout feature of the game? What can hook players in?

Mechanics & Progression
