title: Buggy Simulator Sandbox 3D
description: This is a buggy physics simulator, ride on various maps and observe the behavior of cars and their wheels. There are several cars to choose from - you can switch between them at any time and control any one. Explore the map with the city and the bridge, jump over the hills, drive off the bridge. On the test zone, you can destroy the pyramids, evaluate the work of the suspension and more.

title: Onet Animals
description: Onet Animals is a charming puzzle game that involves matching similar animal tiles. Completing pairs allows you to finish levels. With its engaging challenge and adorable visuals, this game is fun for players of every age.

title: Destructive Car Crash Simulator
description:
All cars can be broken, dented and destroyed! Realistic car damage and deformation system.
Arrange police chases - hit a police car and it will start hunting for you.
Crash test of cars - watch their destruction. All the destruction of cars has a realistic simulation.
Different maps and cars.
A lot of crashing props - cannons, catapults, hummers, presses etc.

title: Bubble Shooter Island Quest
description: Bubble Shooter Island Quest is an enchanting bubble shooter puzzle game set in a lush jungle island paradise. Its core concept involves launching colorful bubbles from a pirate bird's cannon to match 3+ of the same color—reds, blues, yellows, and specials like eggs and coins—causing chain reactions to pop clusters and clear encroaching bubble walls before they reach the bottom. Unique elements include a charming red parrot pirate shooter, power-up barrels (rainbow, lightning, ice), gem/coin collection for upgrades, star/trophy goals per level, and tropical vibes with vines and barrels for immersive, relaxing yet addictive play.

title: Mini ASMR Relaxing Game Relax
description:
Mini ASMR Relaxing Game Relax soothing mini-games and calming sounds help you relieve stress, anxiety and restore peace of mind.

Mini ASMR Relaxing Game Relax It is a relaxing collection of soothing mini-games designed to calm your mind. Pop bubbles, squeeze fidgets, swirl liquids and enjoy satisfying ASMR sounds. Each game offers a unique sensory experience with smooth animations and tactile effects that melt away stress. Perfect for quick relaxation, stress relief, or simply to zone out and recharge. Explore dozens of antistress activities — from popping to pouring and tapping — and immerse yourself in gentle soundscapes. Whether you need a mental break or just want to unwind, Mini ASMR Relaxing Game Relax is your peaceful pocket escape anytime, anywhere.

title: Obby Maker
description:
Create your own levels and play levels made by other players!

Build your own obby courses, come up with challenges, and share them with other players! In this editor, you can create unique levels, customize obstacles, add logic, and program object behavior.

Use the flexible editor to build simple parkour maps, complex puzzles, mini-games, traps, moving platforms, and levels with custom rules. Customize objects, add events, experiment with mechanics, and turn your ideas into full game worlds.

Game features:

* Create obby courses and parkour levels
* Object, obstacle, and platform editor
* Logic and element behavior settings
* Programming of in-game events
* Levels of different difficulty
* Ability to invent your own rules and challenges
* Suitable for beginners and experienced creators

Build, test, improve, and create obby levels that other players will want to beat!

title: Satisdom
description: Satisgame is a globally popular casual stress-relief game loved by players of all ages. Whether you're with family, friends, or children, it's the perfect way to relax and enjoy quality time together.

title: Finger Soccer Tournament
description: Finger Soccer Tournament is an engaging game where players pick teams to outscore opponents. Enjoy free online play with no downloads, featuring quality graphics. Compete solo or with friends on PC, Android, and iOS. Join the finger soccer realm and strive to be the top champion!

title: Mahjong Pirate Plunder Quest
description: Mahjong Pirate Plunder Quest is a tile-matching puzzle game based on classic Mahjong solitaire. Players remove pairs of identical free tiles featuring pirate-themed icons—such as treasure chests, gold coins, parrots, cannons, ships, anchors, and skulls—to clear the board. The core concept revolves around a pirate treasure hunt, where progressing through levels represents a "plunder quest." Its distinctive feature is the immersive pirate theme that replaces traditional Mahjong symbols with vibrant, adventure-inspired graphics, creating a fun and thematic twist on the familiar matching gameplay.

title: Marble Maze
description: A head-to-head 3D maze puzzle. You swipe to roll your marble through a labyrinth and paint every open tile on the board. Each maze uses one color — your job is to cover the whole board, not reach a finish line.

title: Abandoned Mansion
description:
Abandoned Mansion is a first-person horror game set in an abandoned mansion, where a distress call leads you to investigate. Upon arrival, you realize it’s too late.
The game features item interaction, challenging puzzles, and terrifying monsters.

Features:

Optimized 3D graphics and realistic sound effects
Immersive and thrilling music
Multiple levels to test your skills
Variety of enemy types
Boss fights
Puzzles to solve
Exploration of the abandoned building
Hidden rooms and items
"Abandoned Mansion" will test your courage and survival skills. Can you unravel the mansion's mystery and face its monstrous inhabitants? Play now to find out.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color
description: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color is a vibrant brain teaser that blends block placement, color matching, and a playful water park vibe. You guide falling cubes to help cheerful bears enjoy their splash time. You solve increasingly clever puzzles, plan every drop carefully, and enjoy lively water visuals that make each challenge feel refreshing and satisfying.

title: Cartoon cat: naughty kitten
description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Cartoon Cat: Mischievous Kitten - an action-stealth game where you are a nimble kitten collecting delicious sausages and escaping from many dangers!

What awaits you:

Roaring robot vacuum cleaners: avoid noisy machines, hide in secluded corners.

Hooligan pranks: mess around in people's apartments - throw objects, distract the residents, but don't get caught!

Hide and seek: use furniture, boxes and shadows to hide from your enemies.

Chases and traps: escape from vicious dogs and rush through the streets, beware of cars.

Your goal:

Collect as many sausages as possible.

Maneuver between enemies and traps.

Save all lives and find the exit from each level.

Ready to test yourself in the most fun (but dangerous!) kitty adventure of the season? Then go ahead - Cartoon Cat is waiting for you!

title: Word Search & Quiz
description:
🔍 WORD SEARCH & QUIZ — Train Your Brain with 5 Exciting Game Modes!

Looking for the perfect brain training game? Word Search & Quiz combines classic word puzzles with engaging trivia questions to challenge your mind every day!

🎮 FIVE UNIQUE GAME MODES:

📖 CLASSIC WORD SEARCH
Search for hidden words in letter grids. Explore themed puzzles with beautiful pictures that change with each chapter.

🖼️ PICTURE PUZZLES
Look at the image and find the related words hidden in the grid. A fresh twist on classic word search!

🤔 RIDDLE WORD SEARCH
Read clever text riddles and find the answer hidden among the letters. Test your logic and vocabulary!

✏️ WORD FROM IMAGE
See a picture, spell the word! Use the given letters to type what you see. Simple yet addictive!

❓ QUIZ MODE
Answer trivia questions on various topics. From easy warmups to challenging brain teasers — test your knowledge!

📚 PROGRESSION SYSTEM:

- Multiple chapters with unique themes and backgrounds
- Track your completion percentage for each chapter
- Replay any question to achieve 100% completion
- Unlock new ranks as you progress
- Endless mode for unlimited practice after completing chapters

🧠 DESIGNED FOR LEARNING:

Questions are carefully arranged from simple to complex. Whether you want a quick brain exercise or a deep learning session — we've got you covered.

Topics include: general knowledge, science, history, nature, culture, and more!

✨ KEY FEATURES:

- Clean, beautiful interface
- Cloud saves — keep your progress across devices
- Play anytime, anywhere
- Suitable for all ages
- Regular content updates

Play Word Search & Quiz now and start your brain training journey!

Perfect for: word puzzle lovers, trivia fans, vocabulary builders, and anyone who wants to keep their mind sharp!

title: Funny Cubes 2048
description: Discover Funny Cubes 2048, an entertaining twist on the original 2048 game featuring playful physics. Strategically combine cubes to maximize their value, use boosters, and rack up achievements while competing globally. Enjoy free online play across devices and immerse yourself in the fun of merging cubes.

title: Obby Space Challenge: Starships
description:
Obby Space Challenge: Starships is an exciting game where you get to fly starships. Collect energy capsules, earn trophies for your flights, and unlock new starships. Build a collection of the best companions, acquire the ultimate ship, and set out to explore all the locations in this cosmic world!

• Collect energy capsules!
• Earn trophies for your flights!
• Acquire companions!
• Switch starships!
• Unlock new locations!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: The game is about collecting capsules and flying a spaceship to earn trophy points.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of pet and spaceship skins, great graphics, an achievement system, and tasks to engage players.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: The more energy the character collects, the more trophies they will receive after the flight.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features energy and trophies as currencies. Trophies can be used to purchase pets and spaceships to speed up energy acquisition.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers many pet and spaceship skins that come with enhancements.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers rewards that players receive based on their time spent in the game. Rewards are refreshed daily.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Grass Defense
description: Grass Defense is a strategic tower defense where you must protect the wilderness from waves of fierce creatures. Build and upgrade powerful towers, manage resources, and adapt your tactics as enemies grow stronger. With dynamic environments, diverse foes, and challenging levels, you’ll test your strategy and skill to survive the untamed wilds and uncover hidden mysteries.

title: Night Order: Pick & Pack
description: Choose the requested items from the shelf, collect them on a tray, and carefully pack each night order.

title: Help Tricky Story A Complicated Story
description: Dive into the captivating world of Help Tricky Story, a unique online game that tests your problem-solving abilities through complex puzzles. Available for free on mobile or desktop, this engaging adventure encourages logical thinking as you face delightful challenges to sharpen your mind.

title: Sort Master
description:
Drag, tap, or move items to organize or sort them.
Each one is a distinct mini-game.
Arrange items by size, color, or another specified order.
Match items in pairs or groups.
Complete a visual task like building an image or aligning pieces.
Once everything is sorted or arranged correctly, the level ends and you can move on.

title: Obby: +1 to spaceflight altitude
description: Obby: +1 to Spaceflight Altitude invites you to embark on an exhilarating space adventure. Experience the excitement of customizable characters and rocket journeys online for free. Explore the galaxy and hone your spaceflight skills in this unforgettable game filled with thrills and exploration.

title: Pics 2 Word
description: Can you guess the word? Four pictures, one answer! Test your brain with this addictive puzzle game where every image is a clue. From easy words to mind-bending challenges, each level will have you saying "Aha!" Connect the dots between seemingly random images and discover the hidden word that ties them all together. Perfect for quick brain training or hours of puzzling fun!

title: Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing
description:
Start your engine and lose your mind in Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing — the most chaotic racing experience ever! 🇮🇹💥

Drift through endless highways, dodge traffic, and feel the pure brainrot energy of Italian-style chaos. From over-the-top cars to wild memes, it’s not just racing — it’s madness on wheels!

title: Summer Fashion Makeover
description: Lily has been neglected her look for a long time in pandemic time. When the summer come and things get better, she wants to go to the beach again. But look at her! What a scary look she has now! Let's help makeover her to be pretty and neat again!

title: Flag Painting Game
description: Welcome to Flag Coloring Game, the most relaxing coloring game where you can fill colors in beautiful country flags and show your creativity. Enjoy easy and fun painting gameplay with smooth controls and bright colors. Whether you love flag games, color games, or art games, this one gives you endless fun and learning. If you enjoy coloring games for kids or coloring books, this game is perfect for you.

title: Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle Game
description:
Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle
Enter a futuristic world of glowing pathways and strategic challenges in Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle.
Navigate neon arrows, plan your moves carefully, and solve increasingly complex logic puzzles. Every level presents a new challenge that tests your observation, timing, and problem-solving skills.
What looks simple at first quickly becomes a rewarding brain exercise. Analyze the board, identify the correct sequence, and clear the arrows without creating obstacles along the way.
FEATURES
• Challenging arrow-based logic puzzles
 • Futuristic neon and sci-fi visuals
 • Easy to learn, rewarding to master
 • Hundreds of handcrafted levels
 • Increasing difficulty and new puzzle layouts
 • Smooth controls and satisfying gameplay
 • Train your logic and critical thinking skills
 • Play anytime, anywhere at your own pace


Whether you’re looking for a relaxing puzzle experience or a true test of your problem-solving abilities, Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle offers satisfying gameplay in a stylish neon cyber world.
Can you master every puzzle and become the ultimate arrow strategist?

title: Kings Defense: Roguelike
description:
Kings Defense: Roguelike — Defend the Kingdom!

The kingdom is under threat! Enemies are advancing, and only your cannon can stop their onslaught. Kings Defense is a dynamic blend of classic block-breaker and roguelike, where every shot counts.

How to Play?
Your goal is to destroy monsters by launching chains of balls. They ricochet off walls and enemies, dealing damage. But be careful: opponents move toward the castle walls and strike back. Survive all 20 waves and defeat the final boss!

Features:

Unique Builds: Break open chests and choose skills — from lightning to splitting balls. Each run offers a new set of abilities.

Combo System: Hitting enemies with balls fills the combo meter, granting bonuses to damage and healing.

Tower Upgrades: Spend coins in the main menu to increase damage, add more balls, and boost HP.

Varied Enemies: Fight ghosts, "dodging" monsters, and cunning bosses.

Level up, combine skills, and become a legendary defender. Your kingdom awaits!

title: Mike and Mia 1st Day School
description: Mike and Mia are very excited for their first day of school. Help them to clean their room and make a delicious snack box. Get dressed up with various cute clothes. Enjoy the first day at school with fun and loving playful activities!

title: Jumping Bottle 3D
description:
📦Welcome to Jumping Bottle 3D - a game where every bottle throw is fun! 🚀

-🎮Easy and addictive gameplay: once you try it, you won't want to stop!
-🧘‍♂️Relax and unwind with one of the best stress relief games.
-🔄Interact with surrounding objects to complete levels.
-🎯Go through more than 200 levels, each of which will be a real challenge!
-🎨Unlock dozens of stylish skins and collect unique bottles! Milk, Coca-Cola, poison and many others are waiting for you.

Can you complete all the levels? Get ready for incredible adventures with Jumping Bottle 3D!

title: Flow Blast Shooter
description:
Flow Blast Shooter is a fast-paced puzzle shooter where timing and color control are the key to victory. Blocks flow continuously along a conveyor system, and it’s your job to place shooters, aim carefully, and fire at the perfect moment to keep the flow moving.

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what is the objective?
A: The player controls ""units"" (colored characters marked with a number) to fill or clear colored segments on a closed track.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: This is a typical hyper/hybrid casual game, where the narrative is secondary to the constant flow of levels.

Q: What is the unique selling point (USP)? What will hook players?
A: Number-based logic combined with color; the satisfying sensation of ""clearing"" or ""filling"" a space.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses, and how do they differ from one another?
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What in-game currencies exist, and what can they be used for (e.g., standard: gold, premium: crystals)?
A: Currency is spent on boosters.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you qualify, and what types are available (e.g., weekly, monthly, all-time)?
A: No.

Q: Is it advisable to play with the sound on for better immersion, or will playing without sound make the game more difficult?
A: The music is good and complements the gameplay, but it is not essential for completing the game."

title: Obby: Escape from Tsunami Brainrot
description: A dynamic parkour game where you have to overcome obstacles and escape from the oncoming tsunami. Reaction, speed and accuracy decide everything!

title: Robby +1 To Speed Per Second
description:
In this game, your speed increases every second. There is no speed limit. Become the fastest and pass the tests at lightning speed.

There are 4 locations in the game. Each has its own unique challenges.

Unlock the pets. Try to get everyone together.

You can purchase accessories for your character in the store.

title: Car Parking Order
description:
Car parking order game to test your brainpower and skills in this remarkable puzzle game. Unlock new levels of traffic jam game by strategically guiding the cars in the correct way and prepare for an exhilarating journey ahead. With each parking challenge, you'll find yourself fully immersed in this delightful and engaged game.

Navigate through unique parking lots by avoiding obstacles and overcoming various traffic jam hurdles in your way. From parking jam situations to unexpected roadblocks, every parking order level presents a new and exciting test of your parking abilities. Take on the role of a skilled driver and masterfully park your cars to their designated spots without a hitch. But be aware, as even the slightest miscalculation can lead to failure.

title: Turbo Stunt Racing
description: Experience high-speed thrills in Turbo Stunt Racing! Perform epic stunts, race fierce rivals, and upgrade unique cars in this 3D arcade racer packed with action, traps, and ramps. Master precision driving and dominate every level!

title: Laser Survivor
description:
Laser Survivor, a cyberpunk roguelike action-adventure set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse, the last hope for humanity rests in the hands of five heroes fighting hordes of demons pouring through a dimensional rift. Featuring pixel art visuals, randomized weapons, chiptune soundtracks, and relentless survival gameplay, every run is a test of adaptation and skill.

Story
The world has fallen. A dimensional rift has unleashed an unstoppable flood of demons, tearing through what remains of civilization. But from the chaos, five warriors rise. Each wielding unique powers forged for survival in this cyberpunk hellscape. Dropped at random into corrupted maps, they must adapt with whatever weapons and passive abilities they find, carving their path through waves of enemies, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering the truth behind the rift. The fate of Earth depends on them.

Heroes
Blaze: Fires homing bullets that lock onto the nearest enemy, ensuring no demon can escape.
Neon: Projects a protective energy shield that damages anything foolish enough to get close.
Hunter: Drops explosives that create deadly zones, controlling the battlefield with traps.
Slash: Slices enemies apart with razor-sharp horizontal cuts that pierce entire hordes.
Jaxx: A cyber-brute with massive, scaling area damage, crushing everything in his path.


Features
Cyberpunk Roguelike Gameplay: Every run is unique, with randomized spawn points, weapons, and abilities.
5 Maps to Conquer: Battle through the Lab, Forest, Crypt, Factory, and Dungeon, each swarming with demon hordes.
10 Active Weapons & 10 Passive Abilities: Build your arsenal on the fly as you adapt to randomized loadouts.
8 Missions & 11 Upgrades: Progress through challenging missions, earn permanent upgrades, and unlock new survival tactics.
Collectibles & Lore: Discover secrets that reveal the origins of the rift and the story behind the invasion.
Retro Pixel Art: Neon-infused visuals with hand-crafted pixel art and gameplay by the Felicity team.
80s Chiptune Soundtrack: Pulsating tracker music by Drozerix, driving the action with nostalgic energy.

Why Play Laser Survivor?
Fast-paced roguelike survival set in a sci-fi cyberpunk apocalypse.
Play as five unique heroes, each with distinct base abilities and upgrade paths.
Endless replayability with randomized runs and evolving builds.
Perfect for fans of pixel art shooters, bullet-hell roguelikes, and retro-inspired chiptune soundtracks.

Laser Survivor is more than survival. It’s humanity’s last stand in a cyberpunk post-apocalypse. Will you master the chaos, close the rift, and save the world... or be consumed by the demons?

title: Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks
description: Dive into the world of crafting drinks with the exciting **Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks** game. Explore diverse ingredients to create unique cocktails. Enjoy the mixology experience on any device, unwind at your virtual bar, and become a master drink creator.

title: Drakkar Strike
description: Sail the seas on your drakkar, launch spears like a furious slingshot, and crush enemy vikings before they sink you!

title: Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number, where the art of coloring meets the intrigue of puzzles. This free online game offers a delightful escape, combining the therapeutic joys of adult coloring with the challenge of matching stickers to solve intricate puzzles. Unleash your creativity and witness your imaginations come to life as you craft stunning masterpieces, one sticker at a time, on both your phone and computer.

title: Archer Defense
description: Arcade tower defense game where you play as an archer defending a castle. Shoot enemies, earn gold for upgrades, and survive endless waves. Compete with friends on Playgama leaderboards, unlock achievements, and save your progress in the cloud. Simple to learn, challenging to master!

title: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook
description:
😊Want to relax while destroying buildings with rope and grappling hooks? Do you like casual hits like "Rope and Demolish" with realistic destruction physics? Then this game is for you!

⭐ Main features ⭐
- Simple and intuitive controls will allow you to easily master the game
- Realistic and fun physics of object destruction
- You can play from your smartphone and PC. Anywhere and anytime
- A store where you can upgrade your car or buy a new one
- Leaderboard. Take first place and show who is the best destroyer here

💕If you liked the game, please support us! To do this, just leave a good review and describe what pleased you! ★★★★★;-)

✉️If you find any bugs, please write to us and we will try to fix them quickly! Our goal is to make fun and high-quality games!

👆Hurry up and click “Play” and plunge into the exciting atmosphere of the free online game “Demolition Car - Rope and Hook!”

title: Club Guard
description:
Club Guard is a simulation game where you take on the role of a nightclub security guard. Your task is to check visitors at the entrance, find prohibited items (weapons, alcohol and other contraband items) and decide who to allow to enter and who to deny entry. The game is characterized by unusual humor, absurd situations and freedom of action: you can search people, take away their belongings, use force or even beat them if you decide that they violate the rules.

Game Features:

Interactive gameplay : Check pockets, bags and clothes of visitors to find hidden items.
Absurd humor : Each visitor is unique, with unusual dialogues and behaviors.
Freedom of action : You can be strict, fair or even ruthless - it's all up to you.
Variety of situations : From fights to strange requests, every day at the club is unpredictable.
Simple graphics : Minimalistic style and intuitive controls make the game accessible to everyone.

title: Melon Maker : Fruit Game
description:
Merge the same fruits to keep making it bigger and finally match melon.
Challenge yourself with all other players around the world to make the biggest melon!
Don't let your fruit out of the box! Otherwise, you will lose

title: Obby Easy Grow!
description:
A game in Roblox style with the Obby mode! Complete exciting and varied obstacle courses for a while, using checkpoints to save your progress and not start all over again if you accidentally fall.

Incredible challenges and unique mechanics await you here! The main feature of the game is the ability to change the size of the character to overcome obstacles and find a way to the finish.

The game has a large selection of characters and deep customization: choose the appearance, clothes and accessories to create a unique hero. Each level is a new challenge, where it is important not only to complete the track, but also to do it faster than everyone else. Watch the timer and improve your results to become the best in this game.

Nice graphics with bright colors and detailed levels make the game visually attractive, and smooth animation adds pleasure from the passage. Compete with friends and players from all over the world to take first place in the leaderboard!

title: Cannon Ball 3D : Big Boom Obby
description:
A satisfying physics puzzle shooter packed with 100 handcrafted stages. Take control of a powerful cannon, line up the perfect shot, and launch heavy cannonballs into towers, stacks, and tricky block formations. Your goal is simple: knock every block off the golden base plate before your shots run out.

Each stage challenges you to think carefully about angle, force, timing, and momentum. Some levels can be cleared with brute force, while others require smart ricochets, chain reactions, and precise hits on weak points. As the stages progress, the layouts become more complex, with tougher structures, awkward angles, and fewer chances to make mistakes.

With easy-to-learn controls, satisfying destruction, and clever physics-based puzzles, every shot matters. Aim well, make the blocks tumble, and clear all 100 stages to prove you are the ultimate cannon master.

title: BFF Easter Photobooth Party
description: Get the girls all set: it’s time to shine, dress them up in outfits so fine; strike a pose with flair and cheer for Easter fun and style are here!

title: Canyon Drifter
description: 2D moto-trial built around tough tracks and dialing in your bike. Pick a build for the dirt and the terrain, clear steep climbs and jumps by leaning for balance, and fight for the best time on the leaderboard. Stuck on a track you just can't clear? Head to the garage, retune your bike, and suddenly it's rideable.

title: Slide Blocks 3D
description: Slide Blocks 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing sliding puzzle. Colorful pictures are cut into blocks and scrambled across the board — slide the pieces to put every picture back together before the timer runs out. Levels grow bigger and trickier as you progress. Earn coins, claim daily rewards, and climb the leaderboard!

title: Red Hide Ball
description:
Passionate about brain teasers? Want to challenge your logical skills? Then take a look at Hide Ball a logic puzzle game in which you should hide good balls from dreadful and harmful monsters.
Red Hide Ball is an amusing logic game that will test your IQ and raise your intellectual abilities to a new level. Plan every step, estimate a possible outcome and build tactical strategies. Solve logical puzzles, pass lots of interesting levels and win the game!

title: PolyBounce Tycoon
description:
PolyBounce Tycoon is an idle + arcade style ball bounce game with physics! Spawn balls, bounce them around, earn virtual cash, and unlock new arenas.

Features:

Arena Shapes: Play inside circles, squares, triangles, hexagons, and more. Each level changes the arena.

Balls: Spawn manually or let the auto spawner (auto clicker style) do the work.

Virtual Earnings: Every bounce gives you in-game cash with popup text and sound effects. The amount grows dynamically ($1.5k, $2.5m, etc.).

Upgrades:

Spawn new balls.

Increase virtual cash earned per bounce.

Speed up the auto spawner.

Upgrade balls with new sprites and levels.

Next Level: Unlock new arena shapes, reset upgrades, and multiply your in-game profits.

Idle mechanics, bounce physics, and tycoon upgrades combined. Build your ball idle empire in PolyBounce Tycoon!

(Note: All cash in this game is virtual currency and has no real-world value.)

title: Brainrot Merge: Drop Puzzle
description: Brainrot Merge: Drop Puzzle is a wildly absurd merge puzzle game where quirky creatures evolve into chaotic meme-powered icons. Drop and combine animals to unlock hilarious AI-generated characters, each more bizarre than the last. With endless levels, unexpected surprises, and brain-zapping humor, every merge brings you one step closer to the ultimate meme monster.

title: Jewel Blocks
description: Enter the dazzling world of Jewel Blocks, a captivating free online game designed to sharpen your mind and elevate your gaming experience. In this logic-infused arcade challenge, players are tasked with strategizing the perfect placement of classic block shapes to smash high scores and unlock a treasure trove of rewards. With its easy-to-learn mechanics and a vast array of customizable skins, Jewel Blocks promises endless hours of entertainment on both computer and mobile devices. Are you ready to take on this glittering challenge?

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Emily's Hotel Solitaire
description:
Dive into the atmosphere of a light summer adventure in Emily’s Hotel Solitaire!

What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.
Forget about your problems and immerse yourselves in the magical atmosphere of a tropical island and a challenging game of Emily's Hotel Solitaire! Build your own hotel together with Emily, as every victory in Emily's Hotel Solitaire will let you get closer to your dream of creating the best hotel in the world! Plant green parks and picturesque flowerbeds, make sure that the rooms are cozy and also think about the menu of the Chinese restaurant!
Every Star earned on the game levels allows you to select what to decorate a once deserted territory — lay the carpets and place soft little sofas. Or maybe decorate the walls with a picture gallery?

title: Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape
description:
Become the fastest and most daring stickman in this fun arcade game! Your goal is to race through the corridors of the hotel, ring the doors, knock and slam them, arranging epic pranks. The main thing is not to get caught! Residents' reactions are unpredictable, and danger can lurk around every corner.
- Dynamic gameplay — run, prank and avoid capture!
- Different doors and reactions — someone will get scared, someone will get angry!
- Fun challenges — show agility and speed!
- Bright minimalistic style is a classic stickman action game!
- Simple controls — addictive gameplay in a couple of clicks!

title: Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle
description:
Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle combines colorful region puzzles with simple but challenging placement rules. Your goal is to place exactly one cat inside every colored territory while making sure no two cats share the same row or column.

Cats also need their personal space. They cannot touch each other diagonally, even at the corners. Every placement affects the entire board, so careful observation and logical thinking are essential.

The puzzles begin gently, allowing you to understand the rules and develop your strategy. As you progress, the boards become more challenging and require deeper planning. Every cat must be placed for a clear reason, because random guesses can quickly lead to mistakes.

Wrong moves cost hearts, so take your time and study the grid before tapping. Eliminate impossible spaces, compare colored regions, and use row and column restrictions to discover the correct solution.

Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle is perfect for players who enjoy Sudoku, logic grids, brain teasers, and relaxing puzzle games. Its simple controls and adorable cat theme make every challenge easy to start but satisfying to master.

How to Play
Place One Cat in Every Region

Each colored territory must contain exactly one cat. Leaving a region empty or placing multiple cats inside it will prevent you from completing the puzzle.

Avoid Matching Rows and Columns

No two cats can appear in the same horizontal row or vertical column. A placed cat blocks every other space along both lines.

Keep Cats Apart

Cats cannot touch diagonally. Even if two cats only meet at their corners, the placement is not allowed.

Protect Your Hearts

Incorrect taps reduce your available hearts. Think carefully, use logic, and avoid guessing whenever possible.

Features
Relaxing cat-themed logic puzzles
One cat required in every colored region
Row and column exclusion rules
Diagonal placement restrictions
Heart-based mistake system
Simple tap controls
Increasing puzzle difficulty
Clean and colorful visuals
Short levels for quick play sessions
Brain training through logical deduction
Easy to understand and challenging to master

Study every region, find the safest spaces, and place all the cats correctly in Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle.

Spend scrolls on kingdom upgrades and place new structures — a villager-collecting Tower, a resident-attracting Bell Tower and a coin-producing Laboratory — to automate your empire. Keep clicking, keep scratching and keep expanding until every upgrade is unlocked and your kingdom reaches its full potential. Can you build the ultimate Clickdom?

title: Roots and Wheels
description:
This exciting simulator presents you with an ambitious task: get behind the wheel of a powerful truck and transport as many crates as possible through dangerous and unpredictable locations to your destination.


Success depends on your skill—your ability to feel the vehicle and react to road conditions—and your wits—your ability to find the best solutions in difficult situations, whether it's mud, steep climbs, or destroyed bridges. Every box delivered brings you closer to your reward.


By earning money for completed trips, you get the opportunity to upgrade your truck – from the engine to the suspension to the wheels – and better equip it for the challenges of the terrain.


You can also buy new vehicle models, expanding your options and gaining access to new types of missions and cargo. Show what a real driver can do!

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

title: Makeover Mayhem
description: A head-to-head ASMR cleaning duel. You and a rival race to scrub five grimy items back to a sparkling shine — scrape, spray, scrub, and squeegee your way through each one and finish all five before they do (or before the 4-minute timer runs out).

title: Tornado: Fury of the elements
description:
In this game you take on the role of a tornado lord, who must wreak havoc and destruction in the city. Your task is to create powerful whirlwinds, destroy buildings and infrastructure, and avoid collisions with defenses and other obstacles.

You will be able to improve your tornado control skills and destructive power to wreak havoc more effectively.

“Tornado: Fury of the Element” is an exciting game that will make you feel like a real master of the elements. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games and simulators.

title: Car Stunts Driving
description:
Drive a realistic car, drive along tracks with obstacles. Lots of different tracks for car stunts.
You have to drive the car along the tracks in the sky, overcome interesting obstacles and try not to fall off the track into the abyss!
The game has many different levels and realistic car physics.

title: Big Wild Bucks: Voxel Buck Hunter
description: A fast first-person voxel hunting game. Raise your rifle, line up the shot, and take down trophy bucks across changing treks — from pine valleys to ember woods, murky hollows, and frozen basins. Shoot a doe and you’re busted, so aim true. Upgrade rifles and ammo, collect rare coats, fill your trophy room, and chase higher scores with combos, critter bonuses, and bird rounds. Scope in, hold steady, and bring home the bucks.

title: Millionaire Factory
description:
Millionaire Factory 🔩🏭 is a fun and addictive 🎉 clicker game where players collect Metal to grow their fortune. By tapping the giant Metal button 👆, players gather Metals, convert them into Money 💰, and invest in upgrades to build their own factory empire.

The game offers a growth journey that starts with a small piece of Metal 🔩 and expands into a massive factory and investment fortune 📈📉.

title: Origin
description:
Collect the orbs to unlock the door and escape! Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to move and jump. To activate the door, collect all the black orbs.

In later levels, you'll be able to double jump. You can press W or UP twice to double jump. However, you only have a limited amount of chances to do this, indicated by the JUMP counter in the upper left corner of the screen.

Make sure you avoid the spikes!

title: School Escape Obby
description:
Dive into the thrilling world of School Escape Obby — a vibrant online game in roblox style with stunning graphics and diverse locations!
Tackle unique challenges in each zone, from school corridors to mysterious dungeons. Customize your character with hundreds of stylish skins and compete with friends in multiplayer mode. Every obstacle tests your agility and wit: jump, dodge, and solve puzzles to escape the school! Perfect for all skill levels, the game combines fast-paced platforming with creative level design. Regular updates, eye-catching visuals, and competitive leaderboards make this game a top choice for fans of obstacle courses. Join millions of players worldwide and prove your skills!

title: Obby Fishing: Catch the Megalodon
description:
Feel like a real angler! Different fish species require a special approach. Keep a close eye on the float, feel the tension of the line during the bite, and show your skill to reel in a rare trophy! From tiny crucian carps to giant legendary creatures - catch them all!

🛒 Upgrade Your Gear
Start with a simple bamboo rod and earn coins to become a true pro!

🌀 Open Portals to Other Worlds!
This isn't just fishing in a pond! By collecting enough rare fish or completing achievements, you can activate a magic portal and travel to a brand new dimension for fishing!

📈 Achievement & Collection System
Collect a unique catalog of fish from each world, complete daily quests, and earn rewards. Become a legend by catching the rarest fish of all - the MEGALODON!

title: Epic Battle Simulator
description:
Epic Battle Simulator throws you into a thrilling warzone where strategy meets non-stop action!
Train and upgrade your army, push your limits to reach record-breaking levels, and crush enemy forces before they breach your base.
Unleash powerful units, plan your attacks wisely, and prove your dominance on the battlefield.
Will your defenses hold the line, or will the enemy break through?

Join the fight and become the ultimate commander!

title: Epic Battle Simulator
description:
Epic Battle Simulator throws you into a thrilling warzone where strategy meets non-stop action!
Train and upgrade your army, push your limits to reach record-breaking levels, and crush enemy forces before they breach your base.
Unleash powerful units, plan your attacks wisely, and prove your dominance on the battlefield.
Will your defenses hold the line, or will the enemy break through?

Join the fight and become the ultimate commander!

title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
description:
The Road Home: Granny Escape is a terrifying 3D horror survival game where your only goal is to escape a haunted house filled with danger, puzzles, and fear. You're not here by accident — Granny and Grandpa brought you here on purpose, and they won’t let you go easily.

🕯 The Story
Your trip home took a dark turn. While riding a bus through a remote forest, a massive tree crashed down onto the road. You stepped out to investigate… and everything went black.

You wake up in a locked, eerie house. The windows are boarded up. The doors are sealed. And something is watching you. You soon realize the terrifying truth: you’ve been kidnapped and trapped by an evil Granny and her mad husband.

This isn’t just a place — it’s a prison designed to break you.

🎯 What You Must Do
-Explore the dark and haunted house
-Solve puzzles and unlock secret passages
-Craft useful items from the resources you find
-Avoid Granny and Grandpa — they can hear your every move
-Survive deadly traps and unpredictable chases
-Make your way to freedom before it’s too late

⚙️ Game Features
-A chilling 3D horror experience with immersive atmosphere
-Evil and intelligent enemies who react to sound and movement
-Multiple escape paths and secret endings
-A full crafting system: collect, combine, survive
-Puzzles, keys, locked rooms, and hidden objects
-A heavy dose of mental horror and psychological tension
-Every sound matters. Every choice counts.

❗️ Not Just a Game — A Nightmare
This isn’t just a scary house — it’s a living nightmare. There’s evil in the walls, and death behind every corner. Will you outsmart your captors, or will fear consume you?

Use your brain, stay quiet, and find your way out… if you still can.

Download The Road Home: Granny Escape — and see if you have what it takes to survive the fear, escape the madness, and get back home.

title: Pixel Color Flow
description:
Pixel Color Flow is a fun, satisfying color matching puzzle game where you clear a board of pixel cubes by sending cute pigs onto a conveyor. 
Each pig drops balls onto only the cubes of the same color, so your main challenge is choosing the right order and managing the queue to clean the board efficiently.

Every pig has an ammo count (shown as a number above its head). When it runs out, the pig leaves. If ammo is still left, the pig can move into one of 5 waiting slots, ready to be sent again when you tap. The conveyor also has a capacity limit, so smart timing matters don’t overflow it.

title: Color Water Sort 3D
description: Color Water Sort 3D is a fun and challenging 3D casual puzzle game. The core concept revolves around sorting chaotic colors into perfect order, offering players an incredibly satisfying and stress-relieving experience. Set in a vibrant 3D environment, your task is to sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one single color. With levels ranging from simple to brain-teasing, it perfectly balances strategic thinking with a relaxing atmosphere, making it the ultimate brain trainer and time killer. What makes it unique is its realistic 3D visuals, smooth pouring physics, and the deeply addictive sense of accomplishment with every puzzle solved.

title: Trash Sort
description:
You play as a trash sort every bottle, can, paper scrap, or food waste you sort correctly helps nature recover. 
As you recycle more, the scenes slowly change from polluted and gray to clean, colorful, and full of happy animals again. 
It feels simple to play, but very satisfying to watch the environment heal because of your actions.

title: Bouncy Motors
description:
Driving a car that bounces like jelly, you need to get to the finish line.
Beware of red zones - wheels fall off on impact! 
Also be careful when driving on ice!

title: The Pirate Sea. The Smuggler's Way
description:
In the game you have to take on the role of a smuggler.

Search for treasures, complete various tasks, destroy enemy ships, capture islands, upgrade your ship, beware of sea monsters and become the most famous smuggler.

title: Matching Tiles 3D
description:
Match, tap, and clear your way to victory in Matching Tiles 3D.
Train your brain and sharpen your memory in this fun and relaxing 3D puzzle game. Your goal is simple: find and select two tiles with the same image to clear them from the board. Keep matching until all tiles are gone and claim your win.
With beautifully designed 3D objects and satisfying gameplay, Matching Tiles 3D offers the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Whether you want to unwind or test your focus, this game is made for you.
Features:
• Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay
• Stunning 3D tile designs
• Smooth and satisfying matching mechanics
• Increasing difficulty to keep you challenged
• Perfect for all ages
Can you clear all the tiles and become a true matching master? Start playing now and find out.

title: Sorting Ball Puzzle
description:
As the most relaxing and addictive color sorting game, this ball puzzle is designed to entertain and sharpen your mind at the same time. While sorting the colored balls to fill each bottle with the same color, the relaxation it brings will relieve stress and distract you from your daily worries.

This classic color sorting game is pretty simple to play, but hard to master. Just tap to take a colored ball from one bottle and stack it into another bottle, until all balls of the same color are in the same bottle. However, there are thousands of puzzles of varying difficulty. The more challenging the puzzles you play, the more careful you need to be with each move. Each move cannot be taken lightly, or you may get stuck! This Ball Sort game is definitely the best puzzle game for you to exercise your brain and train your logical thinking.

title: PC Cafe Simulator 3D
description:
🎮 Welcome to "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" — become the owner of the gaming club of your dreams!

💻 Assemble gaming PCs from components: powerful processors, top-tier graphics cards, and cool accessories for the ultimate gaming experience.

🕹️ Host gamer clients, including popular characters, and earn money from their love of gaming!

🔧 Repair equipment and keep your club running smoothly, ensuring everyone enjoys their favorite games.

📈 Climb the leaderboard of the best club owners, expand your business, and add more gaming stations.

🌅 Day and night cycles bring your club to life: lively during the day, planning and upgrading at night.

🔥 Build a club that becomes legendary among gamers! Play "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" today!

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens and defeated all the monsters! But just when you thought it was over, the monsters returned!

The evil Huggy has kidnapped all the kittens yet again! But this time, Nubik has armed himself with a whole new arsenal of weapons! In this game, you'll get your hands on an AK-47 assault rifle, an M16 rifle, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two incredibly powerful shotguns!

Help Nubik find the kittens to claim a reward of one million coins! Search for and open loot chests, upgrade your character, and blow up TNT blocks! What's more, Nubik's friend keeps getting caught by the monsters and thrown behind bars—help Nubik break him out of prison!

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens and defeated all the monsters! But just when you thought it was over, the monsters returned!

The evil Huggy has kidnapped all the kittens yet again! But this time, Nubik has armed himself with a whole new arsenal of weapons! In this game, you'll get your hands on an AK-47 assault rifle, an M16 rifle, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two incredibly powerful shotguns!

title: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater
description: Get ready to deck the halls with festive creativity in DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater! Join three BFFs as they design their unique ugly Christmas sweaters for an epic holiday party. Choose sweater colors and decorate them with Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, globes, lights, bows, and more! Complete their holiday looks with new hairstyles and festive accessories. Show off your holiday spirit and create the ultimate cozy, ugly sweater masterpiece in this fun and festive game!

title: Love Story: Find the Piece
description:
What did her boyfriend do? This is the most fun and fascinating puzzle about lovers! Turn on logic and creative thinking! Solve funny puzzles in a love story! If you like hidden object games and finding hidden objects, then this game is just for you
What is she thinking about? What is he hiding? An exciting adventure of a couple and funny situations you will definitely like. Take the scanner and find the solution to the puzzle! It's a lot of fun!

title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
description: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat is a fun meme game where you need to break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks, and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo. Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record. Play the Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat game at now and have fun.

title: Clawler Fight
description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling blend of addictive gameplay of Clawler fight! In this action-packed game, you step into the shoes of an ordinary guy on a mission to survive the zombie apocalypse while tackling challenging levels. Maneuver a crane equipped with a claw to pick up objects and launch them at zombies! As you advance, you will collect valuable resources and currency, unlocking powerful upgrades for your character through a card-based skill progression system.

Prepare for fierce battles against a variety of terrifying zombies, each possessing unique abilities and strengths. Your ultimate objective is to survive.

Are you ready to face the ultimate challenge of skill and strategy? Gather your courage, sharpen your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable adventure in this ARPG masterpiece!

title: BS Simulator
description:
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS
Unlock and upgrade a variety of Brawlers! Level up your Brawlers and collect unique skins.

TROPHY ROAD
Collect trophies to earn rewards and advance to new leagues!

BRAWL PASS
- More than 140 rewards!
- Complete daily quests and unlock exclusive rewards.

LEADERBOARDS
Compete with real players from all over the world!

DAILY BONUSES
Log in to the game every day and receive exclusive bonuses!

In addition, the game has mini-modes.

title: Crazy Merge Room
description:
Crazy Merge Room is a fast-paced puzzle-merging game where chaos and strategy collide!
Inside a mysterious room filled with quirky objects, wacky characters, and unpredictable surprises, your mission is simple: merge identical items to unlock stronger, crazier versions — and clear the room before it overflows!

Slide, combine, and organize everything from everyday objects to bizarre inventions. Each successful merge transforms the room, unlocking new levels, weird challenges, and powerful boosters. But watch out — the room keeps spawning items faster and faster, so keep your strategy sharp!

Perfect for players who love chaotic fun, satisfying merges, and addictive progression.

title: Escape from School 3D
description:
🏃‍♂️ Welcome to Escape from School 3D – the ultimate blox-style school escape game full of chaos, action, and fun! Trapped in a crazy high school, you must fight your way through evil teachers, bullies, principals, and headmasters to break free.

💥 Armed with anything you can find—baseball bats, bricks, slingshots, and more—it's up to you to survive the madness and make your daring escape!

🎮 Game Features:

• Action-packed school escape gameplay with hilarious chaos
• Dodge and fight angry teachers, bullies, and bosses
• Use funny and destructive weapons: bricks, bats, and more!
• Cartoony, blox-style graphics and smooth controls
• Explore multiple school zones: classrooms, hallways, gyms, and rooftops!
• Fast-paced and addictive gameplay with survival elements
• Easy to pick up, hard to put down – perfect for all ages!

title: World Flags: Color Puzzle
description: A unique flag-coloring puzzle combined with world exploration. Test your geography knowledge by painting flags correctly, then fly your plane across the globe to discover and unlock new countries.

title: Sprunki Adventure 4
description:
🎮 Welcome to the frozen world of "Sprunki Adventure 4"! ❄️🏔️

A real disaster has struck the world of Sprunki — the huge Central Heater suddenly broke down, and a harsh winter quickly covered all the lands!

🧩 Begin a new adventure with Sprunki!
🔧 Search for lost parts to repair the Heater
👥 Help characters and complete winter quests

Your main goal is to collect all the necessary parts and help repair the Great Heater before the world completely freezes.

Can you bring warmth back to the world of Sprunki? 🔥

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description:
🌸 Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy 🧊 and fly through levels full of danger: fire 🔥, ice ❄️, lasers ⚡, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control 👆, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

💰 Collect coins, open chests 🎁, find eggs 🥚, and hatch new Fluffies in the incubator! Every hero is a unique fluffy cube with personality. Build your collection — from common to rare and hilarious! 😍

🚁 A friendly drone awaits you in the main menu — it guards your incubator and reacts to your actions. Customize it 🎨 to make it truly yours!

🎵 Fun music, colorful 3D visuals, and tons of fluffy joy await! Happy Fluffy Cubes is perfect for kids and anyone who loves cheerful and casual games! 🐾✨

title: Sheep Sort
description:
Welcome to Sheep Sort Color Match Puzzle Game! 
This is the best Color Puzzle Game where you sort sheep, match colors, and have lots of fun! Sheep Sort Color Match Puzzle Game is easy, relaxing, and full of cute sheep. Enjoy sorting sheep in this amazing Color Puzzle Game!

title: Category Match
description:
Category Match is a fun, relaxing, and brain-teasing puzzle game where you match cute memoji cards by their correct categories.

Look carefully at every card, understand the character style, and place each memoji into the right group. Every level gives you a new matching challenge where smart moves, good observation, and simple logic help you clear the board.

The game starts easy, but as you progress, the puzzles become more interesting with more categories, limited space, and tricky card arrangements. You need to think before every move and match the memojis in the best way.

With colorful visuals, smooth gameplay, satisfying matches, and easy controls, Category Match is perfect for players who love matching games, sorting games, card puzzles, emoji games, and relaxing brain games.

Match the cards, complete the categories, and clear every level with your best strategy!

title: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream
description: Are you a waffle lover? Are you an ice cream lover? This game is perfect for you. Let's make some waffle and decorate it with ice cream and any kind of fruits and syrups! Be a waffle maker!

title: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie
description:
Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie - Your Camp, Your Rules! 

You are the leader of a survivor group in the heart of a zombie apocalypse. This is a thrilling idle tycoon strategy where your goal is to protect the barrier, gather resources, and survive! A true survival simulator for those who love camp management and crushing hordes of enemies.
What awaits you:

✅ Trap Defense: Protect your barrier! Research and install deadly gear - from deadly spikes to massive decoy bombs!
✅  Relocation & Progress: Don't stay still! Move between motels and farms, upgrade your camp, and unlock new zones.
✅  Scavenging Runs: Send your team for fuel. It’s a classic survival strategy - every drop of gas counts!
✅  Camp Evolution: Develop your facilities, automate your income, and become the ultimate master of the wasteland!

Strengthen the barrier, gear up your scouts, and hit the gas. Become a survival legend right now!

title: Gunner Pursuit
description: Dive into the thrilling universe of Gunner Pursuit, where fast-paced action and weaponry collide. Experience intense pursuits and shoot from your fast-moving vehicle while navigating enemies. Enhance your gear for survival and triumph in every challenging stage. Enjoy this free game on your phone or computer for continuous excitement.

title: Tap tap Swing
description: A simple casual game Touch to fly, hold to hover, and release to fall. In this game, your agility will be tested. Pass through obstacles and avoid crashing. Avoid all obstacles and don't fall to stay alive. Enjoy the beautiful music and complete the levels that challenge your adrenaline.

title: Cosmic Dash
description: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you pilot your way across the solar system, dodging space junk, collecting tokens, and smashing asteroids. The core loop is simple—travel as far as you can while managing jumps, shrinks, and speed boosts—but what makes it stand out is its layered mechanics: shrinking lets you slip through debris, boosts let you destroy asteroids, and big tokens chain into massive rewards. The mix of fast reflex gameplay, mission objectives, and planetary backdrops gives it a fresh twist on the classic runner genre.

title: Drago Warrior Tower Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in Drago Warrior Tower Defense, an epic strategy tower defense game where ferocious dragons threaten a trapped warrior hero! As the last guardian, summon legendary heroes, command powerful dragons, and deploy diverse towers to build an impenetrable defense against waves of dark monsters. The core idea is tactical placement and skill activation—unique for its dragon-commanding mechanics, hero spells, manual targeting, and fiery boss battles that blend classic TD with mythical fantasy flair!

title: Ant Colony Idle
description:
Ant Colony Idle is a relaxing incremental clicker game where you grow a tiny ant nest into a thriving underground colony. Tap the soil to find food, send workers to gather resources, and expand important chambers to boost your colony's income over time.

Unlock new food slots, upgrade rooms like the Food Storage, Nursery, and Queen Chamber, and keep improving your colony with powerful upgrades, cosmetic skins, achievements, and prestige bonuses.

Whether you play actively or let your ants keep working in the background, progress never stops. Start small, manage your nest wisely, and build the strongest ant colony possible.

title: Devil Die
description:
Devil Die looks like a simple, cute 2D platformer until the floor suddenly disappears, spikes pop out of nowhere, and the “safe” door turns into a trap.

You play as a tiny pixel hero trying to reach the exit door in each stage. The controls are super easy, but the levels are full of hidden tricks: falling platforms, surprise buzzsaws, moving walls, reversed controls, fake safe zones, and more. The game starts simple and then slowly turns into a rage-game where every step can be a trap.

title: Bubble Boom
description: A classic bubble shooter where you’ll need to show your skills! Aim, shoot, and pop bubbles through colorful levels filled with fun challenges and relaxing gameplay.

title: Good and Evil DressUp
description: Dive into the enchanting world of a sorceress at a magical academy in "Good and Evil DressUp." Experiment with striking outfits that blend good and evil, featuring everything from shiny leather to elegant satin. Enjoy this free online game on your phone or computer, unleashing your creativity in limitless fashion.

title: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon
description: Embark on a journey to build your own empire in Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon, an engaging online economic simulator that combines elements of resource crafting, empire development, and clicker gameplay. As the ruler of a thriving island, your mission is to explore every corner, uncover precious resources, and craft them into valuable goods. By hiring managers and traders, you can automate tasks and maximize profits, ensuring your empire's success both on the phone and on the computer. Upgrade your factories, fulfill production orders, and let your empire shine in this captivating free game.

title: Rocketcar Cup
description: Rocketcar Cup is a fast-paced 2D arcade soccer game where rocket-powered cars battle for victory. Boost, jump, flip, and master aerial moves to score incredible goals in exciting one-on-one or team matches. Use skill, timing, and strategy to outplay your opponents, defend your goal, and become the ultimate champion. Easy to learn, challenging to master, and packed with non-stop action for players of all ages.

title: Arrows Idle
description: Clear the grid, trigger massive chain reactions, and upgrade your way to a perfect flow in this satisfying arrow-merging idle clicker!

title: Stick Box - Ragdoll Slowmo
description:
Immerse yourself in a frantic action game starring a flexible blue ragdoll! Pull his body, help him overcome obstacles, and engage in dynamic battles against hordes of red stickmen. Each level is a new challenge, where not only dexterity but also strategy are essential.

Unlock new weapons: boxing gloves, knives, bats, pistols, and even unexpected objects that transform into powerful weapons.

⚔️ Key Features:
💥 Realistic ragdoll physics – funny and spectacular!
🔫 Huge arsenal: from gloves to firearms.
👊 Levels with enemies and powerful bosses.
🎮 Simple controls: pull, hit, win!

title: Color Hole
description: Color Hole is a fun casual game where you control a hole that sucks in objects. Your task is to guide the hole to eat all the white objects while avoiding the colorful ones. As you progress through the levels, the game gets more challenging with more complex obstacles to avoid. Use your strategy and quick reflexes to become the ultimate Color Hole master!

title: Mega Sweet Fruits - Popper
description:
Welcome to Mega Sweet Fruits - Popper! 🍉💥
Take on 125 exciting levels filled with colorful fruits, plan your moves, and test your skills. 🎯🧩
But be careful! ⚠️🍒 Some fruits hide bombs that can cost you a life. Every move matters! ⏳❤️
Upgrade your abilities: increase your tap power, boost your starting lives, and use powerful pomegranates to clear the screen in one strike! 🍊🚀
Each level gets more challenging, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥
Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮
With 8 supported languages (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese), you can share the same thrill with players worldwide. 🌍🗣️

title: Arrow Fever
description: Arrow Fever is an exciting action game where players use a bow and arrow to defeat foes. It's a trending, free, and no-registration-required title available on iOS, Android, and desktops. Level up your character and enjoy challenging gameplay with rewards for skill and strategy.

description: Arrow Fever is an exciting action game where players use a bow and arrow to defeat foes. It's a trending, free, and no-registration-required title available on iOS, Android, and desktops. Level up your character and enjoy challenging gameplay with rewards for skill and strategy.

title: Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja
description: Experience the thrill of battle in "Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja," a 2D fighting game enriched with RPG elements. Conquer over 120 levels, facing tough bosses, customize your character, and unlock legendary gear. Play this engaging game for free online on your phone or computer.

title: Your Obby Labyrinth
description:
Join an exciting multiplayer maze adventure! Team up with friends to explore tricky mazes full of secrets, funny messages, cool prizes, and hidden paths!

Pick awesome character skins and cute pets to join you! Dodge silly AI monsters and funny NPCs that make your journey fun!

Easy controls let you use doors, levers, buttons, and keys to escape! Each maze has colorful places, sneaky traps and puzzles.

Jump into magical portals and discover new maze adventures! Chat, laugh, and escape in your-styled universe !

title: Sprunki Adventure 5
description:
🎮 Welcome to the scorching world of "Sprunki Adventure 5"! ☀️🌵

A new disaster has struck the world of Sprunki — extreme global warming has turned the once peaceful lands into a blazing desert! The rivers have dried up, the lakes have disappeared, and everyone is desperately searching for water.

💧 Begin a brand-new adventure with Sprunki!
🥤 Collect 15 bottles of water hidden across the world
👥 Help characters and complete exciting quests

Your main goal is to find all 15 bottles of water and fill the giant bathtub before the heat becomes unbearable.

title: Knife Slice 3D
description:
Flip, slice, and conquer your way through exciting obstacle-filled levels in Knife Slice 3D! Master realistic knife physics as you jump between platforms, slice through stacks of objects, collect apples, and avoid deadly traps. Time every flip perfectly to reach the portal and complete increasingly challenging levels.

Explore colorful low-poly worlds filled with forests, castles, and unique environments while unlocking powerful new knives. Easy one-tap controls make the game simple to pick up, but only the most skilled players can master every level and achieve perfect landings.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing casual game or a fast-paced precision challenge, Knife Slice 3D delivers satisfying gameplay that's perfect for both desktop and mobile browsers.

Features
🔪 Addictive one-tap knife flipping gameplay
🍎 Slice objects and collect apples
⚠️ Dodge spinning saws, spikes, and challenging obstacles
🌲 Beautiful low-poly 3D environments
🎯 Smooth physics-based controls
🏰 Unlock new knives and explore unique worlds

title: Obby Royal races in flight
description: Obby: Royal Races in Flight is an exciting online racing game where players can unlock fast cars and navigate challenging courses. Available on multiple platforms, it features stunning 3D graphics, opportunities for car upgrades, and fun for all ages, including exclusive options for premium members.

title: Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots
description:
Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots! Escape the tsunami, upgrade your base, rescue, and steal Brainrots. Can you catch all the legendary Brainrots?

Are you ready for the wildest race of your life? This exciting game offers an incredible mix of action and collecting! Your main goal is to escape the giant tsunami that's relentlessly pursuing you.

How to play? 🎮
Control your character, accelerate, and collect funny creatures along the way—Brainrots. The more you catch, the more you earn! But be careful: hesitate, and the wave will completely overwhelm you.

Development and leveling up 💪
Earn coins and invest them in upgrades! Level up your Brainrots to make them more profitable. Expand your base by unlocking new slots.

Legendary Goal ✨
Rumors of legendary creatures circulate among the many Brainrots... Will you be the lucky one to solve this mystery? Only the fastest and luckiest will reach the final!

Join the chase, dodge the waves, complete your collection, and become the world champion of "Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots"! 🏆

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: You must survive a tsunami, rescue brainrots, and upgrade your base.

Q: Is there a storyline?

A: There isn't a formal story, but the objective is clear: escape the tsunami, save brainrots, and improve your base.

Q: What is the game's hook or unique feature?

A: The game features obbies and rare brainrots.

Q: Are there any particularly engaging elements?

A: The game includes rare and funny brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work?

A: You earn coins from brainrots and invest them to increase your running speed. You can also level up your brainrots to make them more profitable and expand your base by unlocking new slots.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and how are they spent?

A: There are two currencies: money and diamonds. They can be spent on speed boosts, packs, and the battle pass.

Q: Are there in-game purchases?

A: Yes, you can purchase diamonds and a battle pass.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards to keep players coming back?

A: Yes, logging in every day grants you diamonds, money, or a brainrot.

Q: Is it better to play with sound?

A: The music complements the experience well, but it isn't required to progress through the game.

title: Rumbox Designer
description:
"Rumbox Designer" is a game about creating cozy mini—rooms in a box: arrange furniture, combine objects and assemble beautiful scenes step by step. 
The style is a pastel isometry with simple shapes and soft shadows, so that the process is perceived as calm creativity. 
Collect rumboxes from objects: furniture, decor, room details. 
Experiment with the arrangement to find the most harmonious compositions. 
Unlock new sets and room themes by adding to your collection. 
Complete the levels/tasks and develop your rumbox studio.

title: Highway Car Shooting 3D  Action Game 2025
description:
Race and shoot on the highway! Take down enemy cars in this fast-paced 3D car shooting action game.

Get ready for the ultimate mix of driving and shooting in Highway Fury – Car Shooting Action Game 3D 2025. Take the backseat, grab your gun, and unleash chaos as enemy cars chase you on endless highways. With explosive action, powerful weapons, and thrilling 3D graphics, this is the craziest car shooter of 2025 

If you love car shooting games, highway chases, and explosive battles, this is your chance to prove your skills. Take control, aim fast, and dominate the road in Highway Fury – Car Shooting Action Game 3D 2025!

title: Bank Robbery Puzzle
description: Become a master thief! Choose your hero, crack security systems, avoid guards, complete dangerous heists, and steal your way to ultimate riches!

title: Shape Transform
description:

Shift. Race. Conquer.
Get ready for the ultimate shape-shifting race where speed, timing, and smart decisions decide the winner! 🏎️💨
Can you transform fast enough to master land, sea, and sky? 🌊🏔️☁️

🔄 Transform into cars, boats, and planes instantly!

title: Bubble Mania
description:
🎯 Bubble Mania

Shoot, match, and explode! In Bubble Shooter Revolver, your goal is to fire colored balls at matching ones and clear them all! With exciting power-ups like Bomb, Colorful Ball, and Freeze, this game offers endless fun.

title: SnowTail Peaks: 3D bubble pop adventure
description:
Classic bubble shooter but in a glossy 3D world. Drag to aim, bounce shots off the side rails, and match colorful bubbles to clear the board before you run out of shots.

Line up clusters, use bank shots to reach tricky spots, and watch unmatched bubbles fall away after each pop. Power-ups like Bomb, Rainbow, and Lift help you dig out of tight spots as stages get tougher. Clear every bubble to win — run out of shots and the level ends.

title: Slap Master
description: Slap Master is a light-hearted casual arcade game, where chaos and laughs are the point. You play as a character whose mission is simple: slap pedestrians as you run, build up the frenzy, and try to escape without getting caught.

title: BOMBAMAN 3D
description: Dive into an exhilarating 3D journey with BOMBAMAN 3D! Tackle complex mazes, strategically use bombs to clear paths, and defeat fearsome enemies. Discover power-ups, find the secret exit, and face challenging bosses, all while enjoying an engaging solo or multiplayer adventure on your devices.

title: Funny Hair Salon
description: George's hair is in a no bueno situation. His scalp is full of mites and pimps. The only way to fix his hair is going to the salon. Let's cure his scalp and plant new hair to his head, so he can show his true outter beauty!

title: Cosplay Gamer Girls
description: Two BFF are going to a summer cosplay festival. They love computer games. Help the girls choose costumes for their favorite video game heroes and princesses. It is very important for a cosplayer to create a complete look: from makeup and hair to dress. Lots of original and gorgeous outfits are waiting for you!

title: Bubble Stars boxes: Sirius & Najia
description:
104 characters and 1037 skins are waiting for you!

Open boxes and starr drops

Open. Collect. Win.

title: Unboxing Brainrots
description: Open cases, collect Italian animals, upgrade your weapons, and develop your base in the world of the funny Brainrots!

title: Wasteland Hunter: puzzle RPG
description:
Wasteland Hunter: puzzle RPG — a unique combination of Tetris puzzle mechanics integrated into a turn-based combat system and RPG strategy set in a post-apocalyptic world.
What makes the game special:

Innovative Combat System: Players use Tetris blocks with equipment (bullets, health packs, shields, grenades) to create devastating combat combinations
Strategic Depth: Turn-based battles require tactical thinking — players adapt block formations to enemy types and situations
Meta-Progression: Beyond combat, players rebuild and manage a survivor camp, rescue NPCs, and create unique combat figures from discovered blueprints
High Replayability: Map exploration, escalating difficulty, and diverse equipment ensure long-term engagement

title: Card Quest
description:
Card Quest is a card battle game with Triple Triad game rules und strong fantasy visuals, where you progress through the campaign map by encountering enemies with different battle rules and completely unique card decks.
The goal is not only to beat every enemy, but also to collect all cards and complete the collection book of uniquely designed fairy monsters. Start the adventure and find the best card combinations to beat your opponents and collect all cards! Learn to make combos and sweep the board with your powerful cards, but be careful, because your opponents can also turn your cards and steal them from you!

title: Limited Defense
description: Play Limited Defense, a thrilling tower defense game! Command bandits, archers & explosive towers against waves of slimes, orcs & epic bosses. Upgrade defenses & unlock legendary heroes. Test your strategy now!

title: The Depth of the Limbo
description:
The game is about a girl in limbo who has to complete all the levels to wake up. Top view: The character must overcome 13 levels. Each level is a one—minute test cycle, but the camera rotates around the hero, changing the orientation of the space. Due to the moving camera, you can get confused about right, left, up and down, which turns simple routes into a puzzle.

The lines of the path seem familiar until they turn around your head, forcing you to rethink each goal. The goal is simple and touching: to complete the route from beginning to end, overcome the inner noise of fear, and wake up refreshed and free.

title: Shoes Outlet Game
description: In this idle game, simplicity is key! Tap your way to success as you build and expand your outlets from mini to mega. It's easy, it's fun, and it's all about the joy of watching your mall grow with minimal effort! Become a retail tycoon without breaking a sweat! Effortlessly manage your dream mall by hiring staff and making strategic decisions. Deal with displaying goods, cleaning fitting rooms, and helping customers check out. Fear not, for you can build your own dream team and manage them efficiently, turning challenges into opportunities and making every coin count!

title: Magic Water Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Water Sort a smooth and satisfying water sort puzzle that blends vibrant colors, intuitive gameplay, and the soothing process of color sorting. Tap the flasks to fill moving glasses with the right color, complete mocktail orders, and finish levels! Sit back, relax, and enjoy colorful pours as the water sort flows without time limits or pressure!

Beyond classic liquid sorting puzzles, Magic Water Sort brings a cozy, café-inspired twist. You don't just sort water or colors—you prepare mocktails on a conveyor belt, watching glasses glide by as you decide when and where to pour. The pouring happens automatically, so the water sort puzzle feels smooth and effortless, letting you relax while still enjoying the sorting process.

title: Make the glass happy
description: Draw lines to guide the water and fill the glass! Use logic and creativity to solve each level and make the glass happy.

title: Barrel Roller: Stack & Run 3D
description:
🎮 Barrel Roller - The Ultimate Stack Runner Game! 🎮

Play the most addictive hyper casual runner game now! Stack barrels, dodge obstacles, and race to victory in this exciting endless runner adventure.

🏃 HOW TO PLAY THE STACK RUNNER:
- Swipe left and right to control your runner
- Collect and stack barrels as you race
- Avoid obstacles and traps along the track
- Build the tallest barrel stack possible
- Reach the finish line to win rewards!

✨ AMAZING RUNNER FEATURES:
- Hyper Casual Gameplay - Perfect for quick gaming sessions
- Easy Controls - Simple swipe mechanics for all ages
