- Runner Game Fun - Non-stop action and excitement

🏆 BECOME THE BARREL STACKING CHAMPION:
Master the art of stacking in this casual runner game! Challenge yourself to collect more barrels, avoid every obstacle, and achieve the highest score. Perfect for fans of running games, stacking games, and obstacle games.

📦 ADDICTIVE RUNNER GAMEPLAY:
Barrel Roller combines the best of endless runner games with unique stacking mechanics. Easy to learn but hard to master - can you become the ultimate barrel runner?

title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
description: Help Tom & Angela to become Instagram famous. Buy and choose clothes, hairstyles, or accessories by following their moods. Make them look stunning on every occasion, take beautiful pictures to post on Instagram and receive lots of likes. Get their insta-ready outfits and have fun!

title: Tsunami Race
description: Tsunami Race is an exciting online adventure game where players race against a looming tsunami. Select your character, navigate through obstacles, and compete in various game modes, including dodging fruits and racing on water slides. Experience adrenaline-pumping action without downloads or registration across multiple platforms.

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo Games
description: 🎨 Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo offers a unique and creative experience where you not only create stunning ink tattoos but also dress up characters in trending outfits! Dive into the world of fashion and tattoos, where your artistic talents can shine in more ways than one.

title: Draw an Obby
description:
🔥 The Awesome Game for True Pros! 🔥

Want to test your obby skills? Then this is the game for you! 🎮

Here’s what awaits you:

💥 30 epic levels with crazy obstacles — stay sharp!

🎨 Unique twist: draw your own shapes to overcome obstacles — you’ve never seen anything like this before! ✨

👉 Perfect for:

fans of Roblox Obby — this one’s even cooler!

title: Meow Captcha
description:
🤖 The system doubts you: are you human or a soulless machine? 🤔 Your mission is to solve clever puzzles, help furry heroes 🐱, and prove that you have something no algorithm possesses: a heart that loves cats ❤️🐾.

Game features:

• Anti-bot 🔥: Puzzles that would fry any algorithm's circuits 💥.

• Feline Approval 😻: The best currency in the world is purring 🎵 and the contented gaze of cat eyes ✨.

• No Stress ☕️🍃: Just you, cats 🐈, and your desire to make their world better.

• Share Your Results 📢: Brag to your friends not about your level, but about your "Humanity Scale" 📈💯!

Save cats 🐾. Prove that you are human 🙋🙋‍♂️.

title: Pirates Merge: War Path
description: Pirates Merge: War Path is a strategy adventure where you combine swashbucklers to form a powerful army of ground and flying units. Complete 50 challenging missions across three regions, gathering coins and unlocking new upgrades as you go. Train, merge, and expand your forces to create an unstoppable pirate legion ready to conquer the seas.

title: Loopvival
description:
Loopvival is an atmospheric survival game with elements of roguelite, built around the mechanics of cycles.
You find yourself in a world consumed by Darkness, where the only source of light is a bonfire in the center of the map. Collect resources, boost your fire, unlock new territories, and rebuild ruined ruins to learn the story of a lost world.
Each cycle brings the world back to the beginning, but the campfire's progress and key improvements persist, gradually allowing you to move further into the Darkness. The simple action game, meditative gameplay, and gradual opening of the lore make Loopvival a short but seamless gaming experience.

title: City Tuk Tuk Simulator: Racing Game 3D
description:
Race through city streets in your Tuk Tuk! Drive, drift & deliver in 3D fun.

Experience the thrill of city driving in City Tuk Tuk Simulator 3D – Racing Game, the ultimate auto-rickshaw adventure .
Take the driver’s seat of a colorful Tuk Tuk, race through busy streets, pick up passengers, and master the art of high-speed three-wheel driving.

 Explore realistic city environments, dodge traffic, and test your reflexes as you drift through tight corners. Upgrade your Tuk Tuk, earn rewards, and unlock new levels filled with fun challenges and stunts.

title: Wordeck: Associations
description:
WorDeck: Solitaire is a browser-based logic game that combines classic solitaire-style card interaction with word association puzzles. Players are presented with a board of word cards and must clear the layout by grouping related words into the correct categories.
Unlike traditional solitaire games based on suits and card order, the core gameplay here focuses on logic and semantic connections. Players analyze words, identify hidden relationships, and sort cards into meaningful groups. Each level has a fixed structure and gradually increases in difficulty with more cards and less obvious associations.
The game is designed for short and relaxing play sessions while still offering a mental challenge. It runs directly in the browser with no download or installation required, making it easy to start playing instantly.

title: Mystery Digger
description: Join the exciting journey of **Mystery Digger**, an addictive idle clicker game. Explore underground for treasures and stories. Upgrade your drill with each click to uncover fascinating finds. Enjoy this calming game on any device and satisfy your curiosity with every discovery.

title: Mister Bullet: Arcade Shooter
description:
ou are a cool special agent Mr. Bullet. You are sent on the most dangerous missions in the world. Only Mr. Bullet knows how to use all types of weapons perfectly. Only Mr. Bullet can sneak into the enemy base unnoticed.
This time, a new threat looms over the world - the Balloon Villains! They brought a lot of equipment, soldiers, weapons, even Boss monsters! But Mr. Shooter knows what to do!
Features of the game:
- A huge arsenal of weapons! There are so many weapons that the enemies lose all desire to fight! Take what you like - pistols, shotguns, machine guns, grenade launchers and much more!
- Stealth shooter on huge territories! Stay in the shadows so that your enemies are afraid of you!
- Variability of level completion. Act stealthily or take a grenade launcher and give your enemies an unforgettable meeting!
- A large number of levels! You have a long journey through the game worlds, so be ready for battle!
- Many different types of enemies!
Forward to the Battle!

title: Save The Fruit - Draw To Save
description:
Save the Fruit: Draw to Home puzzle game provides a delightful blend of creativity, strategy, and fun, making it a must-play interesting drawing puzzle save the fruit game. Get ready to embark on an artistic save the fruit draw to home and a heartwarming adventure to save the cutest fruits in the gaming world. In this captivating adventure game Save the Fruit, players must use their artistic skills to guide stranded save the fruits safely to their by drawing to go home while overcoming various challenges in this save the fruits draw to home game.


Draw the lines to save the fruits & and cute fruits go home safely share your achievements, and creative solutions with friends this save the fruits draw to home game. You need to Collaborate homes and avoid the villains from bumping into each other on challenging levels, if all fruits collide and the game will fail.

title: Gods Mixer
description:
Gods Mixer is a fun and experimental game where you combine different heads, bodies, and weapons to create unique characters. After assembling them, you can pit them against each other in battles to see which creation reigns supreme. The game encourages creativity through mixing and matching parts for unexpected results.

? Mix & Match Creativity
Combine heads, bodies, and more to create your own unique god-like characters.
Each combination produces a different look and potential battle outcome.
⚔️ Auto-Battle Arena
Watch your creations automatically fight against others to prove their supremacy.
Sit back and enjoy the chaos, or refine your mix for a stronger build.
? Endless Combinations
Thousands of possible combos.
Let your imagination run wild—create funny, powerful, or bizarre beings.

title: 12 minutes to survive
description:
Step into the shoes of a powerful mage in 12 Minutes to Survive, an intense survival game where every second counts! Battle against relentless waves of enemies for 12 action-packed minutes. Level up your character mid-battle to unlock powerful skills and abilities, and collect souls from defeated foes to upgrade your mage’s power.

With each passing moment, the challenge escalates—will your strategic choices and magical prowess be enough to conquer the chaos? Prove your mastery of the arcane and survive the onslaught!

title: Beach Defense: Merge Tower
description:
A Tiny Merge is a beach-themed tower defense game where every run is about building smarter, merging faster, and
surviving longer. Place towers on the board, combine matching towers to create stronger defenses, and discover new
tower types as you progress through the waves.

Enemies keep getting tougher, so you will need to upgrade your strategy, unlock active powers, spend your coins wisely,
and keep improving your setup between waves. Use quick-buy tools, open upgrades, choose powerful bonuses, and react to
the changing pressure on the battlefield.

Push through as many waves as possible, experiment with different tower combinations, and turn a simple beach defense
into a powerful wall of water, splash, and chaos.

title: Monster Slayer. Idle Clicker
description: Monster Slayer is an action-packed game where you battle quirky monsters and gather valuable resources. Strengthen your hero by unlocking powerful skills and spells, capture monster souls to expand your collection, and trade Flame Shards for rare relics. Enhance your abilities with Inlay Stones and potions as you take on ever-stronger foes in your quest for victory!

title: Rough Ball
description: Rough Ball is an addictive and challenging physics-based platformer where you control a cheeky smiley ball on a dangerous journey through rocky caves. Your goal is simple but tricky: roll, bounce, and slide carefully to reach the red flag without falling into the deadly pits. With slippery slopes, tricky jumps, and cute skull warnings, every level tests your precision and timing in this fun "do not fall" adventure!

title: Zombie Derby
description: Zombie Derby is a wild mix of racing and zombie mayhem from Brinemedia. Jump behind the wheel and plow through hordes of the undead standing in your way. But be careful - your fuel is limited, and once you stop, you’ll become easy prey. Time your nitro boosts wisely, as they might be the only thing that gets you over a hill or across a deadly gap.

title: Zombie Derby
description: Zombie Derby is a wild mix of racing and zombie mayhem from Brinemedia. Jump behind the wheel and plow through hordes of the undead standing in your way. But be careful - your fuel is limited, and once you stop, you’ll become easy prey. Time your nitro boosts wisely, as they might be the only thing that gets you over a hill or across a deadly gap.

title: Click & Idle - Slimes!
description: Step into the delightful universe of Click & Idle - Slimes! Tap the squishy slime to generate income and expand your empire. Unlock and enhance various skills, each offering unique perks that go beyond simple click boosts. Some grant instant rewards, while others provide long-term advantages, allowing you to shape your own progression. Collect charming slimes, customize your background, and embark on an endless adventure to become the ultimate slime master!

title: Tile Match
description:
Welcome to Tile Match! Get ready for a fun and exciting game where you need to keep matching tiles before they reach the bottom. It's a perfect game for anyone who loves puzzles and quick thinking!

How It Works:
Tiles keep coming from the top and move down. Your job is to make sure none of the tiles touch the bottom border. If they do, oops, the level is over and you have to start again!

title: Ultimate Obby Parkour Adventure Online
description: Join the thrilling adventure of Ultimate Obby Parkour, a colorful world filled with obstacles and unique challenges across four different realms. Enjoy engaging gameplay and vibrant graphics on both your phone and computer, as you customize your character and strive to become a parkour master.

title: Laser Slasher
description: Laser Slasher is a vibrant casual puzzle-arcade game where you command laser turrets to smash blocks with satisfying ASMR effects. Designed for stress-free relaxation, it combines intuitive one-tap controls, progressive upgrades, turret customization. Perfect for quick breaks or extended play.

title: Animals Battle
description:
Are you attracted to adorable animals, and do you have the talent of a great commander? The new game combines these two passions, giving you the chance to build an empire in a world of endless battles!

 Here, you'll lead armies of cute yet formidable animal warriors. Command your troops, employ clever tactics, and devise effective strategies to conquer various adversaries.

 Explore new lands, conquer islands, and discover unique biomes inhabited by fascinating animals. Summon new fighters to your army, level them up, and turn them into the most powerful and charming armada.

 Remember: with each island you conquer, your enemies become stronger. To fight back, collect powerful artifact cards that will enhance your pets and strengthen your growing empire.

 This exciting strategy game offers hours of deep gameplay for anyone who loves animals and wants to test their tactical skills, regardless of age or gaming experience.

title: Save King
description:
Save King is a fun pull-the-pin rescue puzzle game where your mission is to save the King, protect the royal family, and rebuild the kingdom. 
Each level gives you a tricky situation with pins, enemies, traps, and treasure you must pull the right pin at the right time to win. Use your brain, make smart moves, collect rewards, and upgrade your castle as the story continues.

title: Halloween Stickman 2
description: Halloween Stickman 2 offers an exhilarating gaming experience where you navigate a mischievous, spooky environment. Play online for free and dive into a Halloween-themed adventure as you outsmart your trickster friend, Stickman, to seek revenge amidst the festive chaos.

title: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift!
description: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift! is a fast-paced arcade racing game built around a unique magnetic drifting mechanic. Attach your hook to magnets near the road, swing through sharp turns, and release at the perfect moment to stay on the track. Race through procedurally generated environments filled with bridges, intersections, changing weather, and challenging turns. Set new distance records in Solo mode or compete against AI rivals, collect cash, upgrade your car, and unlock new vehicles and control modes.

title: Moscow Metro Simulator
Destruction Simulator
description:
• Slow-motion
- You have the full control over the time rate: slow it down, inrease the speed or just stop the simulation

• Gravity
- Took it all from freezing time… Well, play with low / high gravity or just turn it off like you are in space ;)

• Control of gameplay
- Disable or enable explosions visualization (if it covers debris you want to see), only smoke or even lights / flashes.
- Too many debris on the screen? Just enable limitation option so all debris over certain value will smoothly disappear
- Not enough debris? Simply increase destructibility level

• Guns
- About 13 different explosives (missiles, dynamites, bombs)
- Earthquake, tornado, singularity
- Different sized cannon balls
- Custom gun editor

• Maps
- Destroy over 30+ prebuild map
- Map editor: Build your own map

• Simulator
We have created this game for our personal needs - always dreamed of the game that allows you to destroy buildings, but there wasnt any, sooo… had to do one ourselves : )

title: Draw One Line: Drawing Puzzle
description: Get ready to exercise your brain with the incredible Draw One Line: Drawing Puzzle! This game is perfect for those who like challenges and want to have fun at the same time. It's a world where logic meets excitement, and simple puzzles become an engaging mental workout.

title: Dot and Dot
description:
Dot and Dot is a vibrant puzzle game where players connect matching dots without crossing paths.Challenge yourself across three exciting game modes:

Normal Mode: 5000 classic puzzles to master
Loops Mode: 1500 puzzles to connect dots back to their starting point
Bridges Mode: 1500 puzzles to cross paths strategically on special bridge tiles

Features designed to enhance your experience:

Daily Login Rewards: Earn hints for consecutive daily logins
Smart Auto-Complete: Double-tap to automatically complete the last remaining connection
U-Turn Detection: Visual warnings prevent invalid patterns
Colorblind Support: Toggle color labels (A-Z) for better accessibility
Hint System: Get help when you're stuck
Quick Reset: Restart any stage instantly

Test your logic and spatial skills with intuitive controls, right-click line removal, and progressively challenging puzzles!

title: Mole Dig Clicker
description: Help the mole dig to the center of the world! An idle clicker where you tap to break dirt, buy upgrades, and watch your mole gear up with pickaxes, drills and a cart. Mining keeps going while you're away — claim your dirt when you return. How deep can you get?

title: Drift Idle Drift Earn Upgrade
description: Drift Idle is a chill arcade drift game where your car drives itself — you just lean into the corners. Slide sideways to rack up combos up to 10× and turn drift into a money printer, then sink the cash into three upgrade lanes: Income, Speed, and Drift. Earn enough and you'll trade your starter for sleeker rides — Boss, Blacklist, Fallout, Cairo, and the elusive Midnight — each one drifting harder and paying out fatter than the last. Customise your paint, your smoke colour, and your skid trails until the track behind you looks exactly the way you want.

title: Monster Truck Racing Game Truck Race
description: Get ready for the most thrilling adventure in the world of monster truck games! Drive powerful 4x4 monster trucks across extreme tracks, perform impossible stunts, and explore dangerous offroad environments in this action-packed monster truck driving simulator game. If you love offroad racing games, truck stunt games, or realistic driving simulators, then this game is made just for you. Easy steering, realistic physics, and responsive handling for the best driving experience.

title: Coloring book
description:
🎨 An exciting coloring game for adults and children! 
Color animals, flowers, mandalas. Anti-stress, creativity and relaxation all in one place !

title: Object 73: Survival Clicker
description:
A post-apocalyptic survival clicker with idle and RPG elements. You awaken inside the underground Jericho Complex as Object 73 — a clone who keeps returning to life after every death. Each new cycle is a chance to uncover the truth behind the Jericho Project.

Explore ruined laboratories, collect resources and fight dangerous enemies including mutants, rogue synthetics and combat drones. Defeated enemies drop materials that can be used to craft weapons, upgrade equipment and survive longer.

Discover multiple locations across the complex such as laboratories, armories, archives and contaminated sectors. Find memory fragments, hidden logs and secret files that slowly reveal the story of Colonel Dmitry Yankovsky.

Craft powerful weapons, upgrade armor and improve your character to defeat elite enemies and story bosses. Your decisions influence the humanity level of the protagonist and change how the story unfolds.

title: Cup Quest
description:
Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey: A Feline Hero’s Adventure Begins!

Join a brave cat on an epic quest in Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey, a fresh twist on the classic balls-and-cups game. This isn't just about tossing balls into cups—it's a full-blown adventure packed with clever puzzles, physics-based challenges, and one courageous kitty determined to save the day.

Your Cat, the Hero
Meet your furry champion—a quick-thinking, nimble cat with a heart of gold. As danger looms and traps lie in wait, it’s up to this whiskered warrior to take on wild levels filled with spinning platforms, explosives, and tricky obstacles.

Precision Meets Puzzle
Each level is a test of aim and timing. Launch the ball just right, bounce it off the environment, and land it perfectly in the cup. It’s not just about power—success requires strategy, finesse, and a little creative thinking.
 What Awaits You
- Over 200 unique levels, ranging from simple to seriously tricky
- Skill-based gameplay that mixes timing, puzzle-solving, and action
- Hero upgrades: unlock new feline champions and grow stronger as you progress
- Satisfying animations and smooth physics that make every throw feel great
- Enemies and traps: it's not just puzzles—you’ll have to outsmart swarm enemies too

Become a Cup Champion
Explore a magical world where every level brings new challenges. Battle your way through enemy swarms, master the art of the perfect shot, and rise as the legendary hero of the cup realm.

Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey isn’t just a puzzle game—it’s a heartwarming, skill-testing adventure that’ll keep you coming back for more. Grab your paws, line up your shot, and get ready to become a legend.

title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: Battle of Banners
description:
A war of banners on a hexagonal battlefield! In this turn-based medieval strategy you command a squad of knights, claim land, build camps, and shape the front line turn by turn. Every move matters: where to advance, which tile to block, whom to push back, and where to set an ambush by the forest or at a crossing. The winner is the one who expands faster than rivals and destroys their forces.

Play your way: locally on one device with friends, against bots for practice, or online — in duels and multiplayer matches. Maps with varied terrain change the tactics, and every match stays dynamic and fair: only you, your opponent, and your decisions.

title: Bubble Smash
description: Bubble Smash is a relaxing yet addictive bubble-merge puzzle game. Aim and launch bubbles into the playfield, merge matching ones to pop them in satisfying chains, and clear each level's goals before you run out of moves. Chain pops together to trigger explosive combos, unleash power-ups when you're stuck, and work your way across a colorful level map. Easy to pick up, tricky to master — one more pop is never enough.

title: Magic Story of Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the amazing and magical world of solitaire. Here you can feel at home, comfortably playing solitaire on a tavern table in the light of a fireplace or in the shade of an oak tree to the sound of a majestic waterfall.

Magic Story of Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world. The card game's simple rules will help first-timers get the hang of things fast, and different challenges in the adventure ahead will keep seasoned players on their toes. But don't worry, your fairy helper will show you which magical powers to use to get out of even the toughest pinch.

What makes this game so great?
- Hundreds of fun layouts
- Beautiful and mysterious places in a magic world
- Different game challenges
- A warm, fun adventure game atmosphere
- Offline Cards Adventure

This beloved card game is perfect for everyone. We hope you enjoy your time in Magic Story of Solitaire!

title: Same Room Same Day
description: Experience the thrilling psychological horror of "Same Room Same Day." As Rosaline, explore a terrifying building filled with monstrous beings. Face intense challenges, collect crucial supplies, and confront your deepest fears to uncover secrets and seek tranquility in a frightening digital landscape.

title: Road Rage
description: Road Rage is an action-packed racing game where players speed through traffic, dodge obstacles, and compete against rivals in thrilling bike races. Featuring fast-paced gameplay, smooth controls, and exciting challenges, the game delivers an adrenaline-filled racing experience across multiple tracks and environments.

title: Sheep commotion
description: Sheep Commotion is a cheerful path-drawing puzzle game about guiding every sheep to the right pen. Draw safe routes, collect stars, avoid wolves, rocks and puddles, and solve increasingly tricky levels with different sheep behaviors.

title: Angry Checkers
description: Angry Checkers is a thrilling take on the traditional board game, where players try to eliminate opponents’ checkers. Available on multiple platforms, it features various play modes including multiplayer and single-player. This action-packed game delivers engaging and strategic fun for everyone without requiring downloads or sign-ups.

title: Relaxing Games: 30 in 1
description: This collection of games is perfect for those who are looking for a relaxing and fun way to unwind. These mini-games are designed to bring a sense of peace and entertainment during short breaks or long journeys. Enjoy a variety of calming and fun games that will help you escape from the daily grind and find harmony. A great way to relax and have fun anywhere and anytime. No ratings or points, just addictive mini-games.

title: Parkour Runner 3D
description:
Parkour Runner 3D is a fast-paced action running game where you sprint, jump, slide, and flip through thrilling obstacle courses! Test your reflexes as you race across rooftops, leap between platforms, dodge traps, and perform epic parkour tricks.
With smooth controls, lively environments, and challenging levels, every run keeps you on the edge of your seat.

Master your timing, collect boosts, unlock new characters, and become the ultimate parkour champion!

title: Robbie: Draw your Sword
description: Enter the exciting realm of Robbie: Draw your Sword, a dynamic online adventure game. Gather swords, complete challenges, and level up to transform your character. Enjoy this free game on mobile or desktop, unlocking various outfits, pets, and abilities. Are you prepared to become the ultimate warrior?

title: Grass Land
description:
Welcome to Grassland, an immersive exploration game set in a lush green land with dense grass.

You embark on an exciting journey to uncover hidden resources beneath the vibrant grasslands. Armed with your trusty grass cutter machine, you must navigate the vast landscape, gather resources, and expand your base to thrive in this unique environment.

Game Features:
-Explore the Verdant Grassland: Discover hidden treasures, and unique locations as you venture further into the unknown.
-Resource Gathering: Use your grass cutter machine to cut through the grass and uncover valuable resources. Collect wood, coal, and other precious items hidden beneath the surface. Each resource will play a crucial role in expanding your base and unlocking new upgrades.
-Base Building: Start with a small base and gradually expand it as you gather more resources. Build structures, markets, workshops, and storage facilities to support your exploration efforts. Customize your base to suit your playstyle and unlock new features to enhance your gameplay.
-Upgrade and Unlock New Features: Enhance your grass cutter machine by upgrading its strength, speed, and fuel capacity. Invest in advanced technology and tools to improve your efficiency in cutting grass and discovering resources.

Key Features:
-Vast and immersive grass-covered landscape to explore
-Satisfying Grass Cutting Effect
-Resource Gathering and Management
-Enjoy the immersive gameplay with a sense of exploration and discovery
-Immerse yourself in stunning visuals of the grassy landscape


Are you ready to wield your grass cutter machine and become the master of the grassy landscape? The journey awaits you in Grassland!

title: Brainrot Hide and Seek Classic
description:
Everyone has played hide-and-seek at least once. With each level, changing locations will keep you busy.

In the game, you have to move quickly and skillfully before you get caught. Each level becomes more difficult, requiring you to have faster reaction speed, agility, and the ability to plan your movements.

title: Card Sort: Challenge
description:
Card Sort: Challenge is a colorful logic puzzle with card sorting, tricky obstacles, boosters, daily rewards, achievements, and customization.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: The game is a puzzle for sorting cards by colors.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: Unique graphics, special cards, and obstacles like fog, bombs, chains, and locks.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to complete more levels to earn more coins.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has currencies: gold and diamonds, which can be spent on card colors, themes, and buying boosters.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-app purchases. Players can buy diamonds, but donations do not speed up game progress as actions are limited by levels.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (daily, monthly, all-time, etc.)?

A: The game has daily, monthly, and all-time leaderboards sorted by win rate and number of levels completed.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can the appearance of the hero be customized, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, in the game, players can change the theme and colors of cards.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?

A: Yes, the game features a wheel of fortune and daily tasks.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: The game has sound, but it is not necessary for progression.

title: Spin and Collect
description:
Spin & Collect is the ultimate collecting game! Every spin awards coins, gems, and rare items. Complete sets to unlock powerful bonuses, win jackpots, and watch your collection grow even offline with AFK rewards. From Common to Legendary, will you be able to collect them all? Optional rewarded ads accelerate your progress without interrupting the game. Perfect for casual players and those looking to complete everything!

Double Wheels: Basic Wheel for constant progression + Premium Wheel for colossal jackpots
Epic Collections: Unlock items from Common to Legendary rarity
Set Bonuses: Complete collections to get permanent bonuses and multipliers
AFK Rewards: Keep earning coins even offline; progress is constant!
Mobile Optimized: Smooth one-tap gameplay, ideal for quick sessions on the go

title: Carvivor Ops
description: Carvivor Ops is a car-based action game that challenges you to survive increasingly intense waves of police within a limited time.

title: Gun Craft and Fight
description:
«Gun Craft and Fight» is a dynamic first-person shooter where you fight enemies, collect resources, and craft new weapons to complete combat missions. Upgrade your arsenal, choose the right weapon for each situation, and clear levels where reaction, accuracy, and smart tactics matter.
The game combines classic FPS gameplay with crafting and progression elements. Explore locations, defeat enemies, unlock new opportunities, and become stronger with every battle. The further you progress, the more dangerous the enemies become — so it is time to craft more powerful weapons and use them to the fullest.
«Gun Craft and Fight» is perfect for fans of shooters, action games, weapons, survival, and upgrade-based gameplay.

title: Mergetopia
description: 🌍 Mergetopia A delightful 2D casual merge game where evolution happens one merge at a time! 🐾 Dive into a Realm each filled with popular sea animals characters waiting to be discovered, merged, and evolved. Your goal? Build and discover the Creatures — one bubble pop and one merge at a time!

title: Gun Bounce Idle
description:
Gun Bounce Idle throws you into a wild chain reaction of bullets, bounces, and nonstop destruction. Drop your weapons into the arena and watch them ricochet across the field, spraying fire in every direction while stacking up cash with every hit.

Build your ultimate damage machine by upgrading power, attack speed, crit chance, and special modifiers. Unlock new guns with unique behaviors and turn simple shots into explosive chaos. The more you optimize, the more the screen fills with satisfying destruction.

Level up to unlock stronger targets, complete achievements, and push your build to its limits. When progress slows, activate Prestige to reset and return stronger than ever — multiplying your power and accelerating your climb to insane damage numbers.

Simple to start. Impossible to stop.
How far can your bouncing arsenal go?

title: Mr.Reckless Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, Nitro to escape the impossible.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Help Me: Tricky Puzzle Games
description: A quirky and funny brain-teasing puzzle game. Solve bizarre, comical scenarios by interacting directly with the characters and objects to find unexpected solutions and rescue them from trouble.

title: Slow Time Ninja
description: Master time and precision in this stealth ninja game! Swipe to throw your weapon, freeze time to plan, and strike with deadly accuracy. Outsmart enemies, use your surroundings, and defeat all foes with true ninja elegance.

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
description: Block Mine Fuse TNT is an exhilarating adventure game where players take on the mission to liberate the world from the ominous presence of Herobrine and its eerie constructions. Step into this action-packed universe and unleash your full potential by upgrading and deploying TNT, rockets, and a myriad of explosive powers upon cubic settlements. Play online for free without the hassle of downloading, and dive into a world where destruction meets strategy, all within the comfort of your browser. With its seamless integration across platforms such as iOS, Android, and desktop, Block Mine Fuse TNT offers a dynamic experience for gamers on the go or at home.

title: Number Sums
description:
Number Sums is a challenging number puzzle to train your mental math. The goal is to make the sum of numbers in each row, column, and colored region be equal to the clues on the side of the board and inside the colored regions. Practice your math skills and logic with Number Sums!

Each row, column, and region has its own solution, but the goal of this math game with numbers is to make them all work at the same time. You have to circle the correct numbers and erase the numbers you don't need. Remember, the sums of the numbers in rows, columns and colored regions should be equal to the numbers on the sides of the board and inside each region. Each level of this numbers game has only one solution, try to find it to solve educational math puzzles!

Mental arithmetic is an invaluable math skill for your everyday life. Inside Number Sums you'll find math puzzles of various difficulty. The mechanics of these math riddles sounds simple but requires a lot of thinking. Playing sum number games and solving math problems can improve your arithmetic skills. If you are interested in number puzzles or math games for adults, and in training your addition skills, play this engaging number game for hours of fun!

title: Kitty Grid Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Kitty Grid Puzzle, a relaxing logic game where adorable cats are waiting for their perfect space!

Each kitty has a number that shows exactly how many grid squares its room must contain. Drag across the board to create correctly sized rectangles, give every cat its own cozy room and fill the entire grid without leaving empty spaces.

The puzzles begin simple but gradually become more challenging, encouraging you to think carefully, plan each move and improve your spatial reasoning. Cute cat reactions, satisfying grid-filling gameplay and clever levels make every puzzle enjoyable to solve.

title: Lift Defender Zombie Carnage
description: Step into the exciting realm of Lift Defender Zombie Carnage, where your role as an elevator guardian is crucial for humanity's survival against a zombie apocalypse. Protect the last safe spaces in skyscrapers through thrilling online gameplay available on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Unfamiliar Object
description: Unfamiliar Object is a first-person office-horror inspection game about finding the one thing that does not belong. Read the rules, explore a silent night-shift corridor, photograph the true anomaly, and submit your evidence by fax before procedure turns hostile. Each shift twists ordinary office objects into something quietly impossible.

title: Idle Pong
description: Idle Pong is a fun and satisfying idle clicker game where every tap launches a high-speed pong ball to smash through colorful obstacles! Watch the chaos unfold as your pong bounces, breaks, and earns you XP even while you're idle.

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

🏁 Race & Earn
Drive your own tracks, earn income for every segment, and refine your strategy.

🧱 Flexible Building
Straights, turns, boosters, and dangerous sections — build a track that works for you.

💰 Economy & Progression
Earn currencies, unlock new blocks and skins, and expand your building area.

🔁 Prestige System
Reset your progress to grow faster and unlock new opportunities.

🎁 Daily Rewards
Come back every day and claim bonuses to boost your progress.

Build, test, and optimize your tracks — and turn every race into profit.
Can you create the perfect track?

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: It's an arcade game where players need to create their own track by placing various blocks.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?

A: The game is about Obby. Players can race on their kart on the track, earn money for each segment, and use the earnings to unlock new blocks, expand their territory, and improve the track for even greater profits.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Racing on the track, earning money for each segment, using the money to unlock new blocks for greater profits, expand their territory, and improve the track.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are diamonds and money as currencies. Both currencies can be spent on purchasing new blocks and skins.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. Players can buy diamonds, which are then used to purchase blocks. Donations speed up game progress.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are Obby and skins for Obby.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers daily rewards and rewards for time spent in the game.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game but is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Don't Open That Door...Seriosly!
description:
You are a plush teddy bear — soft, cute… and completely unprepared for what lies ahead. Arriving at a mysterious hotel in the middle of Nowhere with your little suitcase, you quickly realize — something here is… off.

Behind every door awaits a new absurdity: a chemistry lab with sudden explosions, a boxing ring with no rules, a noisy party full of rubber ducks, and at the end of the corridor — a mysterious door leading into a dark underground…

Explore the rooms, interact with this bizarre world, and watch as the strange hotel slowly descends into madness — along with you.

This is a game of cheerful nonsense, where logic has long since checked out, and common sense never checked in.

title: The Upside Down
description:
A tactical RPG where strategy meets the 80s: Outsmart the Gloom-Walkers and bring your dog home.

📹 Background

December 1984: As the winter solstice nears, the veil over Black Hollow tears open, allowing shadow entities known as Gloom-Walkers to prey upon the unwary. While the town evacuates to escape the encroaching dark, young Eddie Sinclair stays behind, venturing alone into the snowy ghost town to rescue his best friend, Buddy.

title: Screw Out Jam Puzzle
description: Join the exciting adventure of Screw Out: Jam Puzzle, a game filled with engaging nuts and bolts challenges. Explore countless jam mazes across 1000 levels on your phone and computer. Unlock rewards, harness boosters, and keep your winning streak alive in this thrilling free online puzzle experience!

title: Fishtopia
description:
Dive into the magical world of Fishtopia Adventure! 🐠✨
Embark on an underwater journey filled with colorful fish, charming pets, and exciting puzzles. Unlock and decorate your own aquariums, complete thrilling levels, and discover hidden treasures beneath the waves! Enjoy daily events, challenges, and bonuses that make every dive a new adventure. Perfect for puzzle lovers and casual gamers alike!

title: A Block Too Many
description: Build a tower, reach the stars! In this challenging and addictive block-stacking game, you play as an alien trying to escape a mysterious planet. Strategic stacking is key: each block has unique properties, and one mistake can make your tower collapse. Unlock new levels, blocks and customizations as you play. Choose between a challange mode to unlock levels Or compete for the largest tower in endless mode. Wana chillout there is even a sandbox mode to build into the stars.

title: Crazy Bus Station!
description:
✨This is an exciting puzzle game in which you have to drive buses in brightly colored parking lots, solving complex problems and helping passengers find their cars.


📕 Brief features of the game: 📘


✅ Unique gameplay: Each level offers new and challenging challenges. 🎯

✅ Variety of vehicles: Collect stylish and unique vehicles. 🚕 🚗 🚙🚌

✅ For all ages: From easy to advanced levels. 👲👴

✅ Colorful graphics: Immersive world with beautiful cars and characters. 💛


Enjoy the game! 🎮

title: Stairs Trivia
description: Stairs Trivia is an exciting online quiz game that lets players elevate their knowledge by correctly answering questions. Compete to reach the peak and be the last player standing. Accessible for free on various platforms, it offers a unique 3D experience with engaging challenges without any download or registration.

title: Drawing Online
description:
A fast, funny drawing party game for up to 4 players. 
Get a word, draw it with your finger, and let the game guess what it is. The faster it guesses, the more points you earn. 
Play with friends or bots, complete 5 drawing challenges in 3 minutes, climb the podium, and unlock cute new animal avatars. 
Simple controls, hand-drawn style visuals, quick matchmaking, smooth touch drawing, cheerful sounds, and no losing state: you always gain points and experience, but only one player takes first place.

title: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics
description:
Open your own store in the new trading simulator! Sell TCG cards, figures, comics, food, collectibles, toys - everything geeks and fans love. Serve customers, restock shelves, manage the cash register, deliver orders and expand your business. Upgrade your store, unlock new items, hire employees and build a shopping empire!

This game about store combines elements of simulator, clicker and business game, will suit fans of economic strategies, management and TCG-cards. Simple controls, bright graphics and the excitement of business development make the game exciting and accessible to everyone.

Try to become the best merchant and expand your store to the level of the legendary marketplace! Play online for free right in your browser. Perfect for fans of store simulators, card games, shipping and business pumping.

title: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics
description:
Open your own store in the new trading simulator! Sell TCG cards, figures, comics, food, collectibles, toys - everything geeks and fans love. Serve customers, restock shelves, manage the cash register, deliver orders and expand your business. Upgrade your store, unlock new items, hire employees and build a shopping empire!

This game about store combines elements of simulator, clicker and business game, will suit fans of economic strategies, management and TCG-cards. Simple controls, bright graphics and the excitement of business development make the game exciting and accessible to everyone.

Try to become the best merchant and expand your store to the level of the legendary marketplace! Play online for free right in your browser. Perfect for fans of store simulators, card games, shipping and business pumping.

title: Garage Boss
description: Garage Boss is an idle tycoon where you grow a single repair bay into a full garage, supermarket, and gas station in one connected world. Hire workers, upgrade everything, and watch your mini empire run itself while you tap, walk, and expand for more.

title: Fix Pizza: Food Sorting
description:
Enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle packed with pizza ingredients. Each pizza is covered with different food items: find the extra ingredients, collect them on matching plates, and restore the correct recipe. Look carefully, because the number of mistakes is limited.

Complete increasingly busy levels, discover new recipes, and sort pizzas filled with unusual ingredient combinations. As you progress, more items appear and the object search becomes more challenging. Use Highlight, clear mistakes, or Shuffle whenever you need help.

This is a relaxing game about sorting, observation, and finding objects, featuring juicy cartoon graphics, short levels, and simple controls. It works equally well for a quick break or a longer puzzle session at your own pace.

title: Zen Garden Match
description: Zen Garden Match is a match-3 game designed for those who want to escape daily stress. It is a mind-calming game with a peaceful atmosphere filled with magnificent flower landscapes, fluttering butterflies, falling leaves, bird sounds, and floating dandelions.

title: Nut Sort: Build the City
description:
Dive into the captivating world of «Nut Sort: Build the City» — a thrilling puzzle game where your task is to bring order to the chaos of nuts and bolts! This isn’t just your classic color-sorting game. Every completed level brings you closer to building the city of your dreams. Solve puzzles, earn nuts, and watch houses and parks rise before your eyes.  

🏙️ **BUILD CITIES**: Complete levels, earn resources, and construct 14 unique cities.  

🧩 **ENGAGING LEVELS**: Thousands of puzzles with varying difficulty will keep you entertained.  

🎁 **BONUSES**: Unlock special bonus levels after every 5 regular ones.  

💡 **HINTS**: View a level solution or get an extra bolt if you're stuck.  

🧠 **ENJOYABLE EXPERIENCE**: Relaxing gameplay that also trains your brain.  

«Nut Sort: Build the City» is the perfect blend of soothing sorting and engaging strategy. Sharpen your mind and become the ultimate mayor in the world of puzzles!

title: Balls Animal
description: Balls Animal is an addictive brain teaser where players sort colorful balls into matching tubes to solve challenging puzzles. With over 500 increasingly difficult levels, this cute puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours as you strategize the perfect moves to complete each level. The game features adorable animal characters that add charm to your puzzle-solving adventure, making the experience even more delightful. Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages, Balls Animal combines simple mechanics with strategic thinking, making it easy to learn but satisfyingly challenging to master.

title: Easy Obby Parkour
description:
Parkour-based game.
The nickname of the best player is shown to everyone at the start - beat the game and your nickname will be displayed too.
Change skins to easily tell players apart.
And check where each portal leads ;)

Colorful skins and different character models.

Pets (cats, sheep, dragons... they count as pets, right?)

If the game feels too hard, activate a boost like double jump or others to pass difficult sections.

Checkpoints are not saved - each run must start from the beginning so speed times are fair for all players.

title: Monster Truck Offroad
description: Monster Truck Offroad Racing Game is a rugged arcade racer where massive trucks tear through dirt, mud, and rocky terrain. Crush obstacles, jump over ravines, and smash through destructible objects as you race to the finish. The game features multiple monster trucks with unique stats — speed, crush power, and suspension. What makes it unique? Unlike standard racers, you earn points for crushing cars and destroying the environment. Bigger trucks can flatten smaller obstacles, while lighter ones climb steeper hills. With bumpy tracks, hidden shortcuts, and realistic weight physics, every race feels powerful and unpredictable. Perfect for desktop and mobile browsers. No pit stops — just pure offroad mayhem and monster truck action!

title: Sky Ball  - Adventure 3D
description:
Roll, jump & rush through sky tracks! Avoid obstacles and beat the challenge.

Get ready for an epic rolling adventure in Sky Ball 3D: Rush & Roll — a fast, thrilling sky-platform game where speed and precision decide everything!

Control a powerful 3D ball as you race through floating sky tracks, avoid obstacles, jump across gaps, and rush to the finish. Each level becomes tougher with moving platforms, traps, sharp turns, and surprise speed boosters.

Collect coins, unlock new ball skins, and challenge your reflexes in the ultimate sky racing experience — perfect for players of all ages!

🎮 Game Features

🌌 Beautiful sky-themed 3D levels

🏐 Smooth rolling, jumping & control mechanics

💎 Collect coins to unlock new balls & skins

⚡ Fast-paced gameplay with exciting obstacles

🔧 Supports Fire TV Remote & Game Controllers

📶 Fully offline — play anytime, anywhere

🌀 Addictive level progression with increasing difficulty

If you enjoy ball rush games, rolling games, or fast reflex challenges, Sky Ball 3D delivers the perfect combination of speed & fun.
Download now and start rolling through the clouds!

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Pixel hero survivor
description: Pixel Hero Survivor is a Survivor-type game where you must survive endless waves of incoming monsters. Choose from three distinct heroes, select powerful upgrades after each attack wave, and use your hero's unique, exclusive skills to defeat the horde!

title: Ragdoll Brainrot Meme: Walk Challenge!
Mahjong Sweet Connection Easter
description: Indulge in a sweet Easter treat with Mahjong-Sweet-Connection-Easter, a delightful match-3 & mahjong hybrid puzzle game! Combine colorful Easter candies, eggs, and chocolates in this vibrant, candy-filled world. Beautiful 3D-style candy tiles with glossy, mouth-watering visuals, festive Easter theme, smooth matching mechanics, and relaxing gameplay perfect for short breaks or long relaxing sessions!

title: Traffic Craft Rider
description: Ride through craft-style traffic, dodge cars and bikes, collect coins, upgrade your motorcycle, and beat your best distance.

title: Single Line Drawing Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind and unleash your creativity with Single Line: Drawing Puzzle! This exciting game is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers and enjoys solving clever puzzles. Your mission is simple yet addictive: draw one continuous line to complete intricate designs without lifting your finger or retracing your steps. Are you ready to take on this one-line challenge? 🌟 With each level, the shapes become more complex, requiring focus and strategy. From simple patterns to intricate designs, every puzzle is a chance to improve your logic and creativity. Whether you’re solving a quick puzzle or spending time mastering tricky designs, Single Line: Drawing Puzzle offers endless fun! 🧠 Ready to draw your way through fun and challenging puzzles? Download Single Line: Drawing Puzzle today and see how far your skills can take you. It’s time to master the art of one-line drawing!

title: Football: Robots vs Zombies, World Cup!
description:
⚽ Immerse yourself in the exciting world of football, where robots take on zombies!

🎮 Game features:
— 🏆 50 exciting levels
— ♾️ Endless mode
— 🤖 Robot customization
— 🗺️ A variety of locations
— ⚽ An immersive football atmosphere

And that’s not all! Compete with other players, prove your skills on the field, and rise through the rankings. Get ready for football action and adrenaline that will make your heart race!

title: Loose Change: Cashier Simulator
description: A relaxing coin sorting puzzle where you arrange coins by year and value. Plan each move, clear the board efficiently, use boosters when stuck, and improve your best score with every run.

title: Knife vs Fruits
description:
Knife vs Fruits Just Shoot It is a casual game in which you will be playing as a knife-wielding maniac who is on a mission to destroy all the fruits, vegetables, and desserts in the kitchen. The knife-wielding maniac will be thrown to the targets that are located on the kitchen floor. The targets will be rotating and the goal is to hit and stab them all. You can also get cool knives, swords, and daggers from the shop.

The goal of this game is to hit all the targets and become the greatest knife-throwing maniac. To do that, you will need to hit the coins surrounding the fruits. You will also be able to buy cool knives, swords, and daggers from the shop.

title: Blondie in the Real World
description: Blondie lives in her perfect doll world. She is happy, but one day she realizes that something is wrong with her life. Her life is too artificial and perfect. Blondie decides to go to the real world to feel real. Help the Blonde to embody her image in makeup. Bake a cake for the guests and put things in order with Blondie in her new apartment. Choose an adorable party outfit for her and remember that Blondie's favorite colors are pink, gold and white.

title: Squid Game Evolution: All Characters!
description:
Squid Game Evolution: All Characters! is a crazy clicker with strategy elements where you meet all the heroes of the legendary series and upgrade them into incredible forms!

👆 Tap on the characters from Squid Game to earn coins.
💰 Buy new heroes and unlock more and more familiar faces.
⚡ Merge identical characters and watch them evolve into even rarer versions.
📈 Every tap becomes stronger, and your income grows many times over!

But that’s not all:
Between tapping sessions, soldiers will attack you.
⚔️ Build your squad of characters and fight them, showing the true power of the team you’ve managed to gather and upgrade.
🏆 Defeat enemies, earn rewards, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

This is not just a clicker — it’s a full evolution of your favorite heroes and intense battles where every step brings you closer to victory!

title: Street Racer 2D
description: Street Racer 2 is a driving drag-racing game where your goal is to win races, upgrade, and buy new cars. This game offers an exhilarating mix of play modes, including drag racing, off-road challenges, and arcade-style fun. Each mode delivers a distinct experience, whether chasing high-speed thrills, conquering rugged terrain, or enjoying adrenaline-packed track action.

title: Madness: Ward number 6
description:
In this game you are a patient of a psychiatric hospital.

- Upgrade your character by leveling up.

- Try your luck in the rat race.

- Fight with other patients.

- Buy weapons, skins and pets.

title: Mine Mining Islands 2: Skyblock City!
description:
Dive into a world of mining adventures and build your own city!

— Become the mayor: upgrade buildings, trade with villagers, and grow your city
— Explore islands: discover new lands and mine valuable resources
— Upgrade your character: improve speed, strength, and luck
— Fight and defend: protect the city from monster raids and battle in the arena
— Earn wealth: sell resources and become the most successful player

Are you ready to become the best mayor and hero of this world?

title: Drill the Snake
description:
Snake Drill is a casual arcade defense game where you protect the surface from giant segmented snakes crawling up from underground tunnels. A giant segmented snake is crawling up through winding tunnels toward the surface, and your only weapon is a swinging pendulum drill. Time your strikes to shatter the snake's body segment by segment before its head breaks through. Upgrade your drill, use a roguelike card system that changes every run.
 
Swing your drill like a pendulum, time your attack, and shatter the snake's body segment by segment before its head reaches the surface. Simple to pick up, hard to master.

One button. One drill. One chance to stop what's coming.

title: Axe Run
description: Dive into the excitement of Axe Run! Chop through barriers, collect wood, gain speed through gates, and upgrade your character while building a city. Test your skills across various levels, all for free, on both mobile and desktop. Ideal for fans of action and strategy!

title: Obby: Brainrot escape from Lava
description:
🌋 Obby: Brainrot escape from Lava
Collect it. Run. Survive. Meme classics in action!
🔥 Key Features:
• Lava Run: Dodge obstacles, calculate jump timings and outrun the oncoming lava on increasingly difficult and confusing tracks.
• A collection of unique brainrots: Find and unlock dozens of meme characters. Everyone has their own design, rarity, and Easter eggs. Collect them all to add to the album.
• Upgrade your hero: Improve your running speed and jump height.
• Stylish skins: Buy and unlock unique looks for your character.
• Base development: Invest your earnings in your own shelter.

title: Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!
description:
Welcome to “Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!” — an exciting stealth quest where you must escape the house without being seen by your parents! Explore rooms, collect items, and use them wisely to discover new paths to freedom and solve puzzles.

The game features 10 unique endings, each unlocked through clever thinking, observation, and strategic planning. Track your progress and compete with friends on the leaderboard to see who can unlock the most endings.

Combine items, distract your parents, hide, and plan every move — from an ordinary light bulb to a simple stool — every little thing can help you make your escape. The game blends stealth, puzzles, and strategy, making each playthrough unique and exciting.

See how far you can go and prove that you can outsmart even the most watchful parents!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: It's a stealth quest where the player needs to escape from home without getting caught by their parents.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: There is no storyline, but the objective is clear: escape from home without disturbing the parents, using various items to distract them.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game is similar to the legendary game "How to annoy your neighbor." Players need to combine items, distract parents, hide, and plan every move. There are 10 different endings in the game.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has gold as currency. Gold can be spent on skins.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-app purchases in the game? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?

A: There are in-app purchases in the game, where you can buy gold.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are available (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has leaderboards based on the number of endings unlocked.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: Reference to the game "How to annoy your neighbor."

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, in the game, you can buy clothing items for the hero.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: The music complements the game well but is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Sugar Blast: Snowy Pop
description:
Sugar Blast: Welcome to Snowy Pop! 🍫💥
Join 125 thrilling levels filled with colorful candies, plan your moves, and put your skills to the test. 🎯🧩

But be careful! ⚠️🍬 Some candies hide bombs that can cost you your life. Every move counts! ⏳❤️

Level up your abilities: boost your tapping power, increase your starting lives, and unleash powerful candy bombs to clear the screen in a single strike! 🍭🚀

Each level gets tougher, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥

Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮

With support for 8 languages (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese), you can share the same excitement with players from all around the world. 🌍🗣️

title: Raven Estate
description: Raven Estate is a fast-paced shoot-'em-up where you become a fearless crow reclaiming a haunted estate. Blast through waves of monsters with strategically placed weapons that lock in the direction you pick them up. Every choice matters as you dodge, weave, and unleash chaos in this intense bullet-hell adventure. Can you reclaim your home?

title: Cubby Soccer League
description: Cubby Soccer League is a thrilling online HTML5 game that lets you enjoy real soccer action for free. Navigate the field, protect the ball from rivals, and aim for the goal, all while managing your stamina. It's perfect for both casual gamers and soccer fans.

title: Crazy Bar Brawl
description: Crazy Bar Brawl 🍻🥊 throws you straight into the most chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed bar battles ever! If you’ve ever wondered what would happen if you walked into a bar full of drunk troublemakers 🤪, flying bottles 🍾, wobbling chairs 🪑, and wild characters who can barely stand… well, now you can experience it ALL—safely, virtually, and with maximum comedy! 😂 This is the ultimate game where everything becomes a weapon, every fight becomes a story, and every throw becomes a moment of pure madness 💥. Forget real-life fights—keep things safe and enjoy all the ridiculous action right here in-game! 🎯 Easy to Play, Impossible to Put Down Aim ➡️ Throw ➡️ Smash ➡️ Laugh. That’s it! The controls are super simple, making the game perfect for casual fun, quick sessions, AND long chaotic brawling sprees. Watch enemies stumble, spin, fly, flip, and crash into walls like ragdoll rockets 🚀. Every hit feels satisfying thanks to goofy physics and hilarious reactions 🤣. 🍾 Throw Anything and Everything You’re not limited to basic items—choose from a growing collection of crazy throwables such as: Bottles 🍾 Eggs 🥚 Chips 🍟 Chicken legs 🍗 Drinks 🍺 Snacks 🍫 Random junk 🔧🧽 Bar tools 🪓 And many more weird surprises 🎁 Each item behaves differently, creating unexpected chaos every time! 🤪 Meet Wild & Wacky Enemies Every bar is filled with rowdy characters who’ve had way too much to drink: Angry drunk fighters 😡🍺 Hungry customers 🍔 Loud troublemakers 🤼‍♂️ Oddball weirdos 👽 Furious bosses 👑🔥 Random NPCs who just get in the way 😵 Watch them bounce, fall, and flop around thanks to ragdoll physics 🤸‍♂️. 💥 Upgrade & Become a Bar-Legend Boost your: Throwing strength 💪 Accuracy 🎯 Power-ups 🔥 Special moves ⚡ Unlockable items 🎁 Character abilities 🧠 The more you upgrade, the more unstoppable you become. Go from beginner brawler to unstoppable bar champion 🏆! 🌍 Explore Tons of Chaotic Bars Unlock new bars, clubs, lounges, and wild environments: Classic pubs 🍺 Neon nightclubs 🎶 Underground bars 🔦 Rowdy biker taverns 🏍️ Fancy cocktail lounges 🍸 And many more crazy locations 🗺️ Each level introduces new enemies, new layouts, and new ridiculous moments. 😂 Ragdoll Physics = Guaranteed Laughter Everything about the physics is designed for comedy: Enemies flip and fly 💫 Objects bounce unpredictably 🧨 Characters stumble and wobble 🤪 Collisions are extra dramatic 💥 Every fight feels like a cartoon come to life! 🎉 Perfect for Everyone Whether you just want to relax, laugh, blow off steam, or enjoy silly physics, this game is perfect for: Casual players 🎮 Comedy lovers 😂 Physics fans 💫 Stress relief seekers 😌 Anyone who loves chaos ⚔️ Play for 30 seconds or 30 minutes—you’ll always have fun! 🚫 Stay Safe! Real bar fights? ❌ Crazy Bar Brawl? ✔️ Have fun, stay safe, and keep the chaos inside the game! ⭐ Play Crazy Bar Brawl Now! Join the funniest bar fight ever 🤣 Throw anything you want 🍾 Upgrade your power 💪 Smash every enemy 💥 And become the legendary bar brawler 🏆🔥 Play now and let the madness begin! 🍻🚀

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.

title: Rolling Balls 3D
description: Rolling Balls 3D is a casual game in which you have to test your reaction and dexterity. The goal of the game is to guide the ball through an endless maze of obstacles, collecting balls along the way to get more! The bottom line is that every time you collect a ball, a clone of your ball is created and added to the maze, increasing the difficulty as you progress!

title: Merge Guns: Brainrot Battle
description:
Open. Merge. Destroy Bosses.
Dive into a fast-paced merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble a deadly arsenal and take down bosses one after another.

Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical weapons to upgrade their power and unlock devastating stack combos. Strategically place guns, bombs, and knives into combat slots around the boss — they’ll attack automatically while you focus on optimizing your setup and tactics.
Face off against bizarre and powerful bosses like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Sahur, and Cappuccino Assassino—each with unique behavior and escalating difficulty that will push your build to the limit.
Watch out for rage phases, grab limited-time gift events, boost your damage, and activate auto-opening to speed up your progression. Every decision matters as difficulty scales endlessly.
Defeat bosses, earn rewards, and see how far your build can go in an infinite challenge of power and strategy.
Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your loadout can destroy any titan.

title: Dragon Block Blast
description:
Hatch your dragon. Clear the grid. Rise through 100 levels.

Deep in an enchanted forest, a golden dragon egg waits on a stone altar. Your block puzzle skills are the magic that brings it to life. In Dragon Egg Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — each one a score challenge on an 8×8 grid. Clear rows and columns, chain combos, and hit the target before you run out of moves. Every 10 levels, your egg evolves: cracks spread, a hatchling emerges, wings unfurl, and by the end a mighty dragon stands at your side.

Beat Level 25 to unlock Head to Head duels. Complete all 100 levels for the full dragon evolution finale.

title: Basketball Tap
description:
Basketball Tap is a fast-paced casual sports game.
Time your taps perfectly, launch the ball into the air, and score epic slam dunks!

title: Sheepdoku
description:
Welcome to Sheepdoku, a calm and clever puzzle game made for players who love logic, strategy, and relaxing brain challenges.

In Sheepdoku, your goal is simple: place one sheep in every colored area without breaking the rules. It looks easy at first, but every level needs smart thinking, careful moves, and perfect placement.

Each puzzle board is divided into different colored fields. Every field needs exactly one sheep. But sheep need their own space, so they cannot be placed in the same row, same column, or next to each other, even diagonally.

Think carefully before every move. Use your brain, find the safe spots, and complete the board without mistakes. The more you play, the better your logic skills become.

Sheepdoku is perfect for quick relaxing sessions, daily brain training, and puzzle lovers who enjoy simple rules with deep strategy.

title: 2048 checkers
description:
🧩 2048 Checkers is a fresh twist on the classic 2048, where numbers meet the logic and strategy of checkers!
♟️ Move numbered checkers across the board — they can capture only pieces with the same number.
💥 After a successful capture, your checker’s number doubles.
🏆 The goal — reach the 2048 checker and claim victory!

title: Cricket Mania
description:
Step up to the crease and test your reflexes in Cricket Mania, a next-generation online cricket game that combines timing, precision, and high-score challenges.

If you love real cricket, stick cricket, or doodle cricket, you’ll instantly feel at home. Simple to play yet tough to master, Cricket Mania is built for players who enjoy fast matches, realistic animations, and skill-based gameplay.

Every delivery tests your instincts - one mistimed shot, and you’re out! Whether you’re a casual fan or a competitive gamer, Cricket Mania delivers authentic batting fun anytime, anywhere.

title: Color Fall
description: Color Fall is a captivating puzzle game where you match colors with precision by sliding pins in various directions. As the difficulty increases, strategize to navigate levels while avoiding the black color. Playable on Android and desktops, it’s a free game that doesn’t require downloads or registrations.

title: Easter Funny Makeup
description: Eliza and her niece are getting ready for Easter in the most creative way—by designing festive face art! Use cheerful symbols of the season like Easter eggs, bunnies, flowers, butterflies, and rainbows to craft a bright and joyful spring look.

title: 3D Pyramid Maze
description:
A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square
pyramid, climbing terrace by terrace from the base edge to the golden
summit — the maze wraps all four faces, so solving it and climbing it
are the same act.

A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It
paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the
mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them
off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble.

25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four
hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three
of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that
never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid
frames itself.

Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always
available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch
the chase off entirely and just climb.

title: USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator
description:
🚙 USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator 🌲

Drive. Explore. Conquer. Experience the ultimate offroad adventure with powerful luxury 4x4 SUVs across extreme terrains in one of the most realistic offroad driving simulator games ever made! 🌎💨

🌟 Product Features:

🛞 Realistic 4x4 Offroad Physics: True-to-life vehicle handling with suspension dynamics and terrain interaction.
🚗 Luxury SUV Selection: Drive premium offroad vehicles including Range-style SUVs, G-Class, and X-series 4x4s.
🎨 Customizable Vehicles: Change colors, wheels, accessories, and more to create your dream ride.
🌋 Challenging Terrain & Obstacles: Conquer mud, rocks, rivers, snow, and mountain paths like a pro driver.
🌅 Immersive HD Graphics: Realistic lighting, detailed environments, and smooth visuals bring every trail to life.
🌧️ Dynamic Weather & Day-Night Cycle: Drive in rain, fog, or sunshine, and explore the wilderness at sunrise or midnight.
🎮 Multiple Game Modes: Try Free Roam, Time Trial, or Obstacle Challenges to test your offroad mastery.
🕹️ Easy Controls: Choose between tilt, steering wheel, or touch controls for the best driving experience.

🏁 Product Description:

Welcome to USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator — the ultimate offroad car driving game for real adventure seekers and SUV lovers! 🇺🇸

Take control of high-end 4x4 luxury vehicles and embark on an unforgettable offroad journey through rugged mountains, muddy trails, forests, and river crossings. Every mission is a new test of your driving skills, precision, and patience.

🚙 Feel the real offroad physics as your wheels grip and slide across realistic terrain.
🌦️ Experience dynamic weather and breathtaking day-night cycles that make every drive unique.
🎨 Customize your ride to perfection — from paint colors to tire designs — and make your SUV stand out on every trail.

Whether you love offroad simulators, SUV driving games, or 4x4 adventure experiences, this game delivers the real thrill of luxury offroad exploration.

4x4 offroad simulator, SUV offroad driving, offroad jeep game, mountain car drive, offroad car simulator 3D, USA SUV driving, mud racing game, offroad luxury car, extreme 4x4 challenge, SUV simulator game, offroad adventure 2025, real offroad driving game

💪 Dominate every trail. Rule every mountain. Live the offroad life.
Download USA Luxury 4x4 SUV Offroad Driving Simulator now and enjoy the most realistic offroad SUV driving game of 2025! 🚙🔥

So, buckle up, switch on your 4x4 mode, and explore the toughest routes in the USA wilderness! 🌄

title: Monster Truck Stunt Game Racing Games
description: Welcome to the world of monster track stunt games. Get ready for thrilling monster truck stunts in one of the most exciting truck games! Drive powerful monster truck racing vehicles, perform insane stunt jumps, and conquer mega ramps in this action-packed car game experience. Master racing car game challenges, speed through impossible tracks, and prove your skills in monster truck stunts! Take control of a powerful stunt truck and experience truck stunt racing like never before! Compete in monster truck stunts, execute high-speed stunt jumps, and master the most extreme stunt tracks. Drive your monster trucks in the stunts and obstacles of the open free car stunts mode!

title: Shoot & Sprint: Warfare
description: In the game, you will find yourself in the role of a brave fighter who rushes forward without stopping. Your task is to shoot the enemies and survive in this fast—paced action game.

title: Lost Adventure
description:
"Survivors of a mid-air crash find themselves in a mysterious land. The pilot, amidst crafting, mining, and solving puzzles, works tirelessly to save passengers stranded on separate islands in the wild grass. Can they conquer the challenges, reunite, and escape the enigmatic realm before the unknown dangers lurking in the wilderness engulf them all?"

Embark on a thrilling adventure after a plane crash strands you in a mysterious, wild land. As the pilot, you must gather resources from wreckage, craft tools, and navigate through the wild grass to rescue scattered passengers on small islands.

Explore ancient ruins, solve puzzles, and mine resources to unlock the secrets of this enigmatic realm. Encounter friendly and hostile creatures, and use your crafted weapons to survive. Communicate with other survivors, separated by streams and dense vegetation, through makeshift signals.

Your journey is a test of resilience and camaraderie. Each crafted item brings you closer to reuniting with your fellow survivors and discovering the way back home. Will you conquer the challenges of the wild grass and unveil the mysteries hidden within, or succumb to the unknown dangers that lurk in the shadows? The choice is yours in this gripping and immersive adventure!

title: Dronner 3D
description: Dronner 3D - Immerse yourself in dynamic racing in a unique car that can turn into a quadcopter and overcome exciting tracks.

title: Van Rush!
description:
🚚Van Rush!📦
Drive, pass puzzle, deliver deliveries, load packages, earn money and buy offers.

title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
description: Indulge in the Fashionista Christmas Eve Party extravaganza! Discover glamorous holiday ensembles, festive accessories, and the perfect blend of chic for a stylish celebration. Join the fashion-forward festivities and elevate your Christmas Eve style to new heights. Unwrap the magic of the season with Fashionista, where every outfit is a statement and every moment is a fashion triumph. Let the glamour of Christmas Eve unfold.

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: "Jenny's Math Puzzle" is an engaging educational puzzle game that combines math challenges with interactive gameplay. Players must strategically place number tiles onto a grid to form correct mathematical equations. As a unique twist, the game seamlessly blends arithmetic practice with logical problem-solving, offering a fresh take on the genre. Its gradually increasing difficulty and visually appealing design make it both fun and mentally stimulating for players of all ages.

title: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong
