description: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong is a delightful Mahjong Solitaire puzzle game immersed in a vibrant underwater fantasy realm. Its core concept revolves around matching and removing identical fish-themed tiles—featuring colorful clownfish, angelfish, and other sea creatures—to clear intricate layouts against a pirate shipwreck backdrop with corals and seaweed. Unique elements include adorable aquatic tile designs, intuitive UI with hints, shuffles, and color swaps, plus timed levels for relaxed yet engaging play.

title: Scale the wheels
description:
The game where size matters! Your mission is to change the size of the wheels, transitioning from small to large and vice versa, to overcome a variety of obstacles and progress through levels. But that's not all! The size of the wheels also affects the speed of your car, adding excitement to the gameplay.

With over 30 different tracks to conquer, you'll face unique challenges. Additionally, you can upgrading your acceleration, enabling you to jump farther and collect more coins at the end of each level. So, resize your wheels, and embark on the exhilarating journey to earn the highest score and become a true champion!

title: Tile Match Puzzle
description:
Are you a fan of match 3 and combination zen match games? 
Tile Match Puzzle fulfills your desire for puzzle fun with new puzzle challenges every day! Simply match three tiles to reveal even more tiles underneath. Find more combinations until you've cleared everything. But beware: If you select too many tiles without at least three matching each other, you will have to start your journey from the beginning.

Each level presents you with a new addictive puzzle challenge. Take a fun and relaxing getaway as you enter beautiful new landscapes to test your brain. 

Game features
 
Unique Tile Puzzles:
With tiles in over 20 styles, there's no limit to the number of combinations you can make. 

Flex your brain muscles
Test and improve your memory and pattern recognition skills with this fun and relaxing puzzle game!

title: Logo Quiz Master
description: Test your knowledge and challenge your brain with Logo Quiz Master, the ultimate trivia game for logo enthusiasts! Dive into a world of iconic brands, famous companies, and unforgettable symbols as you guess the logos from various categories. Whether you're a casual gamer or a trivia master, this game will keep you entertained for hours!

title: Moto Traffic Rider
description:
Moto Traffic Rider puts you behind the handlebars of a powerful motorcycle and delivers a whole new level of realism while keeping the old-school spirit and simple gameplay.

Jump into the saddle, switch to the first-person view, and race through busy highways, weaving between streams of cars. The game features a full career mode, enhanced graphics, detailed environments, and realistic motorcycle sounds recorded from real bikes. Complete missions, earn money, and unlock new motorcycles to become a true highway legend.

Moto Traffic Rider combines fast-paced arcade racing with the atmosphere of a real biker adventure. Ride day and night on highways and city streets, pushing your skills to the limit.

Features:
• First-person camera view for full immersion
• 13 unique motorcycles with realistic engine sounds
• Detailed roads and dynamic day/night cycle
• Full career mode with no fuel or time limits
• Motorcycle upgrade and purchase system

title: 4 Color Card Game
description: 4 Color Card Game is a fast-paced, easy-to-learn card game perfect for players of all ages. The goal is simple: match cards by color or number and be the first to get rid of all your cards. With action cards that can change the flow of the game in an instant, every round is full of surprises and fun. Whether you're playing with friends, family, or challenging opponents online, 4 Color Card Game delivers quick, exciting matches that keep you coming back for more.

title: Evolution: Survival
description:
A survival game where you begin as a tiny cell in the primordial soup. Collect DNA by consuming food and defeating enemies to trigger evolution and choose your mutation: speed, attack, defense, poison, regeneration, or intelligence.

With each evolution, the world transforms — from open ocean to the deep sea, from shallow waters to dry land. Enemies grow stronger, elite opponents emerge, and fearsome bosses stand in your way. Combine mutations to unlock secret forms: Dragon, Leviathan, Phantom, Hive Mind, and more.

Collect rare stars scattered across the map and invest them into permanent upgrades that carry over between runs. Use active abilities — dash, acid spit, death cloud, traps, and cover — to survive as long as possible.

How many evolutions will you conquer?

title: Loot Island - Treasure Digger
description:
Embark on an exciting treasure hunt! Immerse yourself in fascinating landscapes, look for crosses, and dig up precious items. Collect the loot in your backpack and stack it in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle. Get ready for a game that combines strategic excavation and exciting loot stacking!

🗺️ Focus on the map
💎 Dig deeper into the fascinating landscapes to find precious items
🎒 Collect the loot in your backpack
⚡️ Stack them in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle
🧩 Stack gems, coins, and more to maximize your treasure profit
🛠️ Upgrade your tools and unlock new maps as you delve deeper into the adventure
🌟 Test your skill, strategy, and luck in this addictive game!

title: Miner Builder
description:
You'll become a skyscraper builder!
Operate construction equipment and build the tallest skyscraper in the world.
Collect blocks using a bulldozer.

title: Stickboy Epic Swordsman
description: Embrace your warrior spirit in Stickboy Epic Swordsman, an exciting online game where you equip diverse armor, face tough challenges, and defeat powerful bosses. Explore a vibrant world, gather exclusive gear, and find unique swords to enhance your combat tactics. Rise through the ranks and test your skills against others.

title: Merge 13
description: Merge 13 is a thrilling online puzzle game where players combine numbered cells for higher scores. Accessible on various devices without downloads, it provides a captivating mix of logic and math, perfect for puzzle enthusiasts. Jump right in and challenge your strategic thinking to reach 13!

title: Rolling Balancer Ball
description: Rolling Balance Ball 3D is a simple but challenging balance game where your main goal is to guide a rolling ball across narrow wooden bridges surrounded by water. You must keep the ball steady, avoid traps, and safely reach the boat at the end of each level. The gameplay feels physics-based, so small moves matter one wrong swipe and the ball can fall into the water.

title: SquadZ
description: Get ready for fast-paced, action-packed battles that you can dive into at any time. This hyper-casual shooter features bite-sized levels full of non-stop excitement, where you can unlock cool heroes, collect powerful weapons, and take down enemies in a flash. With simple controls and quick missions, you can play for as little as one minute or twenty, delivering epic fun on the go. Whether you're short on time or ready to aim for a high score, this explosive shooter has something for everyone.

title: Mr.Tung Shoot Zombie
description: Help Mr. Tung and ensure he shoots all the zombies with the most precise shot. You must be very careful. Ballerina Cappuccino can be eaten by zombies at any time. Ballerinakapicuno is currently in prison, and to save him, you must shoot and destroy all the zombies with your arrows. Mr. Tung is the best marksman and will destroy all the zombies. Destroy all the zombies and save Ballerina Cappuccino.

title: Eternal Dance
description: Eternal Dance is a calm, meditative arcade game about keeping balance. Two koi — one black, one white — endlessly circle a glowing orb in a hand-painted zen pond. Drifting ink threatens the orb from the dark, and only the koi of the matching color can dissolve it. Guide their dance, protect the orb, and lose yourself in the flow. Easy to learn, hard to master — a one-touch game that trades frantic reflexes for focus and serenity.

title: Emoji Guess
description: Show off your skills as an emoji interpreter in this supremely fun and frenetic puzzle game where you have to pick the right set of emojis to express the phrase, saying or movie title that’s written or illustrated above. Solve endless emoji puzzles by matching the right emojis in the right order and sharpen your logic, word association and visual perception skills with hundreds of short, colorful and often hilarious levels of brain-teasing entertainment. Emoji Guess Puzzle is a simple-in-concept but endlessly challenging and amusing puzzle game for smart players of all ages.

title: Cooking in the City of Winds
description: Welcome to the City of Winds. The culinary festival starts here today! Participants came from all over the magical land to prepare their favorite dishes and delight the citizens. Try your hand at making smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea and the famous Hocus-Pocus marmalade dessert. This is simply heaven for those with a sweet tooth. Don’t forget that the dish should not only be tasty, but also beautiful. Use your cooking skills to decorate the dish as elegantly as possible. And victory will be yours!

title: Driverz Ed
description:
Welcome to Driverz Ed, with your instructor Ed! Explore Ed's beautiful island, completing challenges, or just drive around and try to find all the secrets the Island has to offer!

Find the hidden Puzzle Pieces and unlock every car.

title: Space Craft: Ship War
description:
Explore deep space,
piloting a cubic ship that can be infinitely expanded with modules.
Collect new decks, melee and ranged weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades on the map, transforming your ship into a true battle station. Enemies also grow, making every encounter a dynamic battle for survival.
Complete levels, upgrade your stats, unlock new skins, and experiment with builds. Vibrant 3D graphics, rich effects, and constant progression make space battles exciting and unpredictable.

Features:
🚀 Infinite ship expansion with modules
🔫 A variety of weapons: melee and firearms
⚡ Boosters and boosters for dynamic battles 🛠 Upgrades after each level
🎨 Skin collection and customization
🌌 Colorful 3D graphics and numerous levels

title: Numbers Match 2448
description: Numbers Match 2448 is a relaxing and addictive number puzzle game where you match, merge, and build bigger numbers with every move. Place number blocks carefully, create smart combinations, and complete each level’s goal before the board fills up. Easy to start and satisfying to master, it is a great brain teaser for players who enjoy number games, merge puzzles, and 2048-style challenges.

title: Click Kitty Idle
description:
Click Kitty Idle– Fast-Paced Cat Clicker Challenge!
Click Kitty Idle is a fun and competitive idle clicker game where speed, timing, and strategy matter! Tap to feed your kitty, level up, and dominate the leaderboard in this addictively cute cat-clicking game!                                             
Why You’ll Love It:
If you enjoy fast-paced clicker games with a twist, It’s not just about clicking—it's about clicking smart and fast.
Play now and prove you’ve got the fastest paws in town!

•Cute & competitive gameplay with pressure-based challenges!
•Buy fun food like tuna, milk, cheese & more!
•Unlock cute cat characters like Miss Pawlina and Captain Purrbeard!
•Boosters: Auto Click, Time Extension, and Massive Click Power!
•Compete for high scores and unlock achievements!

title: Night Club Security
description:
Immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of a security guard simulator inspired by the cult game I'm Security.

Check visitors for prohibited items, decide who is worthy of entry and who is not. Your power is absolute, because you are an unlimited security guard! Use your imagination to have fun and unusual "entertainment" with visitors, leaving them without things or even with a couple of bruises. Everything that happens is in your hands.

Game features:

🔎 Check people for prohibited items.
🕶 Decide who to allow entry and who to refuse.
🤪 Give free rein to your imagination - everything is allowed!
🤝 Interact with visitors in any way.
🎭 Feel like a real "owner" of the club.

title: Archer: Trial by Fate
description:
Archer: Trial by Fate is a dynamic top-down action game. You control an archer who fights through dozens of rooms filled with monsters and bosses, challenging fate itself.

What awaits you:
* Dozens of unique abilities: ricochet, split arrows, meteors, orbs, ice and fire arrows, ghostly companions, and much more. Every run is a new combination of skills.
* Battles against a wide variety of enemies and bosses, each with its own behavior, attacks, and weaknesses.
* Progression between runs: unlock new heroes, upgrade your gear in the Forge, and invest coins into permanent stat improvements.
* Randomized room and wave order, so no two attempts are ever the same.

Can you clear every stage and defeat the final boss?

title: Strike Force: Action Platformer
description:
Jump, shoot, and power up in this action-packed platformer!
Dive into an exciting adventure through colorful levels filled with enemies and non-stop action! Run along the route, dodge bullets, and fight off enemies attacking from all sides — charging straight at you, dropping in with parachutes, or firing from cover.

Collect ammo to stay in the fight, and make sure to blast enemy drones for powerful weapon upgrades. Unlock a roster of unique characters and grow stronger with every battle.

Game features:

Vibrant, eye-catching graphics

Intense shootouts with a variety of enemies

Explosive drone takedowns and weapon upgrades

A collection of heroes with different looks

Simple controls and addictive gameplay

🎮 Ready for battle? Jump in and show them what you’re made of!

title: Arkanoid For Painters
description: Arkanoid For Painters is a thrilling online game where players create barriers to control a ball, clearing blocks and foes. It blends classic gameplay with artistic elements, catering to creative strategists. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it guarantees entertaining challenges on the go.

title: HEX Connect
description: HEX Connect is a captivating hexagonal Mahjong Connect puzzle game where players strategically link pairs of identical colored tiles on a large hex grid, with connections limited to paths of no more than two bends, challenging spatial reasoning to clear the board entirely.

title: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures
description: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures offers a thrilling 2D arcade experience filled with action. Combat zombies and drones, enhance your weapons, and complete missions to save friends. Explore for secrets while playing seamlessly across devices without downloads or registrations directly in your browser. Enjoy the adventure anytime, anywhere!

title: Halloween Merge Mania
description: Halloween Merge Mania challenges players to merge eerie characters, like pumpkins, to create stronger beings. Inspired by 2048, this game requires strategic thinking. As you advance, new surprises keep the game fresh and engaging, offering a thrilling Halloween-themed merging experience.

title: Funny Angela Haircut
description: Give Angela the best hairstyle ever! Enjoy tons of professional tools like curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, magic hair growing spray, and so much more! Dye her hair in any variety of colors. Complete the makeover with stylish outfit, mix and match cute clothes and dress up Angela to become more fashionable!

title: Elements Craft Ultimate
description: Combine the four basic elements—Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind—to create the universe! Drag and drop items to discover hundreds of unique recipes in this addictive alchemy puzzle game.

title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

Run through the streets of the metropolis, uncover a conspiracy, upgrade your weapons and equipment, mine resources, and defeat bosses. The game combines action-packed shooting, survival elements, character development, and a rich storyline about the struggle for human freedom.

Key Features:
🔫 RPG shooter with dynamic action gameplay
🧱 Unique voxel style and cuberpunk atmosphere
⚙️ Deep weapon and equipment customization
🤖 Battles with robots, monsters, and bosses
🧭 Exploration of the city, dungeons, and locations
💰 Resource collection, crafting, and base development

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is an RPG where you fight through hordes of enemies to complete levels, unlock new skills, areas, and weapons.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: There isn't a traditional narrative, but the objective is clear: unlock new territories and defeat bosses.

Q: What makes this game unique? Why would players be interested?
A: There are very few games like this, especially with a stylish cyberpunk archer theme. It features built-in mini-games, great graphics, varied missions, and deep character customization and progression.

Q: What are the most engaging elements of the game?
A: The internal mini-games, a wide variety of weapons, clear objectives, and simple, intuitive gameplay mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: Yes, but the bosses are relatively easy. They act as guardians stationed at the entrances to new cities.

Q: How does the progression system work? How can you level up faster?
A: You level up by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Money is used to unlock new territories, upgrade your character, and purchase new clothing.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?
A: You can spend money on clothing and unlocking new firearms.

Q: Is there customization? Can you change your hero's appearance, use a map editor, or tune vehicles?
A: Yes, you can purchase various outfits and weapons for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, logging in every day provides bonuses such as gear or currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or is it possible to play without it?
A: The music is a great addition to the atmosphere, but it is not required to progress through the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What kind of achievements are there and how are they earned?
A: You can earn achievements for daily logins."

title: Playground Ragdoll Sandbox
description:
In the game world, you can do everything: ride cars, blow up buildings, fight enemies and complete exciting missions. Use a variety of weapons, build objects with a tulgan and experiment with destruction.

The main goal of the game is to destroy the city using a nuclear bomb. How will you achieve this? It's up to you to decide. Move towards your goal through story missions or immerse yourself in a limitless sandbox of possibilities.

description:
Welcome to the fun world of Cannon Strike, an arcade game where you shoot balls from a cannon! It's very easy to play.

Precision Parking Pro is the ultimate test of control, timing, and skill. Step into the driver’s seat and prove you’ve got what it takes to park with perfection. From tight city alleys to complex multi-level garages, every challenge pushes your precision and patience to the limit.

description: Business Go is a classic board game where players buy, sell, and rent properties to build their wealth and outplay the competition.

title: The cow of the apocalypse
description:
A mad cow has escaped from the farm! Feel the taste of freedom! Destroy the city, fly a helicopter and fight back against the cops in this absurd action game! Forget about green pastures and peaceful mooing! Dasha is not an ordinary Burenka. Tired of milking and hay, she runs away from the farm to assert her rights and live freely as a human being. In this crazy game you will find:

Hardcore gameplay: Run through the streets, enter buildings and control a variety of vehicles, from cars to a combat helicopter!

Total Destruction: You are a walking natural disaster! Shoot, smash and explode everything you see. Buildings, lampposts, police cars — nothing can resist your fury.

Resistance to the system: Local law enforcement officers are not ready for such a threat! Give a decisive rebuff to the police, who will try to return you to the stall. Your goal is not just to survive, but to wreak havoc and prove that cows can be free too!

title: ParkOut: Traffic Escape
description:
Ready to solve the ultimate traffic puzzle?

ParkOut: Traffic Escape is a fun, addictive, and colorful 3D puzzle game. The parking lot is completely gridlocked, and it’s up to you to clear the mess! Use your logic and strategy to slide the cars, unblock the path, and guide everyone safely to the exit.

It looks simple, but the puzzles get trickier as you go. Can you untangle the chaos and become the ultimate parking master?

🌟 Key Features:

- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn, incredibly hard to put down.

- Vibrant 3D Graphics: Bright, smooth, and deeply satisfying visuals.

- Endless Levels: Hundreds of brain-teasing parking lots to clear.

- Stress-Free: No timers or penalties. Just relax and solve at your own pace!

title: Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City
description: Experience the thrill of Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City—an intense street racing game with realistic physics, stunning graphics, and adrenaline-fueled drifts. Overtake rivals, master your skills, and dominate the competition. Ready to become a legend?

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description:
Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

description: Roll to Riches is a colorful 3D arcade simulator where you train your rolling wheel, race as far as possible, earn Cash and Trophies, collect pets, unlock new wheels and trails, claim rewards, rebirth for stronger progression, and work toward new worlds.

title: LifeCode
description:
GAME STORY

After the incident in the Zone, all personnel were evacuated. To ensure that no one would uncover the secrets of the facility, the staff deliberately damaged the data storage system. As a result, the A.R.C.H core lost access to critical information, placing an immense strain on the entire system. Sooner or later, it would lead to a catastrophic explosion.
But the staff overlooked one thing.
A.R.C.H is an advanced artificial intelligence capable of calculating thousands of possibilities and creating complex plans within milliseconds. It quickly found a way to avoid its destruction.
There was only one problem: A.R.C.H could not move on its own.
It needed someone else to do the dirty work.
Only the monsters remained inside the abandoned laboratory. Then A.R.C.H remembered that among them was one creature capable of listening, thinking, and acting.
And it found YOU.

ABOUT THE GAME

This is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory. You play as an intelligent creature that must survive, explore the facility, and complete tasks for the A.R.C.H core.
Your main objective is to export memory data for A.R.C.H so the artificial intelligence can recover lost information and complete its mysterious plan.
However, the laboratory is far from empty. Other monsters roam its corridors. Unlike you, they are wild and driven only by hunger. And to them, you are food.
While exploring, you can find a variety of useful items, including food, flashlights, medical supplies, and other resources. Items can be discovered inside crates scattered throughout the laboratory.
The game also features vending machines located at the base and in random locations around the facility. These machines allow you to purchase useful items using a special currency called N-Neutrons.
Every playthrough is unique thanks to procedural level generation. The laboratory is assembled from pre-designed modules, creating a new layout each time while still allowing players to learn and navigate the environment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I earn N-Neutrons?

Starting an M3N memory export grants between 3N and 8N on Normal difficulty.
Completing the export and activating Phase Two rewards between 50N and 65N.
After filling the memory bar, the player can activate Control Core functions:
First Function rewards between 110N and 190N.
Second Function rewards between 210N and 340N.

What is Phase Two for?

Phase Two provides additional memory and helps fill the memory bar faster. A single M3N can provide up to 424 KB of memory multiplied by a factor between 0.5 and 5 depending on the antenna angle.

Why are there clocks in the game?

The clock system prevents players from staying in one location forever. It encourages exploration and increases tension.
At night, the chance of monster encounters is much higher than during the day, forcing players to decide whether the risk is worth the potential reward.

How do I end the day?

To end the day, return to the base and enter the small room where the game began. Inside, you will find an old mattress that can be used to sleep.
Players cannot sleep during the day, which encourages exploration and prevents skipping entire days.

title: Geometry Maze Maps V2
description: Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2 is a fast-paced platformer where you control a cube through six tricky mazes. The game throws obstacles like spikes and moving platforms at you while your character speeds forward on its own, testing your reflexes. title: Echolocation Shooter
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of neon monster enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot.
Unleash soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades to light up the battlefield, upgrade your gear, and fight deeper into the horroristic horde.

Every shot reveals the world—every wave pushes your limits.

title: GreenPEAK
description:

🌟 If you enjoy obby games, peak, only up, or parkour — this game is for you!

• 🌳 Atmospheric green world
• 🤝 Online play with friends
• 🏃 Parkour and jumping
• 📸 Meme collecting
• 🎧 Relaxing, meditative gameplay

Ready to climb? 🧗‍♀️ Explore, ascend, and enjoy GreenPEAK together with friends! 🚀

description:

and real-time PvP battles against friends. Clean night-sky design, satisfying
progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions
and serious learning.

description:

🏐 Download now and roll your way to victory! 🚀✨

title: Block Match 3D
description:
Block Match 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing 3D puzzle where you take apart a giant cube of blocks, piece by piece. Every block carries a cute icon — donuts, animals, emoji, music and more.

Match blocks to the active category goals, dig deeper into the structure, and clear the whole cube before the timer runs out. Simple to pick up, tricky to master: plan your taps wisely, because the storage bar at the bottom fills up fast.

Dozens of levels, colorful icon collections, and handy boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Magic Wand and Undo will keep you matching for hours!

title: Turbo Racer Extreme
description: You race through traffic, dodging cars and trying to get the most amount of points. The closer you get to other cars - the more points you get. You can choose the difficulty and aesthetic of your race every time.

title: Erase the extra element
description: Test your attention to detail! Erase the wrong parts of each scene and uncover the hidden truth behind each puzzle.

title: Real COD Strike
description:
Real COD Strike is a fast-paced modern-warfare shooter where precision, reflex, and tactical skill decide every battle. Enter intense frontline combat inspired by realistic military operations, featuring high-impact gunplay, explosive missions, and squad-based action.

Dominate close-quarters firefights, secure objectives, and outsmart enemy forces across cinematic battlefields filled with chaos, smoke, and fire. Equip your soldier with customizable weapons, tactical gear, and powerful kill-streak abilities to turn the tide of war.

Whether you’re clearing enemy bases, defending strategic points, or surviving ambushes behind enemy lines, every mission challenges you to think fast and shoot faster.

description: Fly into excitement with **Air Warfare**, an endless game where you take charge of a combat plane. Shoot down foes, gather ammo, avoid attacks, and strive for survival. Compete for high scores while enjoying smooth gameplay on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Car And Truck Parking Game

description: Dive into the captivating world of Sea Legends - Match 3, a thrilling puzzle game where you explore ocean mysteries and uncover shipwreck secrets. Featuring beautiful graphics and captivating gameplay, it guarantees endless fun, whether on mobile or desktop.

title: Pop Puzzle
description:

Progressive difficulty — beginner-friendly tutorials up to expert parking puzzles.
Optimized performance for smooth gameplay on mobile devices.
Whether you enjoy relaxed precision driving or intense obstacle runs, Real Parking Game delivers addictive, approachable gameplay that rewards skill and patience. Download now, pick your favorite ride, master the obstacles and park like a pro!

title: Tornado-67
description:

title: Super Fruit Runner - Hyper Casual
description:
In this hyper casual runner game 🚀, you control fast-moving fruits and dodge obstacles to reach the finish line 🍏. With 15 unique levels 🗺️ and 12 special achievements 🎖️, the fun never ends! Thanks to 7 language options — English 🇬🇧, Russian 🇷🇺, French 🇫🇷, Turkish 🇹🇷, Spanish 🇪🇸, German 🇩🇪, and Italian 🇮🇹 — everyone can enjoy the game 🌍.

Destroy fruits by hitting knives 🗡️ and earn Yakut to buy powerful upgrades 💎, including:

Increase starting fruit count 🍎

Increase Yakut earnings 💰

Extra reward for hitting green platforms ➕

Reduce loss from hitting red platforms ➖

Use your speed, reflexes, and strategy 🧠💨 to clear all levels, unlock every achievement 🎖️.

title: Sky Blocks Falling
description:
Sky Blocks Falling is an idle Arkanoid-style game where you catch falling blocks to fill platforms and earn money.

Features
Upgrade your speed for faster block-catching
Add more platforms to increase your capacity
Unlock critical hits for bonus rewards
Boost your income with progressive upgrades
Prestige to accelerate future progress
Complete a variety of achievements
Customize your experience with block skins and atmospheric themes
Can you build the ultimate sky-falling machine?

title: Pulse Of Fear
description:
Trapped in an abandoned place where something unspeakable lives, your survival depends on two things: light and silence.

Fuel your flashlight with batteries to shed light on the eerie secrets of the place. Repair generators to restore power and find a way to escape. Search for items: fuses for electrical panels, first aid kits for healing, and keys to locked doors.

Light the way. Fix the system. Start the elevator. Most importantly, stay in the shadows.

title: Build Obby World
description:
🌈 Welcome to Build Obby World!

Jump, build, explore, and create your own magical world full of surprises, pets, and treasures! 🎁🐾✨

Start with a tiny island… gather resources, then build pieces of other islands to reach new places! 🌟

Tap tiny slimes to bring this world to life!

Upgrade and upgrade your character's tools!

Make your island big, colorful, and happy! 🌈✨

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: It's a game where you gather resources, craft, build, explore, and create your own magical world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? How can it hook players?
A: High-quality graphics, many skins, an exciting obby adventure, survival gameplay, resource gathering, and cute slimes and pets.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Trendy skins featuring Italian brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What do players need to do to level up faster?
A: The obby opens new ports and locations through building and construction.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (e.g., common - gold, premium - crystals)?
A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals. They can be spent on necessary in-game materials, such as an axe or an improved pickaxe for resource gathering.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what effect does it have? Does donating accelerate game progress?
A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy skins and crystals. Crystals can later be exchanged for gold to buy new, improved tools for faster resource gathering.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can buy different skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: Music enhances the game but is not necessary for completing the levels or progression.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are the achievements and how are they earned?
A: The game features a collection of slimes and pets.

title: SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies
description: Engage in SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies, a thrilling strategy game where you defend humanity from a zombie apocalypse. Enjoy online gameplay without downloads, equip over 50 unique weapons, and face endless undead waves. Test your skills in various modes and strive for victory in PvP battles.

title: Merge Mushroom
description:
🍄 Throw mushrooms on mushrooms to get new ones
🍄 Collect all possible mushrooms
🍄 Compete with other mushroom pickers around the world!

title: Funny Rescue Zookeeper
description: Amia had a bad day today at the zoo. As a zookeeper, Amia is responsible for taking care of all the animals there. Only today, things did not go as they should and Amia had a quite serious accident. Let's treat Amia so that she can return to take care of her beloved animals.

title: Geometry Open World
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Geometry Open World, a dynamic 2D action game. Steer your vessel through challenging terrains, face various foes, and confront tough bosses. Utilize upgrades and skills to secure triumph. Ready to dominate this geometrical adventure? Enjoy it for free on your devices!

title: Ocean Pop
description: Ocean Pop brings a delightful new twist to the blast genre, inviting players of all ages to dive into a lively underwater world brimming with charm and color. Unlike typical grid-based games like Toy Blast, Ocean Pop features real 2D bubbles that drift, bounce, and cluster with natural, playful physics, creating puzzles that feel dynamic and alive. Players dive beneath the waves to pop colorful bubbles, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and explore the serene beauty of the ocean depths — all while enjoying intuitive gameplay that’s easy to pick up yet delightfully challenging to master.

title: Paint Race
description: Dive into the dynamic realm of Paint Race, an online game that tests your speed and accuracy. Navigate through vibrant circles while evading dark barriers across 50 thrilling levels. Available on both mobile and desktop, this free game provides an engaging mix of excitement and challenge.

title: Match them up!
description: Match Them Up! is a relaxing 3D matching puzzle where you search for pairs of identical objects scattered around the room. Tap to match, clear the space, and beat your best time! With smooth controls and colorful toon visuals, every round feels satisfying and fun.

title: Hide from School
description:
🏫"Hide from School ": A free online game combining popular genres such as: hide and seek, escape and quests. Help a young schoolboy escape from his teachers!

🕵️Hiding and Disguise: Blend in with the walls, disguise yourself as various objects to avoid teachers' attention. Solve puzzles, open doors, find your way out of rooms - your goal is to escape! Become a real school assassin!

🎮Play Hide and Seek Online: Feel yourself among the school walls and corridors, and test your skills in disguise. This free game allows you to compete with players from all over the world!

🧩Interactive rooms and traps: Explore different rooms, go into the shadows, and use items to create the perfect trap. Only those who can disguise themselves and escape cleverly will reach freedom!

title: Hidden Paint 3D
description: Coloring 3D is an exciting game where you can animate objects with the help of color. Just click on various objects and they will instantly turn into bright and beautiful shades. The game is suitable for all ages, offering a simple and relaxing way to show your creativity.

title: Left 4 Die
description: Left 4 Die is an intense survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic environment. Utilize strategy to face endless enemies in this web-based game with stunning graphics and responsive controls. Experience the excitement across various devices as you navigate dangers, wield formidable weapons, and adapt to survive.

title: Left 4 Die
description: Left 4 Die is an intense survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic environment. Utilize strategy to face endless enemies in this web-based game with stunning graphics and responsive controls. Experience the excitement across various devices as you navigate dangers, wield formidable weapons, and adapt to survive.

title: Left 4 Die
description: Left 4 Die is an intense survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic environment. Utilize strategy to face endless enemies in this web-based game with stunning graphics and responsive controls. Experience the excitement across various devices as you navigate dangers, wield formidable weapons, and adapt to survive.

title: Left 4 Die
description: Left 4 Die is an intense survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic environment. Utilize strategy to face endless enemies in this web-based game with stunning graphics and responsive controls. Experience the excitement across various devices as you navigate dangers, wield formidable weapons, and adapt to survive.

title: Bump Bandit
description: Bump Bandit is a clever top-down puzzle game wrapped in a retro jazzy atmosphere. You play as a quirky little thief determined to snatch every diamond in the city—and by the time the heist is over, he might just steal your heart too. Follow this charming rogue to the end of his adventure and uncover the unexpected twist in his story.

title: Stack Up
description:
Stack Em Up! is a casual single-player puzzle game where your goal is to connect stacks of the same color to combine them. By chaining same-colored stacks, you build longer stacks; you try to reach stacks of length 10 or more.
It’s stylised and simple in controls.
There are many levels that get progressively more challenging.

title: Tap, Think, Save the Kitten!
description:
Danger slithers closer! 

A colorful snake is stalking a helpless kitten, and only YOU can stop it! Tap away at the directional arrow-boxes in the right sequence to solve the puzzle and reload your colored gun. Match the colors, fire the bullets, and watch the beast shrink! Every second counts in this thrilling idle tap challenge. 

Can you outsmart the serpent and save the kitten? 
Download now and test your skills in the most addictive puzzle arcade game!

title: Pop It Master
description:
Play Pop It Simulator for free and collect the entire collection of 150 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys! Relieve stress after school or a day at work with this simple game! 

Features of the game: 
- Relaxing and stress-relieving game 
- Collection of Pop-it and simple-dimple of various shapes and colors 
- Secret game mode

title: Kitten Never Dies
description: Join an interdimensional adventure to help a lost kitten find its way home! Solve unique challenges in each dimension. Cute, clever, and full of surprises—are you up for the challenge? Play now and test your puzzle-solving skills!

title: Stickman Jump
description: Stickman Jump is a fast-paced platformer in which you have to jump and run across platforms with a little stickman. You control a small character who sprints at full speed and needs precise timing to jump over obstacles and complete each level. The further you get, the greater the challenges that will test your reflexes and concentration.

title: Brainrot Mixup
description:
Brainrot Puzzle takes the viral brainrot animal aesthetic and turns it into an actually playable, satisfying, and replayable puzzle game — perfect for mobile, casual web, or PC.

If you love quirky puzzle games, if you’ve laughed at “banana chimpanzee” memes, or if you just want to rot your brain a little in between serious games — this one’s for you.

title: Drift King Racing Multiplayer
description:
Drift King Racing Multiplayer is a fast-paced drift racing game where precision, style, and speed define your victory. Compete against players around the world in real-time multiplayer battles — slide through sharp corners, leave trails of smoke, and prove your drifting mastery.

Upgrade and customize your cars, from street beasts to pro-tuned machines, then dominate neon-lit tracks in various cities. Earn points for perfect drifts, challenge friends, and climb the leaderboard to become the ultimate Drift King!

title: Knife Smash
description: Do you like throwing stuff? Like knives at random spinning targets? Then this is the ultimate challenge for you! Time your actions, aim carefully and become the knife master! Can you beat all the levels? Very simple one-touch gameplay, but challenging to master! Can you collect all the ridiculous knives?

title: Fruits into Baskets
description:
Just tap on the fruits, watch them fall into place, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything going where it belongs.
Your goal is to clear the whole field and sort all the fruits into the right baskets. No timer, no pressure — just you, the fruits, and that satisfying feeling of order after each level.
Perfect for short breaks when you need to unwind and breathe. Grab your phone, get comfortable, and sort fruits to your heart's content! 🍊🍋🍇

title: Dream Room
description:
Six unique rooms await you: a cozy bedroom, a stylish living room, a magical nursery, a charming kitchen, an atmospheric café, and a sunny balcony. In every room, you decide what goes where — total design freedom!

Over 250 items: beds, sofas, wardrobes, side tables, lamps, plants, rugs, curtains, toys, paintings, windows with different views, and much more. Every item can be repainted in various colors and placed anywhere you like.

Choose wallpapers and floors from dozens of options — from delicate stripes and hearts to starry skies and floral patterns. Place windows with views of the sea, mountains, a city at night, or an enchanted garden.

Earn coins, unlock new rooms, and collect rare items!

title: Imposter 3D
description: Imposter 3D offers an exciting arcade adventure where you can choose to be either a "Killer" or a "Hero." Develop strategies to win as you face various challenges. Play for free online on multiple devices without registration, making it accessible for all gamers. Enjoy a thrilling, dynamic experience!

title: SnakeWar.io
description:
Enter the battlefield in SnakeWarz.IO, a fast-paced multiplayer snake game where survival belongs to the smartest and fastest players. Your mission is simple: grow the longest snake in the arena by eating fruits, defeating rivals, and dominating the leaderboard.

Collect delicious fruits scattered across the map to increase your size and score. The bigger you become, the more dangerous you are. Outsmart enemy snakes, trap them into crashing into your body, and consume the massive fruit drops they leave behind after elimination

title: Team Loyalty
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Team Loyalty, where you command a growing army. Start with one unit and strategically pass through gates to boost your numbers. Overcome challenges and dominate your foes with strength in numbers. Are you ready to build the ultimate team to triumph?

title: Shot a Brainrot!
description: Shot a Brainrot! Is an exciting 3D shooter game in which your task is to defeat your enemies. Dynamic battle scenes, challenging opponents, and several different weapons! Join the meme universe and win!

title: Streamer Simulator: Phone Challenge!
description: «Streamer Simulator: Phone Challenge!» – a thrilling arcade experience! Perform kick-flips, spin your phone 360°, and chain insane combos to wow your audience. Follow the live chat and see your fans react in real-time! Rack up likes to unlock new phones, from vintage bricks to the latest foldables. Master your reflexes, agility, and rhythm. Battle your friends and claim the crown as the ultimate hype master!

title: Agrarian Magnate
description:
Agrarian Magnate is a farming business simulator. The farm, processing, and store are all in your hands. Build your business empire!
Complete levels, complete tasks and earn money. Manage your farm, factory and store. Hire salespeople, upgrade your equipment, and take your business to the next level.Buy and earn daily bonuses. Bonuses are given for one round.

title: Draw To Smash!
description: Test your brainpower with the captivating logic game, Draw To Smash! The goal is simple: sketch shapes to eliminate troublesome bad eggs. This engaging free online game mixes creativity and strategy, offering fun on both phones and computers, with evolving challenges as you progress.

title: Kingdom Defense Mega
description:
Kingdom Defense Mega.
Play the classic tower defense game. Build towers! Defend your kingdom! Use magic! Battle powerful enemies and fearsome bosses!
If you're a fan of the strategy genre, then Kingdom Defense is definitely for you.

title: Tiny Sports Empire Idle
description: Tiny Sports Empire Idle is a sports management idle game where you build a growing multi-sport franchise across basketball, hockey, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and baseball. Earn cash, upgrade your training plans, improve your win chance, unlock new sports, recruit players, equip gear, and boost your team power. Matches are simulated automatically, so every upgrade and strategic choice helps your club grow faster. Keep expanding your sports empire with idle income, offline rewards, special events, skills, and season progress as you turn a small hoops team into a full sports dynasty.

title: Water Flow Happy Glass
description:
"Water Flow: Happy Glass" is a captivating puzzle game based on the laws of physics. Each level is a new riddle where you need to show wit and imagination.

Game Features:
 Draw to Win: Your main power is the pencil. Draw any shapes to direct the water.
 5 Unique Worlds: Complete levels in various themes — from a classic lab to fiery lava and magical realms.
 Challenging Obstacles: Encounter teleports, ice blocks, bouncy platforms, and much more on your journey.
 Star System: Use minimal ink to achieve the maximum 3-star rating.
 Daily Challenges: New levels every day for the most dedicated players!

title: One Man Army: Battle Game
description: One Man Army: A casual single player Battle Game that will test your warrior skills and battle reflexes. With challenging levels and intense battles, you must use your tactical skills to survive and defend against arrows, canon, and even dragon flames.

title: BitBanda
description:
BitBanda is your music studio in your pocket! No instrument skills needed: just tap the sound cards, and cheerful musicians take the stage and start playing together. All the sounds are pre-matched in rhythm and key, so playing badly is impossible. From the very first tap, you create a real track!

Feel like a true DJ: control the volume of each musician, trigger solos, tweak effects (filter, echo, reverb), build your track from scenes, and arrange your mix. Hunt for secret sound combinations — they unlock bonuses and turn the stage into a real party!

title: Besties on Wednesday
description: A young bestie goes to school to learn magic and make new friends. She has her own special style. The girl prefers black colors in clothes and a gothic look. Her roommate likes bright colors in her clothes. It will not be easy for new acquaintances to find a common language. However, this bright girl is not as simple as it seems at first glance. She has her secrets. Try to choose for each student an image that suits her perfectly. And one day these besties will be BFF.

title: Brain Line Connect
description:
Brain Line Connect is a simple-but-challenging brain puzzle where you draw one continuous line to connect all dots on the screen. 
It looks easy at first, but each level is designed to make you think ahead especially when obstacle lines block your path. 
Play anytime with no time pressure, enjoy clean visuals, and solve your way through a huge collection of levels made to train focus and logic.

title: Farm: Nubik Vs Zombies
description:
Nubik has to get out! To do this, upgrade the base, upgrade him and his weapons. Use the mercenaries to help you. Find a portal that will get you out of here.
Meditative gameplay.

title: Obby: Save the Brainrots Online
description:
Obby: Save the Brainrots Online is a dynamic reaction arcade game where a huge wave is already on its way, and you only have seconds to make it!
Grab the brainrots, take them away from the advancing elements and deliver them to a safe zone. The faster you act, the more likely you are to find and save the rarest meme characters.
Boost your speed to be able to carry the rescued out of the affected area before the water covers everything around.
Look for Brainrots of varying rarity, from common to legendary. Replenish your collection, unlock new bonuses and feel your progress growing.
And most importantly, the game has online multiplayer: come in with your friends, rescue brainrots with a team, or compete to see who brings the most valuable finds before the wave arrives.
Are you ready to test your reaction and speed? Run, grab and save — the tsunami is not waiting!

title: Cool Tuning - Paint the Car
description:
"Cool Tuning: Paint the Car" is an exciting game for all fans of auto tuning and creativity! Our game resembles such hits as "Car Mechanic Simulator" and "Need for Speed", but offers a unique experience of creating and selling unique cars. Perfect for those who love customization and creativity.

Game features include: buying cars, spray painting, gluing films and stickers, and selling your masterpieces at auction. You can discover new colors, films and stickers in the store for even more variety.

title: Slither Snake 2048
description:
Players begin their journey as small snakes and eat colorful dots to grow.

However, the bigger you get, the more challenges you face.
You will have to avoid colliding with other snakes while you try to eat them. Your strategy and snake control will be key factors in your survival. Be careful, because if your head touches another snake, you will explode and the game will end.

But don't worry, you can always start over and try to beat your previous record. Slither Snake 2048 is a game that tests your skills, reactions and strategic thinking. Are you ready to become the biggest snake? Try it now!

title: Mahjong Chef
description: A tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong Solitaire. Tap two free tiles of the same type to clear them from the board. Complete each stage by removing all tiles.

title: EdgeFire 2
description:
EdgeFire 2 is a large—scale and multifaceted game universe offering a deep reinterpretation of the classic formulas of the genre.

If you are familiar with the unique atmosphere of the iconic Counter-Strike 1.6, have you followed the constant evolution of the gameplay in CS:GO and its successor CS 2, enjoy the intense and mobile battles in Standoff 2 or immerse yourself in any other of the numerous cult projects of the genre — you will find in this game the magic of the classics, recognizable at first glance.

EdgeFire 2 offers its players a unique and balanced fusion of nostalgic "old school" and bold new ideas, where genuine tactical depth and the need for team synergy are seamlessly combined with an exciting, dynamic and visually spectacular action game.

This combination creates an ideal, carefully calibrated space for infinitely diverse competitive battles, where each match becomes a new story.

title: NSR Street
description:
NSR is an underground street racing game focused on speed, style, and competition.

Race through street circuits, master drifts to build nitro, and rise through the ranks in both single-player and real-time multiplayer races. Explore the open-world hub, drive around, live events, and join races whenever you want.

Drifting is central to how you play NSR. Link smooth drifts to build boost, use nitro at the right time, and take corners carefully to stay in front. Each race rewards your driving skills, not chance.

Earn coins, upgrade your car’s performance, and customize your ride just the way you like. With over 50 cars at launch and lots of ways to personalize like changing body parts, paint, wheels, decals, neon lights, stance, tuning, and more every car is unique.

Race on over 50 famous street circuits, try daily challenges, and test yourself in real-time online races with up to six players. 

Whether you play solo against AI, explore the open world, or compete with others for the top spot, NSR gives you a true street racing experience with no damage penalties only speed, skill, and style.

Get ready to hit the streets.

title: Idle Pop Merge
description:
🎮 MERGE, TAP, CONQUER! 🎮
Welcome to the ultimate cartoon merge adventure! Start with one tiny fighter and build an unstoppable team of 32 unique toon warriors!

🌟 SIMPLE YET ADDICTIVE GAMEPLAY
Merge identical fighters to unlock powerful new characters
Tap to boost attack speed and demolish enemies faster
Strategic placement on your 3x3 battle grid matters!

⚔️ EPIC ARENA BATTLES
Conquer 120 challenging enemies across multiple arenas
Face single, double, and triple arena challenges
Each victory brings you closer to unlocking new fighters!

title: Words Story
description:
A man is framed and imprisoned, but he never gives up and plans to self-salvation. Persevere, day after day, year after year. He need your help to take freedom.

Features:
♥ Simple, easy rules, type the correct word to win a game!
♥ ALL LEVELS are for all users!
♥ NEW word gameplay, good news for word gamer!
♥ No time limit, adjust your pace at any level
♥ 2000 levels without repeat, be a word master in our training!
♥ Kill time-no pressure no push!

title: Mega Ramp Car
description:
Get ready for nonstop action in a high-speed driving game built around giant ramps, massive jumps, and extreme stunts. Take control of powerful cars, launch into the air, perform daring tricks, and push your driving skills to the limit across a variety of exciting levels.

Enjoy realistic physics and sound effects, a wide selection of vehicles, and plenty of missions designed to keep every run fun and challenging. Unlock new cars, complete events, and prove yourself in bigger and more intense races.

title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
description: PopCats: Merge the cats! is a fun online puzzle game where you combine matching cats to form bigger, cuter ones. Enjoy the playful feline stories while aiming for the top of the leaderboard. No downloads or sign-ups needed, perfect for all cat enthusiasts on any device!

title: Bunny Escape
description: In Bunny Escape you play as a bunny that gets trapped in different situations. The game works with just one button. Escape from those situations by running, attacking and jumping across the different worlds.

title: Obby Upgrade Your Speed!
description:
Want to become super fast? ⚡
In Obby Upgrade Your Speed you power up by tapping: tap → earn Run Points → run faster!

🚀 More points = more speed.
🐾 Unlock pets to boost progress and strengthen taps: you get 2 or 3 points per tap depending on your pet.
🏁 Hit crazy speed, beat your records, and feel the rush!

title: CraftMart
description:
Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat!

In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food.

And now all the residents of CubeWorld rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :)

Build new fields for wheat and beets, get a cow and a chicken and expand the shop to the maximum assortment!

Simulate a grocery shop in the world of Minecraft:

- plant turnips and wheat, raise chickens and a cow

- make turnip soup as well as warm bread

- serve your customers

- improve your means of production and your abilities

- hire workers to help you

Show your business skill!

title: Car Collision Master
description: Rev up for Car Collision Master Jagged canyons frame your blue jeep versus orange-black rivals on a looping desert track. Smoke trails and starry arches amp the chaos—customize your rig, battle friends, and dominate leaderboards in this wheel-warping thrill ride. Feel the V8 roar; claim victory in dust and daring!

title: Simulator GT Motorsport
description: Simulator GT Motorsport puts you in the driver’s seat of the ultimate racing experience — where precision, speed, and realism collide. Feel the roar of high-performance GT engines as you master challenging circuits inspired by real-world tracks. Featuring advanced vehicle physics, dynamic weather, and customizable tuning, every race demands skill, strategy, and focus. Whether you’re chasing milliseconds in time trials or battling rivals in championship mode, Simulator GT Motorsport delivers the authentic thrill of motorsport competition.

title: Clash of Tanks
description: Clash of Tanks is real time strategy tank game. Objective is to destroy the opponent base by deploying the tanks. Each tank has its own weakness and strength, selecting the right tanks at appropriate time is best way to win the battle. Good Luck

title: Draw To Goal - Soccer Game
description:
Draw to Goal is a fun and creative soccer puzzle game where your drawing skills decide every match! Instead of kicking the ball directly, you draw lines to guide the soccer ball into the goal. Each level challenges your logic, timing, and creativity as you find the perfect path to score.

In this unique draw-to-goal soccer game, every line matters. Use smart angles, avoid obstacles, and create clever paths to help the ball reach the goal. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Soccer is easy to play but hard to master, making it perfect for both casual players and puzzle lovers.

Enjoy hundreds of handcrafted soccer puzzle levels filled with traps, moving objects, and tricky goal positions. As you progress, the challenges become more complex, pushing you to think outside the box and draw smarter lines. Whether you’re a football fan or a brain-teasing puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers endless fun.

title: Circle Car Crash 3D
description:
Drive fast, crash hard! Race in endless circles and survive epic 3D collisions.

Get ready for the ultimate crash challenge in Circle Car Crash 3D — a high-speed, physics-based racing arena where every turn could be your last!

Race around circular tracks, dodge opponents, and cause spectacular slow-motion collisions. Earn points for near misses, perfect drifts, and insane crashes that send cars flying!

With realistic crash physics, simple controls, and thrilling 3D visuals, this game delivers nonstop fun for fans of car stunt and destruction games.

🚗 Game Features

💥 Realistic crash physics and metal-bending effects

🔄 Endless circular tracks full of obstacles & chaos

⚙️ Upgrade cars for better speed and handling

🔊 Immersive engine sounds and visual effects

Can you survive the loop and become the last car standing? Download Circle Car Crash 3D now and crash your way to victory!

title: Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop
description: Welcome to Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop, an engaging simulation game where players can experience managing their very own supermarket. Enter the captivating world of Hypermarket 3D - Store 3D and strive to become a top-notch store manager. Assist customers, restock shelves, and ensure a lively shopping environment in the dynamic Grocery Store - 3D Cashier gameplay.

title: Tap Gallery
description: Tap Gallery is the ultimate puzzle game where you test your brain and tap away blocks to uncover hidden images. This iq game challenges your logical thinking and provides satisfying puzzle-solving experiences that relieve anxiety. Each tap puzzle is a unique brain teaser designed to engage and entertain, making it one of the most addicting games in the puzzle genre.

title: Tower Tap
description:
Where every tap brings you closer to victory! In this fun and addictive puzzle game, your mission is to clear layers of colorful cubes to reach the treasure chest at the bottom. The fewer taps you use, the bigger the reward!
Each tower is made up of layers filled with cubes of different colors. When you tap a cube, all connected blocks of the same color pop and disappear. But be careful! You'll need to think ahead to plan your moves and clear the tower efficiently. Every tap counts!

title: DoggyDoku
description:
Head-to-head sudoku-style puzzle duel with a cartoon dog theme. You and a rival race to solve logic grids before a five-minute timer runs out.

Each puzzle is a grid divided into colored regions. Your job is to place exactly one dog in every row, every column, and every colored region — while making sure no two dogs touch, not even diagonally. Use deduction, mark impossible tiles with X’s, and spend coins on hints when you’re stuck.

Win more boards than your rival to climb the Pup Ladder, earn coins and rank points, and unlock cosmetics, daily tasks, season pass rewards, and more. Matches feel online, but everything runs locally — there’s no real backend.

title: Catch the Bear
description:
Catch the Bear: A Cozy Puzzle Adventure 🐻🧩

A bright, feel-good puzzle game that mixes colorful bears, smart block-sliding mechanics, and satisfying logic challenges. Designed to be both relaxing and mentally engaging.

Gameplay
Slide blocks and catch bears into matching colors. Simple at first, but increasingly tricky as new obstacles, routes, and surprises appear. Each level tests your logic, planning, and strategy.

Key Features
Easy to learn, challenging to master
Adorable bear characters and cozy visuals
Time limits for extra challenge
Gradually increasing difficulty
Ideal for fans of match, logic, and block puzzles

How to Play
Slide blocks freely
Match bears to the correct colors
Avoid blockers and plan smart routes
Solve each level at your own pace

Why You’ll Love It
Catch the Bear stands out with its unique mix of match, logic, and block puzzles. Every level sharpens your thinking while staying fun and calming—great for all ages, casual players, and puzzle lovers alike.

title: Shawarma Kiosk Anomaly Game
description:
Welcome to the scariest fast-food job in the city.

Get ready to click your way to ultimate slime glory in Slime Clicker, the most relaxing and fun idle clicker on the web! ✨

description: Hard Working Man is an offline farming and survival simulator. Start with nothing, rebuild your farm, gather resources, and craft tools to create your dream homestead. Harvest berries and mushrooms, grow vegetables and fruit trees, go fishing, cook food, and expand your farm. Sell crops at the bazaar, buy seeds and tools, and build a workshop, forge, and even your own car from junk. Enjoy realistic survival mechanics, crafting, building, and resource management. description:
CrownGate is an addictive runner game that tests both your reflexes and strategy. Your stickmen run automatically — your job is to guide them through the right gates, grow your crowd, and win the big battle waiting at the end of the road.


Features

title: Emoji Sort
description: Emoji Sort is a pattern recognition puzzle game where players must fill in empty cells with the correct emojis. Each puzzle presents a grid with missing emojis that follow specific patterns - such as categories, sequences, or associations. Players analyze the existing emojis to identify the pattern (animals, food chains, transportation types, etc.) and select the appropriate emojis to complete the grid. The game features 80 increasingly challenging levels with various pattern types, and includes a hint system to help when players get stuck. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who enjoy discovering logical connections between visual elements!

description: SMod: Sandbox in Backrooms is a mod-style game based on the sandbox and the Backrooms. It is a real-time simulator with enemies spawning and levels to complete. In this game, you can spawn enemies using a portal gun, complete quests, and search for weapons.

title: Screw Jam Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Screw Jam Puzzle, where the challenge of unscrewing puzzles and sorting colorful screws, pins, and nuts takes center stage! Dive into an immersive world of wood and bolts, where every unscrew brings you closer to solving the ultimate screw pin jam puzzle. With each twist, you'll match colors and sort nuts and bolts to clear your path through tricky levels.

Tackle hundreds of unique levels designed to test your logic and strategy. As you unscrew, sort, and solve puzzles, you’ll face new and exciting screw pin jam challenges. Unlock levels, refine your skills, and enjoy the thrill of unscrewing complex puzzles while earning rewards along the way. Every level brings a fresh twist on the classic nuts and bolts puzzle adventure.Prepare for a jam-packed puzzle experience, where you’ll navigate wood structures, solve unscrew puzzles, and discover new mechanics with every update. Whether you're into sorting colors or untangling nuts and bolts, Screw Jam offers a puzzle experience that will keep you hooked.

title: Arklet
description:
Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures.

In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets.

🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block
Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable.

🐾 Consider Every Detail:
Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor.
Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP)
Special Requests: Some dream of a room with a view of the lighthouse, while others need to be close to food supplies.

🌿 Relaxing Experience and Aesthetics
The game features a detailed style that combines sharp geometric shapes with soft textures. You can expect:

A Meditative Pace: There are no stress-inducing timers. You can rearrange room blocks endlessly until you find the perfect combination.
Visual Delight: Watch fun animations - from a trembling, frightened elephant to a happy mouse munching on cheese.
Progressive Growth: Gradually build up your zoo, unlocking new locations ranging from sunny piers to icy icebergs. (WIP)

🧠 Who is this game for?
I made Arklet for fans of organization games and spatial puzzles. It is a project for those who want to unwind after a long day and immerse themselves in a world where everything can be put in its place, and the only reward that matters is the happy smile of a square animal.

Create a perfect sanctuary where even the most diverse animals can live in peace and harmony!

description:

Magic Cat Academy is a fun and adorable adventure game where you play as Momo the magic cat, a brave little student with big powers! One spooky night, silly ghosts sneak into her school and steal the magic book. Now it’s up to Momo to save the day!

To help Momo, players draw simple shapes on the screen to cast magic spells and pop the ghosts away. Each level takes you to a new part of the school, like the classroom, cafeteria, and even the rooftop. The ghosts get quicker and trickier, but with fast hands and sharp eyes, you can beat them all!

With cute characters, colorful animations, and easy touch controls, Magic Cat Academy is a safe, exciting, and kid-friendly game that’s perfect for players of all ages.

Help the lovely Momo Magic Cat cast out mischievous spirits by swiping in the shape of the symbols above the ghosts’ heads. And you’d better pounce fast—the ghost that stole the Arcane Magic spellbook is getting away! The school and all arcane magic are depended on your actions.

PURR-ify Ghost and Ghouls with your Arcane Magic. Swipe your magic wand to cast magic and save the Halloween.

II, Russian:

Magic Cat Academy — это весёлая и очаровательная приключенческая игра, в которой вы играете за Момо, волшебную кошечку, отважную маленькую ученицу с огромными способностями! Однажды жуткой ночью глупые призраки пробираются в её школу и крадут волшебную книгу. Теперь Момо предстоит спасти положение!

Чтобы помочь Момо, игроки рисуют на экране простые фигуры, чтобы колдовать и прогонять призраков. Каждый уровень переносит вас в новую часть школы, например, в класс, столовую и даже на крышу. Призраки становятся всё быстрее и хитрее, но с быстрыми руками и острым зрением вы сможете победить их всех!

С милыми персонажами, красочной анимацией и простым сенсорным управлением Magic Cat Academy — безопасная, увлекательная и дружелюбная для детей игра, идеально подходящая для игроков всех возрастов.

Помогите очаровательной волшебной кошечке Момо изгнать злых духов, проводя по символам над головами призраков. И поторопитесь — призрак, укравший книгу заклинаний «Тайная магия», убегает! Школа и вся тайная магия зависят от ваших действий.

Замурлыкайте призраков и упырей своей тайной магией. Взмахните волшебной палочкой, чтобы наложить магию и спасти Хэллоуин.

title: Far Orion: New worlds
description:
The year is 2121. Technology has advanced far beyond the bounds of our wildest fantasies, but great progress demands great sacrifice... 
Explore other worlds in the search for treasure and limitless power! 
Command a team of brave heroes and lead your world to victory!  
Game features: 
- several dozen unique heroes and battle cards 
- dozens of missions on every world 
- no irritating ads 
- PvP arena 
- tower mode 
- clans and clan wars
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an action strategy game where you complete levels (missions) and fight enemies.

Q: Does the game have a storyline?
A: Yes, there is a story. It's a sci-fi setting in the year 2121 with advanced technology, but something went wrong, and the heroes want to save the world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? What can hook players?
A: There are many different heroes with an upgrade system, a large number of missions, a PvP arena, a leaderboard, and clan wars. You can also upgrade attack cards.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A huge variety of heroes, many different and interesting abilities for these heroes, an engaging story, clear objectives, and simple in-game mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: There are bosses throughout the storyline, and they differ in design, attack types, and HP amount.

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should you do to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to play well to earn enough in-game currency. The game is easy to play.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main story? For example, 'match-three' puzzles within the strategy game.
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on upgrading heroes, upgrading cards, and buying hero cards to unlock them.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and what does it affect? Does spending money speed up game progress?
A: Yes, microtransactions will speed up game progress, as you can buy in-game currency with real money and spend that currency on upgrades and cards.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize a hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc.?
A: You can only upgrade the heroes' levels and abilities, which also changes their appearance.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you get on them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are various leaderboards depending on the different game modes, as well as a clan leaderboard. You need to play and gain levels.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages the player to return?
A: Yes, logging into the game every day provides various bonuses: cards, chests, and in-game currency.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: The music is good and complements the game, but it is not essential for completing the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Achievements are awarded for daily logins, reaching a certain level in a specific mode, and completing certain objectives, such as collecting 6 heroes in total. Rewards include chests, in-game currency, and cards.

title: Hook Arena 3D

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description:
Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck.

But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks! The game sends you on a journey to a magical world and tells the story of an adventure across an enchanted land. Forests, mountains, seas and snowy peaks: get ready for a wild ride in Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire!

What makes our solitaire special:
Players can use different boosters on levels to give the game a special twist. Put any card from the board on a Joker. The Combo booster helps you get a five-card combo at the very start of a level, and Eye shows you what card is hiding at the top of the deck.
Start a new level and use the Sword to switch out a card from the deck with one you need. The Bow lets you remove any card from the board, the Fan shuffles cards and brings what you need to the top, and the Hammer flips over a portion of the hidden cards!

Features
♣️️ Hundreds of levels with new ones added all the time!
♦️ Different locations with fun original game mechanics!

Snake Tangle offers an engaging and challenging gameplay experience that will captivate puzzle enthusiasts and snake game lovers alike. So, get ready to twist, turn, and strategize your way through a tangled maze in this thrilling adventure!

Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

description:
PROJECT: SURVIVAL

Welcome to Project: Survival — a fast-paced zombie survival shooter where every shot, every second, and every decision counts.

Drop into Ghost Map City, where chaos echoes through empty streets, or brave the twisted halls of Zombie Hospital, where every corner hides something waiting to strike. From crawlers that lurk beneath wreckage to spitters that melt through your cover, every encounter pushes your instincts and aim to the limit. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn rewards to expand your loadout, unlock brutal new weapons, and forge the arsenal that keeps you alive when the horde closes in.

Your progress is your power — and your only lifeline. Collect ammo and medkits from fallen enemies to stay in the fight. Each mission brings a new test of endurance and precision, taking you one step closer to becoming the ultimate survivor.

Die? Maybe.
Give up? Never.
Use rewarded revives to get back up, skip impossible missions, or unlock exclusive weapons to turn the tide. There’s always another chance — if you’re bold enough to take it.

Two maps. Endless zombies. No excuses.
This is your fight, your survival.

Survive the outbreak. Complete deadly missions. Build the ultimate arsenal.
Welcome to Project: Survival.

title: Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot
description:
Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot is a fast, funny, and totally unhinged snake game inspired by classic slither gameplay and viral Italian brainrot memes.

Control your snake and slither across a chaotic arena filled with absurd Italian brainrot characters, strange creatures, and ridiculous surprises. Eat orbs, grow longer, and avoid crashing into other snakes while the screen explodes with nonsense, memes, and pure chaos.

Featuring iconic brainrot-style characters, exaggerated animations, and colorful Italian-themed visuals, this game turns simple snake mechanics into a wild meme-filled experience. The bigger you grow, the harder it gets—one wrong move and it’s game over.

description: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle is a vibrant multiplayer party shooter that blends competition, speed, and pure joy. The core philosophy centers on "fast-paced chaotic fun," combining adorable mini-characters with intense firefights. Players face off in colorful miniature arenas, using the terrain and randomized weapon drops to outsmart opponents. What makes it stand out is its minimalist controls and high-energy gameplay, delivering an adrenaline-pumping shooting experience in bite-sized sessions, whether playing solo or against friends.
