title: Noob Slingshot: Monsters
description:
Meet Noob, a clumsy hero you load straight into a slingshot. Pull back the band, follow the dotted aiming line, and launch him at the block towers where cartoon monsters hide.

Every level is a small physics puzzle built from glass, wood, stone, and TNT. Glass shatters at a touch, wood needs a solid hit, and stone takes two hits before it falls. Each broken block scores points, so a clean shot and a big collapse both pay off, and your shots are limited.

TNT crates start chain reactions that can fold half a tower in one hit, but blow them at the wrong moment and the last monster stays safe behind cover. Bonus cards hidden in the levels give extra shots when you need another try, turning each stage into a mix of arcade action and light puzzle planning.

Clear levels to earn coins, then spend them back in the main menu to build and grow Noob's house, a steady goal between the tower-smashing stages.

Features:
- Physics slingshot arcade with simple one-finger aiming
- Dotted trajectory preview for planning every shot
- Breakable glass, wood, and stone blocks with different durability
- TNT crates for chain reactions and huge collapses
- Points for broken blocks and efficient shots
- Bonus cards that grant extra shots
- 50 levels with a changing time of day
- Full offline play after install
- Build a house in the main menu with coins you earn

Take aim, manage your shots, and show the monsters what a noob can really do.

title: Animal Merge
description:
Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals.
Gameplay Instructions:
Launching the Animal Bubbles:
Tap on an animal bubble to select it.
Drag the bubble backward to aim.
Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction.
Merging Animal Bubbles:
When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version.
Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress.
Achieving the Objective:
Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal.
Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal.
Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective.
Winning the Level:
The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

A: There are rewards granted for every 5 minutes of play that refresh when you restart the game. these consist of boosts like the magnet, double jump, and movement speed.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without it make the game difficult?
A: It is not required, but the sound design is high quality and enhances the experience.

title: Grand Truck Simulator
description:
Get behind the wheel of powerful trucks in this realistic grand truck simulator! Your mission is simple yet challenging — drive to the location of a broken-down car, load it onto your flatbed trailer, and transport it safely to the repair shop. Navigate busy roads, sharp turns, and unexpected obstacles on your route. Precision matters — secure the vehicle properly before hitting the highway!

Unlock and choose from a variety of trucks, each with unique handling and performance. Complete delivery jobs, earn rewards, and upgrade your fleet to become the ultimate roadside hero.

Feel the thrill of heavy vehicle transport, test your driving skills, and prove you’re the best recovery truck driver in town! Ready to tow, haul, and deliver? Start the engine and roll out!

title: Winged Wheels 2
description:
Ready to challenge your brain and reflexes like never before?

In this fast-paced action game, you'll control a car and a spaceship simultaneously. While dodging enemies and obstacles with one vehicle, you’ll be collecting coins and power-ups with the other – all in real time!

Multitask like a pro: Master the art of controlling two vehicles at once

Unlock new cars and spaceships with unique visuals

Upgrade your abilities after each run for better performance

Face random events and power-ups that shake up the gameplay

Climb the global leaderboard and prove your skills

This game is designed to test your concentration, dexterity, and multitasking to the absolute limit. Whether you're dodging missiles or grabbing that last coin, every second counts.

Can you handle the chaos?

title: Zombie Wave Arena
description: Zombie Wave Arena is a fast top-down arcade survival shooter. Blast endless zombie hordes, earn coins, and upgrade six guns from pistol to legendary Ray Gun. Face nine unique zombie mutations, ten escalating bosses, and five rotating arenas. Grab pickups, hurl grenades, and survive  on desktop or one thumb mobile controls.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: Enter the rugged world of the Wild West in *Cowboys Duel*, where sharp aim and quick reflexes are crucial. Compete in solo missions or face off against friends in thrilling duels. Customize your character, enjoy various game modes, and hone your skills to become the top cowboy.

title: Cube shooter
description:
Cube shooter - 3D battle shooter game! 
Loot weapons, eliminate enemies. 
Be the last player standing in fast-paced PvP matches!

title: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon
description: Step into the role of a manager for a small Hotel. Open and upgrade rooms, restaurants, leisure areas, and various cafes. Embellish the exterior and interior of your Hotel to attract more visitors! Hire staff to service the rooms and open parking lots. Invest your profits back into your business and multiply your earnings! The core genre is Idle Tycoon. You'll need to continuously develop your business - a small Hotel - over an extended period. Open all rooms and leisure facilities (halls, cafes, parks) to increase your profits from each visitor. You can speed up service time by tapping on the progress bar located above each cashier's desk and at the reception. Additionally, you can watch short videos to receive temporary and instant bonuses to your earnings!

title: Attack super hole
description: Play as a hole on the ground and consume as many soldiers as you can before the time runs out to battle the increasingly more dangerous monsters!

title: Tile Stack
description:
This game is perfect for players who enjoy puzzle and strategy games. Its simple mechanics and increasing difficulty levels make it both accessible and addictive.
You will not realize how time passes by playing fun levels by putting tiles together

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory

title: Dungeon Descent
description: Loot. Survive. Descend deeper. A fast voxel dungeon crawler with deadly rooms, powerful gear, and bosses waiting below.

title: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines
description: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines is a logic game where you connect matching colored elements and draw paths across the board, planning every move. The levels gradually become harder: more colors appear, there’s less free space, and more situations where it’s easy to make a mistake. The game is great for relaxing while still giving your brain a workout — short levels, clear rules, and a real challenge closer to the final stages.

title: Stalker 2033: The Path of the Survivor
description: Stalker 2033: The Path of the Survivor – A 3D action shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Battle the undead, explore vast locations, uncover dark secrets, and fight to survive in a mysterious, deadly new reality.

title: Mirrors and Rays
description:
Turn the mirrors, light up the whole field and relax in the peaceful world of lasers.

Reboot your mind — one perfect ray of light at a time! This is your digital zen garden, where every solved puzzle is a step towards inner peace.

title: Craftsman Land
description:
Craftsman Land – build your own farm and help the town recover!

Craftsman Land is a farming and crafting game where your goal is to rebuild the inherited land, expand your farm, and support the local community.

After a devastating flood, the town is in ruins. As the heir to the land, it’s up to you to restore your farm, help the townsfolk, and bring life back to the surrounding villages. Grow crops like corn and onions, go fishing, and construct new buildings such as a house, chicken coop, and cowshed. Inside your home, you can decorate and design the interior to your liking.

Take care of your animals – feed chickens and cows, collect fresh eggs and milk, and use them for crafting or trading. Complete quests for local people, trade with merchants, and produce a wide variety of items thanks to the crafting system. Improve your skills, specialize in your favorite activities, and become a true master craftsman.

The world of Craftsman Land is constantly growing with new places, tasks, and adventures waiting to be discovered

title: Foot Bomb
description:
Football. Why stop at football?
Why not use a ticking bomb instead of a ball?
Foot bomb is a bomb kicking soccer game. Your goal is simple, kick the bomb and race to the goal post before it explodes.

title: Bucket Ball
description: Welcome to the Bucket Ball Game! 🎉 Tap the gate to open it and start the fun. Move obstacles out of the way or use them cleverly to guide the ball into the bucket. You'll get different items to help you complete each level. Remember, as you go higher, the game gets tougher, so think before you move! Each time you finish a level, you earn 1 point and move on to a more challenging one. How many levels can you play? Press on and challenge yourself! Just click your mouse to play. Enjoy the game! 🎮

title: Unstack Tower
description: Unstack Tower is an addictive puzzle game available on Android that challenges players to dismantle a tower of colored cubes in a specific sequence. This game combines the mechanics of a traditional board game with modern gameplay, providing hours of fun. Players must carefully unstack the cubes without causing the tower to collapse, which requires strategy and quick reflexes. The game features various materials, including glass and wood, adding an extra layer of complexity to each level.

title: Shikaku Puzzle
description:
Shikaku is a logic puzzle with simple rules and challenging solutions.

The rules are simple. You have to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle.

title: 3D Pool Mania
description: Pool Mania is an exciting single-player billiards game with smooth controls, realistic physics, and engaging gameplay. Test your skills across various challenges, master trick shots, and enjoy a relaxing yet competitive experience with immersive visuals and customizable options.

title: Ragdoll Football
description:
Ragdoll Football is wild arcade soccer with ZERO gravity! Your goofy yet lovable ragdoll player floats, tumbles and flies across the arena to smash the ball into the opponent's goal.

Every match lasts just 60 seconds and bursts with silly physics, flashy special strikes and surprise modifiers — giant ball, bouncy ball, huge goals, currents and more. No boring rounds, ever!

Win cups in Tournament mode, climb the ranked ladder in 1v1 Duels, unlock dozens of characters, balls and arenas, complete daily quests and storm the leaderboards. Easy controls, instant fun and endless replayable chaos — drop in for a minute and stay for hours.

title: Shape Jam
description:
Get ready to jam with shapes in this playful physics puzzle game!
In Shape Jam, your goal is simple: collect 3 matching shapes to clear the board. 
But every move counts  the pick zone is limited, the shapes tumble with physics, and the order you choose decides your success.

title: Chainsaw 3D
description: Chainsaw 3D is an exciting online arcade game where you cut logs using a chainsaw. Available for free on multiple platforms, this engaging woodcutting challenge blends skill and puzzle elements, requiring concentration to succeed at each new level. Aim to become the top woodcutter!

title: Orbit Shift
description:
You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last?

Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything.

Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second.

Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second.

Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no download required, instant play on desktop and mobile.

Orbit Shift is an original game handcrafted by cfc, a human game developer.

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
Mahjong with history. Puzzle and adventure. Play and win! Connect tiles and collect prizes.

The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong Magic Islands features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format. Collecting components for magic spells adds a fun layer to the gameplay, and meeting cute magical creatures to help out gives the varied levels of the game more significant depth.

* The mysterious worlds of the Magic Islands await discovery.
* Journey through the Mahjong Magic Islands solving fun brain teasers.
* Meet mysterious and mythical creatures, and help them on their way!
* Hunt down magic ingredients and make magic spells.
* Search and connect tiles.
* Mahjong Solitaire

title: Groomy Island
description:
Groomy Island - is a brand new realistic horror-survival game in 3D Island that Your sole objective is Survive and collect all the 10 Grimace Shake.
- There are many enjoyable places to explore on a large island.
- Make sure to keep an eye on a MiniMap to navigate around.

Core: A compelling first-person survival horror experience centered on high-stakes stealth and object retrieval.
Loop: Players engage in a tense evasion-and-search mechanic, navigating environments to find hidden collectibles while actively avoiding an immediate predatory threat.
Start: Instant player engagement is ensured through an immediate and intuitive 'hook,' providing compelling interest from the very first minute of gameplay.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a highly immersive, Realistic visual design to enhance environmental dread and player connection to the experience.
Key Feature: A unique, light-touch horror approach that distinguishes it from traditional genre titles, offering a novel blend of tension and accessibility for a broader audience.

title: Cars Challenge
description:
Welcome to the game about cars, in which you can play in different modes compete with bots, perform tasks and tuning your new cars!

Modes in the game:

- Arena:
Clash with other cars and survive in the arena!

- Spinning Wheel:
The obstacle wheel is spinning, your task is to get to the finish line faster than other cars and not fall into the abyss!


- Hexagons:
Hexagons fall down as soon as a car passes over them.
Show your dexterity in steering and jumping to stay last in the arena and win.

- Insane Track:
On the crazy track you will have to go through a bunch of challenges and obstacles to get to the end of the crazy track faster than the other cars and win!

And much more!

title: Road Crosser
description: Road Crosser is a high-quality 3D HTML5 game built with Three.js, featuring endless city-crossing game play like Crossy Road — but with a modern twist. Players must navigate through busy roads, forests, and city lanes while dodging vehicles and obstacles. With realistic lighting, animated environments, touch and keyboard support, and clean responsive design, this game delivers an immersive experience across desktop and mobile browsers.

title: Rotate Cups
description:
This is a rotation physics puzzle game where you control the angle of cups to try to get the balls to roll into specific cups.
Rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise as needed to turn the clear cups into ramps guiding the ball down the level.
Place at least one ball in each of the blue cups.
In this game you have to get all the balls into the blue cups lower down the screen.
Larger blue cups can hold more than one ball in them.
If there are multiple smaller blue cups you must get a ball into each of them.
Levels are not timed & you can both rotate as many times as you like & pause as many times as you like.

You can skip intermediary cups. On most levels you typically want to use all the cups on the way down, but if you are struggling to do so you can bump a ball off the outside of a cup or skip a cup entirely & it won’t harm you in the least provided your balls eventually get into the blue cups.
Some levels have a long reach you have to make the ball roll. On those levels sometimes a somewhat rapid cup spin toward the destination is enough, but in some cases you have to do that rapid spin as the starting point & then slightly spin back quickly right as the ball is leaving to give the ball a bit more lift.

title: Watermelon: Falling Animals
description:
Merge cute animals and create new, bigger, and rarer ones! 🐾
The more animals you combine, the higher your score and the faster you climb the leaderboard.

Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot in the rankings. Plan your strategy, use powerful boosts and combos to earn even more points and outperform your rivals.

Unlock new animals, set records, and prove that you are the true master of evolution!

Download the game now and start an exciting adventure in the world of animals!
Become the best and claim the title of the ultimate Animal Master! 🏆

title: Go Up
description:
Welcome to Go Up, the exciting free mobile game that challenges you to protect the balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this amazing balloon game that'll keep you on your toes and your eyes glued to the screen.

Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You need to push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon going up. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of all kinds of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right?

But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more difficult to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you will find it difficult to protect the balloon.

title: Shadow Stick Ninja
description:
Shadowstick Ninja is a physics puzzle game with a dark, minimalist style. In this game, precision is more important than speed.

You play as a silent shadow ninja with only a few arrows. In each level, enemy ninjas hide behind obstacles and structures, waiting for you to take them out. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy. 

The way you do it is up to you!

Pull back, aim, and release to shoot arrows with the right trajectory. Pick from different arrow types and solve each level your own way:

- Regular arrows for clean, direct hits
- Bomb arrows to cause explosive area damage and break through obstacles
- Balloon arrows that attach to enemies and lift them into the air, exposing them for easier shots

There isn’t just one right answer. You can play smart and efficient, or try out new ideas and experiment as much as you want.

Lift an enemy into the air with balloons. Use lots of bombs just to see what happens. Try odd angles, mix up different moves, or come up with wild solutions.

Every arrow counts. If you run out of ammo, you’ll need to rethink your strategy and give it another shot.

Plan your moves, try bold ideas, and enjoy every physics-based takedown.

title: Get Off My Farm!
description:
Protect your farm from relentless waves of mutant pests in this action-packed defense shooter!
Your quiet farmland is swarmed by strange and dangerous creatures, and only your guns and quick reflexes can keep them away from your crops. Blast through incoming enemies and pick up temporary power-ups along the way — rapid-fire shots, explosive ammo, health refills, or extra energy for your electric fence.

Survive enough waves and the stage ends, giving you a choice of random upgrades: unlock new weapons, call in a crop duster airstrike, slow down enemy hordes, attract power-ups with a magnet, and more. As you advance, new heroes with unique styles and abilities become available.

Every run feels fresh thanks to randomized upgrades and ever-growing chaos. Can you hold the line and prove yourself as the ultimate defender of the farm?

title: Obby Pizza Delivery
description: Become a delivery boy in the maze and deliver pizzas to the locals. Rent a scooter to move faster. Pick a bigger bag so you can take more orders at a time and deliver even more pizzas. Complete orders, increase your reputation and open new zones with residents!

title: Ants Io
description: Ants Io is a fast-paced and highly competitive multiplayer arena (.io) game. In this microscopic world, you embody a hungry ant striving to grow your colony by collecting food scattered across the map. The core philosophy is "Survive and Expand"—you must evade predators larger than yourself while seeking opportunities to outmaneuver and eliminate smaller rivals. What sets it apart is the fluid colony-following mechanics and dynamic gameplay where every bite brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Ant King.

title: Tank Craft 2
description: Tank Craft 2 (also known as TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War) is an exciting 2D action tank battle game with a unique crafting twist. Players build and customize their own tanks by assembling thousands of parts combinations, then engage in fast-paced side-scrolling combat to repel an infernal invasion from hellish bosses emerging from a raging volcano. The core idea revolves around experimentation: craft powerful, personalized war machines through upgrades and part tweaks, then battle waves of corrupted enemy tanks and towering demonic bosses in dynamic arenas filled with lava, rocks, and explosive action. Its standout features include endless build creativity, satisfying progression through levels, cartoonish yet intense visuals with cute tank characters, and the thrill of engineering your way to victory against apocalyptic threats.

title: Strategy of war: Tanks and helicopters
description: War Strategy: Tanks and Helicopters is an engaging online strategy game where you lead forces to seize enemy strongholds. Play seamlessly on various devices without downloading. Enjoy tactical combat as you use tanks and helicopters to succeed in this skill-testing military challenge—no registration needed.

title: Soccer Strike
description: Experience casual soccer at its finest with intuitive pull-back and strike controls. Form your striking lineup, aim for the goal, and enjoy Soccer Strike—the perfect mix of fun and competitive play in an instant game tribute to the world's favorite sport.

title: Syntagma
description:
A puzzle adventure with platformer elements.

A suddenly arrived package contains a mysterious artifact, similar to a compass, and an ancient map pointing the way to five mysterious locations with abandoned temples.

To activate the compass and reveal the secrets of the temples, the hero must find unique crystals, symbolizing the five elements, scattered around the world.

To obtain a crystal, you can solve the puzzle only by jumping on active platforms. The correct sequence of stepping on the platforms and collecting all the keys on them opens the vault and grants access to the crystal. There are restrictions on moving across the platforms.

Moving backward and diagonally is prohibited.

Movement is only allowed forward, left, and right.

The start of movement activates defense mechanisms and obstacles that cause damage.

There are 2 difficulty levels, which can be changed in the main menu settings. After completing Level 0, the game will automatically suggest trying Level 1.

title: Fake Ninjas
description: There are fake ninjas in town who have caused dishonour to your master. You have to find them all and redeem yourself to the master

title: CLUTTER MASTER
description:
Clutter Master is a casual cozy game where you organize a messy room by placing each item where it belongs.
A secret awaits at the end of the game...

title: Sorcerers Refuge
description:
You wake up in a strange living room. There are no doors. Only whispers behind the wall and darkness in the eyes. Welcome to the Sorcerer’s Hideout, a dark adventure with elements of magic, riddles, and quests.
In this confusing and dangerous place, you will find:
What Awaits You
Mysterious corridors, hidden rooms, and sudden traps
The magic of ice, fire, transformation, and true vision
Mysterious creatures, demons, and a strange Buffoon with his own motives
Intense dialogues, unexpected outcomes, and choices that affect the story
Battles, puzzles, and ancient Contracts made with powerful forces
You are trapped by a Sorcerer who has subjugated four demons. Will you be able to escape, or will you become another soul in his collection?

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a horror game where you need to solve a mystery and fight for your life.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Yes, it's very intricate, interesting, and complex.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The storyline, atmosphere, spells, and interesting mechanics.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: There are bosses with increased difficulty and behavior that depends on the player's actions.

Q: Are there any mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: Yes, there are. Collecting special seals.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: Collecting spells related to the storyline.

Economy & Customization

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Complex mechanics and traps, a well-developed storyline.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is necessary to play with sound.

Q: Is there a system of achievements (achievements)? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, they are obtained as quests and tasks are completed.

title: Bounce TD
description:
Welcome to Bounce TD — a unique fusion of classic Tower Defense strategy and addictive physics-based puzzles!

Are you ready to test your precision and tactical thinking? In this game, your mission is to protect your base from endless waves of enemies. But there’s a twist: your towers only activate when hit by a special energy ball. Calculate the trajectory, use the ricochet, and create deadly chain reactions!

title: Food Sort 3D
description:
In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers,
sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food

title: Tangram Puzzle 2
description: Tangram Puzzle 2 is a classic tangram-style logic puzzle game in which players use a fixed set of colorful geometric pieces (tans) to exactly recreate a given target shape. The core idea revolves around spatial reasoning, rotation, and precise placement of pieces without overlaps or gaps. Its unique appeal lies in the vibrant, multi-colored pieces and targets (unlike traditional monochrome silhouettes), a progressive leveling system with star ratings based on efficiency (fewer moves earn more stars), and UI elements like move counters or hints that add strategic depth.

title: Bus Color Jam
description:
Bus Color Jam – Fun Puzzle Adventure with Colorful Challenges!

Get ready for Bus Jam, the ultimate bus game that’s all about matching passengers to their buses in this relaxing yet brain-teasing bus mania adventure. It's up to you to solve fun, colorful puzzles and clear the way to send each passenger on their dream vacation!

In this exciting puzzle game, you'll encounter progressively challenging levels as you advance. Your goal? Strategically match passengers with their correctly colored buses!

title: Stack the Blocks
description: Dive into the captivating world of Stack the Blocks, a strategic online puzzle game on a 10x10 grid. Challenge your logic by placing blocks to clear lines and earn points. Accessible yet complex, it guarantees addictive entertainment on both mobile and desktop platforms.

title: Only Up Parkour 2
description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Stickman in space
description: Join Stickman in Space for a thrilling journey as a lost astronaut on the moon. Overcome space obstacles and discover your route back to Earth. Enjoy free gameplay on mobile and desktop, tackling aliens, evading meteorites, and solving puzzles along the way for an exciting escape.

title: Hard Puzzle
description: A fascinating puzzle for everyone. A huge number of different levels will not let you get bored. Come every day and train your brain.

title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
description:
Dig through the sand and guide flowing elements through level labyrinths to collect all the stars. Use element physics, plan the route carefully, and control the streams to activate mechanisms and open new paths. Simple controls make the game easy to understand from the first seconds, but each level requires more logic and precision.

Different elements appear throughout the levels — water, lava, and hot steam. Each behaves differently and opens new ways to solve puzzles.

title: Wood Hexa Factory!
description:
Step into Wood Hexa Factory!, a satisfying puzzle game where you fill boxes by tapping colorful hexa pieces. Send the pieces down the conveyor belt and watch them fill the boxes to complete the levels. Simple but challenging, each level will test your strategy and puzzle-solving skills. If you're into puzzle games like hexa sort, card sort, wood puzzles, and a factory theme, this game is perfect for you.
"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: In the game, you need to sort wooden hexes into trays at a factory.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no strict storyline, but the goal is clear: you must sort the hexes into trays while managing your workspace.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? How can it appeal to players?
A: Appealing graphics, good sound design, and the satisfying feeling of completing a task.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to popular franchises, etc.)?
A: Appealing graphics and increasingly complex mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should players do to level up faster?
A: Complete levels and expand your arsenal of upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (e.g., standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on unlocking new slots and upgrades.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without sound make the game difficult?
A: The music complements the game well, but it is not essential for completing the levels."

title: Sausage Life
description:
Avoid obstacles and become the last sausage standing.
A parkour and survival game where you, as a sausage, must compete for survival.
As you progress through the game, you'll unlock various unique skins.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: The game is a mix of parkour and survival for a sausage.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: The game offers fun gameplay, unique skins referencing movies and games, like Harley Quinn.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has currency - money, which can be spent on skins and rebirth.

Q: What is the progression system like? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Progress by surviving levels in the role of a sausage.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game offers many skins with references to movies and games, like Harley Quinn.

Economy & Customization

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players adjust the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, players can buy hats or weapons for their character.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in gameplay without sound?

A: The music complements the game well but is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Quick Draw Cowboys
description:
Quick Draw Cowboys is a fast reaction western duel game where every shot depends on timing, focus, and reading the cue before your opponent does. Play solo through escalating cowboy duels, unlock new guns and characters, or jump into online PvP matchmaking for real-time showdowns against other players.

The game mixes simple one-touch controls with tense, skill-based duels, power-up shots, upgrades, rewards, and multiplayer cowboy battles.

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

Be the hero the world needs!

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Colorful locations, numerous card combos, helpful companions, and many hours of journeying—all of this awaits you in Emerland Solitaire: Endless Journey.

Wisk away to a land filled with wonder and danger. As a new adventurer, you must learn about all the dangers that face you while traversing enchanted forests, majestic bluffs, and more!

Play Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire for:
MYSTICAL CARD PUZZLES!
FANTASTIC WILD CARDS!
EARN STARS FOR SKILL!

title: Pinata Color Smash
description:
Smash Color Pinatas by Selecting the matching color bat. You can Select Bats on top and then the bottom bats are revealed.
You can Place Extra Bats on 5 Tile Slots and use them when needed.
Pinatas Color Smash is a colorful and engaging puzzle game where players aim to break Pinatas by selecting matching colored bats. The game offers a fun and casual experience suitable for all ages.

title: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a highly relaxing yet mentally stimulating color-sorting puzzle game set in a vibrant jungle environment. The main idea is to sort mixed colored liquids across various test tubes until each tube contains only one uniform color. title: Durak
description:
Durak is essentially a shedding card game where each player will try to get rid of the cards in their hand first. Durak is quite an enjoyable game that has over the years made a general impact on millions. It is a game that requires critical thinking, which is why it is more popular among people who consider themselves tech-savvy.

The objective of Durak is to play all your cards. The loser in Durak will be the last player with cards in their hand. So, to ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.

Durak is the most popular Russian card game. Durak means fool and it refers to the person who loses the game.

A Durak card game is one of the easiest and most fun card games. Players do not need much to get started. You will only need: a poker deck reduced to 36 cards from Ace to 6.

However, this game is quite interesting because there will usually be multiple winners. To ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.


Durak might not be a game you are overly familiar with. But in Russia, Durak is by far the most popular card game! It has got a fascinating history and will be sure to make a unique choice if you are looking for something a little different.

Another interesting thing about this game is that it is played with a smaller deck.

Durak is fun and, rather, a unique card game. If you enjoy more strategic card games and are looking for something a little different, why not give Durak a try?

Dive into an action-packed rescue strategy game where every pull of the hook changes the course of the battle!

In Hook Heroes, you control a powerful hook to rescue the underground heroes trapped beneath the battlefield. Time your swings, aim carefully, and pull up warriors, archers, mages, and more! Each rescued hero joins your side and fights to destroy enemy forces and destroy their towers.

🎯 Game Features

Build your army of underground heroes

Real-time battles with enemy waves and towers

Upgrade your heroes and dominate the battlefield

Fast-paced, addictive gameplay with strategic depth

Can you rescue enough heroes to crush the enemy tower? The fate of the battlefield is in your hands!

🪝 Play now and become the true Hook Master!

title: Kitten's Way Home: Word Associations
description:
Looking for a game for the evening? A puzzle that brings people together! Play against a friend on one screen or against artificial intelligence. The rules are simple, the adrenaline is high.
A fun and simple word duel: guess words associated with the theme. Perfect brain training, an excellent educational game, and fun time well spent.
Test yourself and your erudition. Can you guess all the associations?

title: Fruite Swipe
description:
Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours.

Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!

title: Duck Hunter
description: In this game, your task is to shoot ducks. To pass each round of 10 ducks, you must shoot at least 6. Then you will go to the next round!

title: Stick Master Teleport
description:
Jump onto walls, throw knives, and teleport to your enemies ⚔️ to defeat them with a single strike 💥.
Prove your ninja reputation by eliminating bad guys before they even notice 😈.
Walk the tough path of a ninja to become a true ninja assassin!

💪 🎮 “Stick Master Teleport” is one of the most exciting ninja games featuring stealth puzzles 🧩 and teleportation gameplay! ⚡ ⚔️

💠 USE DEADLY WEAPONS
There are many types of deadly gear 💣 to defeat your enemies.
In this thrilling ninja game, you can choose traditional ninja weapons such as:
🔪 knife, 🗡️ sword, 🌀 boomerang, and 🪓 club. Adapt your arsenal for every mission! 🎯

💠 Why you’ll love this ninja game:
⚡ Exciting gameplay
🧩 Challenging ninja puzzles
🗺️ Many tricky levels
🌀 Unique combat mechanics
Play “Stick Master Teleport” now ⚡ and strike down cunning enemies in a flash! 💥🔥

title: Pow
description: Have you ever taken care your pet!? Feed it, clean it, play with it and watch it grow up while leveling up? This is all possible is this brand new Pow game for web and mobile. Feed, nurture and take care of your Pow. Play different games in games room and collect coins to buy food to feed your pow and buy decoration to customize your room! Also challenge your friends in 3 fun minigames!

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Obby Upgrade Your Jump
description:
Ready to jump insanely high? 😄
In Obby Upgrade Your Jump it’s super fun and simple: tap → earn Jump Points → jump higher!

🔥 More points = bigger jumps.
🐾 Unlock pets to boost your progress: they make taps stronger and give 2 or 3 points per tap depending on the pet.
🏆 Level up, beat your records, and show everyone how high you can fly!

title: Roll King
description: You steer a sticky ball through colorful voxel worlds — city streets, picnic spreads, deserts, pastry kitchens, and outer space. Roll into toys, food, furniture, and whatever else is smaller than you; everything you touch sticks and makes you bigger. Hit your size goals, chase stars, and keep rolling through 50 stages (then endless mode). Use power-ups like magnets, freezes, and size boosts when you need a push — and don’t let the timer catch you.

title: Alchemy Elixir of Life
description:
Alchemy: Elixir of Life is an exciting puzzle game in which you can feel like a real creator. Create and find all the elements to save your beloved! Find the elixir of life right now!
Start with four simple elements — fire, water, earth and air — and create everything that exists in the world. Connect the elements, discover new combinations and watch as order is born out of chaos.

Each discovery brings joy, and each new combination brings you closer to solving all the mysteries of the universe.
Use logic, imagination and intuition, because there is no single path in alchemy, only your own.

title: Telekinetic Pumpkin
description:
Telekinetic Pumpkin is an arcade game where an experiment aimed at creating a magnificent, oversized pumpkin for Halloween takes an unexpected turn, resulting in the creation of a telekinetic pumpkin.


You’re a Pumpkin that teleports and moves objects with its mind! Destroy drones by smashing them, and collect power-ups to stay alive. Select your upgrades and try to survive as long as possible.

title: Untangle Threads
description:
"Untangle Threads" — a beautiful puzzle game where you drag nodes so that no thread crosses another.

6 unique worlds, each with its own mechanic:
- Neon — classic puzzles to warm up
- Nature — new threads appear as you solve
- Space — some nodes are locked in place
- Ocean — nodes drift with the current
- Crystals — limited number of moves
- Steampunk — linked nodes move as mirror images

title: Match Challenge
description: A simple but engaging matching challenge! Look at the variety of items at the bottom of the screen, and tap four that belong to the same category whether it's fruits, tools, animals, or household objects. Think fast, but choose wisely!

title: StickerBall
description:
Stickerball is a fast-paced game where you collect stickers using a ball with unique abilities! Your goal is to collect 180 colorful stickers across 9 levels by completing challenges and activating triggers that change the game’s rules. Each turn, 10 stickers fly onto the field from a purchased pack, but any uncollected ones disappear—act quickly and precisely!

The game shines with 14 dynamic triggers: freeze stickers, double rewards with "x2," turn the ball into a magnet or ghost, activate "disco" mode, or control a dual ball! The more stickers you collect in one turn, the higher your combo and the more coins you earn. Holo-stickers, with their unique designs, grant double the currency!

Play across 12 vibrant, randomly changing fields. Buy sticker packs, upgrade your collection, and strategize by activating triggers at the perfect moment to maximize rewards.

title: Pop It 3D
description: Players take turns pressing down any number of bubbles in a single row and consecutively. The player who presses the last bubble loses the game.

title: Bouncy Ball
description:
Bouncy Ball is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where timing is everything ⚡️
Guide a happy bouncing ball across floating platforms, avoid deadly spikes, and survive tricky jumps that get harder every level 😱

Each bounce matters 🟠✨
Tap at the right moment to control the ball’s movement, master precision jumps, and keep your ball alive as long as possible. Simple controls, smooth animations, and vibrant neon visuals make every run exciting and satisfying 🎨🔥

Can you keep bouncing and beat your high score? 🚀🏆

title: Weapons Merge Hero
description:
Weapons Merge Hero is a fast-paced 2D merge action game where precision and strategy matter.
Merge weapons of the same level to create stronger knives, power up your hero, and destroy strange planet-like enemies.

During gameplay, the hero fights using knives only.
Throw knives into round, planet-shaped enemies and keep hitting them until they explode. Each successful hit brings you closer to victory, but timing and upgrades are key.

Merge identical weapons to increase knife damage, speed, and power. As enemies get tougher, only the strongest merged weapons will survive.

Simple controls, satisfying explosions, and endless action make Weapons Merge Hero easy to play and hard to put down.

title: King of Fishing
description:
Dive into the thrilling underwater world of King of Fishing! Take control of powerful fishing cannons in a fast-paced top-down arcade experience where timing, aim, and strategy are the keys to victory. Shoot nets to catch colorful fish, rare sea creatures, and massive ocean bosses while collecting coins and special rewards.

Upgrade your gear, unlock stronger cannons, and explore vibrant ocean zones filled with unique species and dynamic challenges. The bigger and rarer the fish you catch, the greater the rewards. Test your reflexes, dominate the seas, and become the true King of Fishing!

title: Gravity Speed Run
description: Gravity Speed Run is a fast-paced platformer where you control a mini character, switching gravity to navigate through obstacle-filled levels. Tap to run on the top or bottom of the track, avoiding deadly spikes and traps—one hit, and you restart. Each level gets harder with more obstacles and increased speed. Earn coins by completing levels and unlock new skins for your robot avatar. Test your reflexes and conquer the challenge!

title: Playful Cup
description:
The glass is sad because it's empty. Your job is to make the glass filled up with liquid and smile again!

Try to find the best way to complete each level. You can come up with your own solution so be creative and don't be afraid to think out of the box!

There are 3 game modes to play!

title: Push The Box
description:
Welcome to Push The Box, a fun and engaging game where you solve puzzles by just pushing buttons and sliding pieces. Complete different stage missions and try out harder levels as you improve!

Game Features:
- Use handy features like reset and undo to make your gameplay smooth.
- Watch replays of your successful stages to see how you solved them.
- Enjoy clean and stylish graphics that make the game a delight to play.
- Earn achievements and compare your scores with others on the leaderboard.
- Perfectly designed for smart pads and tablets for gaming on the go.

So, if you’re looking for a game that’s easy to understand but also challenges your brain, Push Maze Puzzle is perfect for you! Slide into the puzzle fun and start solving today!

title: Easter Rabbit Style
description: Celebrate the Easter season with style! Join adorable girls in a fun-filled egg hunt and dress-up adventure. Find hidden eggs, style cute spring outfits, and top off the look with playful accessories like bunny ears. Dive into the festive spirit with Easter Rabbit Style!

title: Slappy Bird
description:
Instead of controlling the bird, you control the green pipes. Time your smashes perfectly to crush birds as they fly through the gap and collect coins for every successful hit.

But don't let too many escape—missing three birds ends the run. Spend your coins on permanent upgrades to increase coin rewards, reduce smash cooldown, and improve the chance of rare golden birds worth bonus coins. Test your reflexes, beat your high score, and see how long you can keep the skies clear!

Key Features:
Smash birds to earn coins
Endless high-score challenge
Permanent upgrades
Rare golden birds with bonus rewards
Simple controls, fast-paced action

title: Hop To Rescue
description: Hop To Rescue is an addictive platformer adventure by NapTech Games where every jump counts! Guide your hero across tricky platforms, dodge enemies, and collect all the bags to unlock the exit door. Each level brings new challenges that test your timing, reflexes, and rescue skills. Play anywhere, anytime, and enjoy smooth platform gameplay designed for endless fun.

title: Steve parkour in mine
description:
Jump, run, and don’t fall! Help Steve navigate dangerous levels filled with traps, chasms, and true cubic madness.

The levels keep getting harder, and your reaction speed and jumping precision are your only hope.

This game is perfect for both beginners and those who consider themselves masters of parkour in virtual worlds.

Are you ready to show what Steve is capable of in the world of parkour?

title: Neko's Adventure
description: Neko’s Adventure is a vibrant platformer starring Neko, a playful cat trying to rescue his girlfriend. Explore 20 challenging levels, unlock the Power Beam to shoot fire, and face quirky enemies in a whimsical, fast-paced adventure full of charm, excitement, and cartoon fun!

title: Match Master
description:
Get ready for a new, challenging and original matching pairs brain game.
You need to match 3D objects on the ground and pop them all! When you clear a level, you will find new objects to pair. Sort and find all pairs, clear the board and win!

Start searching for hidden object and matching tile pairs - Match 3D is a perfect way to zen relaxing and at the same time testing your memory and mind skills.

title: Paint Pop 3D
description:
Paint Pop 3D is an one-tap hyper casual shooting game that will keep you hooked for hours!

Tap to paint. Hold for more fun!
Stay away from obstacles and paint all slices on the ring.

Features:
- More than 1000+ levels to experience game play.
- A lot challenging missions.
- Various characters & themes.
- Beautiful graphic.

title: Hook Pin Jam
description:
Master the art of hooking in this addictive puzzle game! Solve intricate puzzles by untie the hooks to accumulate wealth
In Hook Jam, players are tasked with solving intricate puzzles by untying hooks to accumulate wealth. The game offers a variety of challenges that test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex, keeping you engaged and motivated.

title: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon
description:
Idle Magic Academy Tycoon is a charming management simulator that puts you in charge of a growing academy of sorcery. You design classrooms, recruit skilled Magisters, and gather powerful artifacts to shape each lesson. As headmaster, you guide students from simple theories to advanced combat spells, expanding your academy into a legendary center of magic.

Manage your academy wisely, constantly improve the quality of education, and transform your institution into a legendary center of arcane mastery! Develop your Academy’s infrastructure, collect Arcanum Spheres, and research magical technologies. Build your own center of magical education — step by step, classroom by classroom, artifact by artifact
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players do?
A: This is an idle tycoon game set in a magical academy. You build and upgrade various facilities, train students, and generate profits.

Q: What is the game's hook? What makes it stand out to players?
A: The game features a polished, beautiful design along with various features like daily quests, tasks, and achievements to keep players engaged.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What can be done to level up faster?
A: Success requires strategic thinking to upgrade the right functions and academy facilities. This increases your profit, which can then be reinvested into further upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Gold coins are used for upgrading academy facilities and expanding features, such as adding more student slots, increasing training speed, and improving the quality of education. Diamonds can also be purchased to speed up construction.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can players buy, and how do they affect gameplay?
A: Yes, players can purchase diamonds and an option to remove ads to speed up their progress.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to encourage player return?
A: There are daily rewards as well as free hourly chests that contain mages or in-game currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or will players face difficulties without it?
A: The sound design is high-quality, but it is not required to progress in the game.

title: Sort It Out: Category Sort
description:
A fast-paced, head-to-head card sorting game. Cards are stacked on a wooden tabletop grid, each showing an emoji or icon (animals, food, tech, sports, and more). You race a rival to sort cards into the right category slots before the clock runs out.
Each match is a 90-second duel. You and your opponent share the same kind of puzzle: stacks of mixed cards and gold goal slots labeled with categories like Animals, Food, or Tech. Whoever completes the most full categories when time expires wins.

title: Monster Merge: Legends Alive
description: Monster Merge: Legends Alive is a fun puzzle game where you combine monsters to score points and advance. Playable online for free, it features engaging gameplay with mythical creatures. Available on both desktops and Android, it offers an enjoyable experience for all ages who love a good challenge.

title: Heart Box
description:
Professor Rat loves physics puzzles and games with robots! Therefore, he created Robby, but gave him a weak battery, which is why the little robot has to constantly recharge and participate in crazy experiments. Interact with various physical objects to guide robot Robby through all of Professor Rat's puzzle rooms and free him from the charger! Don't want to play the game? Then create your own amazing puzzles in the Level Editor!

Features of the game:

- Over 180 levels for your brain
- Online database "Community Levels" with over 10000 levels by players
- Level Editor and Collection of QR Levels
- Various skins for the robot
- 4 fun game modes
- Realistic physics
- Lots of cartoons
- Leaderboards & Achievements

title: Neon Goal
description:
Step into the Neon Arena and test your aim in this fun physics puzzle game!
Your mission is simple: throw the ball and reach the net but the challenge is real because you have limited hits and obstacles are everywhere. 
Each level is a new puzzle where you must think, aim, and throw perfectly to win.

If you love short, satisfying puzzle levels with neon style, Neon Goal is a perfect quick-play game for you.

title: Head Jump
description: Speed Run Maze Maps is a thrilling runner game with fast action and vibrant mazes. The hero runs automatically and must dodge traps. In this game, one must jump, slide, and climb to avoid hidden obstacles. Moreover, the player should respond quickly to each twist and turn. In addition, the maze layout is tricky and full of surprises.

title: Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars!
description:
Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars — your epic adventure starts now! 🎈 Rescue the balloon from sneaky traps and become its fearless hero 🛡️! Control the speedy defender, smash obstacles, and catch stars ⭐ to soar to the top!  

What’s waiting for you:  

- Tons of fun and thrilling challenges  
- Super-awesome powers 💥  
- Bright skins for the balloon and defender 🎨  
- Non-stop adventure 🔁

Conquer the skies, unlock cool looks, and prove you’re the ultimate champ! 😎

title: RECOIL
description:
🔫 Recoil

A point-and-shoot platformer where every shot pushes you closer to victory… or straight into death.

Recoil is a point-and-shoot game built around a simple idea: your weapon is also your movement. Each shot launches you through dangerous, handcrafted levels filled with traps, precision jumps, and brutal timing challenges.

Expect unique, fun level designs, instant restarts, and endless deaths as you fight against momentum, physics, and your own reflexes. Frustrating? Absolutely. Satisfying? Even more.

Master recoil, embrace failure, and try again.

title: Build My Brainrot
description: Build My Brainrot is a casual puzzle–simulation game where players collect and place colored blocks on a grid to complete quirky “brainrot” characters. Blending light resource management with creative pattern-building, the game’s core idea revolves around filling shapes efficiently while upgrading abilities like speed and inventory. Its charm comes from its simple controls, humorous character designs, and the satisfying progression of turning scattered resources into complete, animated figures.

title: Tile Harvest 3D
description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.

title: Halloween Stickman
description: Halloween Stickman is an exciting adventure game where you can exact revenge on your tricky friend by rewinding time. Set in a spooky atmosphere, experience a captivating story with your choices influencing the outcome. Play for free on any device, and immerse yourself in this thrilling 2D horror journey.

title: Tile Match Camp
description:
Tile Match Camp is a relaxing and addictive triple-match puzzle game set in a beautiful camping world. Explore nature, match colorful items, and clear challenging levels as you journey through forests, campsites, and outdoor adventures.

Match three identical tiles to remove them from the board and uncover new challenges. Plan your moves carefully, keep your tray from filling up, and complete each level to advance further into the adventure.

With charming visuals, smooth gameplay, and hundreds of satisfying puzzles, Camp Match Adventure is perfect for players who enjoy casual brain-training games and relaxing puzzle experiences.

Can you master every level and become the ultimate camping puzzle explorer?

title: Mine Jump
description: Join the exciting world of Mine Jump, an engaging online experience that merges quick thinking with rapid actions. Explore a captivating realm where each jump reveals hidden treasures. Enhance your character and uncover the mysteries of an alien planet, all while enjoying the thrill on any device!

title: Patagonians
description: Explore horror and mystery in Patagonians! Search for your missing daughter, battle monsters, solve puzzles, and survive deadly traps in eerie caves and mansions. Dare to face the darkness? Play now!

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: No Shorts
description:
🌟 Welcome to the exciting world of ragdoll physics and creative fun in the style of short videos in the game No Shorts! 📱 Quickly switch between levels with swipes, just like in your favorite social networks. ⚡️ Use various tools to interact with ragdoll stickmen and activate objects on the stage. Create your own playgrounds in the level designer! 🛠️

🎮 Fans of physics-based sandboxes and creative simulators will definitely love this new trendy game!

🎲 Game features:
👆Simple one-finger control: Click to interact with the stickmen and the environment.
🌈Simple and funny casual graphics. 
🤸‍♂️Addictive gameplay with unique ragdoll physics. 
📱💻Play online from PC or mobile phone anytime and anywhere. 
🏗️Level builder where you can create your own game stories and scenarios. 

⭐️ Hurry up and click "Play" and don't forget to leave a review to help us improve the game!

title: Micro GT Racing
description:
Micro GT Racing brings high-speed action to a smaller scale with massive thrills. Take control of compact GT cars built for precision, agility, and pure adrenaline. Race through challenging circuits packed with sharp corners, tight chicanes, and fierce competition — every millisecond counts.

Customize your micro racers, master realistic handling, and push your driving skills to the limit as you climb from rookie to champion. With stunning visuals, dynamic lighting, and intense arcade-style gameplay, Micro GT Racing delivers a bite-sized racing experience with full-sized excitement.

title: Cookie Match
description:
Cookie Match is a sliding puzzle game where you must match each cookie to its corresponding cutter.

If you move the cookies off the edge of the board or into knives, they’ll be destroyed. Use the tubs of butter as barriers to keep the cookies in one piece.

title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
description: Join the thrilling endless runner in "Vikings: An Archer's Journey," where you control Nott, a bold Valkyrie archer, navigating the Underworld to rescue her wolf, Oder. With sleek visuals, it’s available for free on mobile devices and computers, appealing to gamers everywhere.

title: Sudoku - Number Games
description:
Увлекательная логическая игра-головоломка с числами! Тренируйте внимание, развивайте память и логику, да и просто получайте удовольствие!

По мере повышения уровня игра усложняется, но всегда можно вернутся к прошлым уровням и играть на более легком уровне сложности.

title: Lumbering At Sea
description: Set sail on an endless ocean adventure in Lumbering At Sea, a captivating 3D stickman runner with lumberjack action! Control a nimble stickman lumberjack dashing across glowing paths on tropical islands, chopping trees to harvest wood planks while racing toward distant checkpoints. The core idea is resource timing and raft-building progression—perfectly time your axe swings to collect enough lumber to construct a raft that propels you to the next island before falling into the sea or running out of momentum.

title: Okay
description:
Okay? is a minimalist puzzle game that turns simple shapes into clever challenges. Every level is made of blocks, lines, and objects placed on a clean, abstract screen. Your goal is simple: clear all the objects with just one perfect move.

Draw a line with your finger, release it, and watch it bounce around the screen. If your move is right, the line will hit and remove every object until the screen is empty. Sounds easy? As levels go up, the puzzles get smarter, requiring perfect angles, timing, and logic.

title: Hex Block Puzzle Master
description:
Engage your mind 🧠 and enjoy satisfying puzzle moments with Hex Block Puzzle Master 🟣⬡ – a relaxing yet challenging hex puzzle experience! Place colorful hex blocks 🎨 into the grid, solve clever layouts, and watch the board come alive ✨ as you complete each puzzle.

Designed for both casual fun 🎮 and deep thinking, Hex Block Puzzle Master offers endless entertainment without stress or pressure 😌.

Why You’ll Love Hex Block Puzzle Master ❤️

• Sharpen Your Mind 🧠
Challenge your logic and spatial thinking with carefully designed hex puzzles that get smarter as you progress 🔥.

• Relax & Enjoy 🌿
No timers, no rush ⏳❌. Play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, stress-free puzzle experience 😴✨.

• Beautiful & Colorful 🎨
Bright hex blocks, smooth animations, and clean visuals make every puzzle satisfying to complete 💎.

How to Play 🕹️

• Drag hexagonal blocks ⬡ and place them into the grid.
• Blocks cannot be rotated 🔄❌, so plan your moves wisely 🤔.
• Fill the available spaces perfectly to complete the puzzle ✅.
• Progress through increasingly challenging layouts and obstacles 🚀.

Features You’ll Enjoy ⭐

• Simple Yet Addictive Gameplay 🎯
Easy to start, hard to master – perfect for all ages 👶➡️🧓.

• Tons of Unique Puzzles 🧩
Enjoy hundreds (and more) of handcrafted hex challenges 🔢🔥.

• Rewards & Bonuses 🪙🎁
Earn coins and rewards to keep the fun going.

• Auto Save 💾
Your progress is always saved automatically.

• Play Anytime, Anywhere 📱🌍
Great for short breaks or long, relaxing play sessions 😌.

Train your mind 🧠, relax your thoughts 🌿, and become a true puzzle master 👑 with Hex Block Puzzle Master ✨🎮

title: Obby: RPG Slasher Blade Loot
description:
A dynamic action RPG where dangerous levels, enemies, and constant character progression await you. Fight enemies in close combat, use powerful abilities, and clear challenging obby stages filled with trials.

Collect a variety of weapons and armor, compare stats, upgrade your gear, and strengthen your hero. Each item affects attack, defense, and health, while upgrades make your character even stronger. Choose the best equipment and shape your own playstyle.

Progress through levels, unlock new areas, grow more powerful, and defeat increasingly dangerous enemies. The game combines easy-to-learn mechanics with deep RPG progression that fans of loot, upgrades, and action will enjoy.

title: Bouncy Arrow
description:
Bouncy Arrow is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where every arrow shot creates a fun bouncing action. Aim carefully, choose the right direction, and pop the colorful orbs with smart timing.

The game is simple to understand but challenging to master. Each level needs focus, planning, and the correct move order. Do not throw arrows randomly  watch the color pattern, understand the path, and shoot the arrow at the perfect time.

With bright visuals, smooth gameplay, and satisfying popping effects, Bouncy Arrow is perfect for players who love relaxing puzzle games, arrow games, color matching games, and smart tap puzzle challenges.

Play carefully, think before every shot, and enjoy the smooth bounce and pop puzzle experience.

title: Epic Mine Idle
description:
⛏️ Dig at full speed! Break rocks and extract rare resources. But don't let your guard down: keep an eye on your health (HP) to avoid being caught off guard by a cave-in.

🔥 Hot work! Use powerful drills for fast mining. But beware—the equipment can overheat! Optimize your timing and let your tools cool down to keep digging without stopping.

💎 Real treasures. From sparkling sapphires to pure gold—collect a collection of the rarest minerals. The deeper you mine, the more valuable your loot!

👷 Stylish hero. Your miner is a true professional in a fashionable blue suit. Who said mining can't be stylish?

⚡ Leveling and upgrades. Improve your equipment, increase your health, and reduce your drill's cooldown time. Become the most efficient miner in history!

title: Sticker Jam: Peel Off & Match
description: Dive into the lively experience of Sticker Jam, a free online puzzle game that merges sticker collecting with engaging challenges. Whether on your phone or computer, it's an enjoyable way to relax and stimulate your mind after a busy day.

title: Squishy Sheep
description:
Your mission is to help an adorable cat friend collect every balloon in each level. All it takes is removing the right platform at just the right moment and letting physics do the magic.

Every level is carefully designed to be solved with just a few clicks, while the sheep bounces across ledges and gathers balloons in delightful, unexpected ways. With fluid animations and a cute, inviting art style, Squishy Sheep keeps you coming back for more until every level is complete.

title: Magic Block Sort
description:
Magic Block Sort is a fun, addictive, and brain-teasing puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! If you love classic sorting games but want a fresh, magical twist with 3D blocks, this is the perfect game for you.

Your mission is simple but challenging: sort all the magic blocks with matching colors and symbols into their own tubes. Strategy and forward thinking are your best tools. As you progress, the levels become more complex with more blocks, hidden mystery symbols, and extra tubes to test your IQ! Can you master the ultimate sorting puzzle?

title: Brain Coloring Puzzle
description:
Discover Italian Brainrot Meme Coloring Puzzle Game
Step into the viral world of Italian Brainrot Meme Characters, where over thirty absurd creatures await your palette. No numbers, no hints—only your eye for color and a playful spirit.

Meet the Stars

Bombardiro Crocodilo: Our most fiendish color‑match boss.

Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur: A viral sensation inspired by Italian Brainrot.

Shimpanzinni Bananinni, Boneca Ambalabu, Tralalero Tralala and many more bring humor and challenge.

Why You’ll Love It

Brain‑Boosting Fun: Sharpens visual memory and logic.

Creative Freedom: No right answer—trust your instincts.

Offline Play: Dive in anytime, anywhere.

Designed for Ages 12+: Simple enough for kids, intriguing for teens and adults.

Ready to color outside the lines? Tap Install and unleash your inner artist on the most delightfully absurd paint‑puzzle around!

title: Tower Necromancer's
description: You are a necromancer living in a tower, but the local kingdom sees you as a threat. They continuously attack, trying to destroy your tower. Defend against relentless waves of enemies, master dark magic to summon skeletons and zombies, upgrade and expand your tower, and develop strategies to counter different enemy types.

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Tap into your creativity with Paint Sponges Puzzle, a captivating online game that requires strategic skills and maze-solving ability. Navigate your colorful sponge across the grid, leaving a vibrant trail. Challenges increase as you advance, providing a fun blend of logic and artistry on both mobile and computer platforms.

title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Sea Magic
description:
I, English:
**🎃 Magic Cat Academy 2 – Underwater Halloween Adventure**

In this fun and spooky *Halloween Doodle* game, you get to play as **Momo**, a brave magical cat who dives deep **under the sea** to protect ocean creatures and stop ghostly trouble! 🌊🐱👻 

After her school adventure in the first game, Momo returns to face a **new challenge** — this time in the ocean! Ghosts have followed her underwater and are hiding in all kinds of sea creatures. Your mission? **Draw magical shapes** to cast spells and send the ghosts away so everything can be peaceful again. 

**✨ What Makes It Exciting**

* You explore **deep sea zones** filled with spooky ghost-infested sea creatures like jellyfish and anglerfish.
* Each ghost shows a **shape above its head** — your job is to draw that shape quickly to cast a spell and defeat it.
* As you go deeper, the challenges get harder but more fun!

**🐾 Why Kids Love It**

* Bright, colorful underwater world 🌈
* Cool characters and cute ghosts 👻
* Easy swipe or mouse drawing to cast magic ✨
* Great for players who like something spellbinding and fun!

II, Russian:
🎃 Magic Cat Academy 2 – Подводное Хэллоуин-приключение

В этой весёлой и немного таинственной игре от Google на Хэллоуин вы играете за Момо — храброго волшебного котёнка, который отправляется в подводный мир, чтобы защитить морских жителей и остановить непослушных призраков! 🌊🐱👻

После событий первой игры Момо снова вступает в бой — только теперь под водой! Призраки спрятались в разных морских существах, и вам нужно помочь Момо прогнать их. Чтобы победить призраков, рисуйте простые фигурки на экране, и котёнок наложит заклинание, чтобы очистить море. ✨

✨ Что делает игру интересной

Вы исследуете глубины океана, где в морских обитателях прячутся призраки — медузы, рыбы-удильщики и другие.

Над каждым призраком появляется символ, и вам нужно быстро нарисовать его, чтобы победить врага.

Чем дальше вы играете, тем веселее и сложнее становится приключение!

🐾 Почему детям нравится эта игра

Красочный подводный мир 🌈

Забавные персонажи и милые призраки 👻

Простое управление — рисуй и побеждай ✨

Отлично подходит для тех, кто любит магию и приключения!

title: Even Odd Dice
description: Play Even Odd Dice – a thrilling online game for 1-4 players! Easy rules, fun gambling twist. Great for families, friends, or solo play. Test your luck and prediction skills now in this exciting dice game!

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description:
Were you one of those children who could spend hours with their puzzles, whiling away a rainy afternoon or cold winter’s day putting together a 500-piece jigsaw of the Eifel Tower or London Bridge? Well, now you can revisit your childhood on your smartphone or tablet from anywhere in the world.

Melt away from reality with this captivating puzzle game that challenges you to use your thinking skills to connect virtual pieces in real time and create unique images of increasing complexity. Arrange a variety of items to produce a pretty picture right on your screen, while developing your abilities as you progress through the levels. You’ll never be bored again!

title: Tiny Delivery
description:
Tiny Delivery is an game, created by combining the ideas of food delivery and hill climbing.
Customize your car and wheels in the store, and complete each level with your favorite vehicle.
Before starting the game, you can activate the truck rack to keep the food from falling out, making it easier to finish the level.

title: Tiny Archer
description: Nock, Draw, Loose! There is unlimited number of targets in front of you, and it is up to you to find out how many can you hit. Do not give up, try again and your skills will improve with every game.

title: Blasting Marbles
description: Blasting Marbles is a thrilling 2D puzzle adventure game where your objective is to strategically place the required number of marbles into the hole. Explore the game world, collecting crates to boost your marble count and discover marbles with unique abilities. Switch between marbles to split their efforts and coordinate teamwork for successful challenges. Immerse yourself in a captivating gameplay experience that combines puzzle, physics, and skill.

title: Survival for 100 dollars
description:
Congratulations, you're the owner of a fortune of 100 dollars! Unfortunately, that's all you have. Welcome to a survival simulator set in harsh reality.

In this game, you'll:
Masterfully manage your budget: is "Doshirak" a delicacy or an everyday staple?

Look for work in the urban-type settlement: from unloading train cars to carrying out dubious errands.

Monitor your hunger, health, and mood (it's hard to be happy when your pocket is empty).

Prove to everyone that you're an economic genius, capable of surviving where others give up. Your empire starts with a hundred-ruble note!

title: Spore Guard
description: Defend a living spore core against waves of animated microbes. The core fires automatically while you tap priority targets, collect biomass, unlock mutations, and survive escalating acid, shield, tank, fast, slime, and boss enemies.

title: Pixel Conquest
description:
Pixel Conquest is a fast-paced, addictive strategy game where you compete against AI opponents to conquer the most territory. Draw trails to enclose land and claim it as your own, all while your city automatically grows within your borders.

Use clever tactics to cut off and eliminate your rivals. Grab powerful-ups like Speed, Shields, and Bombs to gain an edge and become the last tracer standing!

title: Chu Choo Cake
description: If you love cake, then you will want to help Chef Piggo to save his creations from the hungry mice! These mice are greedy, and they will stop at nothing to try and stop the chef. This game combines elements of both Pacman and Donkey Kong and has retro graphics too. Move the chef around the level and try to drop the cakes to the bottom by standing on them. You must save each cake before you can complete the level - make sure you avoid the greedy mice too though!

title: Connect Line
description:
Connect Lines is a puzzle game in which the goal is to rotate line-segments so that together they form a continuous connected path or network i.e. all the lines must join up into one single connected structure.
It is simple in appearance but grows challenging, because you must figure out the correct orientation of each piece so that the network is complete without any breaks.
As the puzzle advances, the arrangement / layout becomes more complex. The number of line-pieces increases, the shapes become more varied, and finding the correct connection scheme becomes harder. You may need to think ahead about how rotating one piece will affect connections with several adjacent pieces. (This is standard for these kinds of puzzles.)

title: Happy Coloring Book
description: Color your world with our interactive web coloring book game! Choose from a variety of fun drawings to bring your imagination to life.

title: Crusher Block
description: Crusher Block is an idle game where you smash blocks, earn money, and upgrade your tools to create the most powerful crushing machine! Can you build the ultimate resource-crushing machine?

title: On Fire Basketball Shots
description:
