The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!
"Core: A highly engaging, physics-based arcade sports simulator centered on precision shooting and high-score chasing.
Loop: Players engage in skill-based shooting mechanics to accumulate points, which convert into hard currency (coins) used for continuous progression and reward loops.
Start: Features instant, intuitive accessibility, ensuring immediate player engagement and a strong hook from the first session.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Utilizes a clean, contemporary Flat Design aesthetic that ensures visual clarity and broad appeal.
Key Feature: Offers deep player customization through various unlockable ball and environment skins, underpinned by robust, authentic shot physics."

title: Nexusorbiter
description:
Single-finger orbital-defense arcade. Your drone orbits a fragile space station and auto-fires at incoming hazards — tap
to flip the orbit direction, that's your only control. Each stage layers in new threats: glue bombs you must shoot at
range, homing suicide drones you can't miss, EMP drones that silence your auto-fire on contact, healing orbiters that
protect bosses. Six upgrade tracks shape your build. 30+ stages, multi-boss waves, plus a fresh daily challenge for
bonus scrap every day.

title: Hexa Block Puzzle
description:
Try our highly addictive unique hexagonal pieces puzzle game!
Use your puzzle skill and put blocks into board.
Hexa BlockPuzzle will improve your logical skills and mind power.
Difficulty level will be increase as much as you play.

title: Precise Shooting
description: Test your aim and precision in Precise Shooting, a satisfying basketball shooting challenge! Launch the ball with perfect timing and angle to score into the hoop from various tricky positions and distances. The core idea is mastering trajectory and power — one well-timed shot can earn you massive points and combos. What makes it unique? Beautiful minimalist 3D visuals, realistic ball physics with satisfying arcs, increasing difficulty with moving hoops and obstacles, and the addictive “one more try” feeling as you chase perfect shots and high scores!

title: Fortress of the Sinister
description: Dive into the thrilling world of *Fortress of the Sinister*, a 3D strategy game filled with tactical gameplay and challenges. Lead a diverse team through intricate fortresses, face enemies in turn-based combat, gather resources, enhance abilities, and uncover secrets in this engaging online adventure for mobile and PC.

title: Parking Boom
description:
Parking Boom is a fun and addictive physics-based game where your goal is to launch your car straight into the parking spot!
Adjust the power and angle, smash through other vehicles along the way, and try to land as accurately as possible.

Each level offers unique obstacles and creative challenges that make your ride exciting and unpredictable.
Sharpen your parking skills, beat level after level, and aim for perfection in this fast-paced and explosive adventure.

With a variety of cars, dynamic stages, and tons of destruction, Parking Boom turns every parking attempt into a chaotic thrill ride!
If you're looking for something fresh, loud, and action-packed, Parking Boom will drive you into a world where crashing is half the fun!

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

title: Rolling In Gears
description: Rolling In Gears is an engaging puzzle physics platformer game where you control a ball navigating through a series of mechanical challenges. The game’s main mechanic revolves around rotating gears and moving platforms to guide the ball towards its target destination. Players need to carefully maneuver through the levels, using precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end of each stage.

title: Cats Go!
description: Cats Go! - is a game from the genre of obstacle course passage. In this game you need to play as a cat to pass the map and get to the fish. Hardcore platformer challenges you, can you beat the game? The cats are waiting for you to go only forward!

title: Alpha Balls
description: Alpha Balls is a stimulating word puzzle game that sharpens your mind and vocabulary. Enjoy it online for free on any device. Solve puzzles to earn coins for hints, making it an entertaining and educational challenge for all.

title: Stackitaire
description:
Stackitaire is an addictive solitaire card-sorting puzzle. Shuffle through stacks of mixed cards and sort them into complete suits — one suit per stack. Every level deals a new layout that gets trickier as locked cards, hidden decks, and tighter stacks are introduced. With hundreds of levels, daily bonuses, and handy boosters to rescue a tough hand, Stackitaire is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and satisfying puzzle play.

Tips:
Keep at least one stack empty as a holding spot — it gives you room to reorganize.
Think a few moves ahead before placing a card; getting blocked is how levels get tough.
Use Undo before spending a Hint.

title: Zombie Merge
description:
A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out.

The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.

title: My Little Farm
Blocks Adventure Jungle Saga
description: In jungle lands where wild vines grow, drag and drop blocks in a vibrant flow. Match them right and hear them click: stack up points and do it quick!

title: Neon Snake
description: A fast-paced arcade snake game with neon visuals, combo multipliers, power-ups, and global leaderboards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

title: Skebob Gun
description:
Welcome to a frantic open-world shooter where you decide who to be: a hero, a villain, or just have fun! Fight with friends, run, jump, shoot, and explore huge maps full of secrets, weapons, and surprises.

Game Features:

- Online multiplayer: play against other players in real time
- Wide selection of weapons: from blasters to rocket launchers
- Open world: explore maps, drive cars, and cause chaos
- Various modes: duels, survival, fun minigames
- Lots of skins and customization: stand out from the crowd
- Physics and tricks: jump, flip, and make the most of the environment

title: Love Sheep
description:
Love Sheep is a fun, quirky, and relaxing puzzle game you can enjoy anywhere.
Enter a world of bouncy, jelly soft sheep in a physics based adventure full of squish, stretch, and smart puzzles. 
If you like brainy challenges but also want cozy, relaxing vibes, Love Sheep is the perfect game for you.

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Get ready for a thrilling slicing experience in Halloween Fruit Slice a spooky twist on the classic arcade game. With a Halloween-themed environment filled with eerie backgrounds, ghostly effects, and creepy music, this game combines fast-paced action with brain-teasing precision. Slice your way through a flurry of haunted fruits while avoiding the deadly traps that threaten your progress.

title: Mad Day Special
description:
Mad Day Special throws you straight into an all-out alien invasion of Earth, where only speed, firepower, and sheer madness stand between you and total destruction. Race across hills, smash through walls, and blast alien enemies as you fight to rescue your beloved pet octopus, Fluffy. Part racing game, part shooter, this is an action racing experience that won’t let you down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day game. With quick loading, simple controls, and addictive progression, it’s built for both short sessions and long, high-score-chasing runs.

With its blend of racing and shooting, Mad Day Special delivers chaotic fun and that irresistible “one more run” feeling. Drive hard, shoot fast, and don’t let the aliens take Fluffy.

title: Cube Island 3D
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of survival and adventure! In the role of brave Steve, you have to start from scratch on a mysterious and uninhabited island. Your goal is to turn this corner of nature into a real paradise for life.

Game Features:

- Survival and Adventure.
- Tasks and Achievements.
- Construction and Development.
- Resources and Crafting.
- Discovery of New Islands.

An exciting journey from survival to prosperity, where your creativity and strategic decisions will be the key to success. Get ready for the adventure of your life on an island of your own making!

title: Paint & Roll
description:
Paint & Roll is a fun and satisfying color puzzle game where every move fills the world with vibrant paint 🎨✨

Roll your connected paint rollers across the board, cover every surface, and turn dull paths into colorful masterpieces 🌈🌀
Each level challenges your timing, direction, and planning skills as you glide, rotate, and paint your way to victory 🧠🎯

Simple controls make it easy to play, but mastering every level takes skill and strategy 😄🔥
Enjoy smooth animations, juicy paint effects, and relaxing yet challenging gameplay that feels great every time you roll 🎵💫

Perfect for quick sessions or long playtimes, Paint & Roll delivers a colorful experience that’s easy to learn and hard to put down 🚀🎮

title: Brainrot Hunters: Shooter 3D
description:
Dive into an intense battle for your farm in BRAINROTH HUNTERS: 3D SHOOTER!
Your mission: defend the farm from the invasion of cunning Italian Brainrots and wily rival hunters. Hold the line, shoot back waves of meme-inducing monsters, and don't let the enemies break through!
Key features:
🐗 A variety of Brainrots—each with their own habits and tactics
🔥 Stunning 3D graphics, full of chaos and adrenaline
👂 Smart enemies—they react to shots and footsteps, forcing you to keep your head down!
Become a hunting legend, save the farm, and show who's boss! 🏹🔥

title: Nullify - Merge Math
description:
Nullify is a minimal abstract relaxing puzzle with the goal of clearing everything from the screen by merging numbers and math symbols.
Improve your logic and math skills by completing unique handcrafted levels and infinite generated levels.

Features:
-56 Levels to complete
-4 Infinite games modes
-Simple and easy controls by dragging elements
-13 math symbols

title: Impossible Parkour 3D
description:
Are you ready for the impossible challenges and levels in this Impossible Parkour game?
Every level has its unique experience and at every level you will experience new things with 25 levels of the game. You can play it all the day but never finish the game. Let's see if you can?

title: Mindblow
description:
Welcome to Mindblow: Guess the Word! Experience a word-guessing game like no other, where every image cleverly hides a word. Unlike other games, this game isn’t just a mix of stock images, but we've carefully created each level’s image to challenge your brain! Discover the word through a concept creatively depicted in each picture.

A New Kind of Puzzle: Forget what you know about word quiz games. In Mindblow: Guess the Word, each image has a special word for you to guess. It’s not just about looking at the picture, but understanding the clever idea behind it.

title: Bonkhalla
description:
Choose one of 6 heroes and battle endless waves of monsters across three unique biomes: Forest, Desert, and Graveyard.

Collect experience, level up, and combine 12 weapon types with upgrade tomes to unlock powerful evolutions: the Sword transforms into a Holy Blade, the Fireball into Inferno, and Lightning into the Thunder God!

Over 30 items, 30 quests, 10 challenges with unique rules (one-on-one with bosses, no healing, glass cannon) and a shop with permanent upgrades — every run will feel unique.

Survive 10 minutes, defeat the final boss, and try to endure the Final Storm!

title: Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!
description:
🌟 Welcome to "Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!" — an exciting online game with ragdoll physics, where every descent turns into a real adventure! Roll, tumble, dodge obstacles and prove that you are the best in this crazy race with epic falls and popular meme heroes!

If you like such popular games as "Deadly Slide!" or "Ragdoll Crash Test: Throw and Break!", then quickly click "Play" and enjoy the exciting gameplay.

🔥 Game features:
- Simple and intuitive controls
- Funny ragdoll physics: watch your hero tumble, break and get up again! 🤸
- Cartoon 3D graphics and funny animations make every fall even funnier
- Skin shop: play as Hagi Wagi, Stickman, Noob, Obby and other popular heroes
- Compete in the leaderboard and show the best result
- Online game for any device: smartphone, PC or tablet

title: Good Knight Story
description:
What happened last night!? Join our unlikely hero as he awakens in a dungeon with a sore head and no memory of how he got there.


Solve puzzles, battle monsters and survive bad jokes as you piece together events from the night before.


FEATURES:


* Rich and entertaining story

* Over 100+ levels of puzzle solving action

* Dynamic character upgrade system

* Daily gifts to help with your quest

* Epic Boss battles

* Special Boosts to unlock

* Upgradeable weapons

* Custom themed soundtrack

* Over 1000+ handsome tavern owners

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Color Dash - Chameleon Runner
description:
Run, jump, and switch colors to survive! Fast-paced endless runner challenge.

Get ready for a fast and challenging color-changing adventure in Chameleon Runner: Color Dash!
Run through vibrant worlds, switch your chameleon’s color at the right moment, and avoid obstacles that match the environment. Your reflexes are your greatest weapon!

Race through endless levels where speed increases, colors shift, and platforms test your timing. Collect gems, unlock skins, and climb the global high-score leaderboard. Simple to play, hard to master — perfect for players of all ages.

✨ Features

🎨 Color-switch gameplay — tap to change colors and match the world

⚡ Fast-paced endless running and reflex challenges

🦎 Unlock chameleon skins & effects

🌍 Multiple themed worlds: jungle, neon city, crystal cave


If you enjoy endless runners, color switch games, or skill-based platformers, this is your next favorite.

Download Chameleon Runner: Color Dash and master the color rhythm! 🦎💨

title: Mandala Meadow
description:
Mandala Meadow is a relaxing mandala coloring game where you paint intricate designs, unwind, and create stunning art one tap at a time. Choose a mandala, fill each section with soft, calming colors, and watch detailed patterns bloom to life. With dozens of hand-crafted mandalas — from simple flowers to elaborate lotus, peacock, and animal designs — there's a soothing coloring puzzle for every mood.

Perfect for mindfulness, stress relief, and creative relaxation. No timers, no pressure — just you, gentle music, and beautiful art

title: Black Friday Mystery Sale
description: Dive into the excitement of Black Friday shopping with a twist! In the Black Friday Mystery Sale dress up game, fashion surprises await, and it's up to you to style the princesses with fabulous outfits hidden inside the mystery boxes. Ready for a shopping spree you’ll never forget? Start playing now!

title: Zip Zap
description: Dive into Zip Zap, a beautifully minimalist physics puzzle where simplicity meets ingenuity. In this one-touch adventure, you guide quirky mechanical beings across intricate levels, orchestrating movement with just a tap and a release.

title: Vikings
description:
Vikings is a card game, develop your cards, conquer new lands.
There are many adventures waiting for you.

title: SORTY BOLTY
description: SORTY BOLTY revolves around the theme of organization and color coordination. Players are tasked with sorting vibrant nuts onto corresponding bolts, creating a visually satisfying and mentally stimulating experience. The game's appeal lies in its straightforward mechanics that gradually increase in complexity, challenging players to think several moves ahead.

title: Village of Colors
description: Dive into the lively realm of Village of Colors, where your imagination is key. In this free online game, defend the village by sketching protective barriers. With unique villagers and challenging foes, you can pause time and boost your skills to keep your vibrant home safe.

title: Sling Chicken
description:
You start in a barn and climb upward by attaching to wooden rungs (pegs). From each rung you pull back and release the chicken like a slingshot to fling it to the next peg higher up.

The track is endless and gets harder as you climb:

Spinning saws guard some rungs
Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through)
Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels
Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time.

Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead.

Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).

title: Quizmasters
description: QuizMasters is a colorful trivia quiz-show game where you answer questions, climb the prize ladder, and aim for the grand reward. Choose the correct answer from four options, earn cash and crystals, collect reward stickers, and challenge other players in trivia battles. Each level becomes harder, keeping every round exciting, fast, and rewarding.

title: Space Obby
description: A fun and lighthearted platformer set in outer space. Join other intrepid astronauts as you adventure to the far reaching corners of a destroyed space station, using your trusty jetpack to navigate the floating wreckage. Featuring six unlockable characters and collectable battery cells scattered across four massive levels -- do you have what it takes to reach the end?

title: Mega Car Stunts
description:
A high-intensity driving game where every track becomes a test of skill, speed, and control. Perform daring jumps, fly off massive ramps, survive dangerous obstacles, and push your car to the limit in extreme stunt challenges. It is not just about racing fast — every course demands precision, timing, and the ability to stay in control under pressure.

Earn money by completing events, unlock new vehicles, and expand your collection with even more powerful cars. With varied modes, challenging tracks, and physics-based crashes, each run offers a new adrenaline-filled experience.

title: Toxic Arena: Biological Threat
description:
Toxic Arena: Biological Threat is a thrilling action-roguelike "survivors" game where your only goal is to survive in the heart of a global biological catastrophe. You are a fighter trapped on an arena with endless hordes of mutants. Test your nerves and your reaction time!

What awaits you:

Insane Drive: Fight against ever-growing waves of enemies. Every minute on the arena is a new challenge and a test of your tactics.
Deep Mutation System: Choose unique upgrades with each level! Increase damage, fire rate, or unlock abilities like ricochet and armor penetration.
Survivor's Arsenal: Collect weapons of various rarities — from 'Common' to 'Legendary'. The cooler your gun, the less chance the monsters have.
Diverse Locations: Fight your way through gloomy forests, abandoned military bases, and secret laboratories.
Become a legend of the "Toxic Arena: Biological Threat" and top the global leaderboards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Only Jump RPG
description:
Only Jump RPG is a fast-paced action runner with RPG progression: one road, one jump, thousands of decisions. Jump left/right, strike, use skills, and dodge traps and enemy attacks. Unlock heroes, collect items, and power up your skills.

Key Features:

- Minimal buttons — maximum action: a jump = attack + movement.

- RPG progression: upgrade unique hero perks.

- Dangerous patterns: spikes, chasms, ghosts, and tight timing.

- Quick runs: short sessions with a growing skill ceiling and depth.

- Hero collection: unlock characters with distinct abilities.

title: Capyballra - Capybara Ball Collector!
description:
Rotate the maze, roll to collect, unlock cute skins!

Twist the maze with your mouse or your finger, send your capyballas rolling into the pipe. Simple one-touch controls, snappy physics, and clever level design make every run satisfying. Use coins to unlock new Capyballra skins—classic, seasonal, and rare animated variants—to show off your favorites.

Perfect for quick runs or chasing full-collection completion: rotate, collect, unlock.

title: 11 Kisses
description: Join the thrilling journey of "11 Kisses," where you aid Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy in their fight for love. Solve intriguing puzzles across diverse terrains to help them overcome obstacles. Accessible on both mobile and desktop, immerse yourself in this enchanting tale of passionate reunion.

title: BuildemUp
description: BuildemUp is an entertaining and cool game where you should put various color and shape blocks on a cargo machine in order to deliver them and finish building beautiful houses. You will enjoy the challenge of keeping all these weird blocks on the truck. As you progress in game you will earn coins witch you can buy and unlock other cool looking trucks and activate power up to help you advance more easily in levels. BuildemUp is an ideal game for all ages, providing easy to difficult mind challenges and enhancing puzzle solving skills.

title: Dress Up Anime Girl
description: Anime DressUp is a fun online game that lets you style a cute anime princess. With a variety of outfits, hairstyles, and makeup, you can unleash your creativity and fashion skills. Enjoy creating unique looks and make your princess a standout fashionista in her realm!

title: Bloop!
description:
Bloop is a brainy isometric maze puzzler. Each level is a small grid, roll Bloop around, collect every diamond to open the exit, then reach it before your energy runs out. Every step costs energy, so the clever route always wins.

Across four themed worlds: Splash Garden, Frankenstein Lab, Wonderland and Lost Pyramid and 130+ levels, paths that look obvious rarely are.

title: Amigurumi: Cozy Stitches
description:
Welcome to your cozy amigurumi workshop! Craft adorable knitted friends with your own hands — from sweet bears and bunnies to fantastical dragons and dinosaurs.

Every toy comes to life in 4 delightful stages:
- Knit the parts by tracing spirals with your finger
- Stuff them with soft filling to perfect plumpness
- Sew on little paws, ears, and tails
- Style the face — eyes, nose, smile, and accessories

Choose your yarn color and type, fulfill customer orders, display your toys in the shop window, level up your crafter skills, and complete your full collection. New quests and bonuses await you every day!

title: SNAKES
description: SNAKES is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you guide colorful snakes to fill the entire board. With over many handcrafted levels, the game challenges your mind with clever layouts that get trickier as you progress. The minimalist art style and amusing background music make it enjoyable for all ages. Play at your own pace or compete with friends to see who can solve the puzzles faster. If you love brain teasers, logic puzzles, or casual games, SNAKES is the perfect choice!

title: Skibidi Toilet: Attack Hole
description:
Skibidi Toilet: Attack Hole is a free-to-play and highly addictive hole game full of crazy fun and satisfying action! 🎮🔥
Dive into chaotic levels packed with surprises and nonstop destruction. Play anytime to relax, have fun, and release stress 😤💥

You start small and weak… but don’t worry 😈
Your hole has a special power — it can swallow EVERYTHING on the map! Toilets, enemies, objects, and anything that moves. Be fast and catch them before they escape 👻💨

The more you move and eat, the bigger and stronger your hole becomes 🕳️⚡
Grow in size, speed, and power to consume stronger enemies and unlock powerful units that will help you defeat epic bosses 👾🔥

Easy to play, hard to put down, and extremely satisfying!
Are you ready to control the ultimate Skibidi Attack Hole? 🚽🌀🔥

title: Racing: Online!
description:
Experience real online racing right in your browser.
  Compete against players from around the world and climb to the top of the leaderboards.

  🏎️ What's Inside:
  • Drift mechanics for skill-based driving
  • Unique cars to collect
  • Limited-time events with exclusive vehicles
  • Daily quests to keep you progressing
  • Create a lobby, chat, and race with friends — or challenge someone on the same device in local co-op

  Race. Win. Dominate.

title: About a Frog
description: A puzzle game about a frog in which you need to pass various obstacles to activate the sail on a small raft to advance further.

title: Merge Plane Tycoon
description:
Merge Plane Tycoon is a fun and addictive tycoon game where you build your own air empire by merging planes and upgrading them into powerful aircraft ✈️⚡

Start with small planes, merge identical ones, and unlock faster, stronger, and more advanced jets 🚀 Each upgrade boosts your income and expands your airline business 💰

Manage your runway, discover new plane types, and watch your fleet grow automatically even while you’re offline ⏳

Simple controls, satisfying merge mechanics, and colorful visuals make Merge Plane Tycoon perfect for casual and idle gameplay 🎮

How far can you grow your air empire and dominate the skies? ☁️👑

title: Hipsters vs Rockers
description: Gaia, Ero and Ai are best friends forever. They like to try the latest fashion and compare with one another that suits them. This time they tried the style of rockers and hipsters. Wonder which fashion is suitable for them?

title: Neon Ball Slope
description:
If you love fast-paced runner-type endless games, then you'll definitely love Neon Ball Slope!
It combines fast reactions with physics-based ball maneuvering. It'll start easy, but as you roll down the slope, it only gets steeper from there! Avoid obstacles, and collect coins and gems to invest into upgrade packs for cards to become more powerful and earn higher scores. Gain XP on runs to level up and the increase card amounts gained from packs and unlock content. Complete missions to get gems and equipment chests. Participate in the daily leaderboards and gain coins by getting the highest score out of your division!

title: Spider-Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: Solve the maze
description:
The game will appeal to fans of puzzles. There are 100 unique levels in the game. The difficulty of the levels gradually increases. If the level is too difficult for you, you can skip it by watching a video advertisement. For each level you complete, you are given crystals that can be spent on unlocking new items. Collect the entire collection!
You will definitely like:
- Smooth ball movement
- Lots of beautiful and vibrant paint colors
- Simple one touch control
- Great way to kill time

title: Radial 3D
description: Join the thrilling adventure of Radial 3D, where you explore space while controlling a black hole. Your goal is to absorb celestial bodies, avoid dangers, and ascend through the cosmos. This free game challenges your skills on both mobile and PC. How far will you go?

title: Ultimate Brainrot Battle
description:
Chaotic fights, insane upgrades, pure Italian Brainrot.

Enter the madness of Ultimate Brainrot Battle, where Italian brainrot characters throw hands in explosive, fast-paced combat.

Play as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, or Cappuccino Assassino, each bringing their own chaotic playstyle and uniqe abilities.

Fight. Upgrade. Repeat. Become the strongest brainrot ever!

title: Resize Stickman
description:
Resize Stickman: Master Your Size, Conquer the Run!

Dive into "Resize Stickman," a thrilling and visually polished 3D runner where your only power is to change your size! The core idea is simple yet deeply engaging: your stickman automatically runs forward, and you must strategically resize him — grow to smash through towering barriers or shrink to slip under low obstacles.

This game stands out in the crowded runner genre by blending instant pick-up-and-play simplicity with hybrid-casual depth. It's not just about reflexes; it's about smart, split-second decisions. With a sleek, reactive interface, satisfying animations, and a wealth of content including a vast collection of collectible skins with a progressive gacha-style shop and multi-tiered achievements, "Resize Stickman" offers a premium-quality experience. Fully localized for a global audience, it delivers a captivating and rewarding challenge that will keep you coming back for more.

title: Ninja dash: Cozy tactic puzzle
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle, a free online game where stealth and strategy unite. As a ninja tactician, eliminate foes with careful planning, using your surroundings to perfect each move, whether on your phone or computer.

title: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles
description:
Mahjong Tower: Puzzles are a mix of "puzzle" and "three-in-a-row" genres in a mahjong setting.
An exciting puzzle game for MAHJONG and THREE-IN-A-ROW fans! More than 60 levels of varying difficulty. SOLVE THEM ALL!

Combine mahjong tiles to remove them from the board or create special tiles that will help you clear the board even more effectively.

Solve fascinating puzzles in the "Puzzles" game mode.
Clear the board from mahjong tiles in the "Board Clearing" game mode.
Score as many points as you can in the endless "Arcade" game mode.

title: Cute Shapes
description: "Cute Shapes" is an adorable casual observation puzzle for the whole family. Spot the differences among cute shapes with eyes, solve fun little challenges, and train your powers of observation!

title: Drift Master 3D
description:
Short Description: Get ready to burn rubber! Drift Master is an addictive arcade drifting game where timing is everything. Tap to slide around tricky corners, avoid obstacles, and survive as long as you can.

Long Description: Do you have what it takes to tame the asphalt? Drift Master puts you behind the wheel of explosive cars in an endless arcade drifting experience! The rules are simple: hold to drift right, release to drift left. But mastering the tight turns and narrowing roads will test your reflexes to the limit.

Collect coins, dodge dangerous obstacles, and chain together massive combos to unlock a garage full of legendary vehicles—from the classic street racer "Blaze" to the furious "Phoenix." How far can you drift before you crash?

Key Features:

🔥 One-Tap Controls: Extremely easy to learn, impossibly hard to master.
🏎️ Unlockable Cars: Earn coins to unlock 4 unique cars with distinct styles.
⚡ Combo System: Link your drifts to multiply your score and hit the top of the leaderboards.
🏁 Endless Thrills: Procedurally generated corners mean no two runs are ever the same.

title: Stickman Archer Kick
description:
Stickman Archer Kick is an engaging and highly addictive action shooting game where precision meets captivating Ragdoll physics. Take up your bow and arrows and embark on a critical mission: utilize expert archery skills to kick and save the lives of numerous Stickmen caught in dangerous traps.

Master the art of shooting and apply strategic thinking to complete challenging Puzzle stages. Success relies on your ability to judge angles and trajectory accurately, making this a top-tier Shooter experience. Collect Stars across all Levels to unlock new character skins and enhance your gameplay.

Optimized as a Mobile Ready title, this game offers immediate action and seamless controls on any device. Download Stickman Archer Kick now and become the ultimate hero in this frantic Stickman rescue adventure.

title: Crazy Sheep
description: Crazy Sheep is a fun puzzle-platformer where you help a clumsy sheep overcome obstacles by building a bridge with different items. Available for free online, it features engaging physics challenges. Playable on any device, it's perfect for those who love light-hearted, casual games.

title: Match Story : Animals
description: Match Story Animals is a fun and addictive 3D puzzle game where players must match cute animal objects to clear the board. With smooth gameplay, colorful graphics, and hundreds of levels, it offers hours of entertainment for puzzle lovers. Use power-ups, boosters, and smart strategies to progress through challenging stages. Perfect for casual gamers of all ages!

title: Block Sort Puzzle
description: Block Sort Puzzle is an exciting multi-colored block sorting puzzle that will test your logic and attentiveness! Sort as fast as possible to collect the highest tower, as well as to multiply your points! Nice animation of moving tiles.

title: Crazy Emoji Blast
description: Match colorful emojis, chain explosive combos, and blast your way through 10 increasingly challenging levels! Swap adjacent emojis to create matches of 3 or more — trigger row blasts, column blasts, cross explosions, and total nukes. Watch out for bombs hidden on the board — match near them to unleash devastating chain reactions

title: PARK IT
description:
Advance Car Parking specially designed for lovers of Car parking games. You can improve driving skills by enjoying the best car parking of 2023. Extremely an addictive game with ultra challenge levels.
50+ different levels
Realistic vehicle physics
Reverse Camera
Challenging levels to test your driving skills
Challenging levels to push your Parking Skill to the limit
With a lot of Skin to customize your CAR.
High detailed graphics

title: Dark City. Multiplayer
description:
Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game where players are divided into two factions: police and bandits, fighting for control over an abandoned city consumed by darkness.

The world is alive and shared among all players — every step could lead to a confrontation with an enemy... or something far worse.

The police try to restore order, protect survivors, and reclaim captured territories.

The bandits aim to establish their rule by taking over zones, setting ambushes, and hiding in the shadows.

Capture areas, hold control, fend off enemy attacks… and survive the horror slowly awakening in the depths of the city.

title: Ball: Path Through Obstacles
description: Roll through an obstacle course playing as a ball. Avoid traps and collect coins to unlock new skins

title: Mushroom Runners
description: Run endlessly in Mushroom Runners! Dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow HUGE! Ride the Happy Flying Cloud in this fun, fast-paced endless runner with a unique platforming twist.

title: Furry Kung Fu
description:
Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun!

Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons!

Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.

title: Furry Kung Fu
description:
Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun!

Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons!

Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.

title: Mini Car Racing Master 3D
description:
🏁 Mini Car Racing Master 3D

Feel the thrill of speed in Mini Car Racing Master 3D — an endless highway racing adventure packed with excitement, smooth controls, and powerful cars! Race through city streets, dodge heavy traffic, and become the ultimate racing champion.

⚡ Game Overview:

Jump behind the wheel of your favorite ride — from classic sports cars to high-speed formula racers. Push your limits as you race endlessly across highways, city roads, and challenging weather conditions. Use nitro boosts to blast past opponents and show your racing mastery!

The more you race, the more you earn. Collect coins, upgrade your vehicles, and unlock new, faster cars to keep the adrenaline pumping!

🚗 Features:

🛣️ Endless Highway Racing: Race non-stop through highways and city streets.

🚘 Unlock Cool Cars: Choose from 4WDs, sports cars, and formula racers.

💨 Nitro Boost Action: Hit the nitro and feel the rush of extreme speed!

🌦️ Dynamic Environments: Drive through sunny, rainy, and snowy roads.

🪙 Upgrade & Customize: Earn coins to improve your car’s performance.

🎮 Smooth Controls: Easy to play, hard to master — perfect for all racers!

🌆 Vivid 3D Graphics: Realistic visuals bring every race to life.

🏎️ Why You’ll Love It:

Fast-paced, addictive racing gameplay

Realistic car physics and sound effects

Endless fun for racing and arcade game lovers

🔥 Start your engine and hit the road!
Download Mini Car Racing Master 3D now and become the true master of the highway!

title: Red-Blue Forge
description:
Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate core orbs to match incoming embers and survive as long as possible. Start in classic 2-core mode (Red/Blue), then unlock 4-core mode (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow) for higher intensity and a x3 score multiplier. The game features smooth touch/mouse controls, quick sessions, and a “Ready” start gate so each run begins on your command.

Between runs, collected materials feed a persistent Forge Tree progression system. Temper upgrades to improve control, stability, scoring bonuses, and long-run mastery. Every match rewards precision and timing, while long-term progression gives players clear goals and replay value. Ideal for mobile and desktop, Red-Blue Forge combines skill-based gameplay, readable visuals, and satisfying build progression in short, addictive runs.

title: Ball Attack
description: Blast through endless waves of bouncing balls, dodge incoming obstacles, and upgrade your powerful cannon to survive longer in this intense, fast-paced arcade shooter filled with nonstop action and explosive fun!

title: Grand Escape!
description: Join the adventure of Grand Escape!, a thrilling online platform game. Discover a fascinating realm filled with odd beings and exciting challenges. Guide your character to triumph while navigating vibrant levels. Enjoy this free game on your computer or mobile device and embrace your adventurous spirit!

title: Arrow Pop
description:
Arrow Pop is a fast-paced hyper-casual archery game where every shot counts! 🎯

Aim with precision, hit colorful targets, and clear increasingly challenging stages packed with moving obstacles, tricky angles, and satisfying chain reactions. Unlock new bows, improve your accuracy, and master your timing as you pop every target in your way.

Easy to learn but hard to master, Arrow Pop delivers quick, addictive gameplay that's perfect for short breaks or long high-score sessions. Can you become the ultimate archer?

Features

🏹 Simple one-tap controls
🎯 Hundreds of fun and challenging levels
⚡ Smooth, satisfying shooting mechanics
🌈 Colorful 3D visuals and juicy effects
🎁 Unlock awesome bows and arrows
🏆 Test your precision and reflexes

title: Smash & Merge Balls
description:
Short Description: A skill-based arcade game with colorful physics.

Full Description: In this game, you control a character that starts a fusion chain reaction! 
Strike the colorful balls to get them moving. 
The key rule: when two balls of the same color collide, they merge, and you earn points. 
Create massive chains of mergers to maximize your high score!


(lore)
(from the Showman):
Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! Welcome to the greatest show in the cosmos — the Arena of Fusion!

Here is your instrument of chaos — the mighty merger mallet! Don't be shy, give it a swing! 
Your mission is brilliantly simple: step onto the arena floor and prepare for a rainbow deluge! 
Smash those colorful spheres, make them crash, and when two of the same color meet — 
BOOM! — they fuse into a glorious explosion of points!

title: Geek Escape: Run for Survival
description: Geek Escape: Run for Survival is an exciting arcade game where players control a nerdy hero racing against bullies. Available for free online on various platforms, it combines action and strategy. Players dodge obstacles and use trash cans as weapons in this thrilling adventure filled with excitement.

title: Balls: Pixel Art
description:
Balls: Pixel Art is a game about knocking out pictures with balloons. More precisely, you
have to disassemble the drawn picture into pixels by breaking it up with balloons.
This is a very interesting, exciting process. In which you need to show ingenuity,
and accurate calculation. The game has to offer:
- Exciting gameplay.
- Multiple images for you to smash
- Nice graphics
- Lots of levels to complete
Ready to be the Anti-Artist? Cracking the works of art? Then onward to new
victories!Balls: Pixel Art

title: Commit
description:
Explore an isometric world full of puzzles where every move is permanent. Take control of a curious cat that must traverse all the tiles in each level to collect food—but beware: every tile you step on disappears forever.
No turning back.
Only pure strategy.

title: Purrfect Match
description:
Welcome to a cozy casual match-3 game with cats, created for relaxation and pleasant emotions.

In this match-3 puzzle, you connect identical cats by drawing a continuous line across the board using your finger or mouse. You can create combinations of three or more tiles horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal connections are not allowed, so each move requires attention and planning.

The game has no rush — you play at a comfortable pace, enjoying the cute visual style and warm, relaxing atmosphere. Each level offers a new objective and gradually increases in difficulty while maintaining a balanced and enjoyable experience.

Bright 2D graphics, soft colors, and adorable cats make the game perfect for unwinding. The vertical layout is ideal for mobile devices and one-handed play. The game is suitable for all ages and will especially appeal to fans of cats and relaxing puzzle games.

title: Subby Quest
description:
Welcome to a world swallowed by darkness. An underwater cave stretches endlessly before you, full of mystery, danger, and things you never expected to find. Explore it, survive it, and uncover what lies beneath.
Coins are scattered all across the deep. Grab them and spend them wisely, whether that's growing your submarine fleet or loading up on boosts to push through the toughest moments the cave throws at you.
And keep your eyes open. Rare gems are hiding in places most players never reach. Finding them is the real challenge.
The cave doesn't care how far you've come. It just keeps going. Will you?

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.

title: Mole In The Hole
description:
Gameplay Overview

Dual Terrain Challenge: Navigate through layers of stone and sand, each requiring a specific tool for efficient digging.
Stone Blocks: Use the pickaxe to break through solid stone barriers.
Sand Blocks: Switch to the shovel to swiftly move through loose sand.
Treasure Troves: Keep an eye out for special blocks embedded with gold. Breaking these not only clears your path but also boosts your score.

title: Stellar Shot-Gravity Puzzle
description: Stellar Shot is a physics-based space puzzle where every shot bends to gravity. Drag to aim, release to launch, and use orbiting planets, heavy masses, repulsion fields, and wormholes to curve your path into the portal. Each level rewards precision with fewer shots and smarter trajectories. From gentle intro stages to challenging late-game puzzles, Stellar Shot is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. Plan ahead, read the gravity, and find the cleanest route through the cosmos.

title: Blocky Set - 3d brick constructions
description:
A 3D emulator of real-life brick-building games, where you are presented with a complete model and must reproduce it by placing the pieces in the correct location.

Enjoy!

title: Fill The Lines
description: Lines to Fill is a thinking game where you draw lines to complete the given puzzle shape. Simply drag one of the colorful blocks using your finger or the left mouse button, and make sure there are no blank spots left. Since the game has no time limits and no way to lose, you can enjoy this stress-free experience complete with hundreds of unique levels on your computer or mobile device. Can you block out some time and finish every level?

title: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle
description: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle is a charming and addictive one-line puzzle game where players draw a single continuous line to connect and activate all the water pipes on the farm. Set in a vibrant, colorful cartoon farm filled with blooming flowers, cute animals, and relaxing scenery, the core gameplay revolves around clever pipe-connecting logic that challenges your spatial thinking. With its relaxing atmosphere, satisfying one-stroke mechanics, and progressively tricky levels, it brings the joy of farming and puzzle-solving together in one delightful package.

title: Safari Match
description: Safari Match is an exciting, jungle-themed memory puzzle game where players test their focus and speed by finding matching animal cards. Navigate through beautifully illustrated exotic wildlife cards against a ticking clock. As you progress, the grid expands, offering greater challenges and higher rewards. Unlock special power-ups like 'Reveal All' or 'Row Reveal' to help you conquer the hardest levels. Featuring vibrant artwork, dynamic animations, global leaderboards, and an immersive safari atmosphere, it's a premium brain-teasing adventure suitable for all ages!

title: BeastForge Rival
description:
BeastForge- Epic PvP Tower Defense Battles!

Dive into the ultimate real-time PvP strategy showdown! Command your army of 20 uniquely balanced units in intense Clash Royale-style tower wars. Outsmart global opponents in lightning-fast multiplayer duels or battle god-tier AI bots that train themselves through 1000+ simulated matches for unbeatable tactics. No waiting—seamless matchmaking and instant AI fillers keep the action non-stop!

Key Features:

Real-Time PvP Multiplayer: Challenge players worldwide, climb global leaderboards, and dominate ranked arenas!
Revolutionary AI Training System: Watch your AI opponents evolve in real-time—self-play 1000 matches to master counters, perfect your strategy against pro-level bots anytime.
20 Balanced Units: Rock-paper-scissors meta with archers, tanks, spells, and more—deploy, upgrade, and synergize for victory.
Stunning Graphics & Sound: Crisp visuals, explosive effects, immersive audio—feels premium on desktop & mobile.
Quick Matches: 3-5 minute battles perfect for "one more game" addiction.
Daily Challenges & Rewards: Earn upgrades, unlock skins, and compete in tournaments.
Whether you're a strategy master or casual battler, AI Clash Royale.io delivers endless replayability. Build your deck, destroy enemy towers, and claim royale glory! Download now and unleash your inner commander—can you conquer the arena?

Drag and Drop or Touch and Place

title: Cards in Fool
description: Play Cards in Fool – a strategic turn-based online card game! Outsmart opponents, make them draw cards, and climb the leaderboard. Flip cards, win matches, and earn points in this classic multiplayer challenge!

title: Brainrot Merge & Fight
description: Brainrot Merge & Fight is a chaotic strategy brawler where you fuse quirky heroes into stronger versions and send them into battle. Every merge boosts your squad’s power, letting you build crazy combinations to take on tougher enemies. With each fight, your evolving team grows funnier, wilder, and more unstoppable—can you conquer every challenge?

title: Draw and Guess Online
description: Draw and Guess is a fun and fast-paced online multiplayer game where creativity meets quick thinking! Players take turns drawing a given word while others try to guess what it is in real-time. The faster you guess correctly, the more points you earn. Compete with friends or players from around the world and show off your drawing skills!

title: Match Story: Weapons
description:
🔫 Match Story: Weapons takes you into an action-packed puzzle adventure!
Match powerful weapons, expand your arsenal, and challenge your brain in this fun and addictive 3D puzzle game.

⏳ Solve tricky puzzles against the clock, keep your mind sharp, and become smarter with every level!

🧠 Each stage gets harder, testing your reflexes and thinking skills.

✨ Discover unique weapon models you’ve never seen before, build powerful combos, and master the art of matching!

🎯 Key Features:
🔥 Fun and addictive match-3 gameplay
🪖 Discover unique weapons never seen before
⏱️ Race against time – solve puzzles before time runs out
🎨 Colorful and eye-catching 3D graphics
🧩 Increasingly challenging puzzles and levels
🧠 Keep your brain active & boost your intelligence

Merge your weapons, unlock new levels, and write your own matching story.

title: Mouse Survivor
description: Get ready for the thrilling journey of Mouse Survivor! In this dynamic 2D game, you'll dodge dangerous snakes and tackle explosive obstacles while gathering cheese to explore new areas. Stay agile and quick to thrive in this constantly changing environment, available on both mobile and desktop!

title: Hungry Cats
description: Hungry Cats is a casual puzzle game where you guide several cats at the same time to find their food. By rotating the entire level, you must think carefully about how every cat moves together. This unique mechanic turns simple movement into a fun and playful puzzle challenge. 🐾

title: Rolling Cube 3D
description: Embark on an exciting journey with the Rolling Cube 3D! Through countless levels and challenging obstacles, your goal is to lead the cube to the finish line. Avoiding traps and reaching the end. Test your agility and reaction time and see how far you can go in this exciting game!

title: Clicker Knights Vs Dragons
description: Clicker Knights vs Dragons is a pixel-art idle clicker RPG where players tap for "Hero Tap DMG"  while auto-attacking foes like skeletons in progressive stages across fantasy biomes, as seen in this desert Stage 4-1 with 8.81 Total DPS. Its core revolves around addictive hero team-building and upgrades for exponential scaling against monsters and dragons, uniquely blending simple taps with spellcasting, offline progression, and epic boss raids for boundless medieval fantasy adventures.

title: Draw Action Freestyle Fight
description: Unleash your creativity and power in Draw Action Freestyle Fight, a super fun draw-to-fight action game! Draw lines and shapes with your finger to command powerful punches, kicks, and combos against tough opponents in intense battles. Complete freedom to draw any attack you want, hilarious ragdoll physics when enemies get slapped or punched into the water, satisfying one-tap drawing mechanics, and addictive battles across different arenas!

title: Unravel Eggs Puzzle
description: Celebrate Easter weekend in style this year with the sweet new puzzle game, Unravel Eggs Puzzle! Complete each level by untangling eggs such that each line connecting eggs is not intersected by any other line connecting eggs. Warm up with some light puzzles and work your way up to an egg-tangling like you've never seen! Happy Easter!

title: The Fill
description:
Sharpen your mind with a connect-the-block-style one-line brain training puzzle game.
A simple but addictive one-line puzzle game that’s completely free to play.

Your brain becomes more active the more you play.
During your commute, before you sleep… enjoy downtime with brain training.

The rules are extremely simple.
Just fill in all of the blocks using only one line.

Use hints for puzzles that are too hard to solve.
Hints are also free, of course.

title: Mad Day 2 Special
description:
Mad Day 2 Special throws you back into explosive action as ex-Marine Bob takes on a full-scale alien invasion. Ride, shoot, jump, and smash your way through hostile worlds as you battle evil aliens and fight to rescue Bob’s kidnapped pet octopus. Packed with speed, firepower, and attitude, this is an action runner that never slows down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day 2 game. With fast loading, simple controls, and nonstop progression, it’s perfect for quick play sessions and long score-chasing runs alike.

Customize Bob’s truck with powerful weapons, armor, and boosters, then unleash chaos on waves of enemies and epic boss fights. Collect coins to upgrade your gear, unlock stylish outfits, and improve your chances of going further each run.

title: Mushroom Hunting: Forest Search
description:
Step into the forest and start your quiet hunt! 🍄 

Mushroom Hunting: Forest Search is a relaxing hidden object simulator for true mushroom lovers. 
Study mushroom descriptions and find them hidden among leaves and grass — but watch out for poisonous ones! 
🌲 Explore birch groves, spruce forests, and overgrown meadows 
🍄 Over 30 mushroom species to discover 
🛒 Sell your harvest and unlock new forest areas 
⚠️ Ate something wrong? Time to find the village healer! Perfect for fans of peaceful walks, hidden object games, and a relaxing escape from everyday life. No stress — just birdsong, fresh air, and the joy of a good find.

title: Fruit Slicer
description:
Get ready to become a fruit-slicing master in the most exciting fruit cutting game ever! It's simple: slice fruits to master the art of fruit cutting. The best part? It’s absolutely free to play and packed with fun!

Game Modes:
- Classic: Just relax and slice.
- Time: Race against the clock!
- Arcade: Plan your slices without time limit!

Fruit Slicer offers simple yet addictive gameplay that will keep you entertained for hours. With cool challenges and the chance to compete against friends, there's never a dull moment. 🎯

title: Farm Business Saga
description:
Farm Business Saga is a captivating farming simulation game where players build and manage their dream farm. Perfect for nature lovers and strategy enthusiasts, this game lets you cultivate crops, raise livestock, produce goods, and expand your agricultural empire.
What makes Farm Business Saga unique?
✅ Addictive gameplay – Manage resources, trade, and grow into a farming tycoon.
✅ Stunning graphics & intuitive controls – A visually pleasing experience for all ages.
✅ Endless customization – Design your farm, village, and factory your way!
Whether you're a casual player or a strategic mastermind, Farm Business Saga offers a relaxing yet challenging farming adventure!

title: Car Parking Order
description: Join an exciting adventure in mastering parking skills with Car Parking Order. This fun online game tests your ability to park vehicles in the right order amidst traffic and barriers. As levels progress, challenges become tougher. Play for free on any device and see if you can solve them all!

title: Brain Draw Line
description:
Put your mind to the test with Brain Draw Line: Link Dots, a simple yet captivating puzzle game that challenges creativity and logic. Draw one continuous line without lifting your finger or going backward to connect the dots and finish complicated designs.

The goal of this game is simple: create a single, continuous line without lifting your finger or overlapping any lines to link all the dots in a specific shape. With each level, the puzzles get more complex.

title: Obby: Mine, Build, Launch
description:
Dive into a fast, satisfying browser obby where the real goal is simple: mine resources, upgrade everything, and grow your digging empire. Grab your tool, break blocks, collect loot, and turn every run into progress. Improve your base, boost your power, and watch your income climb.

Mine more — upgrade faster:
• Upgrade tools to mine quicker and carry more.
• Upgrade your base to process resources and unlock stronger boosts.
• Hire workers to speed up routine farming while you push for bigger upgrades.

Build your style and your squad:
• Buy cute pets that help you mine and accelerate progress.
• Collect skins to stand out and customize your character.
• Unlock new tools and upgrades to keep your grind smooth and rewarding.

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into the exciting world of Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits, a free game that blends 2048 with billiards in a fruity setting. Enjoy merging fruit balls on your devices while savoring ASMR sounds through challenging levels, all while aiming for high scores. Experience nonstop fun!

title: Inner City Drive
description:
Weave through neon traffic at 390 km/h, one mistake and it's over!

Inner City Drive drops you into a rain-soaked neon city at night, behind the wheel of a car built for one thing: surviving the storm at impossible speed. Dense oncoming and same-direction traffic floods every lane — thread the gaps, launch off ramps over gridlock, and blast through tunnels while lightning cracks across wet, reflective streets.
The hook is the near-miss combo: shave past traffic as close as you dare and your combo climbs, stacking speed and score multipliers the longer you hold your nerve. Play it safe and the combo bleeds away, every run is a gamble between going faster and staying alive.
Every day brings a brand-new procedurally-generated drive, the same route for every player worldwide, reset at UTC midnight, so you're racing the whole planet on a level playing field on the daily global leaderboard. Grind XP and coins to unlock all 14 cars, each with its own speed and grip feel, knock out daily missions, and build your day streak. Instantly playable on desktop or mobile.

title: Zigzag Snow Adventure
description: Control a bouncy red ball as it rolls down a snowy mountain! Dodge trees, rocks, and other obstacles while trying to survive for as long as possible. The faster you go, the harder it gets!

title: Prásino
description:
Prásino is a small survival game set in a world drowned in trash. 
Your only lifeline is the trees - without them, there’s no air to breathe.

Plant magic seeds to grow trees, restore barren zones, and carve a path forward. 
But stay alert,  trash-born enemies lurk everywhere, ready to stop you.

title: Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge
description:
Tap the arrows and remove the blocks! A logical puzzle game for adults! Can you beat all levels?

Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge is a relaxing puzzle game where you need to remove blocks by tapping the arrows. Clear the field, solve puzzles, and complete levels at your own pace.

This is a casual logic game that combines puzzle gameplay, an anti-stress experience, and thinking challenges. Simple controls make it accessible for everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it engaging.

The game is perfect for relaxing: easy gameplay, pleasant visual style and engaging levels help you unwind and take your mind off things. Sometimes you’ll need to think a bit to remove all the blocks and avoid getting stuck.

Features:

Casual puzzle game
Logic and thinking games
Puzzles with blocks and arrows
Many levels
Relaxing anti-stress gameplay
Boosters for help

If you enjoy puzzles, logic games, and casual games, try Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge.

description: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight! — is a fast-paced voxel multiplayer shooter with fully destructible, physics-driven maps — buildings collapse and debris change the battlefield. Build bases and fortifications, carve tactical paths, and turn the environment into a weapon. Core modes: Sandbox (creative freedom), Capture the Flag (team tactics), and Team Deathmatch (intense PvP). Quick matchmaking, custom rooms, localized UI and optimization for web/mobile platforms. title: Obby: Upgrade Your Lucky Machine!
description:
Forget boring spin machines! - here you're not just spinning reels, you're building your own luck machine.
Increase the number of slots, speed up spins, add multipliers and bonuses - every spin becomes more powerful!

🔹 Upgrade everything:

Spin speed—from slow to lightning fast

Number of reels—from 1 to 20

🔹 Battle against the bot—your challenge!
Who will collect more winnings? The winner takes all winnings from both machines—the loser gets nothing.

🔹 Money—your weapon:
Earn coins, buy upgrades, compete in battles—and watch your machine become unstoppable.

Perfect for those who love:

Idle games with progression

System upgrades

Competing against bots!

About: Upgrade the Spin Machine! – a game where you're not just a player, but the creator of a legendary machine.

title: Stunsteval Siderollers
description: STUNSTEVAL SIDEROLLERS is an arcade race with a side view. Try to outrun a helicopter, a biplane or a fighter jet. Drive in the rain or on a dark highway.

title: Kinetic Puzzle
description:
Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up.

Master four block types:
- Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal.
- Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction.
- Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board.
- Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum.

Features:
- 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains
- Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts
- Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback
- No timers, no ads mid-puzzle
- Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support
- Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.

description:
Slide, Solve, and Smile with Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle!
Welcome to Slidey, a heartwarming sliding cat puzzle game that brings you cozy vibes, playful challenges, and the fluffiest kittens ever! ?

We give you Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle, the ultimate sliding block puzzle game with unique gameplay and endless fun!

The Slidey is simple: slide cute cat blocks left or right to create and clear full lines. The Slidey is free to play and easy to learn.

With no timers, no stress, and no pressure - just you, charming puzzles, and adorable feline friends - this game is your perfect escape from the daily grind.

In this relaxing clicker game, you earn money by tapping on your house. Every click brings you closer to upgrading your home, earning gold, and unlocking beautiful decorations. As your income grows, you can customize your house with furniture, decorations, and upgrades that reflect your progress.

description:
Rearrange picture fragments, connect matching pieces and restore beautiful images. Relaxing and satisfying puzzles for all ages with endless level variety.

Jigmerge Puzzles is a calm and satisfying puzzle game where you restore images that have been split into shuffled picture tiles. You can play endlessly — levels cycle through the theme, and new images are added regularly. A great way to unwind, improve focus and enjoy beautiful visuals.

title: 100 Doors Puzzle Box
description:
100 Doors  Puzzle Box is an exciting puzzle and escape room game where every level brings a new challenge, mysterious doors, and hidden secrets.

Explore rooms, search for hidden objects, combine items, and solve clever puzzles to unlock the next door. Some challenges require logic, attention, and creative thinking.

Inspired by classic “100 Doors” and “escape room” games, this version features modern 3D graphics, smooth animations, and fun interactive mechanics.

Features:
• Dozens of unique levels
• Hidden object gameplay
• Interactive puzzles
• Escape room atmosphere
• Modern 3D graphics
• Easy controls
• Challenging brain teasers

Can you open all the doors?

title: Square Sort
description:
The game involves swiping colorful cubes in any direction to clear the board. The objective is to sort the squares by color, and the game gets progressively harder with each level.
The user interface is simple and easy to use, with visually appealing graphics that are pleasing to the eye. The game has a relaxing soundtrack that complements its challenging gameplay. Square Sort offers a great way to exercise your brain while having fun, and it's perfect for those who enjoy puzzle games. The game is free to download and play, with no in-app purchases or ads to interrupt the gameplay.

title: Astro Shooter
description: Astro Shooter is the high-octane arcade shooter where danger comes from every angle! Command your advanced starfighter against endless waves of enemies attacking from all directions. Collect power-ups mid-run for temporary, powerful builds, and take down massive 3D boss ships. Spend your hard-earned coins in the permanent garage to unlock new ships and max out your core stats, ensuring you get further in every run. Your run ends, but your power doesn't!

title: STAIR BALL
description:
Climb an endless staircase full of danger in Stairs Ball, a fast and minimal arcade game.
You control a small ball running up colorful steps. The path looks simple, but each stair is covered with deadly spikes and tricky gaps. One wrong move and your run is over.

Collect shiny rubies on your way to unlock new balls and styles. Chain “perfect” moves to build huge combos and smash your high score. The higher you climb, the faster and harder it gets it’s all about timing, reflexes, and focus.

title: Stand on the Right Color, Robby!
description:
"Stand on the right color, Robby!" is an addictive arcade game where your goal is to reach the finish line by jumping on colored tiles. You need to react quickly when the color tiles change randomly. You have limited time at each stage. Be vigilant and react instantly so as not to fall and get ahead of your rivals.

Your reaction, accuracy and skill will be put to the test. In this exciting game you have to fight for first place on your way to the finish line.

Earn in - game currency and unlock unique Robls skins, items and effects - this will add excitement and variety to the gameplay.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and complete all the tiles to the finish line in this incredible game? Defeat your opponents, reach the top of the leaderboard and prove that you are the best!

title: Capi bar
description: Capi Bar is an idle game, business simulation and relaxing gameplay in one app. Combine fruits, save juice and gradually upgrade your bar!

title: Dicey Chickens
description: A dice-vs-monsters castle defense game. Your chicken heroes stand at the bottom of the battlefield and roll six-sided dice automatically — whatever face lands fires that attack upward at monsters marching down from the top. Each hero’s die is built from two attack types (and sometimes shield, heal, or speed faces), so every roll matters. Kill enemies to gain XP, level up, and pick spells that upgrade die faces or add effects like bleed, poison, freeze, and knockback. Survive five waves per stage — recruiting up to three heroes along the way — with the final wave being a boss fight. Win by clearing all waves; lose if your castle HP hits zero. Between runs you earn coins, crystals, and weapon shards to permanently upgrade heroes, rank up spells, and push through 100 stages across ten worlds in the Chicken Coop Run campaign.

title: Zombie Raid
description:
Zombie Raid is a fast-paced survival action game where you must fight off hordes of zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your gear. The city has been overrun by monsters, and only you can clear the streets and stop the growing threat.

Unlock new characters, buy and upgrade weapons, earn resources, and find the best playstyle for each challenge. You will have access to a wide range of equipment, from bats and crossbows to lightsabers and blasters.

Each new mission becomes harder, and the enemies become more dangerous. Survive, upgrade your loadout, and prove that you can stop the zombie onslaught.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: The game is about survival, where you need to fend off waves of zombies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: There is no specific storyline, but the goal is clear - fend off zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your gear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: Good graphics, various missions, and a wide range of melee and ranged weapons.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to complete missions, upgrade weapons, enhance their character, increase their level, and watch ads to earn more gold.

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game offers a wide selection of weapons and various types of zombies with different characteristics.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in gameplay without sound?

A: While the music complements the game well, it is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Connect: Monsters
description: Connect: Monsters is a fun online puzzle game that enhances your mental skills through monster matching. Compete with friends to achieve high scores on various platforms without needing to download anything, offering enjoyable gameplay whether you're at home or traveling.

title: Backslash Slash
description:
Backslash Slash is a keyboard-first blade clicker that turns simple key presses into satisfying combo chains. Instead of tapping, press /, \, P or K to strike a human-shaped training dummy using knives, daggers, machetes and more. Each key corresponds to different attack timing and combo opportunities — master the rhythm to unlock special multi-hit moves and new weapons as you level up.

Key features:

Keyboard controls: intuitive use of /, \, P, K for fast-paced slashing.
Weapon variety: each blade (knife, dagger, machete) has unique speed and combo patterns.
Combo progression: build and maintain combo chains to multiply damage and unlock advanced techniques.
Level-based unlocks: reach higher levels to gain access to new combos, weapons and passive upgrades.
Upgrade system: improve attack speed, combo window, crit chance and weapon power.
Focused, stylized visuals emphasizing skill and progression.
Whether you want quick, rhythmic keyboard action or deep upgrade planning, Backslash Slash delivers addictive feedback and meaningful progression. Learn key timings, discover the best combo sequences, and climb the ranks as you unlock ever-more lethal blades

title: Police Drift Escape
description:
Police Drift Escape is a fast, simple, and addictive top-down drift survival game.

You are the getaway driver. Police cars are coming from every direction. Drift, dodge, collect cash, and make the police crash into each other before they catch you.

There is no road. No traffic. No complicated rules. Just pure arcade chasing on a clean open surface.

Drift to Survive

Your car keeps moving. Use smooth control to turn, slide, and escape at the last second. The police cars are faster, but they cannot turn as sharply as you. Use that advantage to make them miss.

A perfect drift can save you.
A wrong move can end the chase.

Make Police Crash

You do not need weapons. Your best weapon is your driving skill.

Bait police cars into following you, turn at the right moment, and watch them crash into each other. Every police crash gives you more score and makes the escape more satisfying.

Grab the Cash

Cash bundles appear during the chase. Collect them for extra rewards, but be careful. Some cash is placed in risky spots, and chasing it too greedily can get you caught.

Normal cash gives quick rewards.
Golden cash gives bigger rewards.
But survival always comes first.

title: TetraDice–Merge & Blast Blocks

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description:
Cargo Path Puzzle is a free puzzle-platformer that puts your logic and movement skills to the test. Navigate tricky levels filled with deadly voids, collapsing blocks, trampolines, ice slides, and directional blocks.
Your goal: collect all the keys to activate the exit portal—then reach it to win.
Each level has only one correct solution, so plan your moves carefully. One wrong step can trap you or block your progress.
If you enjoy clever puzzles, single-solution challenges, and smart platforming, Cargo Path Puzzle is made for you.

title: Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines
description: Discover the exciting world of Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines, where online arcade fun meets thrilling challenges. Engage in various mini-games, collect tickets for rare pets, and unlock new machines. Spin the Wheel of Fortune for prizes and explore unique machines for exclusive rewards. title: Stonks!
description:
An arcade game about an amoeba with huge evolutionary ambitions and a very questionable plan: keep jumping higher until nature admits it has a point. The goal is simple: cling to platforms, gain height, and avoid finding out exactly how deep the abyss goes. The higher the run, the trickier the stages become: platforms change shape, routes get tighter, and every sloppy jump turns into a scientific experiment with a sad ending.

Collect biomass to boost your jump, unlock new stages of evolution, and use a mid-air jump when ordinary amoeba determination is no longer enough. Every run is a chance to beat your personal record for height, time, and collected biomass.

Stonks! starts fast, pulls you in easily, and keeps reminding you: evolution loves persistence, but gravity is still stronger.

title: Checkmate
description: Step into the world of Checkmate, a strategic chess-inspired game featuring 500 unique maps and 24 challenging achievements. Engage in intense battles on diverse boards, each requiring a fresh approach. As black squares off against white, aim for the elusive checkmate and prove your mastery. Whether youre a chess pro or a newcomer, the game offers an accessible interface for all skill levels. Unlock achievements, explore diverse maps, and experience the thrill of outsmarting your opponent in this ultimate game of kings and queens. Check and mate your way to victory!

title: Hi-Fi Snake: Groove-Driven Arcade Challenge

Dive headfirst into a vibrant, isometric world where classic arcade action meets a pulsating disco atmosphere. In Hi-Fi Snake, you control a tireless robot with a single goal: power the party forward!

Inspired by the timeless game Snake, you must guide your bot to collect sequences of glittering pellets. As you do, your trail grows, demanding precision navigation. But don't dawdle—a molten-hot problem is right behind you! A tide of raging lava is steadily consuming the dance floor, giving you only seconds to act.

Once your quota is full, you must race to the exit door to unlock the next room and escape the fiery fate. Every chamber presents a new, expertly crafted challenge filled with moving obstacles, environmental hazards, and robotic enemies determined to make you crash. It’s a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategic movement under intense pressure. Get your groove on and escape the heat!

title: Emoji Solitaire
description:
