Welcome to Emoji Solitaire, a fresh, captivating puzzle game that beautifully marries the timeless rules of classic solitaire with clever word-association mechanics.
Instead of traditional suits like Hearts and Spades, you deal cards featuring vibrant words and stunning emojis representing categories like Animals, Food, Music, Space, Weather, Sports, and Nature. Your objective is to declutter the playing field by matching and stacking related words onto their dedicated category foundation piles.
Starting with simple piles, the puzzle complexity expands as you unlock new levels, bringing blocker cards, locked cards, and intricate category boards. Perfect for casual gaming sessions, language learners, and puzzle enthusiasts alike, Emoji Solitaire offers a tranquil, deeply satisfying spatial sorting experience.

title: Assemble Factory Puzzle
description: Play Assemble Factory Puzzle, a free online game where you solve challenging assembly line puzzles. Strategically place machines to craft perfect car parts. Test your logic, speed, and problem-solving skills in every level!

title: Blade Hit
description: Throw knives at logs to break them, collect coins, and unlock new knives. Collect up to 96 weapons (swords, staffs, knives, tridents, shurikens, and more), set records, and become a knife master in Blade Hit!

title: BouncePop Quest
description: Join the adventure of BouncePop Quest, guiding Jumpo, a colorful jelly creature, through 150+ vibrant levels. Overcome obstacles, navigate moving platforms, and face challenges while collecting stars and defeating enemies. Experience exciting new worlds in this free game available for both phone and computer, delivering hours of fun!

title: Miner Jam
description: Miner Jam is a fun puzzle game where you strategically use colored axes to break boxes and advance through levels. Play online for free and enjoy vibrant gameplay. Unlock rewards and enhance your skills as you challenge yourself across iOS, Android, or desktop platforms.

title: Wednesday’s Battle: Monster Symphony
description: An endless action game that fuels the urge to try again after every defeat, keeping you hooked for ‘just one more round.’ Built around the popular Wednesday theme, it features various enemy types, gradual difficulty escalation, and smooth, satisfying animations that make each battle feel rewarding.

title: Cars Vs Blocks
description:
Welcome to Cars & Blocks — a fun and satisfying color-match puzzle game where strategy meets smooth driving!

Tap to blast colorful blocks and free the matching stickmen.
Each stickman must enter the car with the same color.
Clear the path, avoid traffic chaos, and make sure every car drives away safely!

It starts simple… but don’t get too comfortable 😏
As you progress, levels become more challenging with tighter spaces, more colors, and smarter puzzles that test your logic.

Game Features 🚗
• Addictive color-matching gameplay
• Easy tap controls
• Satisfying block blast effects
• Smooth stickman animations
• Challenging levels with increasing difficulty
• Clean and colorful visuals

Think fast. Plan smart. Clear the blocks.
Can you master every level and create the perfect traffic flow?🚀

title: Mage Adventure: Mighty Raid
description: The game is simple but addictive: just aim and throw projectiles at enemies to clear wave after wave. As you progress, you'll unlock a variety of projectiles—each with its own unique twist.

title: SpeedMatch Competition
description: A competitive fast-paced tile-matching & puzzle competition. Put your stakes on speed, accuracy or both to come on top of your opponents.

title: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG
description: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG is a casual fantasy role-playing game where you lead a small team of brave adventurers through dangerous monster-filled floors. Hire warriors, archers, mages and other fighters, upgrade their equipment, learn new skills and defeat powerful bosses. Build your party, collect loot, improve your heroes and go deeper into the adventure.

title: DEAD FREQUENCY
description: Defend the Signal Tower! A fast-paced tower defense game set in a vibrant red wasteland. Protect your crystal-powered signal tower from waves of enemies using upgradeable stats like damage, speed, bounce, and diamond yield. Level up your defenses, manage resources, and survive as long as you can!

title: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel
description:
Imagine a game where, instead of the usual movement on your feet (or paws), you roll... a barrel! But simply rolling isn't enough — to gain truly incredible speed, you need to throw bombs and use their explosions for momentum. Every correct move is a combination of timing and tactics.

You'll experience:

Unusual movement mechanics — roll on a barrel and learn to control the chaos of explosions.

Lots of enemies — for classic use of explosions.

Destructible environments — explode tiles and carve your way through.

This isn't just an arcade game; it's a test of reaction, ingenuity, and the ability to find solutions, where physics itself becomes your ally.

title: Crash Control
description: Experience the thrilling challenge of managing traffic in Crash Control. This free online game tests your ability to maintain order at busy intersections with easy one-tap controls and impressive 3D graphics. Can you ensure safety amidst growing complexities? Jump into the action and discover your skills!

title: HoleMart
description:
HoleMart is a fun and addictive casual game where you control a growing hole inside a busy market.
Move around the area, swallow objects, and expand your size as you consume more items.

Start small by absorbing tiny goods, shelves, and carts. As your hole grows bigger, you’ll be able to swallow larger objects and clear the market faster. The more you consume, the stronger and bigger your hole becomes.

Simple controls, satisfying growth, and smooth gameplay make HoleMart perfect for quick play sessions and endless fun.

title: Palkovil The Way Home
description: The unique world of "Palkovil" will allow you to immerse yourself in the crazy atmosphere of the New Year! Hundreds of monsters and mobs, favorite animals, fascinating riddles and quests, gifts, toys and sweets, huge laboratory spaces will help you learn the most terrible secrets of this place! Collect toys, feed squirrels, dogs and cats, fight with swords, defeat bosses, collect cards by looking at paintings, find connections and do everything to bring the Christmas tree home. Save your favorite holiday together with the heroes of this game.

title: Clash of Cars: Arena
description:
Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive!

Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents.

Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast.

Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind!

Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory.

Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!

title: Constella - single line puzzle
description:
Starlight - Single Line Drawing Puzzles
Relax and unwind as you connect the stars to reveal beautiful constellations in this calming, line-complete puzzle experience. Journey through a serene celestial atmosphere where every single-line puzzle you solve brings a new shape to life. Draw your continuous path through the cosmos to discover hidden figures—from a peaceful desert cactus and a crisp apple, to a majestic celestial turtle and a starry crab. Enjoy a tranquil game that gently challenges your mind while soothing your soul.

title: Cubic Coil
description: Guide a green-black voxel snake inside a rotatable cube. Spin both snake and cube to line up moves, collect voxel fruit squares and rare big fruits for bonus points. Classic Snake rules, reimagined in 3D with a crisp green backdrop.

title: Pop Sweet Fruits
description:
🎉 Dive into a fruit-filled adventure with Pop Sweet Fruits! 🍍🍑
🎮 Start with 2 fruits, pop more 💥 to unlock new ones 🔓 and boost your strength 🚀!
🔫 Upgrade bullet speed ⚡, fire rate 🔥, and earnings 💰!
🌍 Play worldwide with 7 languages (🇹🇷🇬🇧🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇫🇷🇷🇺)!
🍒 Sweet fruits 🍇, quick reflexes ⏱️, and endless action await you! 🌀

title: Logic Islands
description: A logic puzzle game inspired by Nurikabe and Islands of Insight. Create islands with exact numbers while keeping walls connected. Navigate through 6 unique worlds with different rulesets - from Classic Nurikabe to advanced mechanics like Yin-Yang connectivity. Each world introduces new challenges with ice blocks, one-way arrows, and special orb mechanics across 240 hand-picked puzzles.

title: Magic Potion School For Witch
description: Magic Potion School for Witch is an enchanting match-3 puzzle game where young witches cast spells with a wand to connect and pop numbered magical bubbles and shapes like triangles and squares in a bubbling cauldron, mastering potion brewing through increasingly challenging levels in a whimsical wizarding academy.

title: Winter Battle
description: The perfect winter season has arrived. Join the battle between Santa Claus and the Grinch under the snow. Collect all the gift boxes falling from the sky, but remember, some gift boxes are very dangerous. As you collect gift boxes, your size increases; naturally, if you collect the wrong box, your size will shrink. Collect the highest score before time runs out to win the game.

title: Drone Dash - Time Challenges!
description:
**How to Play**

Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists.

Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start.

Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Fast reflexes and smart movement make all the difference!

**Controls:**
🖱️ On PC: Just click to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!
📱 On Mobile: Just tap to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!

Ready to test your reflexes and grab those stars? Dive into the dash and beat the clock!

title: Sweet Supermarket Simulator
description:
- Collect ingredients  
- Stock shelves  
- Earn money  
- Unlock new shelves with products  
- Hire new staff  
- Upgrade your character  
- Unlock new supermarkets

title: DashMash.io
description: DashMash.io is a chaotic multiplayer obstacle race where up to 10 players battle it out in real time! Jump, dash, and dodge your way through stages packed with moving platforms, swinging hammers, crumbling blocks, and deadly spikes. Each round cycles to a brand-new map, forcing you to adapt on the fly. Reach the finish line first to claim the top spot on the leaderboard — if the chaos doesn't get you first!

title: Pongoal
description:
PONGOAL is an exciting fusion of classic Pong and high-stakes football action! Experience the timeless paddle gameplay you love, reimagined with the energy and intensity of a penalty shootout. Defend your goal, outsmart your opponent, and score spectacular goals in this fast-paced arcade sports challenge.

Battle against intelligent AI opponents across three difficulty levels, or challenge a friend in local multiplayer mode. Every match is a test of reflexes, strategy, and precision as you race to be the first to reach the winning score. With dynamic physics, responsive touch controls, and thrilling goal celebrations, PONGOAL delivers non-stop competitive fun!

title: SWARM MINERS
description: SWARM MINERS is a cozy mining-idle adventure. Swing your pickaxe to smash gem-rich rocks, hatch a swarm of collectible pets that mine and fight alongside you, and unlock 40 vibrant worlds from sunny meadows to cosmic voids. Upgrade tools, chase treasure rocks, spin the Wheel of Fortune, blast ore with dynamite, and battle bosses. Easy to pick up, endlessly rewarding.

title: Gun and Roll
description: Roll your roller object, improve it to other shapes, press cards and improve your gun! Use it gun for shoot objects. Pick the correct doors to improve yourself in level, pass the levels!

title: Electron dash
description:
Attract. Repel. Survive.

Master the invisible forces of physics in this high speed magnetic arcade game. You do not just run, you glide, slam, and swing using the power of magnetism.

Use the polarity slider to instantly switch your charge between Red and Blue. Repel off walls to launch yourself across the map, or attract toward magnetic pillars to drift around tight corners.

Key Features:
Unique Control System: Master the polarity slider to push and pull your way to victory.

Physics Based Movement: Feel the momentum as you squish into walls and rocket through open spaces.

title: Car Cargo Ship Simulator Game
description: Welcome to the car transport ship simulator game. The ultimate cargo transport and driving game where your driving, parking, loading, and ship navigation skills will be tested to the limits. Become a professional car transporter, load cars onto massive cargo ships, sail through deep ocean ports, and deliver vehicles across exotic islands and modern ports. If you have ever dreamed of managing a high-tech transport fleet with jeeps, ships and cars, this game is made for you! Test your parking skills, ship handling, and time management in this action-packed cargo simulator game.

title: Buttons
description:
Experience a tactile plinko adventure in a hand-drawn scrapbook world with satisfying physics.

Battle grumpy felt monsters and enjoy a uniquely crafted visual style as you progress through the game.

title: Block Sculptor
description:
Block Sculptor is a 3D puzzle game where you become the sculptor. Inside every block hides a colorful shape — your goal is to carefully remove all the extra gray cubes without touching the shape itself.
The challenge grows steadily: shapes get bigger, and the margin for error gets smaller. Rotate the block, study it from every angle, and think through every move!

title: Boys - Battle for the District
description:
Boys - Battle for the District is an addictive idle clicker game where you tap to battle and conquer urban turf against rival gangs. Grow your power through relentless tapping as you defeat foes and expand your district empire.

Core Gameplay

Tap the screen furiously to smash opponents in fast-paced idle battles - no complex controls needed. Watch enemies crumble with each click.

Key Features

1) Idle Tapping: Simple one-tap combat to defeat gangs and claim districts.

2) Upgrades & Prestige: Boost damage and restart stronger each run.

3)Endless Growth: Climb leaderboards through incremental power spikes.

title: Sledding Hills
description:
Sledding Hill is a whole world of sliding games. Explore different worlds: deserts, snowy mountains, and wild forests. Grab your sled and slide down the hill!

* 🌎 Explore Worlds — Unlock new levels, sandy deserts, snowy mountains, and more.
* 🎁 Unlock Characters & Upgrade Gear — Collect coins to upgrade your ride and personalize your adventure.
* 🎳 Mini Games — Test your skills in different mini-games and place your best score on the leaderboard.
* 👀 Secret Skins — Unlock secret characters and more.

Stay with us, and we will bring more maps, mini-games, and more content.
Subscribe to our Discord and share your thoughts and ideas.

title: Egging On
description:
A fragile egg begins a dangerous journey toward the sky. The world around you is unstable — steep slopes, sharp edges, and tricky obstacles that can crack your shell at any moment.

Master the physics of movement as you balance, tilt, and jump your way upward. Each level introduces new challenges, from simple inclines to complex platforms that require precision, timing, and steady control.

Unlock a variety of fun and epic egg skins as you progress and turn your climb into a unique adventure. With realistic physics, challenging gameplay, and a colorful visual style, every move matters.

Can you keep your balance, climb higher and higher, and reach the stars without cracking?

title: Santa Holiday Adventure Game
description:
Fly with Santa, deliver gifts, and spread Christmas cheer in a magical holiday adventure!

�� It’s Christmas time — Santa needs your help!
Join the fun in Santa Holiday Adventure Game, a cheerful, family-friendly journey packed with snow, gifts, reindeer, and joy — made for Fire Tablet and Fire Stick players of all ages!

Santa Holiday Adventure Game brings Christmas magic to your Fire Tablet and Fire Stick! Join Santa on his sleigh as he delivers gifts, collects coins, and spreads joy across snowy villages. Fly through winter wonderlands filled with sparkling lights, decorated trees, and holiday cheer.

Enjoy easy family-friendly gameplay, smooth controls for Fire Stick remotes or touchscreens, and colorful 3D graphics that capture the spirit of Christmas. Complete gift delivery missions, unlock reindeer and sleigh upgrades, and race to deliver every present before sunrise!

Play offline anytime and make this holiday season unforgettable.

�� Fly. Deliver. Celebrate. Download now and experience the most magical Christmas adventure!

�� FEATURES

Festive Gameplay: Help Santa deliver gifts, collect coins, and spread happiness across snowy towns.

Magical Worlds: Explore winter wonderlands filled with decorated trees, sparkling lights, and holiday surprises.

Fun for Everyone: Easy controls for Fire Stick remotes and Fire Tablets — perfect for kids and family playtime.

Gift Delivery Missions: Race against time to reach every home before sunrise!

Power-Ups & Collectibles: Use boosters, unlock sleigh upgrades, and meet Santa’s trusty reindeer team.

Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning 3D visuals, snow effects, and colorful holiday scenes.


�� Bring the magic of Christmas to your home!
Play Santa Holiday Adventure Game now and enjoy hours of festive fun with your family this holiday season!

title: Bus Jam: Pick up them all!
description: Bus Jam is an addictive traffic puzzle game where you navigate through a parking jam! Experience the rush of traffic mania as you strategically move cars out of the way to help your bus escape. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who love traffic escape challenges!

title: Castle Claw
description: Castle Claw is a fast arcade strategy game where every capsule pull changes the battle. Move the claw, drop it into the capsule field, summon units, and push your army toward the enemy castle. Between runs, upgrade claw size, claw speed, army health, army damage, and support claws. The game includes a 30-level campaign, endless mode, daily quests, weekly contracts, skins, command talents,  storage, lifecycle messages, and leaderboard submission.

title: Draw Dot Picture Game
description: Welcome to Draw One Miss Part Brain Games, the addictive puzzle game where logic, drawing, and brain games come together! Think you’re good at spotting details? Test your skills by identifying the missing part in each scene, and use your finger to draw it back in. Sounds simple? These brain puzzles are trickier than you think!

title: Samurai Survivor
description: In the land of ancient Japan, a mysterious portal has opened, unleashing hordes of monstrous creatures into the world. As the last line of defense, a group of brave samurai warriors must stand against the onslaught to protect their homeland. Each warrior possesses unique skills and abilities, handed down through generations, to combat the dark forces. Together, they must fight to close the portal and restore peace to the land.

title: Traffic Racer 3D
description: Traffic Racer 3D drops you behind the wheel of a high-speed sports car on an endless highway packed with traffic. Weave through cars at full throttle, rack up near-miss bonuses, and chase the longest distance you can survive. Earn coins on every run to unlock a garage of new vehicles — from agile hatchbacks to heavyweight muscle cars — and upgrade your fuel, top speed, and armour to push deeper into the chaos. With multiple challenge levels, an endurance mode, and a star-rating system that rewards skilful driving, every run pushes you to beat your best.

title: Sheep Escape: Farm Sorting Challenge
description:
Sheep Escape: Farm Sorting Challenge is an exciting casual puzzle game about a farm full of animals! Help the sheep find their way out and make a great escape from the farm.

On the field you will see sheep that can move only in straight lines. Think ahead, plan your moves, and guide the animals along the correct path to clear the field and complete the level.

Each level is a new challenge: more sheep, more obstacles, and trickier combinations. Use logic and strategy to solve farm puzzle tasks and help every animal escape.

Game features:
• Simple and intuitive sorting mechanics
• Fun and challenging puzzle levels
• Cute sheep and a cozy farm atmosphere
• Relaxing casual gameplay
• Interesting logic challenges

Are you ready to help the sheep escape? Solve farm puzzles and complete all the levels!

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It's a casual puzzle game about animals on a farm. Your goal is to help the sheep escape from the farm.

Q: What is the main hook of the game? What makes it stand out to players?

A: It features simple and intuitive sorting mechanics, unique puzzle levels, adorable sheep, and a relaxing farm atmosphere perfect for casual play.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What’s the best way to level up faster?

A: Progression is level-based; you can earn extra coins by watching ads after completing a level to speed up your progress.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What types of currency are in the game and what can they be spent on?

A: The game uses coins, which can be spent on boosters to help clear levels as well as various character skins.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?

A: Yes, the game features in-app purchases that allow you to buy boosters and coins to assist with your progress.

Q: Does the game offer customization? Can you change the appearance of your character, environments, or vehicles?

A: Yes, you can purchase clothing for the sheep, trail effects for when they run, and different skins for the fields and roads.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you climb the ranks and what types are available?

A: Yes, you can climb the leaderboards by completing as many levels as possible.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or can the game be played without it?

A: While the music enhances the overall atmosphere and complements the gameplay, it is not required to complete the levels.

title: Panda Go!
description:
Panda Go: The ultimate test of reflex and rhythm!
Tap to soar through glowing rings, chain perfect combos, and dodge mind-bending obstacles. Collect coins, power up with shields and magnets, and unlock unique pandas. Simple to play, impossible to put down—how far can you fly?

title: Close Ads
description:
A fast chaos arcade game where your only goal is simple: close ads.
But every few levels, the ads become more annoying.

title: skyfall siege
description: In this fast paced aerial battleground, I wanted to create a pure, adrenaline-driven experience where every second counts. You’ll face relentless waves of enemies descending from the skies, and survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and smart movement.

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
Grab power-ups mid-chase
Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
Grab power-ups mid-chase
Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: This is Blast
description:
Ready to blast your way through puzzles? Welcome to This is Blast, the exciting blast game that combines colorful puzzles, explosive chain reactions, and addictive ball blast mechanics. If you’re searching for a fun, free, and challenging puzzle blast game, you’ve found it.

From the very first shot, This is Blast delivers an experience that is simple to play yet packed with depth. Aim carefully, unleash your balls, and trigger epic blasts that clear the board in a single swoop. With intuitive controls, smooth visuals, and clever puzzles, this game keeps you hooked whether you want a quick session or hours of puzzle-blasting fun.

title: Car Runner
description: Car Runner is an exhilarating low-poly arcade racing game with puzzle-platformer elements set in surreal, gravity-defying environments. Players navigate a compact delivery van through twisted, winding pipes and looping checkerboard tunnels, dodging hazardous obstacles like spinning giant red windmills, wooden barriers, and scattered boulders. The core unique selling point is the combination of momentum-based tunnel racing with high-stakes physics, where mastering the curves of the track is just as important as maintaining high speed to scoop up valuable gold coins.

title: FatBoy Dream
description: Join an exciting adventure in **FatBoy Dream** as a playful child hops between donuts, gathering delicious treats. This engaging online game promises a sugar-coated thrill for sweet enthusiasts, challenging you to leap higher without falling. Ideal for those seeking fun and excitement on **mobile and desktop** devices.

title: Max: The secret of Grandpa's letter
description:
A treasure hunt quest. Meet Max, a young wolf who dreams of adventure. One day, Max receives a letter from his late grandfather, who, like any good grandfather, always loved to play riddles with his grandson. Even after he passed away. With the letter, Max receives a treasure map and mysterious clues from his grandfather's old notebook. This means it's time to pack a backpack and embark on a journey!
Embarking on an exciting journey, our friendly wolf cub will face simple yet fun challenges. Max's path leads to the mysterious Island of Lost Ships, where the routes of sailors end and the adventures of true treasure hunters begin! 
With enthusiasm and a wagging tail, Max sets out to find his grandfather's treasure. Are you ready to unravel mysteries and become true adventurers alongside him? Let's embark on a new journey of discovery!

title: Nubik Courier: An Open World
description: Nubik Courier: An Open World is an exciting delivery game that turns you into a skilled pizza courier racing through lively city streets. Navigate obstacles and switch vehicles as you complete each delivery, all while enjoying free online play. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it's perfect for casual gamers seeking thrills.

title: King of pirate
description:
Try yourself as a brave pirate, able to repel the attack of enemy zombies! 🧟
Show dexterity and attentiveness!

title: Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess
description: "Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess" is a cozy online party game where one player draws a word, and the others try to guess it as quickly as possible. You can play with friends in a private room or jump straight into a quick game with other players. The built-in chat helps you discuss your guesses and have fun, and the leaderboard system keeps track of your progress and shows you the best guessers. The game works directly in your browser, without downloading, supports keyboard and mouse, and is perfect for short sessions after school or work.

title: Rotcalypse Idle
description:
Rotcalypse is a satirical idle tycoon where you monetize digital decay. Transform questionable content into pure profit, scaling from primitive RotToks to a global Brainrot VR-machine.
No thinking required—only expansion. Your goal is the total degradation of the internet for the sake of infinite numbers. Experience a dark reflection of social media addiction, perfect for "killing" time.

title: Tangram Triangle
description: Tangram Triangle is a captivating mobile puzzle game that reimagines the classic tangram tradition with triangular blocks, challenging players to drag and rotate colorful pieces—blue, yellow, red, and orange—to perfectly fill irregular silhouettes on a grid. Its core idea revolves around spatial reasoning and problem-solving, blending accessibility for all ages with progressively tougher levels and a time-attack mode for high-score chases, making it uniquely addictive through clean visuals, hundreds of puzzles, and family-friendly brain-teasing fun.

title: Flag Merging Game - Puzzle Game
description: Are you ready to discover the flags of the world? 🌍 With 8 language options (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese), 75 challenging levels await you. Beat the clock by grabbing and dropping the flags that appear 🎮, then merge two identical flags to clear the target ones! 🎯 As each level gets harder, you can unlock 12 mysterious achievements 🕵️‍♂️ and power up with two upgrades: increase your coin rewards 💰 and gain extra starting time ⏳. Show your strategy, speed, and reflexes to become the ultimate flag master! 🏆

title: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky
description: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky is a captivating logic puzzle game set in a lush forest meadow, where players connect pairs of numbered construction blocks with precisely the exact count of road segments—no more, no less—to link all cities and clear the board within time limits, earning stars and trophies in increasingly challenging levels tracked by a dynamic timer and handy undo feature.

title: Heroic knight
description: Heroic Knight is an engaging puzzle adventure game where you guide a valiant knight through treacherous terrains to achieve glory and seize hidden treasures. This free-to-play, browser-based game requires no download or registration, allowing you to dive directly into an epic medieval quest. Strategically maneuver through obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and vanquish formidable foes on your journey. The game's captivating 2D world is perfect for fans of mind-bending puzzles and adventurous escapades, offering a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile platforms.

title: Toytopia
description: Toytopia is a cozy merge game where you are tasked to combine and produce art materials which you can use to fix broken toys. Each toy presents a unique challenge and difficulty.

title: Move Emoji
description:
Move Emoji Match Puzzle

Welcome to Move Emoji Puzzle! In this game, your task is to match emojis by moving them around. You have to think carefully because you only get a certain number of moves to solve each puzzle. 

Be smart about using your moves! If you use up all your moves and haven't cleared the puzzle, you'll lose the level. The goal is to match all the emoji boxes to clear the level and move on to the next fun challenge!

title: Go! Up! Samurai
description: Go! Up! Samurai offers an action-packed HTML5 gaming experience. Dive into a vibrant samurai realm, where quick reflexes and smart tactics are essential. Players must skillfully maneuver through various challenges and foes, emphasizing accuracy and ability.

title: Pop Balloon
description: Pop Balloon is an exhilarating and fast-paced arcade game that combines precision with rapid reflexes. In this game, players are challenged to pop as many balloons as possible using a set of bouncing spikes. The objective is simple yet addictive: aim and launch the spikes in such a way that they hit and burst the balloons scattered across the screen.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

With simple controls, satisfying destruction mechanics, and progressive upgrades, Space Cleaner delivers relaxing but addictive gameplay for fans of arcade and idle-style space games.

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Discover the intriguing realm of Eco Block Puzzle, where strategy and environmental healing converge. Solve complex puzzles to cleanse the planet and earn eco coins, introducing new life to the restored valley. Enjoy this unique blend of traditional puzzles and eco-friendly play on your device. Join the journey of creativity and restoration!

title: Fun Toy Pals
description: Step into a cozy playroom and explore a world full of charming toys! In this addictive merge game, your goal is to combine matching toys on the colorful carpet to create higher-level toys. Unlock achievements as you reach higher scores and compete with players around the world on the global leaderboard. Cute visuals, fun combinations, and endless merging challenges make this game perfect for casual gamers of all ages.

title: Art'N Ball
description:
Art'N Ball is a mix between classic tennis and 3D platform game. The player will travel different locations within the Art’N Ball rolling-out world, skillfully returning his Earth-ball to have it pass walls, art exhibits, photo and puzzle challenges to finally set it free from its enclosed gallery pathway into infinite Space. 

He will experience different levels of complexity as the Earth-ball takes him from countryside or mountainous territories to the inner bowels of the underground, the depths of the seas, past frantic cityscapes towards arty lush landscapes and onto a surprise finish journey in orbit…

title: Hex Mine 3D
description:
Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where every move matters. Explore beautiful spherical hex worlds, clear the correct tiles, and solve carefully designed levels with logic, focus, and precision.
Each level presents a unique hex-tile pattern wrapped around a 3D globe. Your goal is simple: analyze the board, make smart choices, and complete the puzzle without mistakes. As levels progress, the layouts become more challenging with larger patterns, trickier tile placement, and deeper strategy.
Rotate, inspect, and solve each hex puzzle at your own pace. Easy to understand, satisfying to play, and challenging to master.

Features
Unique 3D hex puzzle gameplay
Beautiful globe-style puzzle boards
Carefully designed level-based progression
Simple controls and clean visual style
Increasing difficulty across many handcrafted levels
Relaxing but brain-teasing puzzle experience
Perfect for short play sessions or focused puzzle solving

title: Colors&Forms
description: Colors&Forms is a thrilling online game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Enjoy a variety of entertaining puzzles and colorful designs without any downloads. With different game modes available, you’ll find countless challenges to complete as you progress through the levels.

title: Liquid Sort
description:
Dive into a calming yet addictive puzzle experience where every move matters.

In this trendy liquid sort game, your goal is simple: organize colorful liquids into the right containers. But don’t be fooled—each level brings new challenges that test your logic, planning, and attention to detail.

Watch vibrant colors flow smoothly as you pour, stack, and solve your way through increasingly satisfying puzzles. Whether you’re looking to relax your mind or sharpen your thinking, this game strikes the perfect balance between chill vibes and brain-teasing fun.

Features:
• Smooth and satisfying liquid animations
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Easy to learn, tricky to master
• No time limits—play at your own pace
• Clean, modern visuals with a relaxing atmosphere

Can you master the art of sorting?

title: Viaducts
description:
Viaducts - Relaxing Zen Puzzle Game

Embark on a serene journey with Viaducts, the latest trending cozy, and meditative puzzle game designed to transport you into a world of calm challenges and scenic landscapes. Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of relaxation and strategy as you craft seamless paths for trains and objects using a limited number of attempts.

Viaducts is more than just a puzzle game;

It's a mindful escape into a world where challenges are met with grace, and success is achieved through thoughtful contemplation. Let the rhythmic flow of trains and the gentle rotation of bridge blocks guide you through this truly relaxing and trending gaming experience.

title: Raised Knight
description:
Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test!
Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!

title: Raised Knight
description:
Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test!
Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!

title: Animal Blocks
description: Animal Blocks is a delightful fusion of block puzzle mechanics and charming animal-themed visuals. Crafted for casual fun, this game offers a colorful and relaxing experience perfect for quick play sessions or winding down.

title: TANKNAROK
description: Step into the explosive world of TANKNAROK, the definitive top-down multiplayer arena shooter built for intense, quick-fire web combat. Forget long downloads and complex setups—this is pure, competitive chaos delivered straight to your browser. If you love fast-paced action, dynamic destruction, and competitive gameplay, TANKNAROK is your next addiction.

title: Bottle Color Match Challenge
description:
Your task is simple but thrillingly challenging: arrange the bottles so that the colors match! Move, combine, and find matches to complete the level.

✨ Why will you love it?
✔ Simple yet addictive – easy to start, hard to stop!
✔ Vibrant graphics – pleasing colors and smooth animations.
✔ Relax or challenge yourself – play for fun or race against the clock.
✔ Perfect for all ages – fun for the whole family!

Can you beat all the levels? Test your wits and become a true Bottle Master! 🏆

👉 Start playing right now! 👈

title: Noob: Big Item Sorting
description:
Do you enjoy keeping things tidy? Do you enjoy sorting things?

Then this game is for you! Introducing a fun new game all about sorting and cleaning!

😻In this exciting puzzle, you'll find identical objects and match them together. Arrange the objects so that two identical ones end up next to each other and form a double.

🎁Match items in pairs to advance through the levels!
Cleaning has never been so enjoyable and exciting!

🎮"Noob: The Big Object Sorting Game" is a light and calming game suitable for anyone who loves order, regardless of age or gender!

title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
description:
Challenge your memory, speed and attention in "Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training". Watch boxes appear, remember the count, then submit your guess faster and more accurate each round wins.

Enjoy single-player focus mode or competitive rounds vs local friend or multiplayer. Simple tap controls, short rounds, addictive replayability perfect for quick brain workouts on desktop and mobile.

Train memory, logic, agility and reaction time now!

title: Pim Path
description:
Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over.
You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.

title: Boba Blast
description:
Fast, head-to-head pearl-duel game. You and a rival each face a spinning mega-ball of colorful boba pearls. Shoot matching pearls to pop them in satisfying chain reactions, chip away at the cluster, and be the first to clear your ball.

Matches feel like a competitive arcade duel: aim carefully, manage limited shots, and race the clock while your opponent does the same. Wrong-color hits ricochet instead of popping, so every throw matters.

title: Italian Brainrot: Popper Crazy
description:
Welcome to Italian Brainrot: Popper Crazy!💥
Join 125 thrilling levels packed with quirky characters, plan your moves, and put your skills to the test. 🎯🧩
But be careful! ⚠️ Some characters hide deadly mines that can cost you a life — every move counts! ⏳❤️

Upgrade your abilities: boost your tap power, increase your starting lives, and unleash powerful bombs to clear the screen in one go! 🚀
Each level gets tougher, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥

Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮
Enjoy the excitement in 16 supported languages from around the world. 🌍🗣️

title: Cube Smash
description: Enter the exciting realm of Cube Smash, a free online game where you break colorful cubes. Use strategy to choose projectiles, earn currency for upgrades, and unlock various ammo. Prepare for greater challenges, whether you're playing on mobile or desktop!

title: 99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads
description:
99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads - Defeat monsters and rescue lost children!

What's in the game:
30 levels with various monsters from the forest!
The ability to assemble a squad of different characters with unique abilities!
Level up your characters and improve their skills!

title: Crazy Bob
description:
Ready for a crazy adventure across floating islands?

Take control of Crazy Bob, battle dangerous enemies, cause explosive chaos, and fight for survival in a world full of challenges.

Explore floating islands, overcome traps and obstacles, complete quests, and unlock new portals to unexplored lands.

title: Merge Items Build City
description: A game about building a city. Make houses and streets simple for the residents of the city and make the lives of the citizens happy.

title: Block Puzzle: Prize Mania
description:
A classic block-drop puzzle that transforms into a true collector’s experience!

Drag pieces onto the grid, clear lines, and enjoy satisfying combos. But the real hook? 32 unique collectible items with awesome abilities.
Before each match, you build your loadout: pick up to three items that work together.

One boosts your score, another lets you blast blocks, and a third changes the board rules. Every combination delivers a fresh, highly engaging playstyle.

All items are pulled from the gacha machine. Use a ticket, pull the lever, and feel the thrill as a capsule rolls out and pops open to reveal your newest gear.

title: Voxel Master
description:
A 3D puzzle and builder in one! Assemble volumetric models from colored blocks using hints, or create your own masterpieces in sandbox mode.


Two game modes:
- Puzzle mode — hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty. You're shown a model and must recreate it block by block.
- Sandbox — free 3D modeling on grids of various sizes. Save your creations and share them with friends.

title: Twist Your Path
description:
This is a single-player arcade game about reaction and focus. The character runs forward along a rotating trunk, and your task is to turn the path at the right moment to avoid obstacles. The longer you survive, the higher your score becomes.

You can collect coins during runs and use them to unlock new characters. The game is built for short sessions: the rules are simple, but the speed and direction changes quickly make every run tense.

title: DOP Fun: Delete One Part
description:
Play the popular logic game DOP Fun: Delete One Part! This game invites you to use logic to tackle engaging and smart puzzles, each erasure unveiling new secrets. Prepare to become a true detective as you explore images and uncover the hidden mysteries behind them. Get ready for each level to surprise you with unexpected plot twists!  

Simple and clear gameplay makes DOP Fun: Delete One Part the perfect choice for anyone looking for quality entertainment. Simply swipe the eraser across the screen to remove parts of the drawing and discover what is hidden behind it. The game is suitable for both children and adults, enhancing skills in critical thinking and attention to detail.  

Enjoy the colorful graphics and creative challenges that will keep you entertained. It strengthens mental abilities and provides tons of fun for players of all ages.

title: Gun Blast
description:
Fast-paced arcade shooter where every tap fires your weapon and flips it through the air, turning recoil into movement. Master ricochets, chain precise shots, and stay in control as you bounce around the screen in chaotic, skill-based action.

Switch between different weapons like SMGs and shotguns, each with unique feel and strategy, and adapt on the fly to survive longer. Grab powerful upgrades such as rockets for explosive shots and shields for protection, adding depth to every run.

Simple to learn but hard to master, the game delivers nonstop action, satisfying mechanics, and endless replayability.

title: Merge Builders
description:
Open. Merge. Build! Dive into a bright and cheerful merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble the ultimate toolkit and construct beautiful houses step by step.
Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical tools—like screwdrivers, paint rollers, and hammers—to upgrade their efficiency. Strategically hand the best tools to your four hardworking builders stationed around the foundation. They’ll work automatically while you focus on optimizing your board. Watch in satisfaction as the house realistically takes shape and grows right before your eyes!
Take on increasingly ambitious construction projects, from a Cozy Cottage to a Grand Mansion. Each new building brings escalating requirements that will push your merging tactics to the limit.
Grab limited-time gift events, boost your progress with Efficiency x2, and activate Auto-Open to speed up your workflow. Every decision matters as your building empire scales endlessly. Finish projects, earn rewards, and see how far your crew can go in an infinite challenge of fun and strategy.
Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your team can construct any dream home!

title: Twisty Planet
description: Twisty Planet is a minimalist arcade-style game in which your goal is to survive as long as possible on a rotating planet, dodging obstacles while collecting items to boost your score.

title: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle
description: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle is a thrilling pirate-themed bubble shooter puzzle game where players fire numbered cannonballs from a mega cannon at the bottom to match and sink clusters of enemy hex-shaped pirate boats bearing the same numbers floating above the water, conquering challenging levels in an epic sea battle.

title: Uphill Racer2
description: Uphill Race2 is a fun and challenging physics-based driving game where you race across hilly terrain and rough roads. Control your car carefully, balance your speed, and climb as far as possible without flipping over. Collect coins, unlock new vehicles, and upgrade your ride to go even further. The farther you go, the harder it gets!

title: Color Match Rush
description:
Color Match Rush is a lightning-fast, one-thumb reflex arcade game built for quick sessions
and high-score obsession. A glowing ring of colored segments spins at the center of the
screen while colored dots rush inward toward a fixed gate at the top. Your only job sounds
simple: rotate the ring so the segment under the gate matches the color of the incoming dot.
Nail it and your score climbs; pick the wrong color even once and the run is over. There are
no second chances — just you, your reflexes, and the next dot closing in.
What makes Color Match Rush so addictive is how the pressure ramps up. You start with four
colors and a calm pace, but

title: Worms
description: Worms Puzzle is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you help cute, colorful worms find their way across small tile boards. Just swipe to move, collect dots, and reach the goal — it’s easy to learn but gets more interesting as you play! With bright visuals and bite-sized levels, it’s perfect for quick breaks or winding down anytime.

title: 21 Rush - Ultimate Card Game
description:
Welcome to 21 Rush : Ultimate Card Game - A smart, fast paced card challenge that blends the thrill of Blackjack with the strategic depth of Solitaire. Designed for both casual fun and competitive mastery, 21 Rush rewards sharp thinking, quick decisions, and clever Combos!

A single game takes only just few minutes... but chasing high scores and perfect runs will keep you hooked for hours!

🧠 Easy to Learn. Hard to Master.
Whether you’re an aspiring card counter or a casual card lover, 21 Rush offers a perfectly balanced experience:
• Play relaxed games at your own pace
• Or push your limits and compete for the highest scores
Every move matters. One wrong card can change everything.


⭐ KEY FEATURES:

✅ Fast & Addictive Gameplay
• Play quick matches on the go, at home, or while travelling.

✅ Strategic TRASH Button
• Skip dangerous cards and avoid busting critical lanes.

✅ High-Score Driven Design
• Chase Streaks, lane bonuses, and perfect plays to beat your personal best.

✅ Challenge Mode
• Face fresh challenges that introduce new twists every time you play.

✅ Helpful Tips & Tricks
• Learn advanced strategies through the in-game Help section.

✅ Smooth Touch Controls
• Optimized for Android mobiles & PC with responsive controls.

✅ Fast Loading & Smooth Animations
• Lightweight, polished, and performance-friendly.

✅ Customization Options
• Unlock and customize card backs and background themes.

✅ Blackjack-Inspired Fun
• Enjoy the essence of Blackjack in a brand-new strategic format.

🏆 Can You Master the Rush to 21?
• Perfect your strategy.
• Chain massive combos.
• Climb higher with every run.

Play 21 Rush - your Ultimate Card game now!

title: Parkour World 2
description:
Welcome to Parkour World 2, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. 
-Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. 
-While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles.
-Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!

title: Space Blast
description: Space Blast is a 2D game full of action arcade game where your piloting skills and strategic thinking are key to navigating relentless waves of meteors. Command a powerful spaceship equipped with advanced weapons and take on the challenge of protecting the galaxy from incoming threats.

title: Ghost Guard
description: Shoot all ghosts before they reach you! Use arrow keys on PC, or tap on screen quadrants on mobile. Be careful, as some ghost will change directions!

title: Noobik Arena - 99 nights
description: Noobik Arena - 99 nights is a fast 3D survival arena where the hero fights waves of monsters, collects coins and experience, unlocks upgrades, and improves weapons. Between waves, you can build defenses: place turrets, fences, and barracks, select buildings with a click, and upgrade their stats. Survive as long as possible by combining weapons, grenades, dashes, perks, and defensive structures against increasingly dangerous enemies.

title: Time Travel: Tower Rush - TD
description:
TRAVEL THROUGH TIME & DESTROY ENEMY BASES!  Step into a thrilling time-hopping journey in this dynamic idle tower defense game! Build and evolve your ultimate tower armed with deadly weapons, powerful abilities, and epic upgrades. Battle your way through the ages — from ancient kingdoms to futuristic warzones and magical lands. Can you stand against the relentless waves of demons, skeletons, and mythical beasts?
 BUILD & UPGRADE YOUR FORTRESS
 Expand your stronghold floor by floor into a towering war machine
 Equip it with lasers, traps, and a variety of unique firearms
 Strengthen your power with upgrades and special synergy effects
 Personalize your tower with exclusive styles and boosts

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description:
You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

Oversee your business, upgrade your stations, and hire employees to keep everything running smoothly. Even when you're offline, your gas station continues to earn! This isn't just a simulator—it's your path to success and the fun of managing your own mini-empire.

Game Features:
⛽ Upgrade your gas station and service more cars
🍔 Cook hot dogs and open a cozy cafe
🛒 Add a store and restroom for customers
💸 Earn money even when you're not playing
🏆 Become the ultimate gas station boss!

title: Robot Unicorn Dash
description:
Enter a dreamy, neon world full of sparkles, stars, and rainbow roads. 
In Robot Unicorn Dash, your Robot Unicorn runs nonstop through magical landscapes where every second gets faster and harder. 
Jump over gaps, dodge dangerous obstacles (like dark crystals), and keep the run alive as long as you can while chasing a new high score.

title: Hook King Runner
description: Hook King Runner is a physics-based runner where you tap, swing, and time your jumps to master wild obstacle courses. Use ropes and hooks with precision to dodge traps, collect coins, and outmaneuver enemies. With ragdoll physics and varied levels, your agility and timing are the keys to conquering every thrilling challenge that awaits.

title: Sleepwalkers
description: Discover a magical world with Sleepwalkers, where colorful characters need your help to find their beds. Navigate challenges and avoid dangers in this free online adventure. Play on any device and unveil the secrets of this captivating fairytale realm.

title: Cow Cow Run
description:
A cow was having a nice life, but all changed when the UFO nation came and wants to kidnap the cow. Help the cow avoid the UFOs while collecting coins to buy it’s freedom!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: The game is similar to 3D Pacman where you need to escape from aliens while being a cow, to complete a level you need to collect all the coins on the level.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: There are few similar games, pleasant cozy voxel graphics.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Coins are spent on upgrades and bonuses.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You can increase the chances of bonuses appearing.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Yes, there are achievements that players want to complete as they are related to mechanics.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties without sound?
A: You can play without sound, but the music and SFX are very pleasant.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: 10 levels.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, they are obtained as you progress and apply game mechanics.

title: Hand Daily
description: A daily card roguelite. Every day, the same 52-card deck deals across the world. Build five-card hands, chain joker effects, climb 5 antes, build a daily streak. Five minutes per run, one chance per day. Same hand for every player. Free, no install, no microtransactions.

title: Power ball soccer
description: Top down soccer game with special moves, 2 game modes, 16 characters, 32 levels. Unlock new characters. the next opponents are stronger than the previous ones.

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action game where you take to the skies on a broom, engaging in battles against hordes of enemies! Collect experience points from defeated foes – experience that will help you level up and grow stronger. Explore new spells and evolve the ones you've unlocked to defeat enemies even faster. Face a variety of different enemy types and challenging bosses attempting to halt your progress. Accumulate coins to unlock new, faster, and more agile brooms. Don't forget to upgrade your brooms to achieve maximum power. Combine different magical spells, each associated with its own element, and find your winning strategy! Two distinct game modes are at your disposal: a leveled game mode where you can train, explore new enemies, and, most importantly, conquer bosses; and an endless mode for those seeking to challenge themselves against wave after wave of monsters. Either way, good luck in battle – you'll need it!

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an intense zombie shooting survival game set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by the undead. You play as one of the last survivors, armed with powerful weapons to fight endless waves of zombies. Combining action shooting, survival gameplay, and strategic movement, the game delivers thrilling combat and nonstop excitement. Defeat enemies, collect rewards, upgrade your weapons, and survive against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes. With immersive environments, challenging missions, and fast-paced gameplay, every battle feels epic and rewarding!

title: Sweet Flip
description: Match delicious cakes of the same color, clear the board, and earn points! Unlock new flavors and increase the challenge as you progress. A simple yet addictive puzzle game with bright, tasty desserts.

title: Stack Swipe
description:
Welcome to Stack Swipe, a colorful puzzle game where every swipe brings you closer to satisfying chain reactions!
Swipe to shift entire rows or columns and stack same colored plates.
Match at least 5 plates in one stack to trigger a blast and work your way toward the level’s target!

title: Walk Master: Stilt Walker
description:
Ready for fun and a challenge?

Walk Master: Stilt Walker is an arcade walking simulator where you'll test your agility!

You start out clumsy, but the further you go, the cooler you become.

Stumble through forests and fields, level up your skills and become a real stilt master.

Unique levels and encounters with crazy creatures await you in Walk Master: Stilt Walker!

title: Line Control
description:
Line Control is a tactical game about routes, bases, and quick decisions. Draw lines from your points to neutral and enemy positions, send squads, and gradually take control of the map.

Every level is a new logic challenge. Sometimes you need to capture free points quickly, sometimes you must defend key positions, and sometimes one smart route can change the whole match. The more bases you control, the stronger your advantage becomes.

Simple controls make the game easy to start, while growing difficulty keeps every level tactical and engaging.

title: Spinner Clicker 2D
description: Spinner Clikcer 2D is an engaging progression-based game featuring a roster of 34 uniquely designed 2D fidget spinner models categorized across four distinct rarities, where players master 3 core gameplay mechanics: the Idle & Upgrades system to manually spin and permanently boost stats, the Collection system to unlock visually striking new spinners, and challenging Battle Encounters where players put their momentum and upgraded configurations to the test against scaling bosses.

title: Spin&Mow
description: You pilot a saw-chain robot — two spinning gears tethered by a serrated chain — across scalloped grass islands floating over deep water. Anchor one gear, watch the other orbit at chain length, then tap-swap to fling yourself across treacherous gaps. Cut grass to meet each stage's quota, dodge stumps, boulders and crystals, time landings on moving platforms, then touch the flag to escape. Upgrade Sharper Saws, Longer Chain, Reinforced Frame, Coin Magnet and Tuned Gearbox. Finish 20 stages to enter the Hall of Fame as a MOW-A-HERO.

title: Movie Star Daily Routine
description: Let's join the a day in the life of a movie star stream. We will spend the whole day with a famous actress from the series. The morning begins with cosmetic procedures and skin care. See how the skin of a movie star shines! Time to go in for sports to maintain excellent physical shape. Preparing for going to the gym begins with packing a bag - you need to take water, a yoga mat and other accessories. A star needs to look stylish even in the gym, so you need to get serious about choosing a tracksuit. It's time to put on your makeup and go to the screen test. The movie star will have to go through a casting and try on the image of the heroines of films and series. And finally, it's time to enjoy the glory. Having collected everything you need in a small clutch, the girl goes to the red carpet to amaze everyone with brilliant and original outfits!

title: Zestful Match
description:
Dive into a vibrant and refreshing tile-matching adventure with Zestful Match! Challenge your focus and strategy as you match three identical fruit tiles to clear the board. With juicy animations and premium aesthetics, it's the perfect game for quick sessions or hours of fun.

Key Features:

Juicy Match-3 Gameplay: Simple mechanics with satisfying visual effects.
Powerful Boosters: Stuck? Use Undo, Hint, or Shuffle to keep the game going.
Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against players worldwide!
Achievement System: Unlock medals for your skill and progress.
Fully Responsive: Flawless experience across mobile and desktop devices.

title: Maskinery Idle
description: Maskinery Idle is an incremental clicker game where you explore mysterious islands, fight enemies, and collect powerful masks that grant unique abilities. Clear all tiles on each location's grid to progress through 5 stages. Defeat the Boss on the final stage to complete the zone and unlock the next one. Collect gold to buy upgrades, earn energy to level up your masks, and use the Rebirth system

title: Draw & Drop
description: Dive into the thrilling universe of Draw & Drop, where creativity and skill collide! Navigate the ball into a basket by sketching your route, while overcoming tricky obstacles. Test your ingenuity through various levels, available for free on both mobile and desktop. Enjoy the challenge!

title: Love Archer Hero
description:
Welcome to Love Archer Hero game - one of the games about inspiring love feelings! In this interesting project, you play as a cheerful tricky Cupid, using your archer skills, bow and magic arrows of love to connect everyone and create loving couples!
Play have fun, solve puzzles and throw the arrow to a creature of your choice. After your arrow hits the target, they will fall in a beautiful garden and a magic of love will take them over.

Are you ready, my tiny Cupid hero? Shot your love arrows right into funny creatures' hearts to make them love each other and born a baby. Even the different types of creatures can make a solid couple and become happy parents. Combine orc and human for example and see how love conquers all!

title: Transport Run
description: Navigate the roads in Transport Run, a thrilling 3D traffic avoidance arcade runner! Drive your colorful vehicle along winding highways lined with pink trees and multi-lane traffic, dodging oncoming cars and buses to reach the goal without any crashes. The core idea is careful timing and precision driving in dense traffic—unique for its relaxing yet tense endless run style, isometric cartoon visuals with vibrant environments, and easy upgrades earned through skillful play that make each run feel progressively smoother and more rewarding!

title: Doodle RPG Survivor
description:
Scribble your way through waves of classroom doodles in this notebook-themed survivor RPG. Spells auto-cast. You just dodge and pick upgrades.
16 stages from elementary to university. 64 unique bosses. Spells with crazy combos. Many gear pieces to loot, upgrade, and stack.

title: Bounce Heroes
description: Bounce Heroes is a thrilling blend of idle RPG, merge puzzle, and roguelite action where your hero battles fierce monsters, an evil empire, and ancient beasts, all in pursuit of treasure and victory. Armed with a trusty crossbow and magical bouncy balls dropped by fallen foes, you’ll crush enemies wave after wave.

title: Moto Obby
description: Join the exciting world of Moto Obby, where your motorbike skills face intense challenges. Overcome tricky hazards like swinging hammers and sharp spikes in a quest for victory. Test your reflexes across various levels in this thrilling online game, available on phones and computers.

title: Fillblox
description:
An engaging logic puzzle where your goal is to fill the playing field with shapes. You're given several blocks of different forms — drag each one into place so that not a single cell is left empty. Sounds simple? With every level, the board gets larger and the pieces grow more numerous and more intricate.

An adaptive difficulty system adjusts to your pace — if you're blazing through levels too quickly, the game will throw a tougher challenge your way. Stuck? Use a hint to automatically place one piece in the right spot.

title: GeoVex - Daily Geography Challenge
description:
The daily map challenge for flag and geography nerds.

GeoVex is an engaging daily educational puzzle game that puts your world geography knowledge to the test.
In this map-based trivia challenge, you are presented with a series of national flags and must pinpoint their exact location on the globe. 

Play on Easy mode to see country names and map borders, or test your true expertise on Hard mode, with a completely borderless map!
Compete in the 10-round Daily Challenge to build your daily streak and share your score with friends!

title: Extreme Balancer
description: Extreme Balancer is an exciting and challenging game where you have to balance a ball on narrow wooden bridges and guide it safely to the end of each level. Be careful, if the ball falls off, you will have to start over! The game has beautiful 3D graphics and realistic physics that make it feel like you are really balancing the ball.

title: Ninja Survival Simulator
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Spaceball Jump
description:
Spaceball Jump is a thrilling, physics-based arcade game where you must navigate a glowing astronaut ball through a treacherous and beautiful galaxy. Your goal is simple: hop from planet to planet, collect all the golden stars, and unlock the portal to warp to the next sector!

But space is full of dangers. You'll need to time your leaps perfectly to utilize the rotational momentum of the planets while avoiding deadly orbital spikes, giant death stars, and the endless void of space. With 25 levels of increasing difficulty—featuring moving platforms, chaotic planetary clusters, and tight precision jumps—do you have what it takes to conquer the galaxy?


Features

Orbital Physics: Use the spin of the planets to slingshot yourself across space.

Hazards & Collectibles: Dodge spinning spike walls and collect 3 stars in every level to open the escape portal!

title: Find Visitors - 99 Nights
description:
Find Visitors - 99 Nights -  is an atmospheric game where you take on the role of the manager of a forest refuge. Let the forest creatures in and drive away the visitors.

Check for signs and identify hidden monsters – the visitors!

title: Legions: Way of War
description: Dive into the exciting world of "Legions: Way of War," a real-time strategy game that tests your tactical skills. Lead your troops to success by expertly positioning them and utilizing your heroes. Enjoy this captivating blend of strategy and competition on any device!

title: Stickman Punishment 2
description:
According to the game's plot, Stickman has cruelly set up a player, who nearly died as a result. It's time to hold the insolent guy accountable and punish him for all his antics. The game offers ample opportunity to do just that, thanks to a unique superpower.
Choose any available punishment for Stickman!

title: Container Auction
description:
"Container Auction" — an exciting auction simulator! Bid on mysterious containers, competing against rivals. Peek inside through the door gap, assess the contents, and place your bid!

Open containers and discover items — from old books to gold watches and diamond brooches. Every item has its own rarity: common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary!

title: Stick Roll Arena
description:
Challenge your skills in Stick Roll Arena !



Roll the dice to summon your stickman army and push the enemy team off the platform.

Use strategy and timing to defeat your opponents in exciting 1v1 battles.



Features:

- Unique colorful stickmans

- Satisfying push mechanics and physics

- Simple one-touch controls

- Addictive gameplay with increasing difficulty

- Beatiful vibrant graphics



Can you become the ultimate arena champion? Roll the dice and find out !

title: Cut In Half
description: Cut In Half is a casual mobile slicing action game where the core concept revolves around precisely cutting objects, obstacles, and elements in half using a knife or sword to clear paths and advance. In its vibrant low-poly 3D cartoon world of grassy campsites and nature scenery, players simply tap to start each stage, collect coins for upgrades, and boost attack power (shown at 100% Lv. 1 in the screenshot) while navigating cute characters like the smiling yellow emoji ball. What makes it unique is the satisfying physics-based cutting mechanic combined with effortless one-tap controls, an intuitive upgrade system, and rewarding progression that turns simple slices into addictive, visually charming challenges.

title: 248 Scribble
description: 248 Scribble is a casual mobile merge puzzle game inspired by 2048, where players connect adjacent dots with matching numbers (like 2s, 4s, or 8s) horizontally or vertically on a colorful grid to merge them into higher values, aiming to achieve 248 while managing space and earning coins—its unique "scribble" art style with hand-drawn, vibrant, doodle-like tiles and intuitive touch controls sets it apart as an addictive, relaxing brain teaser.

title: SUM+SUM
description: Match the numbers. The numerical grid awaits your solution. Your task is to retain only those numbers that add up to the desired horizontal and vertical values. Eliminate the unnecessary, maintain balance, and uncover the logic behind each move

title: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme
description:
Bicycle Mountain Xtreme is a relaxing but challenging mountain biking game where you ride on epic trails, perform cool tricks, earn points, and unlock new trails as you get better. 
The game feels smooth and fun because it uses realistic physics, has procedurally generated trails, and includes a day/night cycle plus a dynamic weather system that changes while you ride.

title: Merge Emoji Arena
description: Merge Emoji Arena is an addictive casual idle-merge game where your favorite emojis come to life to battle! Build your ultimate army by purchasing basic emojis, merging identical ones to evolve them into stronger fighters, and deploying them to the front lines. What makes this game unique is its seamless blend of satisfying puzzle-merging with hands-free idle combat—your deployed emojis will continuously fight and farm gold for you even while you have the game running in the background!

title: Puzzle Candle
description:
Your goal is simple: Reach the end of each level -- but getting there won't be easy.
Solve tricky puzzles and master precise platforming to clear the stages. Use a variety of helpful items to turn the challenge in your favor and find clever ways to progress.
Explore a total of 50 levels set in different environments, each offering new obstacles and surprises.

title: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
description: Casual 2D puzzle game where you guide slimes safely to the exit. Instead of controlling them directly, you place simple instructions on a grid to change how they move.

title: Domino Camp
description:
🀄 Domino Camp is a fun and addictive puzzle game where strategy meets quick thinking! Match domino tiles, clear the board, and complete exciting challenges across a variety of levels. With simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying matches, Domino Camp offers endless entertainment for players of all ages.

🎯 Test your logic, improve your matching skills, and discover new ways to solve each puzzle. Whether you're looking for a relaxing experience or a brain-teasing challenge, Domino Camp is the perfect place to start your domino adventure! ✨

Features:
🀄 Easy-to-learn gameplay
🎮 Challenging puzzle levels
✨ Smooth animations and satisfying effects
🏆 Fun challenges and rewarding progression
🌟 Suitable for all ages

Join the camp and become a domino master in Domino Camp! 🚀🀄

title: Bird Game Clicker
description:
This is a clicker game about hesitation, doubt, and the eternal “well… maybe”.

In this world, birds never give clear answers.
To any question you’ll hear:
“I doubt it”, “50/50”, “unlikely”, “partially”, “hard to say” — and dozens of other evasive replies.

Click, collect feathers, and upgrade your flock of doubtful birds.
Unlock new ones and complete the full collection of the most uncertain creatures in the world.

🔹 Feathers — used for regular upgrades and faster progression
🌾 Grain — a rare currency for unique improvements and special bonuses
📈 Many upgrades with unexpected effects
🏆 Leaderboards — compete to become the most doubtful keeper of grain
💬 Chat — talk with other players who are just as uncertain

You don’t need to be right here.
You just need to doubt.

Become a legend of hesitation.
Or… maybe not.

title: Hexholm
description:
Hexholm is a fast, turn-based hex strategy game. Start from a single province and carve out a kingdom — recruit troops, claim the map hex by hex, and crush rival AI factions before they overrun you. Every battle is a tight tactical puzzle: manage your gold, position your units, and time your pushes to expand without overextending.

Take on 100 hand-picked campaign stages, fight for the top of the global leaderboard in the daily challenge, or jump into a quick random skirmish. Climb the worldwide rankings for total stages cleared and daily high scores.

No fluff, no waiting — just clean, snappy strategy you can play in a few minutes or sink hours into.

title: Escaping Arrows
description:
Ready to test your logic in a game where every move matters? Escaping Arrows is a minimalistic and deep puzzle game in which you have to untangle a complex knot of directions and paths.

The essence of the game is simple: there are arrows on the field, and your goal is to remove them all one by one.

What awaits you inside:

– 100 skill levels: Test yourself with tasks ranging from elementary to truly complex mazes.

– Special challenges: Every 5th level tests your skills with increased difficulty.

– The game is perfect for both short breaks and long evening sessions thanks to its anti-stress effect and smooth progression of difficulty.

Can you clear the field without making a single mistake? Test yourself in Escaping Arrows! Good luck!

title: Shape Ascent - Roguelite
description: Shape Ascent is a strategic puzzle game inspired by 2048, where you merge geometric shapes on a 5×5 grid to reach the legendary Ascent Crown. Starting with simple Triangles and Squares, you'll combine matching shapes by swiping in four directions — merging them into Pentagons, Hexagons, Stars, Crystals, Essences, and ultimately the Ascent Crown (8128). What makes Shape Ascent unique is its roguelike card system: every few moves, you're offered a choice of Power Cards with Common, Rare, and Epic abilities — from Score Boosts and Merge Bonuses to Emergency Saves and Auto-Cleanse effects that permanently alter your run. Manage your Undo charges, use the Remove Tile tool wisely, and plan every swipe to avoid filling the board. With 13 shape tiers, stackable card effects, milestone celebrations, and a save system that lets you continue where you left off, Shape Ascent blends classic merge puzzle satisfaction with strategic depth and replayability. Available in 6 languages.

title: Flows
description:
Flows is a cozy logic puzzle about sorting colored liquids between flasks. Tap one flask, then another, to pour the top color — your goal is to leave every flask filled with a single color (or empty).

✨ Features:
• 40 hand-tuned levels with a smooth difficulty curve
• Per-level time leaderboards — race the world for the fastest solve
• Optional hint system (rewarded ad)
• Clean minimalist visuals, calming palette
• Plays in 4 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português
• No accounts, no timers, no pressure — pick up and play

Perfect for short coffee breaks or long focused sessions.

title: Bomb Royale Online
description: Enter an explosive online battle royale inspired by classic bomber-style arcade games. Fight inside dangerous maze arenas where players compete in fast-paced multiplayer battles filled with traps, strategy, and nonstop action. Place bombs, destroy obstacles, outsmart your opponents, and survive chaotic chain reactions to become the last player standing. With unique bear characters and dynamic PvP combat, every match is a test of timing, positioning, and smart tactics.

title: Copy the Drawing
description:
