An exciting drawing game with hundreds of levels! Look at the example and recreate the drawing on the canvas — the more accurate, the higher your score.

The game features 300 levels across 18 categories: from simple shapes to animals, transport, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. Every day brings a new drawing of the day — build your streak and compete with yourself!

Three brush sizes, undo last stroke, hints, and a medal system — all designed to make drawing fun and enjoyable. Gold, silver, or bronze — which medal will your drawing earn?

title: JigRot
description: JigRot is a chill puzzler: drag scattered pieces, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full crazy brainrot picture locks in. Easy to learn, smooth to play, and built for a relaxing flow — one oddball pack after another when you want to unwind without pressure.

title: Hoppy Stacky
description:
A charming and captivating infinite game, Hoppy Stacky will keep players occupied for many hours!
In this vibrant world, your mission is to help the main character build a sky-high tower out of flying logs (sliders). Think of that as straightforward? Just give it a try! The game will constantly put your reflexes to the test as the sliders appear completely at random: they vary in size, come from unexpected directions, and move at unpredictable speeds.
Just one second of distraction and your tower could collapse. Do you have the agility and sharp timing to conquer the highest peak? Jump into Hoppy Stacky and prove your skills now!

title: Blind Box Master
description:
Blind Box Master is a cozy, hand-drawn blind box collection game. Open mystery boxes and discover 100 adorable collectibles across 6 rarities and 5 conditions (Broken to Mint).

Features:
• 4 box tiers, Lucky Charm upgrades & Legendary chases
• 20 cute themed series to collect
• Daily & weekly tasks, achievements, card-flip mini game
• Sell, haggle, synthesize 3 items into higher rarity
• Idle income & showcase your best finds

Tap to play. Desktop & mobile.

title: Sand Tetris Pro
description:
Sand Tetris Pro is a fresh take on the classic Tetris formula with realistic sand physics. When tetrominoes land, they crumble into hundreds of sand particles that behave like real sand, filling the level in dynamic and unpredictable ways. Instead of simply clearing rows, you must think about the flow of sand and how piles form and collapse.

The game features two main modes: Endless Mode and Campaign Mode, which includes hundreds of levels with objectives and up to three stars to earn for completing challenges.

Key features include dynamic sand physics, unique power-ups (bomb — destroys a large area; vacuum — removes accumulated sand; slow motion — gives you extra time to place pieces precisely), in-game currency, a booster shop, and a progression system.

title: 2048 Knights
description: 2048 Knights is a puzzle twist on the classic 2048. Slide your knights across the board, merge matching numbers to forge stronger units, and reach the goal in as few moves as you can. Every level is hand-crafted — plus daily challenges and 60-second time trials to keep you coming back.

title: Cube Quiz
description: CubeQuiz is a relaxing 3D spatial-reasoning puzzle. Two sandy voxel blocks fit together when one slides down and the other slides up to form a solid box. Rotate the pieces, read their shapes, and decide which ones lock perfectly together. Progress through four puzzle packs of increasing difficulty, then test yourself in endless Challenge mode. No timers, no pressure — just you and your mental rotation skills.

title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
description:
Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!
Key Features
•	Choose Your Pace with Two Modes:
o	Relax Mode: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no lives limit and no time pressure. Simply relax and solve puzzles at your own speed.
o	Challenge Mode: Put your logic to the test! This mode features limited lives (represented by the heart icon) and a time limit, challenging you to solve the farm layout before time runs out.
•	Interactive Tutorial: Easy-to-follow instructions guide you through your first placements, helping you learn to "cross out" cells where animals cannot be placed.
•	Helpful Tools: Use the "Find" or "Hint" features if you get stuck on a tricky arrangement.
•	Challenging Levels: Progress through increasingly difficult grids as you move from Level 1 onwards.
•	Cozy Visuals: Enjoy a clean UI and charming animal icons designed for a pleasant gaming experience.

title: Knight Crown Idle
description:
Game Details

What is Knight Crown Idle about?
Knight Crown Idle is a pixel-style idle RPG where you battle monsters, earn gold and experience, and grow stronger with every fight. Upgrade your hero’s abilities and explore new areas filled with challenges.

What’s the main goal in Knight Crown Idle?
The main goal is to defeat monsters, earn gold and experience, and continuously upgrade your hero to become stronger. As you progress, you unlock new areas, rescue trapped animals, and complete achievements while building a more powerful character.

Is Knight Crown Idle easy to control?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle features simple and intuitive controls, making it easy to pick up while focusing on progression and upgrades.

Can we play Knight Crown Idle on mobile?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle can be played on both mobile devices and desktop computers. It runs directly in the browser and does not require any downloads.

Is Knight Crown Idle free to play?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle is free to play and runs directly in your browser.

Can we play Knight Crown Idle in full screen mode?
Yes. The game supports full screen mode for a more immersive experience.

title: Cat Block Puzzle
description:
Cat Block Puzzle is a fun and relaxing block slide puzzle game with a cute cat theme. 
In this game, you slide blocks across the board and arrange them to match the target picture. 
Every level gives you a new puzzle to solve, and each move matters. 
It is simple to start, but it becomes more challenging as the puzzles get harder.

title: Build And Run
description: Build And Run is an exciting arcade game where you navigate, construct, and triumph! Play instantly on various devices without downloads or sign-ups. Race through levels while building ramps and defeating foes with diverse weapons. Customize your character with stylish gear and enjoy endless fun in both modes!

title: Mem Brawl: Merge Simulator
description: Merge Brainrot memes! Combine Skibidi Toilet, Gugugaga, Granny and legendary brainrot characters. Clicker + Arena battles. Build the strongest meme squad!

title: Spartan fruits
description: The Spartan fruits must overcome obstacles and find chests containing coins to unlock rewards and advance to the next stages. They must also collect gems to unlock new types of fruit.

title: Criss Cross Colors
description: Criss Cross Colors is a fun, addictive color-matching puzzle game that puts a vibrant twist on classic crosswords. Instead of letters, players drag and drop colorful blocks from the bottom palette to fill the grid, matching colors both horizontally and vertically to clear every square. With its simple one-tap drag controls, relaxing yet challenging gameplay, colorful cartoon style, daily rewards, hints, and timed levels, it delivers pure brain-teasing joy for all ages — the perfect mix of logic, color, and satisfaction!

title: Epicrolla
description: Epicrolla is a one-tap isometric roller. Your ball climbs a diamond grid hopping corner to corner — every tap flips its heading left or right, and it bounces off the edges. Survive the gaps, lava, boxes and spinning portals long enough to hit each stage's tile goal. Snatch item boxes for Invincibility, Coin Magnet, Slow-Mo, Dodge and Push power-ups, bank coins, and spend them on permanent upgrades, ball skins and a repeatable Second Chance. Easy to pick up, hard to master.

title: Merge Fruit Monster Defense: Tower Defense
description:
A bizarre infection has brought huge changes to the world. Ferocious little monsters are getting ready to attack. But Tao is never scared, because all kinds of magical fruit warriors are holding the line firmly! Your goal is to protect Tao and stop monsters from eating her!
Game Features
Creative mixed gameplay of backpack merging, roguelike and tower defense, featuring funny fruit characters and weird zombie monsters.
Simple backpack merging mechanics. You can easily experience character development, inventory sorting, silver coin management and tactical troop arrangement.
Fruit crossbreeding. After upgrading fruits to Tier 4 via merging, cross them with other creatures to gain stronger combat power and funny unique looks.
Hybrid monster styles. Most in-game monsters are designed with diverse crossbred visual styles.
Exclusive endless challenge mode. Start with plenty of silver coins to finish quick backpack merging. Countless monsters keep spawning nonstop for you to take on extreme battles.

title: Hunting Master
description: Become the ultimate hunter in Hunting Master, a fun and strategic archery shooting game set in a beautiful desert world! Jump between floating islands and use your bow to hunt wild animals like boars and wolves with precise shots. The core idea is aim, power, and chain reactions — shoot arrows to defeat animals and collect points while upgrading your bow with powerful abilities. What makes it unique? Stunning floating island visuals, satisfying bow-shooting mechanics with glowing effects, multiple power-ups (Meteorite, Thunder, etc.), and addictive progression as you become a stronger hunter in this desert hunting adventure!

title: Kitty Kitty
description: Kitty Kitty is a charming casual idle simulation game where players nurture and level up adorable kawaii cats in a festive snowy winter wonderland, collecting cat food as the core idle resource (with passive production like +50/s) to raise stats such as Sweetness and unlock new features via daily check-ins and challenges. Its unique appeal lies in the heartwarming blend of cozy cat-collection mechanics, customizable habitats (Toy Room, food bowls, Kitty Wiki, and recycling), and seasonal Christmas charm with Santa-hatted felines, decorated trees, and snowmen—all presented in vibrant, playful 2D art that emphasizes relaxed, feel-good feline care over competitive gameplay.

title: Recycle Game
description:
Turn trash into order and save the planet!

Recycle Game is a relaxing and oddly satisfying waste-sorting game that combines casual fun with a meaningful eco-friendly mission. If you love cleanup games, and zen-like puzzles, this one's for you!

Why you'll love Recycle Game:
ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY – Smooth controls and calming sorting mechanics. The perfect way to de-stress after a long day.
LEARN THROUGH PLAY – Master real-life recycling rules naturally. Paper, plastic, glass, metal – you'll become an expert without even noticing!

Key Features:
• Simple controls – just drag and drop, easy for all ages
• Relaxing vibes – calm aesthetics and satisfying feedback
• Global leaderboard – compete with players around the world
• Family friendly – safe, educational, and fun for kids and adults alike
• Progressive levels – from simple tasks to challenging recycling puzzles

title: Trash Baron
description:
Trash Baron: Turn trash into treasure!

Have you ever thought that trash is not waste, but a resource? In Trash Baron, you will create a waste recycling empire. Start with a small landfill and turn it into a high-tech enterprise!

Gameplay:
♻️ Collect and sort: Tons of waste - plastic, glass, metal, and rubber. Sort it all properly.
🏭 Recycle into goods: start production lines! We turn plastic bottles into new bottles and so on
💰 Sell and grow: the higher the quality of your recycled products, the higher the profit. Earn money to buy new equipment, expand your workshops, and hire employees.
📈 Become a baron: from a small waste collection point to the largest waste recycling plant in the city. The future of the environment and business is in your hands!

title: The Sort Agency
description: Take over the best sorting agency in the world! Sort fruit, cakes and toys! Find 3 identical items and they will disappear! Bring order in 1000 levels of this addictive and colorful 3D puzzle game!

title: My SweetStreet Shop
description: Sweet Street Shop is a charming shop management simulation where you run your own candy and pastry store. Serve customers, collect money, unlock new products, upgrade your character, hire helpers, and expand the shop into a successful sweet business

title: Crystalia
description: A vibrant block puzzle game. Place pieces on the board so that 3 or more blocks of the same color line up next to each other — and watch them vanish in a satisfying explosion. Simple rules, endless depth, and a fierce battle for the top spot on the leaderboard.

title: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense
description:
Archer Madness: Crystal Defense is an exciting casual tower defense game packed with endless waves of monsters, powerful archers, and addictive strategic gameplay!

The Crystal Core is under attack, and only you can protect it from the invading monster army. Start as a rookie archer and gradually unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your weapons, and build the ultimate defense lineup. Place Arrow Towers wisely, combine different tower skills, and create unique strategies to stop increasingly dangerous enemies.

Explore colorful worlds filled with forests, castles, and mysterious battlefields while enjoying smooth controls and satisfying combat. Collect resources, strengthen your archers, upgrade your towers, and discover powerful combinations to survive every wave.

Game Features:

• Fast-paced tower defense battles with endless monster waves
• Multiple Arrow Towers with unique skills and attack styles
• Train your archer and unlock powerful abilities
• Build different defensive formations and strategies
• Upgrade weapons, towers, and talents to defeat stronger enemies
• Bright cartoon graphics with beautiful maps and animations
• Easy to learn but challenging to master

Be brave and defend the Crystal Core! If it falls, the entire continent will become the monsters' kingdom!

title: Magic Aim
description: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game starring a chibi magician. Read the shifting wind, charge your wand, and fire arcing elemental blasts that split in mid-air to clear waves of monsters across hilly terrain. Dash for a better angle, raise an energy shield to block incoming fire, grab item drops that supercharge your next shots, then warp to a fresh layout. Unlike classic turn-based artillery games, every shot is live and fast — mastery is reading arcs and wind on the fly. Four elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth) each fly differently, so swapping changes how you read the same shot. Pixel-art, juicy, and easy to pick up for a quick run.

title: Supa Tic Tac Toe
description:
Tic-Tac-Deck evolves the classic grid into a brutal tactical arena. Forget simple X’s and O’s—here, your hand is your weapon.
Draft powerful cards to manipulate the board, sabotage your opponent, and shatter the rules. Will you control the field or execute a game-winning combo? Every card offers a one-time, high-impact ability that turns a stalemate into a checkmate. Master the deck, claim the line.

title: Tile Matcher Triple Fun
description: Tile Matcher Triple Fun is a relaxing triple tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong Solitaire, where players tap to find and match three identical fruit-themed tiles (like peaches, blueberries, and bananas) to clear the vibrant, stacked board against a tropical beach backdrop. Its core concept revolves around strategic triple matching to conquer increasingly challenging levels, with unique vibrant fruit designs, a serene seaside theme featuring a surfer and palm islands, and helpful tools like hints and shuffles for endless addictive fun.

title: Clash of Skulls
description:
Clash of Skulls is a tower defense game where you try to prevent enemies from destroying your base by deploying various types of units. Face a dangerous horde of evil creatures that intend to invade your lands. Combine and level up your units to have the upper hand and increase your damage output. Once you've taken care of the defense part, you can start planning your attacks to take over your enemy's territory. Hire skeleton warriors with blades, spears, scythes, explosives, battering rams, and much more... Go ahead and try it. Clash of Skulls rules!

This side-scrolling strategy game features a lane-based tug-of-war mechanic where players deploy diverse skeleton units to destroy the opponent's fortified tower. The gameplay loop centers on managing a regenerating mana resource to summon units from a card-based hand, including melee warriors, archers, and heavy-hitting bosses like the hog rider. Each unit automatically marches right toward the enemy base, engaging in combat upon contact. Victory is achieved by depleting the enemy tower's health bar displayed at the top of the screen. The visual style is a clean 2D cartoon aesthetic with flat vector graphics against a bright, tranquil backdrop of rolling green hills and blue skies. The color palette is dominated by vibrant greens, yellows, and blues, contrasting with the dark, gritty character designs of the skeletal army. A wooden HUD at the bottom tracks current mana and unit cooldowns, while the top UI displays player names and health bars. The tone is casual yet competitive, offering accessible pick-up-and-play mechanics suitable for a wide audience. Progression is indicated by an upgrade system accessible from the main menu, likely allowing players to strengthen their unit cards using earned currency to tackle more difficult bots or players.

title: Mole Kingdom Defense
description:
Mole Kingdom Defense is a charming tower defense adventure filled with brave little moles and endless battles!

Build your ultimate mole army, recruit powerful heroes, and defend your kingdom against waves of dangerous enemies. Each mole warrior has unique abilities—from fearless fighters and sharp archers to powerful mages with devastating magic.

Upgrade your heroes, unlock stronger weapons, and create the perfect strategy to defeat bosses and conquer challenging stages. With colorful graphics, adorable characters, and addictive idle progression, Mole Kingdom Defense offers endless fun for players of all ages.

Game Features:

• Cute and funny mole heroes
• Strategic tower defense gameplay
• Multiple hero classes and upgrades
• Fight epic bosses and enemy waves
• Idle rewards and easy progression
• Beautiful cartoon graphics and animations

Defend your kingdom and lead the Mole Army to victory!

title: Space Break
description:
Space Break is a casual pixel space shooter with great graphics and lots of locations!
Get into the fight against aliens in this pixel-art shooter game!
Upgrade your ship, explore different galaxies and defeat bosses!

Fight the alien invaders! Space Break is a great casual game to kill time.

What's in the game?
- Randomly generated waves of aliens for a new experience in each level.
- Endless gameplay, levels will never end
- Unique spaceship skins
- Boss battles
- Control with 1 finger or mouse
- All levels are randomly generated

Be careful - the game can be addictive!

title: Tick-Tack-What?
description:
Think you have mastered Tic-Tac-Toe? Think again! In this mind-bending twist on the classic game, you are playing against an AI opponent that absolutely refuses to play by the rules.
As you progress through increasingly complex and irregular board shapes, the bot will use an arsenal of dirty tricks to stop you from winning. From erasing your precious X's and locking cells, to literally dropping bombs on the board and faking its own victories! You'll need to stay one step ahead of its gravity-shifting, glitching, and rule-breaking mechanics.
Can you outsmart a machine that constantly cheats? Test your logic, adapt to unpredictable board mutations, and prove that human ingenuity can beat an unfair AI!

title: Chess Royale
description: A non-standard chess game in which kings have magical powers. The player needs to cut down the enemy king, building a victorious tactics by combining the queue of moves and magical abilities.

title: Snake Rush
description:
Get ready to dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Snake Rush! 🐍 Embark on an electrifying journey through this competitive twist on the classic Snake game. Challenge your survival instincts and strive to outmaneuver your opponents in the ultimate Snake Rush showdown!

With Snake Rush, you'll experience the timeless arcade fun with a fresh, modern flair. Engage in thrilling live events online, where the competition never sleeps! Can you climb to the top of the leaderboard and claim victory in this dynamic mobile adaptation of the arcade sensation?

Snake Rush merges cutting-edge visuals with the iconic gameplay mechanics of the original snake game, delivering an unmatched gaming experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Get ready to slither, dodge, and dominate your way to glory in Snake Rush! 🎮

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: Snake Rush is a game where you play as a slithering snake, surviving as long as possible by running into and defeating opponents.

Q: What is the game's unique feature? What will hook players?
A: Great graphics and unique, Indian-themed skins.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game features unique Indian-style skins and offers a revive option for watching an ad, which gives the player a chance to recover their progress after a mistake.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does leveling up work? What should players do to level up faster?
A: Cut off as many enemies as possible and complete tasks from the menu.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available, and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game has one currency, gold, which can be spent on skins for your snake.

Q: Is there character customization? Can the hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc., be configured?
A: Yes, you can purchase skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound make it difficult to progress?
A: The music complements the game and makes it more dynamic, but it is not necessary for completing the game.

title: Runic Curse
description:
Runic Curse is an action-adventure game where you step into the boots of Adrian, a shipwreck survivor stranded on a mysterious island. 
As you explore ancient ruins and cursed lands, uncover the secrets behind the Rune Curse and search for your lost crew. 
Face danger, solve mysteries, and embrace your fate in a world shrouded in shadows. 
Features Dynamic combat system with endurance management and rolls that give invulnerability frames. 
RPG elements: Level system with selective improvement of characteristics, equipment, and abilities for previously inaccessible areas. 
Many options for combining cold weapons and magic runes.
10 vast locations with various enemies and bosses. 
Crafting consumable runes and improving runes for weapons. 
More than 55 types of spells. 
New Game + in unlimited quantities. Boss Rush mode. Customization of the button layout.

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: Paws And Pals Diner
description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

title: Mavy The Fish Mom
description: Mavy is a devoted fish mom who takes care of her children by cooking food for them. It's an Idle farming game.

title: Car Escape Parking
description:
🚗🅿️ Car Escape Parking is a mind-twisting puzzle adventure where every move counts! The parking lot is packed, cars are stuck, and only your brain can solve the mess 🧠💥

Slide, move, and escape! 🚘➡️ Carefully shift each vehicle in the right order to clear a path and free the trapped car without crashing into obstacles 🚧😬 Sounds easy? Think again!

Each level brings a new parking nightmare 😵‍💫 — more cars, tighter spaces, and smarter challenges that will test your logic and planning skills to the limit 🔥🧩

✨ Features you’ll love:
🚗 Tons of tricky parking puzzles
🧠 Brain-boosting gameplay
🚦 Increasing difficulty with unique layouts
😌 Satisfying and relaxing problem-solving vibes

Can you escape the ultimate parking jam and become the true Parking Master? 🏆🅿️
Start your engine and prove it! 🚀🚘

title: Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot
description:
Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot A fun physics puzzle game: feed hungry animals from Italian memes by using gravity, logic, and creativity!

Is a one-of-a-kind physics puzzle game where your mission is to feed adorable and funny animals inspired by Italian memes. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity: manipulate objects, control gravity, and build action chains to deliver food straight into the paws or beaks of quirky creatures. The game offers dozens of levels with increasing difficulty, hilarious scenarios, surprising solutions, and signature humor. Attention to detail and precision will be the key to success, while your reward will be the grateful looks of happy, well-fed animals. Dive into a world of carefree fun, where physics is your main tool for playful experiments, and every completed level brings fresh emotions. Test your skills and prove that you can feed every Brainrot animal!

title: Gothic New Era
description: A goth-girl arrives at the new Academy. She did not suspect that she would fall into a nightmare, the abode of chaos and mysterious riddles. She will definitely like it there. But before the trip, the gothic princess needs to update her wardrobe while staying true to style. Only dark, gloomy shades, gothic dresses and school uniforms. Join her and help the gothgirl create a unique image of the dark princess and find friends.

title: EdgeFire
description:
EdgeFire is a fast-paced online shooter that throws you into thrilling battles against real players from around the world. Whether you're flying solo or teaming up with friends, every match is a chance to prove your dominance on the battlefield.

Sharpen your aim and unleash lightning-fast reflexes, earn rewards, and become the top player in each round. Outsmart your opponents with clever tactics and strategic plays that turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Dive into action-packed gameplay with a variety of stunning skins that enhance your experience and appeal to both seasoned shooter veterans and newcomers alike. Each battle is a fresh challenge, packed with intensity and adrenaline.

Step into the arena, test your skills, and rise to glory. Are you ready to dominate the fight?

title: Fruit Match
description:
A fresh twist on fruit puzzles!
Tap two identical fruits to detach them and send them falling into the basket.

But it’s not that simple — fruits follow real physics. They can get stuck, stack, and only fall further when you clear what’s below.
Use gravity to your advantage, trigger chain reactions, and watch satisfying cascades unfold.

Clear the board and keep the flow going as new fruits drop in!

title: Jewels Blitz 6
description: Jewels Blitz 6, the long-awaited 6th installment of the legendary Match 3 game that takes you deep into the mystery of ancient cultures of Central America. You will explore Mayan Temples and try to solve their secrets and mysteries. Enjoy hundreds of levels, Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges. Earn gold and magical items!

title: My Parking Lot
description: Welcome to "My Parking Lot," the ultimate puzzle challenge! Navigate through a chaotic mess of cars stuck in a parking lot and strategize to safely remove each vehicle without crashing them into each other. Your goal? Clear the parking lot by guiding all the cars to the exit, unlocking new levels as you master the art of precision parking. Can you untangle the traffic and solve each puzzle with finesse? Test your skills in "My Parking Lot" now!

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Bus Parking Out
description: Logic meets strategy! Operate 3 types of buses in 8 vibrant colors, each requiring careful planning. Enjoy a stunning 3D environment, as you clear the way for the selected bus and collect passengers. Master the art of optimal movement.

title: Garden Tales 4
description: Garden Tales 4 is one of the most anticipated Match 3 releases of the year. This long-awaited 4th sequel boasts 4,000+ incredible levels full of fun and adventure! Your longtime friend gnome Willy needs your help with collecting flowers, fruits and mushrooms in his magical garden. The more flowers and fruits of the same kind you combine, the cooler the extras you get in the game. Turn on the famous catchy soundtrack and dive into this magical adventure in the best Match 3 game there is!

title: Snow Rider 3D
description:
Owned by Ashima Prabhakar, email id : superapps25@gmail.com

Would you like to ride on a sleigh? Then, no need to go anywhere. Because now, you can experience riding a sleigh for free anytime you want in Snow Rider 3D. Although you are not actually on a sleigh, you will feel like you’re actually riding one because the game is in 3D. Try to go as far as you can to get high score. You may also collect gifts to purchase sleigh.

title: Bubble Shooter Extreme
description: Bubble Shooter Extreme is a HTML5 version of a popular Bubble Shooter game with awesome HD graphics. Additionally, the game is unusual because of it's complexity.  The more bubbles you remove in one shot the more score you'll get. Game is completed once all bubbles are removed out of the gamefield! If you are in a trouble you may use reward buttons to help you complete your mission in exchange for viewing a short sponsored content. Good luck and enjoy the game!

title: Geometry Arrow
description: Dive into an exhilarating journey through a treacherous cave! Your mission: reach the portal at the end of each level while avoiding deadly spikes and obstacles. With six progressively harder levels, you’ll need sharp reflexes and spot-on timing to survive. Can you conquer every challenge and make it out of the cave? Put your skills to the test in this high-speed action game!

title: Puzzle Blocks Classic
description: Get ready for an addictive block puzzle challenge! Drag and drop colorful blocks to clear lines and rack up points. Think ahead, make big matches, and unleash powerful Super Blocks to crush multiple lines at once! Stuck? Use boosters to keep the game going. With three chances to clear the center, aim for the highest score and climb the global leaderboard. Easy to play, hard to master—can you become the ultimate puzzle champion? Let the block-dropping fun begin!

title: Thread Match
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Thread Match — a unique and exciting puzzle where you sort colorful threads to complete embroidery patterns. Unravel layers of palettes, carefully working your way down to reveal hidden threads. Use logic and strategy to avoid running out of moves. But be careful — the color palette can be tricky, and every choice matters!

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4
description: The highly anticipated 4th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks including Australia, Antigua and Barbuda, Antarctica, Peru, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Majorca and the Easter Island in Chile! With incredible 3500+ levels, Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4 is one of the deepest Solitaire games of all time.

title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 6
description: The highly anticipated 6th installment of one of the most popular Solitaire Story card games of all time! Your good friend Foxy will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting countries, landscapes, and landmarks like Japan, Egypt, Brazil, Korea, New Zealand, Madagascar, North Pole, and Fiji. With 6700+ levels, Daily Missions, Weekly Air Balloon and Pet Events, and dozens of new card designs, this is the biggest Solitaire Story game yet!

title: Hexa Stack
description: Welcome to Hexa Stack—an all-new hexagon puzzle that’s equal parts relaxing and challenging. Sort colorful tiles by color, stack smart to create powerful combos, and think ahead before the board fills up. Each level adds new twists, requiring focus, memory, and clever planning. Stuck? Use boosters like swap and shuffle to keep your run alive. Simple controls, satisfying merges, and nonstop brain fun!

title: Bubble Rush
description: You are surrounded by colorful bubbles. You need to shoot bubbles in such a way as to form a group of three or more bubbles of the same color. When you use up all your available shots, a row of bubbles will approach you from above, below, or from the sides. When you completely clear one side, bubbles from that side will no longer appear

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5
description: The highly anticipated 5th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks.

title: Dream Pet Link 2
description:
Enjoy the endless linking gameplay of Dream Pet Link 2 online for free! In this tile matching game, it’s your goal to find and clear the doubles from the game screen. With dozens of cute animals and two different difficulty modes waiting for you, this is the perfect game to train your brain or relax.

The easy mode has fewer tiles and more hints available, and is ideal for leisurely play. If you’re up for a challenge, turn on hard mode!

title: Fruit Connect 3
description: Get ready for a tropical twist in Fruit Connect 3 – the juicy sequel to the popular fruit-matching puzzle series! This vibrant new chapter brings even more summer vibes, exotic fruits, and relaxing gameplay that fans love. Collect daily rewards, participate in limited-time summer events, and unlock fresh, fruity designs along the way. It’s a fun, family-friendly Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Candy Rain 8
description: Candy Rain 8, one of greatest Match 3 games of all time! It’s the only Match 3 Game to ever have the lucky 8 sequels! Because of its huge popularity, the players simply asked for more and we delivered. Candy Rain 8 is the deepest Candy Rain game we have ever made - with more levels, more candies, more waffles, more chests of coins and fun packed saga map to enjoy!

title: Sweet Match
description: Sweet Match is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by selecting matching sweets. Choose candies, donuts, waffles, marshmallows, and other treats in the right order so they can fall freely into the basket below. When two identical sweets meet in the basket, they instantly disappear, creating more space for new matches. Think ahead, remove blockers, and create satisfying chain reactions as you solve increasingly challenging levels.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 4
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 4 is here with over 3,800+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps like Greenland, South Korea, Sumatra, and Nepal while growing unique crops such as Mountain Avens, Ginkgo, Durian, Flax, and Orchids. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this relaxing solitaire journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy country life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Hidden Objects
description: Hidden Objects is a visually stunning puzzle game that challenges your observation skills. Explore beautifully detailed scenes filled with cleverly hidden items. Use hints if needed, but the real reward lies in uncovering every object on your own. Dive into a world of mystery and sharpen your perception.

title: Pixel Path
description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Geometry Vibes
description: Geometry Vibes is a reaction-based arcade game where you avoid obstacles, traps and spikes that come at you in waves. Your goal in the game is to keep your arrow on the route and take it as far as possible. The game includes a classic mode with levels, a race mode (2-3-4 players) where you can do multiple races, and an endless mode where you can test yourself! Geometry Vibes, where the excitement never ends, invites you to challenge...

title: Bubble Shooter HD 2
description: Bubble Shooter HD 2 is the long-awaited second sequel to the the legendary Bubble Shooter game. Bubble Shooter HD 2 is a combination of the classic Bubble Shooter gameplay combined with brand new graphics in HD quality and new features such as Stats and Novice, Expert and Master modes. What is the highest score you can achieve? Enjoy Bubble Shooter HD 2 now and make bubbles pop!

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Basketball Stars 2026
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

title: Bubble Around
description: Bubble Around is bubble shooter with a twist. You shoot the bubbles from the inside to the playing field around you. Match 3 or more bubbles to make them pop. Clear all bubbles to complete the level. Each level will be slightly more challenging. Stuck in a level? Use the bomb, rocket or multi color power up. Find out all level shapes!

title: Number Bubble Shooter
description: Have fun with the whole family in this colorful number puzzle game! Shoot numbered balls onto the board and merge matching ones to create bigger numbers. Use powerful rocket boosters to clear a round area and make room for more moves. Easy to learn and packed with cheerful challenges, it’s perfect for players of all ages to practice quick thinking, strategy, and have a blast together.

title: Grand Mahjong
description: Grand Mahjong is a captivating multi-level puzzle game based on the traditional Chinese Mahjong. Match identical tiles, clear the pyramid, and progress through increasingly challenging levels. This game is perfect for fans of logic games, brain puzzles, and anyone searching for a fun free Mahjong online experience.

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Magic Tiles 3
description:
Love music games? Play your favorite songs on Piano Magic Piles 3!
Magic Tiles 3 is an engaging music game that combines magic piano, rhythm, and games for a fun and immersive experience. Tap the tiles to the beat, challenge your reflexes, and enjoy a massive library of 45,000+ songs across various genres, pop, EDM, hip-hop, and more! Tap the black tiles to the rhythm while avoiding the white ones.
Support email: magictiles3.support@amanotes.com

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends
description:
Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore this new temple. This time with 3 new friends that will help them solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds! 

Play alone or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in this new adventure!

Turn levers and push buttons to complete these 36 new levels of the official Fireboy and Watergirl series.

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Jewels Blitz Legends
description: Embark on a dazzling adventure in Jewels Blitz Legends, the epic sequel to the beloved Match 3 hit! Travel through ancient Inca temples, uncover mystical secrets, and match colorful gems to unlock treasures. Explore Machu Picchu, complete hundreds of challenging levels, and take on exciting daily missions and weekly events. Collect gold, magical artifacts, and experience stunning visuals in this addictive journey through the heart of ancient legend!

title: Journey Of Escape
description: Escape games have always been a popular genre among puzzle enthusiasts and adventure seekers. They challenge players to think critically, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets while racing against time. "Journey of Escape" is an immersive collection of escape games designed to test your intelligence

title: Basketball Stars
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3 pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen, once it’s fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you are standing, it never fails. Be the best player on the field. Enjoy Basketball Stars!

title: Ludo Hero
description:
Ludo Hero, modern version of the royal game of Pachisi has arrived. It's a game which was played among Indian kings and queens in ancient times.

Roll the Ludo dice and move your tokens to reach the center of the Ludo board. Beat other opponents and become the king of Ludo in this multiplayer game.

No complicated login screens. Just enter your username and play against the world.

Play with your friends in a 2-player or 4-player mode.

title: Penalty Shooters 2
description:
Sequel to the classic football penalty shootout game brings more leagues and improved competition system.

Pick one of 360 football teams from 12 leagues (World cup, Euro cup, England, Germany, Spain...)! Cup is played in two phases - group stage and knockout. During the group stage you need to rank 1st or 2nd to go to the knockout phase.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 3
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 3, the highly anticipated sequel, continues the charming farm theme of Seasons 1 and 2 with incredible 3,400+ levels! Train your brain with diverse solitaire puzzles while enjoying country life. Explore new scenes and travel to new countries. Grow new crops such as Gooseberry, Foxgloves, Celery, Papyrus, Loquat, Prickly Pears, Berseem, and Blackberries. Enjoy stunning visuals and engaging gameplay in this delightful solitaire adventure!

title: Geometry Arrow 2
description: Geometry Arrow 2 is the fast-paced sequel to the original rhythm arcade hit! Navigate through 6 dynamic levels, dodging obstacles that move to the beat. Switch between the Arrow and the all-new Wheel character, each with unique mechanics. Unlock achievements and customize your Arrow and Wheel with different skins, particles, and block textures. Time your moves, feel the rhythm, and reach the portal in perfect sync!

title: Jump Dash
description:
Leap, soar, and survive in this fast-paced rhythm platformer!
Step into the intense world of Jump Dash, where every move must be perfectly timed. Test your reflexes as you jump, glide, and flip through treacherous levels packed with spikes, traps, and relentless obstacles.

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Block Dropping Merge
description:
Block Dropping Merge is a special but classic number merge puzzle. It's easy to play but hard to master.
Show us how good you are among other puzzlers!

1024 2048 4096 8192 16384... Drop them numbers and merge to get bigger numbers and show how smart you are!

Play and share your best score now!

title: Forest Match 4
description: Forest Match 4 is back with the highly anticipated fourth chapter of the beloved Match 3 series! Return to the enchanting forest to collect juicy fruits, uncover hidden coin chests, and discover sparkling gems across 4,620+ exciting levels. Follow your fairy guide back to the charming village and journey along a beautifully crafted saga map. Can you complete level goals with limited moves? Use powerful boosters when you need an extra push.

title: Jetpack Heroes
description: Jetpack heroes – an exciting game of skill, the main task is to go as far as possible without crashing into obstacles on the hero’s path, collect coins, fuel, boost, bombs, exclusive items and much more. Let’s play!

title: Fish Story 4
description: Fish Story 4 returns with its biggest underwater Match-3 adventure yet! Dive into over 4,500+ colorful levels packed with fun challenges, clever puzzles, and sparkling ocean treasures. Join your friend Mermaid on Daily Missions to earn coins, boosters, and special rewards every time you play. Take part in exciting Treasure Hunt events and uncover hidden pirate loot beneath the waves. Relax, match, and explore the deep blue sea!

title: Wood Block Puzzle 3
description: Wood Block Puzzle 3 is a polished, relaxing 10×10 wooden block game featuring a fresh UI, smart boosters, and satisfying break animations. Drag shapes from the right tray, complete rows or columns to score, and chase your best record. Use boosters at the bottom—watch rewarded ads to earn coins and unlock boosters when needed. Simple to learn and hard to master, it’s perfect for quick breaks or long zen sessions.

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Kingdoms Wars
description: Throw the dice and step into the Kingdoms Wars game! Monopoly alike, the objective of this board game is to travel around the globe, buying streets and building hotels onto them. Going to jail, pulling bonus cards, paying fees to the king, and paying overpriced when you stay at your competitor houses, are parts of the game. Collect rents, upgrade your hotels, and have fun traveling around!

title: Fruit Ninja
description: Welcome to the dojo, ninja. Your objective: become a master of slicing fruit! What better way to do that than play Fruit Ninja, the original hit fruit-slicing mobile game? ? Unsheathe your blade and start the juicy carnage with the three classic game modes that billions of players have come to know and love.

title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.

title: Pop Adventure
description: Welcome to Pop Adventure, an addictive bubble shooter game that offers endless entertainment and relaxation to players of all ages. Match 3 balls to explode and clear all bubbles on the screen to complete the mission and win rewards

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.
This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.
Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
description: Begin a fruity puzzle adventure. Princess Rescue Fruit Connect is a delightful match puzzle game where your mission is to rescue a beautiful princess by matching fruits and solving tricky levels. Connect two identical fruits to eliminate them. But notice clearing the board before time runs out. All while progressing to rescue the princess.

title: Forest Match 3
description: Explore the enchanting world of Forest Match 3, the third sequel to the ultimate Match 3 game! Embark on an adventure through a magical forest full of fruits, hidden coin chests and surprises in 4000+ incredible levels. Your journey begins in a charming village, guided by a fairy and a saga map. Can you match forest fruits while achieving level-specific goals using limited moves? Use boosters for extra help. Forest Match 3 is your ticket to a magical match-3 adventure!

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Vex 9
description:
Vex 9 is here- the next evolution in the legendary stickman platformer series! Take your parkour skills to the limit as you run, jump, and slide your way through a brand-new set of Acts filled with dangerous traps, bombs, and other deadly surprises. 

For the first time ever, take to the skies with the powerful new Jetpack! Put your reflexes to the ultimate test in the all-new Challenge Mode! Can you conquer every challenge and become the ultimate Vex champion?

title: PoppyTile
description: PoppyTile is a soothing and delightful tile-matching puzzle game set in a peaceful, picturesque countryside farm full of charm!

title: Cake Merge
description: Cake Merge is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you build whole cakes from colorful slices. Clear the tray, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and unlock new desserts as you play. With smooth animations, cute visuals, and easy-to-learn gameplay, Cake Merge is perfect for fans of casual merge, sorting, and matching games. Earn points, level up, and enjoy the sweetest merges!

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Kings and Queens Match 3
description: Step into Kings and Queens Match 3, the enchanting third chapter of the royal Match-3 adventure! Match jewels, crowns, and other royal artifacts to progress through exciting levels. Use powerful boosters like bombs, hammers, and royal blasts to clear challenging boards. Unlock new parts of the kingdom as you enjoy stunning visuals and a charming soundtrack. Join the royal quest and discover treasure, challenge, and endless fun!

title: Hotel Fever Tycoon
description: Wanna be a Hotel Empire Tycoon or a Top Cooking Chef? Come to "Hotel Fever Tycoon" to start an interesting hotel management and cooking journey with Emma and Uncle George! Work together to build your world-class hotel chain!

title: Wild West Match 2: The Gold Rush
description: Wild West Match 2 immerses you in the thrilling Gold Rush era of the Wild West! Match three or more gold nuggets, cowboy hats, horseshoes, and other treasures to earn points and unlock new levels. Use Dynamite to clear obstacles or reveal hidden gold! With hundreds of challenging levels, you’ll dig through the Wild West to find hidden treasures and secrets. Ready to strike it rich? Join the Gold Rush adventure now!

title: Sorting Xmas Balls
description:
Sorting Xmas Balls is a cozy winter puzzle game where you sort colorful Christmas ornaments into their correct tubes. Move the balls, group matching colors together, and enjoy calm, festive gameplay.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging with more tubes and more colors to organize. Bright graphics and a cheerful holiday theme make every level relaxing and satisfying to complete.

title: Bubble Shooter Pro 4
description: Get ready for Bubble Shooter Pro 4, the ultimate bubble-popping adventure! The latest sequel introduces exciting new features: the explosive Bomb and Firebomb to pop multiple bubbles at once, Bonus Gifts, and collecting Stars to complete Missions. Customize your gameplay with new Props, Frames, and Hats. Dive into the action and enjoy hours of strategic bubble shooting with these thrilling updates!

title: Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow
description: Play Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow – a relaxing and colorful butterfly-matching puzzle game with fresh mechanics and vibrant rainbow visuals! Enjoy hundreds of exciting levels, earn daily rewards, take part in special events, and unlock beautiful new wings. A fun Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Woody Hexa
description: Woody Hexa is a visually engaging puzzle game that challenges players to complete 250 levels by strategically arranging hexagonal blocks by color. With simple drag-and-drop controls and increasingly complex layouts, each level tests your logic and spatial awareness. Combining relaxing gameplay with clever merging mechanics, Woody Hexa offers a satisfying brain workout perfect for all ages.

title: Juice Merge
description:
Juice Merge is a colorful and addictive merge puzzle game where you combine drinks to unlock new, more complex recipes. It’s the perfect casual game for fans of merge games, matching mechanics, and relaxing gameplay.

Enjoy a vibrant tropical beach atmosphere as you expand your collection — from simple water to exotic fruit cocktails. Discover new drinks, fill your collection, and keep progressing even after each round.

title: Yummy Tales 4
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 4 - a delightful Match 3 adventure full of fresh farm fun! Swap and match tasty fruits, colorful veggies, and charming treats to complete level goals and keep your hungry farm animals happy. Explore a lively world packed with clever puzzles, daily rewards, exciting challenges, and helpful boosters. With plenty of surprises waiting along the way, Yummy Tales 4 brings a brand-new harvest of puzzle fun. Start playing now!

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: Farm Match Seasons 2
description: Farm Match Seasons 2 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the legendary Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Your friend Poppy needs your help to look after the most beautiful farm in the village. Together you will harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on their farm fields. What is important that you keep the farm free from weeds! The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Tropical Match 2
description: Tropical Match is back with its highly anticipated second sequel! Join your island friend Coco for a colorful Match 3 adventure in a lush tropical paradise. Match juicy fruits, vibrant flowers, and clear away algae and clouds across 1,250+ exciting levels. Complete Daily Missions and discover tropical treasures along the way! With relaxing island tunes and gorgeous scenery, this is the perfect summer escape. Dive in and start your tropical adventure today!

title: Wave Dash : Geometry Arrow
description: Ride the wave in Wave Dash, a rhythm platformer where each tap steers your arrow through tight corridors. Read patterns in waves, time jumps to music, and beat brutal stages. Build routes with the level editor, share creations, unlock icons, chase ranks, and perfect speed runs. Simple controls, fast restarts—pure focus and flow. Inspired by classic geometry platformers, tuned for dash mastery.

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: Wonders of Egypt Match
description: Begin a legendary journey in Wonders of Egypt Match, a thrilling Match 3 game set in Ancient Egypt! Join your guide, the Amara, as you match three or more gems and artifacts to uncover hidden treasures and secrets buried in pyramids, temples, and obelisks. With stunning visuals and immersive soundscapes, explore a world filled with ancient mysteries and challenges. Ready to prove your skills? Join the adventure and experience the wonders of Egypt today!

title: Water Sort - Collections
description: Sort, pour, and relax! Complete each level by filling bottles and unlock beautiful collectible images. Test your logic, calm your mind, and build your own gallery as you master the art of sorting water!

title: Thread Match 2
description:
Thread Match 2 is a satisfying logic puzzle game that combines color matching, layered challenges, and calming embroidery visuals.

Solve clever thread puzzles by planning the correct order of moves and dismantling complex constructions. Each level challenges your brain with blocked and unlocked elements, where strategy and attention matter more than speed.

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Fish Story 2
description: Welcome to Fish Story 2 - the second sequel to the beloved underwater Match 3 Game coming with fresh new graphics, a catchy tune, and lots of improvements! Meet your new host, the mermaid herself who will be pleased to guide you on your adventure through incredible 2,000+ splashy levels and teach you all the tricks you need to know to solve even the most complicated puzzles.

title: Kings and Queens Match
description: Welcome to Kings and Queens Match! Dive into a magical kingdom , matching jewels and crowns to progress through levels. Unleash Royal Bombs, hammers, and wands for extra fun. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack will transport you to a world of magic and wonder. So what are you waiting for? Join Princess Bella on her quest for treasure and adventure today!

title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
description: Immerse yourself in a timeless Mahjong experience with Heritage Mahjong Classic. Featuring a single elegant layout, three unique tile skins, a time bonus for quick matches, and a competitive leaderboard, this game offers a simple yet captivating challenge. Perfect for players of all levels, enjoy a relaxing atmosphere as you match tiles, earn bonuses, and climb the ranks. Are you ready to test your skills and embrace the charm of classic Mahjong? Start your journey today!

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

title: Paper.io 2
description:
Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition.
A smooth drawing experience!

Use your paper block to steal the area from your online opponents in this game. Capture as much space as possible and try to get the highest score in the lobby. If you move outside your own color, your tail becomes exposed. You will be eliminated when someone manages to catch your tail. So you need to take risks to expand your colored area.

title: Bubble Shooter Panda Blast
description:
Step into the colorful world of Panda Blast, where your mission is to rescue baby pandas by popping bubbles. Mama Panda needs your help to bring her lost cubs home. With vibrant graphics, charming animations, and exciting puzzles, this game is perfect for all ages.
Match three or more bubbles to clear them, free trapped pandas, and progress through hundreds of fun levels. Use powerful boosters, enjoy daily rewards, and experience smooth animations that bring the adventure to life.

title: Royal Garden Match 2
description: Royal Garden Match 2 is here! Join Aria as she tends the kingdom’s most prestigious Royal Garden. Restore it to its former glory by completing fun match-3 puzzles! Match royal flowers, fruits, and plants across hundreds of levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Enjoy a magical journey full of beauty, strategy, and rewards. Play Royal Garden Match 2 now and bring the Royal Garden back to life!

title: Athena Match 2
description: Athena Match 2 - the epic sequel returns! Join the goddess Athena on a new mythical journey through ancient Greece. Match 3 or more legendary artifacts to restore temples and unlock the secrets of the gods. Enjoy stunning visuals, immersive sound, and hundreds of new levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Step into the world of Greek mythology and prove your match-3 skills in this divine adventure!

title: Vex X3M 2
description:
Building on the classic Vex experience, VEX X3M2 introduces intense levels packed with new hazards and mechanics. New features like kite gliding let you soar over gaps, while teleportation portals help you navigate tricky sections. Floating platforms and shifting obstacles keep you on your toes, making every race an unpredictable thrill ride.
Earn stars to unlock high-performance bike skins and conquer each track in easy and hard mode to prove yourself as the ultimate Vex champion!

title: Slice it All
description:
In this game, you need to slice obstacles ahead of you! Tap to flip your knife and neatly slice various obstacles on your path into equal halves! This is the juiciest way and become the slice master!

Armed with your super sharp knife, no obstacle can stop you! Flip your knife at the right time and slice various obstacles – pencils, pipes, anvils, and the list goes on!

title: Hawaii Match 5
description: Escape to the paradise in Hawaii Match 5! Explore dreamlike landscapes while matching exotic fruits and flowers. With over 4000+ levels, complete challenging goals in limited moves by forming rows of five or more symbols. Unlock powerful boosters and combine symbols for explosive bonuses. Discover hidden treasures and let your soul unwind in this captivating island adventure. Play Hawaii Match 5 now and enjoy endless fun!

title: Forgotten Treasure 2 - Match 3
description: In this puzzle game you need to combine jewels to crash obstacles using your logic. Enjoy Forgotten Treasure 2 – Match 3! There are different modes: you can go through exciting adventures: collect treasures, help the deer return the Christmas mood decorating the Christmas tree! In addition to adventures, you can pass seasonal packs, for each of which you collect different ingredients, and with them you can create the most beautiful relics!

title: Tripeaks Solitaire Escapes
description: Play Solitaire TriPeaks Escapes, a relaxing card game with a warm summer vibe. Explore hundreds of unique solitaire levels featuring stunning graphics and vibrant beach landscapes. Master challenging card puzzles using powerful boosters, train your brain and sharpen your strategy. Dive into this colorful TriPeaks world and enjoy a soothing, slow-paced adventure. Escape the daily grind and find your zen in every hand you play!

title: Cookie Land
description: Step into Cookie Land, the ultimate sweet Match 3 adventure! Match cookies, candies, pies, donuts, cupcakes, and cotton candies to clear the board and trigger scrumptious chain reactions. Explore a fairytale-like saga map filled with colorful sweets, charming graphics, and a catchy soundtrack. With new treats raining down and endless levels of fun, Cookie Land is the most addictive, mouth-watering Match 3 game for all sweet lovers!

title: Bubble Shooter Billiards & Pool
description: Do you love Pool, Billiards, or Snooker? Now, imagine them combined with your favorite Bubble Shooter game! Bubble Shooter Billiard Pool brings a fresh twist to the classic bubble shooter by blending the thrill of billiards with strategic bubble-popping action. Line up your shots, swap bubbles for the perfect move, and aim for high scores in a vibrant pool hall setting. The crowd is watching—can you master your technique and become the ultimate champion? Play now and find out!

title: Xmas Hexa Sort
description:
Xmas Hexa Sort is a festive twist on the classic hexagon puzzle!
Move and place colorful stacks of blocks on the board to create perfect combinations and clear space. Relax, think ahead, and enjoy the cozy holiday atmosphere as you solve each cheerful puzzle!

title: Travel Story Match
description: Embark on a global adventure with Travel Story Match! Match 3 identical travel items to complete exciting puzzles. Use powerful boosters to tackle tricky combinations, explore iconic destinations, and uncover hidden gems. Complete Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges, collect rewards, and enjoy hundreds of thrilling levels. Start your journey now and create your very own unforgettable travel story!

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Safari Story Mahjong
description: Set off on a bright Safari Story Mahjong adventure filled with animals, plants, fruits, and sunny nature tiles! Match free pairs, clear relaxing Mahjong boards, and journey through a colorful saga map packed with cheerful safari moments. Complete levels before time runs out, unlock Gift Box milestones every 8 levels, and collect helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. A light, rewarding puzzle escape for players who love casual Mahjong fun.

title: Juicy Match 2
description: Juicy Match 2 returns with even more natural, fresh, and juicy fun! Step into the best Juice Bar in town and match delicious fruits to create perfect juice blends. Your cheerful Banana friend will guide you with helpful tips along the way. Match three or more fruits to juice them, trigger chain reactions for big bonuses, and master hundreds of new levels. With Daily Missions, Weekly Challenges, and endless juicy puzzles, the adventure never stops in Juicy Match 2!

title: Candy Match 4
description: The long-awaited sequel to our popular Match 3 game! Candy Match 4 takes you on a delightful journey through the world of delicious candies. With incredible 4000+ levels you will enjoy endless fun combining candies, completing Daily Missions and Challenges, and discovering gifts along the way. Meet your friend Luffy the cat, who helps you navigate through tricky blockers and master the game. Experience one of the best Match 3 games ever!

title: Hawaii Match 4
description: Hawaii Match 4 will take you on a journey through the beautiful nature of Hawaii. You will explore magical islands, collect exotic fruits and flowers and have endless fun completing New Daily and Weekly Challenges. Play Hawaii Match 4 now and enjoy 3000+ brand new levels!

title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
description: Escape into a cozy Winter Wonderland filled with snowflakes, penguins, and festive cheer! Relax with calming music as you match beautifully crafted tiles in this soothing Mahjong puzzle game. Unlock charming new backgrounds and unique tile designs as you progress, each adding warmth and wonder to your journey. Perfect for unwinding, celebrating the holidays, and discovering the magic of winter—one match at a time.

title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game where you clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Play a new puzzle every day, unlock missed days with ads, and keep your weekly streak for exciting rewards! Track your progress in the Weekly Record, where you can challenge yourself to beat your All-Time Best Score. Enjoy smooth gameplay, balanced difficulty from easy to hard, and use helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo to master every layout.

title: Hidden Object: My Hotel
description: Hidden Objects: My Hotel – A fun hidden-object game where you help a young woman restore her dream hotel! After buying the old building, she needs your help to clean up cluttered rooms, find hidden items, and bring back its lost charm.

title: Big Block Blast
description:
Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Kings and Queens Match 2
description: Kings and Queens Match 2 is one of the most anticipated Match 3 sequels! This long-awaited second chapter features 2,500+ incredible levels full of magic and adventure. Join Princess Bella on a magical adventure, matching jewels and crowns to uncover hidden treasures. Create powerful boosters like Royal Bombs, hammers, and arrows to clear obstacles and win big. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack bring the kingdom to life. Get ready for a royal journey full of fun and surprises!

title: Thread Sort
description: Thread Sort is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game where you organize colorful threads on spools and turn them into beautiful cross-stitched pictures. Sort mixed threads by color, clear the pegs, and watch as neatly arranged strands automatically stitch a charming image on the canvas. With cozy visuals, smooth animations, and simple controls, Thread Sort is perfect for fans of sorting puzzles, knitting games, and calming casual challenges.

title: Nose Hospital
description: In Nose Hospital Games, The patients are counting on you in this nose surgery hospital game. Will you rise to the occasion and become the hero in plastic surgery games, they desperately need? Step into the operating theater and redefine the world of nose plastic surgery games.

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

title: Number Merge 10
description: Number Merge 10 is a very innovative math puzzle game.Select a rectangular area, and if the sum of the numbers within that area equals 10, all the numbers in that area will be eliminated!

title: Bubble Shooter HD 3
description: Bubble Shooter HD 3 is the long-awaited third sequel to the the legendary Bubble Shooter game. Bubble Shooter HD 3 features the classic Bubble Shooter HD gameplay with a set of fresh new bubbles, the option to choose between the arrow vs pointer when shooting bubbles as well as the mighty BOMB feature that lets you blow up 15 bubbles at once. So what is the highest score you can achieve? Enjoy Bubble Shooter HD 3 now and break a new record!

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 5
description: Solitaire Farm Season 5 is here with over 4,200+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps, grow unique crops, and enjoy even more relaxing solitaire fun. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this countryside journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy farm life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Dig out of Prison
description:
You are a prisoner determined to break free. Dig tunnels with a spoon, shovel, or anything you can find. Discover valuables, trade with fellow inmates and even the guards, and earn the prison’s top currency — toilet paper.

Upgrade your digging and trading skills, unlock better tools, and speed up your escape. But be careful — plan your moves and avoid drawing attention, because freedom is the prize only for the most cunning.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
