description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Bubble Shooter Butterfly
description:
Bubble Shooter Butterfly is your next favorite bubble shooter game! It is a classic arcade game with a fresh look and new twists. With its bright butterflies and breezy gameplay this online butterfly game is perfect for Spring and Summer.

The game includes 300 diverse levels, divided over beautifully serene day and night backgrounds. Release all the butterflies and achieve the highest scores!

title: Arrow Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Escape, an addictive arrows puzzle escape game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments.

title: ASMR Pet Treatment
description: Take care of your adorable puppy and kitty in this relaxing ASMR game! Wash, heal, and pamper your pets with gentle treatments. After they feel happy and healthy, have fun dressing them up in cute outfits. Relaxing sounds and sweet pets make every moment enjoyable!

title: Mansion Story Match
description: Step into Mansion Story Match, a captivating Match-3 adventure set inside a grand and mysterious mansion. Explore hidden rooms, uncover long-forgotten secrets, and discover dazzling treasures. Solve hundreds of challenging puzzles, match gems, and collect rare relics as you reveal an intriguing story. From dusty attics to lush gardens, every corner holds a surprise. Begin your journey now and uncover the secrets within!

title: Traffic Tour
description: Traffic Tour is an endless arcade racing game offering a smooth driving experience with realistic graphics. Choose your favorite racing car, navigate through traffic, and challenge players in real-time multiplayer mode. Complete 100 online missions, beat opponents, and enjoy 1v1 matches with friends. With a great car racing system (CRS), this is one of the best free racing games.

title: Vex X3M
description:
VEX X3M, a new extreme hill racing game with bike stunts and obstacles, is here! 
Enjoy the classic Vex elements, but this time you will be racing your way to the finish line! 

Perform crazy bike stunts in 30 unique levels filled with danger - from spikes and shooting knives to rockets and lasers. Reach the finish safely and obtain stars to unlock new unique bike skins.

Complete all levels in easy and hard mode to crown yourself a master VEX X3M Rider.

Start your engines and enjoy VEX X3M!

title: Football Legends 2026
description: Football Legends 2026 is a fast-paced arcade soccer game where you can play solo or challenge your friends in exciting 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Choose from a variety of unique players, each with special abilities like powerful superkicks or teleportation, and use them to outplay your opponents. Compete in tournaments, master your timing and strategy, and score incredible goals to become the ultimate soccer champion

title: Geometry Vibes 3D
description: Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

title: Scala 40
description:
Scala 40 is an Italian card game played with two French decks and jokers.

Players form sets and runs to reach at least 40 points and lay down their first combinations.

Each turn, players draw and discard, trying to optimize their hand and use their own or opponents’ combinations.

The first player to run out of cards wins, while the others add up the points of their remaining cards.

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Athena Match
description: Embark on a mythical journey in Athena Match, a Match 3 game set in Ancient Greece. Guided by the goddess Athena, match three or more identical artifacts to clear levels and uncover Greek secrets. Stunning visuals and rich soundscapes bring this world to life as you solve puzzles and overcome mythical obstacles inspired by Greek lore. Ready to prove your skills? Join Athena and dive into the adventure!

title: Farm Match Seasons
description: Farm Match Seasons is a brand new Match 3 Game from the creators of the legendary games like Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Together with your friend Poppy, a little farm girl, you will look after the most beautiful farm in the village! Harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on your farm fields. Don't forget to keep your farm free from weeds! So what are you waiting for? Turn on the catchy soundtrack and enjoy this fantastic brand new Match 3 game!

title: Fish Story 3
description: Welcome to Fish Story 3! Immerse yourself in 4,000+ levels of Match 3 excitement guided by our mermaid host. Solve puzzles, conquer Daily Missions, and unlock treasures in the Daily Challenge. Dive into addictive challenges and return daily for rewards. Join the underwater adventure now!

title: Merge Flowers
description:
Merge Flowers is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game! Grow your vibrant garden, discover unique flowers, and earn coins. Enjoy merge puzzle and match-3 mechanics as you combine flowers to create a blooming paradise.
With simple controls and cozy visuals, place flowers strategically to make space for new plants. Perfect for puzzle lovers and fans of casual idle games, Merge Flowers offers endless fun and a soothing experience. Start your floral journey today!

title: Aqua Blitz 2
description: Welcome to Aquablitz 2 - the newest iteration of the beloved underwater match-3 game that comes with fresh new graphics, a catchy tune and lots of improvements! Meet your new hostess, Pearl, the little mermaid. She will be pleased to guide you on your adventure through more than 700 splashy levels and teach you all the tricks you need to know to solve even the most complicated puzzles.

title: Clash Crowd Game
description: Clash Crowd Game is an addictive arcade runner game where you tap to run, survive obstacles, and reach the destination. Control your crowd, avoid traps, and face thrilling challenges in every level. Easy controls, engaging gameplay, and colorful 3D graphics make this game perfect for quick fun. Run smart, grow your crowd, and prove your survival skills.

title: Bubble Shooter Free 2
description: Bubble Shooter FREE 2 is back with a long-awaited sequel to the popular bubble shooter game. The game embraces endless play and is designed to enjoy for hours without time pressure. It boasts a brand new ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which enables you to swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one. Now you can play even more strategically making sure that you match at least 3 bubbles of the same color each time!

title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
description: Journey into an ancient Egyptian night in Bubble Shooter Pyramid Quest! Match and pop glossy bubbles to climb rising score goals. Fill the goal bar to trigger quick celebrations, then push onward as the ceiling creeps closer. Beat your High score, earn a second chance with a rewarded continue, and watch desert backdrops shift as you progress. Easy to start, hard to master—aim, bounce, and clear your way to legend! Start in Beginner, then unlock Medium and Hard as your score surges ever higher!

title: Mahjong Connect Gold
description: Mahjong Connect Gold is an exciting puzzle game with captivating gameplay that is known to all fans of the Mahjong series. Collect all the tiles by matching their pairs according to the rules of classic Mahjong. Immerse yourself in Mahjong's unique world and dive into this captivating puzzle's depths!

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong: Tile Match features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format.

title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
description: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything.

title: Farm Match Seasons 3
description: With over 2700+ levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy, Farm Match Seasons 3 is a charming Match 3 game that continues the story of the beautiful farm in the village. Your friend Poppy needs your help managing the farm — harvesting strawberries, collecting flowers, and protecting butterflies in the fields. Don’t forget to keep those pesky weeds under control! This sequel comes packed with a major content update and new challenges to discover.

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: Color Block Jam
description: Color Block Jam – an exciting puzzle game! Move the colored blocks, solve logic challenges, and complete levels. The game has many levels, from simple tasks to real brain teasers.

title: Block Wood Puzzle
description:
Drag and drop the wooden blocks to fill the gap.

Complete a row to score points. Complete 2 rows or more to score bonus points.

How high can you score?

title: Magic and Wizards Match
description: Magic and Wizards is an enchanting Match 3 game where you and your friend Aurora embark on a mystical journey through a magical realm. With over 4000+ levels, match gems representing magical elements to overcome obstacles, using powerful boosters to progress. Complete Daily Missions, tackle tricky blockers, and uncover hidden treasures. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, Magic & Wizards delivers a captivating experience filled with mystery. Ready for your magical adventure?

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Airport Security
description: Airport Security is a casual simulation game that immerses you in the high-stakes world of airport safety, placing you in the role of a vigilant security officer dedicated to safeguarding a bustling terminal. Your mission is to maintain a secure environment by identifying suspicious passengers, spotting fake passports, and uncovering hidden contraband using cutting-edge X-ray machines.

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: ASMR Stye Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient came with dirty pimply face and a stye problem. Help her to take care of the pimples, and prove your medical skills by performing this ASMR Stye Treatment game. After finishing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and make up from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: Royal Pin
description: Royal Pin: King Adventure – A thrilling rescue puzzle game where you save the King, protect the kingdom, and rebuild the castle! Solve tricky pin puzzles, help the queen and princess, and become the ultimate king of this adventure!

title: Jewel Legend
description: Let the great Jewel Legend begin! Travelers from all around the world have come to the mines to dig those diamonds out. Join them in the effort to find as many diamonds as possible while engaging in various challenges that will keep you entertained for long stretches of time! So, what are you waiting for?

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries
description: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries is a relaxing hidden object game set in cozy interiors. Solve mysteries with a detective, accompanied by soothing melodies.

title: Solitaire Winter
description:
It’s cold outside and you’re snowed in with a game of Solitaire! Travel the icy land and rebuild 5 beautiful winter locations across 200 levels, plus unlock 18 bonus game variants like Klondike, Spider and Freecell!

Overcome obstacles like locks, frozen cards, chains, vines, and more to collect the bonus gems and coins in each level which you can spend in the shop for upgrades. 

Choose between multiple card decks, but don’t freeze up as you go for the elusive 3 stars on every level!

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: MR RACER - Car Racing
description: MR RACER - Car Racing is a thrilling and challenging racing game that will excite you! Race at high speed with stunning supercars and beat the traffic. This game provides a very easy-to-control car movement and is extremely fun to race.

title: Tank Stars
description: Are you ready for an action-packed 2D tank warfare? Welcome to the Tank Stars, one of the best battle tank games that you can play with friends online & offline. Find the right shooting angle and unleash your iron force against your foe's war machines! Make the right shot quickly or you'll lose!

title: Vex Hyper Dash
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced challenge in this brand-new Vex spin-off: Vex Hyper Dash! Inspired by the legendary Geometry Dash. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible. Jump from platform to platform, time your moves perfectly, and avoid the countless dangers that stand in your way. One wrong move, one mistimed jump, and it’s game over. 

Vex Hyper Dash puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Can you master the flow and set a new high score?

title: Four Colors Multiplayer
description:
Four Colors is a HTML5 Card Games.
Face up to 3 computer-controlled opponents.
Match cards by color or number, play action cards to mix the game up and be the first to get rid of all cards.
Last but not least: Do not forget to press the 1 button when you have only one card left!

3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Obby On a Bike
description: Obby On a Bike, a thrilling bike-riding platformer that combines exciting obstacle courses with fun parkour gameplay! It features two exciting gameplay modes: Normal and Challenge. In Normal mode, you can carefully ride through each level without the stress of a timer. Challenge mode lets you test your speed and skill as you race against time. Whether you're playing alone or competing head-to-head in the 2 Player mode, there's always a thrilling challenge awaiting you!

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Ludo Legend
description: Play a game of Ludo! Everyones favourite board game! Play alone or with your friends on one device! Just pass it on! Colorful design and easy mechanics will keep you playing for hours!

title: Master Blender
description: Becoming the Strongest Bartending Master！Tap the bottle lightly to pour water. Organize the water so that each bottle's water is distributed to the corresponding colored cup!

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions, and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of seats, so plan your moves carefully to untangle the chaotic traffic jam.

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Candy Rain 5
description: Get ready for a delightful and vibrant match-3 experience with Candy Rain 5! The beloved Candy Rain series continues with even more sugary fun and challenging puzzles to enjoy.

title: Solitaire L'Amour
description: Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! Enter an enchanting world as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure!

title: Unblock It 3D
description:
Power up your logic and spatial reasoning skills with Unblock It 3D! Rotate the cluster of bricks to find unblocked tiles you can slide away without hitting any obstructions. 

Play Classic Mode and enjoy hundreds of intricate puzzles with unlimited moves, new cube designs and backgrounds to unlock.

Or, journey through time in Adventure Mode. Try your hand at 25 additional levels of increasing complexity and size. Explore Ancient Egypt, Medieval Europe, the Aztec Empire, feudal Japan, and more.

title: 67 Clicker Tap Tap
description: 67 Clicker is a fast, funny, and highly addictive meme clicker game where every tap brings you closer to unlocking a strange and unforgettable collection of 67-themed characters. Your goal is simple at first: click or tap to earn 67 Points, spend them on upgrades, and keep growing your power. The ultimate objective is to reach the final upgrade, The 67 Galaxy, and unlock all 14 unique 67 characters waiting across the journey.

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower is a fun, free web game that takes you into a magical world of witchcraft. Ascend the Witch Tower by bursting as many bubbles as possible in this thrilling bubble-shooting puzzle adventure. Progress through levels, rescue adorable pets, and restore the Witch Tower piece by piece. With hundreds of enchanting bubble-shooting challenges, there's always something new to conquer. Play anywhere, anytime—no time limits!

title: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate
description:
Enter the magical world of Tarot in this captivating solitaire adventure! Each card tells a story, and every level presents a new puzzle. Meet iconic Tarot characters like the wise Hermit and bold Knight of Swords as they guide your journey.
A dark sorcerer threatens to unravel the Arcana's magic—only you can uncover its secrets, solve riddles, and restore balance. Will your intuition and strategy save this mystical realm?

title: Dog Puzzle Story 3
description: Dog Puzzle Story is back with a third instalment of fun! Join your beloved friend, the cute puppy Charlie on another adventurous journey in a winter theme! Play colourful Match 3 puzzles full of toys, dog pillows and treats scattered all over the garden in more than 4000+ incredible levels! Help Charlie to put all the items in the right place and dig up all the bones! This is going to be so much fun!

title: Steal Brainrot Duel
description: Steal Brainrot Duel is a fast, competitive collector-raider where you hunt for the best brainrot characters, defend your base from thieves, and outsmart rivals in Solo or 2 Player mode. Start with simple picks like Noobini Pizzanini, then grind your economy to unlock rare and legendary favorites such as Tralalero Tralala, Cocofanto Elefanto, and Graipussi Medussi. Build income, raid others, protect your stash, and style your obby avatar with hats, glasses, backpacks, wings, outfits, and pets!

title: Zumbo Mania
description: Get better at marble shooting and try to complete all the levels with three stars in each level. This marble game is easy to play and addicting at the same time.

title: Tropical Match
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure in Tropical Match 3! Help Coco, your lively island guide, find fruits and other island gems in a tropical paradise. Match exotic fruits, uncover vibrant flowers and observe colourful exotic birds while enjoying the island adventure. The game features exciting levels and a relaxing island soundtrack! So what are you waiting for? Enjoy the tropical paradise adventure now!

title: Gummy Blocks
description:
Gummy Blocks is a HTML5 Puzzle Game. Drag the forms in the free cells and clear rows and columns in the grid! 
Go ahead and try to become the best in the game!

title: Royal Bubble Blast
description: Welcome to Royal Bubble Blast, where you'll be transported to a majestic castle to enjoy a royal Bubble Shooter experience! Featuring vibrant, handcrafted designs and a colourful, lively theme, this game offers endless, relaxing gameplay accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack. Play as a King or Queen in the most exclusive Bubble Shooter enjoyed by royalty. Dive into a world of colourful bubbles and endless fun. So, what are you waiting for? Join the royals and start popping!

title: Sudoku Garden
description: Players must expand their thinking to solve puzzles in adventures. Learn to approach problems from different angles and discover hidden clues and patterns to overcome challenges. These games test wit while fueling interest and challenge-seeking mentality.

title: Wooden bolts and nuts
description: As you play, you'll find tangled screws, nuts, bolts, plates, rings, ropes, and more. Find out how to solve the riddle. It's not just a game, it's a journey through the many fun nuts and bolts of the game.

title: Backrooms
description:
Trapped in the eerie maze of the Backrooms, your only goal is to escape or survive, trying.
Play solo or team up with friends in this online multiplayer horror experience. Explore surreal levels, avoid lurking entities, solve puzzles, and use proximity voice chat to stay connected… and stay alive.

title: Helix Jump
description:
Helix Jump is a game with simple and addictively fun mechanics. In the game, you guide a bouncing ball continuously down a series of circular platforms. Fall through the cracks and avoid landing in the forbidden zones!

This is a simple yet challenging game with harmonious and colorful interface to provide players with a comfortable visual experience.

Features:
One-tap easy-to-learn controls, rich visual effects and addictive gameplay mechanics.

title: Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: Bubble Shooter Neon
description: Bubble Shooter Neon brings vibrant neon colors and exciting bubble-popping action! Match and pop glowing bubbles before they reach the bottom—new rows appear every 15 seconds, so stay focused! With sleek, modern visuals and fast-paced gameplay, it’s perfect for bubble shooter fans and casual players alike. Sharpen your aim, beat the clock, and enjoy the glowing thrill of Bubble Shooter Neon!

title: Master Chess Multiplayer
description:
Use the most effective strategies to defeat the computer or real players from all over the world in this classic game for all time.

The goal of the game is to capture your opponent's king. This is done by moving the pieces on the board.

Who will be the first to say ""Checkmate"".

To make a move, click on the shape and drag it to the desired position.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Step into the shadows with Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks! Explore abandoned castles, fend off lurking vampires, and rebuild forgotten halls. Play 200+ haunting Solitaire levels plus 50 chilling Mahjong boards. Face spooky twists like frozen and locked cards, tricky obstacles, and powerful boosts. Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins to purchase new castle upgrades and power-ups. Are you ready for a Solitaire adventure that sends shivers down your spine?

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Idle Farm
description:
Run your own successful farm and build an empire! The more you grow and harvest, the more money you get!
Use the money to upgrade your fields and make harvesting even more effective at producing food. Keep an eye on your production - with careful planning you’ll achieve everything! Expand your farm further and further until you truly own an empire.
Hire farm managers to do most of the work for you. Use their help to expand your farming empire, plant new crops and produce even more food!

title: Marble Sort
description: Marble Sort is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where colorful marbles travel along a conveyor belt waiting to be sorted. Fill matching trays, complete sets of three identical marbles, and clear every level. Plan your moves carefully, manage the flow, and enjoy smooth animations, relaxing gameplay, and rewarding sorting challenges. Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Unblock it Atlantis
description: Dive into the underwater world of Unblock It 3D: Atlantis and test your logic with endless brain-teasing puzzles! Rotate the puzzle cube to reveal which blocks you can slide away. Discover a vast collection of levels inspired by the lost city of Atlantis, featuring stone tiles textured like coral, shimmering pearl finishes, and sea flora woven through ancient ruins. Unlock new cube styles, explore vibrant oceanic themes, and keep your mind sharp as the puzzles grow more complex.

title: Summer Rider 3D
description: Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and 2 player mode!

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
description: Get ready to dive into the world of beauty and creativity! ASMR Makeup & Makeover Studio offers an incredible opportunity to give your virtual model a stunning makeover. This isn't just any makeover game — it's an immersive experience that combines relaxation and excitement through the power of ASMR!

title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
description: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt is an exciting endless bubble-shooting puzzle game where players must collect specific target bubbles along with rare magical crystals that appear among the bubbles. Aim carefully and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear space while the bubble wall slowly moves toward the border line, increasing tension with every shot. Crystals are hidden within bubble clusters and must also be collected to progress and boost scores.

title: Pop The Bubble
description: Think you have what it takes to master the bubble chaos? Precision is everything! Navigate tricky patterns, use boosters wisely and spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards. With infinite levels, the game stays fresh and addictive through every challenge.

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Dynamons 12
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 12! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Tomb world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons Captain Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon trainer. Encounter the 8 titans from the Guardian King: Bearmoryx, Sharkonyx, Crocynos, Horzaryx, Visi, Rhinodys, Fenixaro, Uryndur and many more special Dynamons.

title: Toilet Pin
description: Join the daily story of the toilet boy in the monster letter world. This new pin pulling game is for you. Let's explore Alphabet Lore with extraordinary characters! In the land of evil letters, you will have a chance to meet various amazing characters and powers of them: evil B ready to punch in your face, Angry C biting with sharp teeth, boring F with a gun, Crazy Z with fire, monster D who loves lava ....

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a relaxing yet addictive color sorting puzzle. Move colorful balls between tubes and organize them by color until every tube contains only matching balls. Plan your moves carefully, use empty spaces wisely, and solve increasingly challenging levels. Easy to learn but difficult to master, Ball Sort offers satisfying gameplay that will keep your brain engaged for hours.

title: KrisMas Mahjong 2
description:
This Winter, enjoy Krismas Mahjong 2, with brand new levels and items to discover. Play the classic mahjong game or try the relax mode with a larger grid and more repeating tiles. You can also follow along with the advent calendar that has a new connect puzzle every day! After solving the level, open the fortune cookie and read your fortune for the holidays and the new year.

Discover these levels with seasonal ornaments to get in the Christmas spirit! Or should we say KrisMas spirit?

title: Royal Garden Match
description: Welcome to Royal Garden Match! You’ve inherited a grand Royal Castle and a once-beautiful garden—now it’s up to you to bring its beauty to life! Solve exciting match-3 puzzles by combining exquisite royal flowers, fruits, and plants to unlock powerful boosters. With hundreds of challenging levels, unique royal characters, and a magical journey ahead, there's always something new to discover. Can you make the royal garden flourish? Play now and start your enchanting adventure!

title: Ludo World
description: Experience endless fun with various vibrant environments, where every roll of the dice brings a new challenge. Choose between classic or quick mode, progress along the trophy road, and prove you're the master of the board with every move you make.

title: Kings and Queens Mahjong
description: Enter the magical Royal Kingdom in Kings & Queens Mahjong! Match pairs of jewels, crowns, and other royal treasures to clear the board and climb the Royal Leaderboard. Race against the clock, use boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo when needed, and enjoy handcrafted tiles with a majestic design. Perfect for puzzle lovers looking for a royal challenge!

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
description: One of our patrons came in today with her homeless friend, Anna, who is in need of urgent hygiene care. Let’s assist the doctor in cleaning her body, teeth, and the area around her piercing. After the treatment, style her in the best outfit!

title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
description:
Obby Highest Jump Ever is a click-based jumping and climbing game where every click makes you stronger. Start from a small 10M building and push your way up to massive 2500M towers as your jump power grows step by step. Each new height feels like a new milestone, and every rooftop trophy proves you earned it.

Your goal is simple: jump higher, reach the top, and collect trophies. The higher the building, the bigger the reward.

title: Jewel Coloring
description:
Jewel Coloring is a unique puzzle game where colorful gems become part of beautiful pixel-art pictures.
Sort colorful jewels, match them with the correct cells, and complete beautiful pixel-art images. Every level is a brain-teasing puzzle where the right colors must go to the right places. Solve hundreds of satisfying challenges, unlock new pictures, and transform scattered gems into sparkling masterpieces. Perfect for fans of sorting games, color matching, logic puzzles, and relaxing gameplay.

title: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong
description: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong transports you to the mystical world of Ancient Egypt in this brand-new Solitaire Mahjong game. Play through beautifully designed hand-drawn tiles featuring Egyptian motifs and captivating backgrounds inspired by the wonders of Egypt. With 40 unique new layouts and three smaller tutorial layouts, it’s perfect for both beginners and Mahjong experts. Dive into hours of challenging gameplay and uncover the secrets of the Pharaohs!

title: Pizza Tycoon
description: Play as Boss Hei Wa, running a pizza shop! Serve food, collect payments, hire and upgrade staff, and expand sales channels. Manage and grow your business to success!

title: Diamond Solitaire Mahjong
description: Step into the radiant world of Diamond Solitaire Mahjong! Enjoy a beautifully crafted single puzzle with shimmering tiles adorned with diamonds, gems, and sparkling jewels. Zoom in and out for the perfect view as you match tiles in a relaxing setting. Earn points for quick matches and climb the leaderboard. Perfect for casual players and Mahjong fans seeking a peaceful yet rewarding experience.

title: Hair Salon: Beauty Salon
description:
Get ready to unleash your inner hairstylist with the adorable and entertaining game Hair Salon: Beauty Salon Spa! ?

This charming simulation game allows you to run your very own hair salon, where you can give your cute and quirky customers the hair style of their dreams.
From washing, styling hair and providing luxurious jewelry & makeup accessories, there's never a dull moment in this delightful game.

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.

title: Shop Sorting Xmas
description: Love a well-organized, neatly arranged space? Then Shop Sorting Xmas is the perfect game for you! Step into a delightful Christmas-themed puzzle game where you’ll sort and arrange festive items in a magical Christmas toy shop. In this captivating holiday sorting game, find and match identical toys and Christmas decorations, organizing them on the shelves. Your goal is to gather three identical items together to create a triplet and clear the shelves.

title: Card Master
description: Card Master is a fun and addictive puzzle game for all ages! Strategically merge identical cards to create stronger, higher-level ones while keeping the board from filling up. Use special cards and powerful boosts to clear space and score big. With its mix of strategy, challenge, and endless replay value, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves to think ahead and have fun.

title: Bubble Shooter Remastered
description: Shoot groups of bubbles and form groups to make them pop. Form groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make the bubbles explode.

title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient arrived with a dirty, pimply face and teeth problems. Help her take care of these issues and showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Beauty Treatment game. After completing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and makeup from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Master Checkers Multiplayer
description:
Master Checkers Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this stylish version of the classic Checkers Game. 
3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
description: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Submarine Attack
description: Command a submarine, destroy enemy ships with torpedoes, unlock new weapons, and conquer the ocean. Engage in thrilling naval battles, use unique abilities, face numerous enemies, and wield powerful armaments to achieve victory.

title: Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match
description: Jump into a fresh and relaxing brain challenge with Mahjong Triple 3D - Tile Match, a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game that brings the classic mahjong experience into a colorful 3D world! In this game, the tiles are stacked in beautiful 3D shapes. Your goal is simple but satisfying: tap and collect three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

title: Egg Adventure
description: You need to manipulate eggs to solve all kinds of puzzles and get out of the door, seemingly simple but hidden secrets.The key to solving the problem may be a word or an action, which means that you need to understand it carefully

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Woolloop! Color Puzzle
description: Knit Color Flow is a cozy yarn game where soft wool, gentle motion, and colorful puzzles blend into a peaceful experience. Watch the bobbins glide across conveyor belts as patterns slowly take shape, creating a world full of balance and visual harmony. The calm atmosphere, smooth animations, and comforting design invite you to relax while enjoying a steady sense of flow from the very first level.

title: Dream Kitchen
description: Dream Kitchen is a fun and fast-paced restaurant simulation game inspired by shawarma-style cooking gameplay. Take customer orders, cook the right food, and serve every dish on time to keep customers happy. Complete levels with 3-star ratings, earn coins, upgrade your kitchen equipment, and unlock new recipes. Explore multiple themed chapters, including a Pancake Shop, Street Stall, Fast Food Restaurant, and Western Restaurant, each with unique dishes and challenges!

title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
description: Welcome to Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY, the ultimate playground for those who love to personalize, design, and express their unique style!

title: Gin Rummy
description: "Gin Rummy" is a classic and engaging card game where the goal is to strategically arrange your hand into sets and runs. Place your cards in either groups of the same rank or in sequential order of the same suit. Score points by eliminating these combinations from your hand. The game ends when a player reaches the target score, typically set at 100 points.

title: Magic Bubbles
description: Quick games, satisfying pops and constant rewards — what’s not to love? Enjoy a bubble shooter built for endless play, with weekly bonuses, boosters that change the game and the Lucky Wheel for a little extra fun. There’s always something new to pop.

title: World Cup Soccer Caps
description: World Cup Soccer Caps is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Tape Sort 3D
description: Tape Sort 3D is a captivating puzzle game available on Android that invites players to engage in a unique untaping experience.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Balloon Match 3D
description: Relax and enjoy this addictive ballons 3d matching game as you collect items and complete different missions.Your goal is to clear the bubble by finding and matching all ballons before the time runs out!

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Small Wardrobe
description: Small Wardrobe is a casual game designed specifically for cotton dolls. Collect and create beautiful and cute dresses for your cotton dolls, and experience heartwarming and fun stories. The game offers a variety of adorable doll clothes, shoes, and accessories. Let's happily organize and tidy up the doll's wardrobe together!

title: Dynamons 11
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 11! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Island world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Chyroax, Scorvenox, Axolotix, Uryndur, Skyvioru, Golunaryx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Solitaire 13in1 Collection
description: Popular solitaire is simple and addictive game for one player, which goal is to get rid of all the cards on the table, with the help of certain rules. Every of the thirteen modes are following different rules. Among them we will find popular variants like Klondike or Freecell. Can you win all of them?

title: Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour
description:
Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour is a wild and hilarious 2 player platforming experience that blends meme-fueled chaos with classic obby parkour mechanics. Inspired by games like Tower of Hell, this title brings the unpredictable humor of the Italian brainrot meme universe into a 3D climbing challenge.

Available characters are: 
-Tung Tung Sahur
-Brr Brr Patapim
-Burbaloni Luliloli
-Frigo Camelo
-Girafa Celestre
-Lirili Larila
-Orangutini Annaucini
-Tralalero Tralala
-Vaca Saturno Saturnita

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description:
Drive Nubik along exciting tracks. Jump over gaps, go around obstacles and reach the finish line! Lots of different levels, drive a motorcycle, get there without destruction.

You have to drive a motorcycle with a noob and get to the finish line.
Jump over gaps and go around obstacles at high speed.
Exciting levels are waiting for you!

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels
description: Embark on a temple adventure in Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels! Pop colorful bubbles as you progress through ancient ruins inspired by Central American temples. Keep track of your journey with the Stats screen, showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With vibrant visuals, exciting challenges, and detailed progress tracking, this bubble shooter keeps you motivated to aim higher and improve every round!

title: Toy Match 3
description: Toy Match 3 is the third sequel to one of our cutest Match 3 puzzle games! Get ready for colorful graphics, fun animations, and a catchy soundtrack. Match adorable toys in over 4,100+ exciting levels and take on Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges! Embark on thrilling quests like the Treasure Hunt for amazing rewards. With tons of extras and surprises, Toy Match 3 is pure puzzle fun. Start playing now for free!

title: Tales of Lagoona
description: Embark on a magical Hidden Object adventure beneath the waves! In Coral Bay, the New Anemone Orphanage is in danger of closing – only you can save it. Search beautiful underwater scenes for hidden treasures, sell your finds at the market, upgrade the orphanage, play 160 mini-games, and take on quests from the townsfolk. Join Islabelle the Mermaid in a heartwarming quest to rescue the orphans!

title: Fruit King Merge
description: Fruit King Merge is a bright and addictive arcade game where your goal is to merge identical fruits to create new, larger, and more valuable ones. As you play, you will earn coins, unlock new types of fruit, and aim for the highest possible score. Colorful graphics, smooth animations, and simple controls make the game suitable for all ages and perfect for engaging gaming sessions.

title: Solitaire Tripeaks
description: Explore the mysteries of the Deep Sea with Solitaire TriPeaks, the classic solitaire card game which allows you to train your brain with different solitaire puzzles.

title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
description: Welcome to FreeCell Solitaire! Dive into this classic card game where strategy and patience are key. With all cards visible from the start, plan your moves carefully to arrange them into the foundation piles by suit, from Ace to King. Use the free cells wisely to maneuver your way out of tight spots. Are you ready to tackle the challenge and clear the board? Play the Best Classic FreeCell Solitaire now and put your skills to the test!

title: Hidden Pairs Mahjong
description: Match and clear all the tile in this Hidden Pairs Mahjong solitaire game. Use your observation skills to find and select identical open tiles to remove them from the board. With beautifully designed classic Mahjong symbols, smooth animations, and a calming background, each level offers a fresh puzzle challenge.Earn bonus time, increase your score, and progress through endless levels of tile-matching fun!

title: Rooftop Run
description: Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Mahjong Earth
description: Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Mahjong Earth! This captivating game offers a tranquil escape with its soothing earth-themed soundtrack and stunning tile designs. Explore over 250+ unique puzzle layouts, each more challenging than the last. Use the Combo meter to match quickly and earn stars. Climb the leaderboard for recognition and claim boosters by reaching the top. Immerse in the relaxing soundtrack and earthy tiles for a truly calming experience!

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: Step into the world of AOD - Art Of Defense, a free online strategy game where your main goal is to stop enemy waves by placing towers in smart locations. Play on your phone or computer and test your skills in this action-packed defense challenge. Every move matters—can you build the perfect defense?

title: Labuba Merge
description: Labuba Merge is a fun and relaxing casual merge game where you combine adorable fluffy Labuba to unlock bigger, cuter, and funnier versions! Perfect for kids and adults, this addicting merge puzzle game will challenge your strategy and bring a smile to your face. Just drag, drop, and merge your Labubas to evolve them into new forms. How big can your Labuba grow?

title: Crazy Tunnel
description: Crazy Tunnel is a fast-paced, first-person arcade game. Navigate through the tunnel at breakneck speeds and aim for the longest distance possible.

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Sophie's Farm
description:
Plot: After a divorce, Sophie is left alone with a child. She starts from scratch, hoping to turn her life around.
Gameplay: Fulfill customer orders by matching items on the playing field. Spend your earnings to restore the farm and other locations. Each task reveals more of the story and brings you closer to the finale.

title: Car Paint
description: Carpaint is a free, family-friendly HTML5 logic puzzle game and casual brain teaser featuring 30 vibrant color grid challenges. Guide colorful cars across a 3×3 board, leaving paint trails to match reference patterns. This addictive, cross-platform online puzzle works in any browser or on mobile - play now!

title: Nonogram Jigsaw
description:
Discover the mystery of Nonogram! A large number of puzzles are waiting for you to solve, a lot of puzzles are waiting for you to complete, and various themes are waiting for you to unlock.
The difference is that this game can play puzzles and nonograms at the same time. Each time you pass a level, you can get a piece of puzzle piece, and finally you can unlock a lot of beautiful pictures. Train your brain from the basic rules and logic behind the picture cross puzzle!

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: My Little City
description: My Little City is the latest Match-3 challenge for aspiring city planners! The City Council has commissioned your company to prepare countless new building plots for construction. They need you to ensure the construction projects go according to plan! Supply building materials such as stones, water, electricity, and more! Use various boosters like sledgehammers, dynamite, or paint bombs to complete tasks on time. Play My Little City for free now and build your own Little City!

title: Teacher Simulator
description: Teacher Simulator is a fun simulation game in which you play the role of a teacher. Mark exams and ensure the kids are on their best behavior. You may have been the student, but now you get to be the one in charge!

title: Motor Tour
description: In Motor tour, the ultimate racing game, you'll experience an unforgettable adrenaline-pumping adventure with multiple modes to choose from. Take on fierce competitors, embark on an endless journey, or take things up a notch by daringly weaving through traffic with heart-stopping near misses. Don't wait any longer, start playing now and immerse yourself in this epic experience that is sure to leave you on the edge of your seat!

title: Color Yarn Sort
description: Color Yarn Sort is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you need to sort colorful spools of yarn into their matching buckets. The challenge? You have limited space to place the buckets, and you must think carefully about which bucket to move forward. Each yarn color must be placed in its corresponding bucket, but you can only move the buckets into the available spaces—there’s no room for error!

title: Number Rush
description:
You can absorb smaller or equal numbers while avoiding obstacles.
If you collide with a number bigger than you, it's game over.
Make the largest number possible to break through the wall and get the treasure chest~!

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Merge Home Mania
description: Welcome to an exciting game where creativity meets strategy! Merge items, build unique structures and decorate your perfect home. Use materials like stone, wood, textiles, flowers and plants to create furniture and decorations. Design beautiful rooms and show off your decorating talent!

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Find Hidden Cats
description: Explore charming black-and-white scenes inspired by iconic European cities in this relaxing yet addictive hidden object game. Every corner is packed with clever details and playful surprises - can you spot all 20 mischievous cats hiding in plain sight? Test your observation skills, take your time, and enjoy the satisfying thrill of discovering each well-hidden feline!

title: Shop Sorting 2
description:
Love organizing and keeping things tidy? Then Shop Sorting 2 is the perfect game for you! Step into a satisfying sorting puzzle where you arrange and categorize products in a well-stocked store.
In Shop Sorting 2, the challenge shifts from organizing specialty goods to managing the variety and chaos of a busy supermarket. Test your skills as you handle groceries, household items, and more. Enjoy rewarding match and sort gameplay, unlock new products, and upgrade your store layout.

title: Bird Sort Puzzle
description: Bird Sort Puzzle - Latest free sorting puzzle game with a new art style and collection of colorful birds. Bird Sort will definitely make you enjoy it while training your brain. This sorting game stimulates your brain in a very fun and challenging way. It's easy to play with one finger control and suitable for all ages. Test your IQ by passing unique levels and unlocking new challenges. Play Bird Sort now for free and enjoy super fun challenges and awesome brain teasers!

title: Crazy Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning supercars with crazy speed limits and drive them through 4 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Crazy Traffic Racer!

title: Build an Aquapark
description:
? Welcome to the craziest water park! ?

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

title: Machine City Balls
description: Machine City Balls is a ball parkour game. A must play game for those who like challenges. Collect rare balls and complete all ball game challenges to become a winner! Are you ready? Start your parkour journey now!

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Penalty Challenge Multiplayer
description:
Penalty Kicks: Striker or Goalkeeper?
Challenge the AI or players from around the world to earn experience points and climb the global leaderboard!

Choose a team from among the strongest clubs in Europe and European national teams to enter a high-level competition and show your talent!

You can play with your footballer, either male or female, as a striker or a goalkeeper: put your skills to the test amid the stadium smoke and the cheering crowd!

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: Dream Pet Hotel
description: Dream Pet Hotel is a charming connect puzzle game with an engaging hotel meta. Match tiles to clear levels, earn rewards, and unlock cozy rooms. Decorate and furnish spaces to create a unique style, then welcome adorable pets to stay in your hotel. Watch your collection grow as you design the perfect home for cats, dogs, pandas, and more. Relaxing, addictive, and fun to play online — build your dream pet hotel today!

title: Royal Crown Blast
description:
Royal Crown Blast is a colorful and relaxing casual puzzle game where you tap, blast, and clear vibrant blocks to complete each level’s goals.
Immerse yourself in a royal atmosphere as you match groups of blocks of the same color and shape, triggering spectacular explosions and powerful boosters.
With many levels, charming visuals, and simple one-tap controls, the game is both relaxing and delightfully addictive.

title: Merge Fantasy
description: Look around! The island is rich with raw materials waiting to be gathered. Extract resources from rocks, trees, gold ore or crystals,  then merge them to breathe life into the land! Dragons will be your companions on this magical journey filled with secrets and surprises at every turn.

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Drift Boss
description: In Drift Boss, master the art of controlled chaos as your car hurtles towards the top left corner, requiring your precise clicks or taps to execute perfect drifts to the top right. Anticipate tight spots, earn daily rewards, unlock new car skins through lootboxes, and gear up for the upcoming Easter holidays with an exclusive skin pack.

title: Hawaii Match 6
description: Escape to paradise in Hawaii Match 6! Explore beautiful island landscapes while matching exotic fruits, flowers, and tropical treasures. Complete fun and challenging goals in limited moves by combining symbols and creating powerful bonuses. Unlock helpful boosters, discover hidden rewards, and enjoy a relaxing island adventure full of colorful puzzles. Play Hawaii Match 6 now and enjoy endless tropical fun!

title: Snow Rider 3D nostalgia
description: Snow Rider 3D: Nostalgia brings back the beloved old version of the iconic sleigh-riding game — the same thrilling ride, relaxing snow tracks, and joyful music that started it all.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Cake Sort
description:
Cake Sort is a colorful and cozy puzzle game where you stack and sort delicious desserts to score as many points as possible! Move cakes around the table and match them by type to build perfect stacks of identical treats.
Bright graphics, smooth animations, and tasty visuals make the game relaxing, cheerful, and endlessly replayable.
Your goal is simple — keep sorting cakes and earn points for every perfect match until the table is full!

title: Ragdoll Football 2 Players
description: Ragdoll Football 2 players is an exciting and fun sports game in which you can feel like a real football player! Fight with friends or the computer by controlling a ragdoll stickman on the football field. Show your skills and wit to score grand goals and become a champion.

title: Tap 3 Mahjong
description: Match the mahjong tiles in a refreshing new way in Tap 3 Mahjong. Solve puzzles and train your brain while enjoying the classic mahjong motifs and soothing music. By collecting and matching the tiles, you clear every level one by one. Try this relaxing puzzle experience!

title: ASMR Nail Treatment
description: Today's patient is dealing with thickening of the fingernails. Help her maintain good nail hygiene by providing proper nail care. Showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Nail Treatment game. Once the treatment is done, dress her in fashionable outfit and create captivating nail art using various styles and accessories.

title: Soccer Tournament
description: Soccer Tournament is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Pool Party 3
description: Pool Party 3 is back with a highly anticipated third sequel boasting 4000+ levels! Match colorful water balloons in sets of three or more to clear levels with unique goals. Your friend Bunni is waiting for you to go on another trip to the water park together to have fun and solve puzzles! Enjoy this ultimate waterpark adventure, available for a splash of excitement anytime, anywhere!

title: Pop Fruit
description:
Pop Fruit is a bright and relaxing fruit-sorting puzzle game. Each bubble contains different fruits, and your goal is to pick the right fruits and place them into baskets. Match three identical fruits in a basket to clear them and keep the board moving.
Plan your moves carefully, because baskets have limited space.
Clear fruits, complete each level, and unlock more challenging stages with new fruit combinations.

title: Block Blaster Puzzle
description: Aim for high scores or complete level objectives. Rotate and arrange blocks to clear rows and columns while enjoying stunning visuals. Each perfect move brings satisfaction, challenging you to beat your best and master each puzzle!

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Stick War Saga
description: Prepare for an epic clash in Stick War: Saga, an exciting blend of fighting, action, strategy, and tower defense. Take command of your stickman army and lead them through nervous war campaigns. Mine resources, build your army, and unleash your strategic power to conquer enemy lands.

title: Jungle Temple Blast
description:
Hidden deep in the jungle stands an ancient structure known among explorers as the Crystal Temple. Stories say it holds an unimaginable trove of gems and jewels - but only the best puzzle solvers can help themselves to its riches.
Blast your way through hundreds of clever match 3 puzzles, crush gems and jewels, explore the secret jungle temple and recover ancient riches in this exciting treasure hunt adventure!

title: Watermelon Suika Game
description:
Engage, Merge, and Challenge!
Dive into a fruit-matching journey where you collide identical fruits to evolve them and keep them from falling out of the box. But here's the twist: when the same fruits collide, they transform into an entirely new fruit. Can you merge your way to the grand watermelon?

title: Shiny Jewels
description: Conquer each level with your logic, unleash powerful boosters and claim victory! Complete missions to earn unique rewards or join special events: break the chest, collect as many coins as possible within limited moves or race against time to complete the level.

title: My Purrfect Cat Hotel
description: Welcome to My Purrfect Cat Hotel, a super cute cat hotel simulation management game. Enjoy cute and vivid cartoon cat animations. This is the vacation spot for all meow stars, and your mission is to create the most cozy cat hotel. Serving a variety of adorable cats and catering to their needs. Make your hotel the most popular animal tycoon hotel.

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
description: Animal Block Pop Puzzle is a fun puzzle game with cute animal-themed visuals. ??✨ Match 3+ animal-shaped blocks ?? on a grid to clear them and score points. As you progress, the game gets faster and adds new tile colors for a growing challenge. With easy drag-and-drop controls and vibrant graphics, it offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages.

title: M5 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Farm: Merge Harvest
description: Transform your land into a beautiful farming haven. Start with a small plot and grow it by merging crops, designing structures and unlocking new areas. The more you build, the more surprises await, bringing new rewards and adventures at every stage!

title: Escape School Duel
description: Escape School Duel is a fast, funny, and tense escape challenge set inside a school that does not want to let you leave. Play solo to chase your best time, or go 2 player and turn every hallway into a race for freedom. One moment you are dodging traps, the next you are trying to slip past the principal in a long corridor or outsmart a teacher waiting near the classroom. Every section has its own danger, so learning the school layout is part of the strategy.

title: Racing in City
description: Racing in City is a driving game where you dodge traffic and complete challenges. Navigate through city traffic on a range of tracks while sitting with a view from behind the wheel. Participate in a long and illustrious driving career. Earn points and cash them in for cars and upgrades.

title: Wild West Match
description: Embark on a captivating Wild West adventure with Bonnie! Explore iconic landscapes, face challenges, and uncover secrets in this thrilling journey. The frontier spirit awaits – join Bonnie on the quest for an unforgettable adventure!

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion
