description: Step into the glamorous world of K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion! In this fun dress-up game, you become the ultimate stylist, creating spooky yet stylish looks for popular K-Pop stars. Mix and match Halloween costumes, trendy hairstyles, and cool accessories to design jaw-dropping outfits for the season’s most exciting event.

title: Halloween Merge Mania
description: Halloween Merge Mania is a fast-paced casual game with a fun Halloween vibe. Cute monster balls—pumpkins, black cats, mummies, vampires, and other iconic characters—appear on the screen. Your task is to merge identical creatures to create new, rarer, and more valuable ones. Each successful merge unlocks the next level of spooky yet adorable monsters, while the dark background and vivid graphics immerse you in the festive autumn atmosphere.

title: Egg Adventure 2
description: Mr Egg comes back, and also a challenge of intelligence and imagination.In egg adventure 2,you need to operate the Eggs to solve various puzzles and get out of the door.Imaginative levels ann funny painting style will take you into a whole ner puzzle world!The key to solving the puzzle may be a word or an action, that can you give it a try？

title: Mega Lamba Ramp
description: Crazy car stunts and stunt car racing games that will give you the most thrilling experience. Perform dangerous stunts on impossible tracks in our racing and stunt simulator. Perform stunts on all the cars for your favorite characters to move to the next level!

title: Tile Farm Story - Matching Game
description: Are you tired of your dull daily routine? Discover the magical world of the remote corners of the Earth where life is in harmony with nature. Help the heroines in the game build parks and nature reserves in the most exotic countries and populate them with the greatest variety of animals. But first, they will have to solve the mystery of the inheritance that the Stone sisters were left by their mysterious Grandpa.

title: Farm Mahjong 3D
description: Have you ever imagined playing your favorite 3D mahjong game in a farm setting? Mahjong 3D Farm does just that! It brings the popular Mahjong 3D game into the charming world of farms, filled with adorable animals, crops, and farming tools for you to match! So why wait? Play Mahjong 3D Farm Connect now and solve the puzzle amidst the fields!

title: Drop 4
description:
Drop 4 is a logic game. 

Drop your discs into the columns of the game grid and make a line of at least four chips either vertically, diagonally, or horizontally -  before your opponent does!

Two Game Modes:

 - Challenge a friend using online multiplayer or from the same device!

 - Play against the pc!

title: Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2
description: Welcome to "Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2," the sequel with more fun! Featuring Quick Play for random layouts and Chapter Division for structured progression. Complete chapters to unlock new ones, each filled with unique puzzles. A new shuffle mechanism solves tricky tile pairs, enhancing gameplay. Perfect for strategic minds seeking engaging, themed challenges. Join now and continue your Mahjong farm adventure!

title: Dummies World Cup
description: Dummies World Cup is a fun HTML5 football game for all ages! Choose your favorite team from 32 national squads and control your silly dummy player on a mini soccer field. Score goals, enjoy simple controls, and have fast-paced football fun. Easy to play, perfect for kids and families!

title: Motorbike
description: Drive your way through the harsh traffic on high speed, in this adrenaline pumping experiment, Motorbike is a Motor racing game with various modes. You can race with other opponents, drive on an endless trip or maybe even take it to the next level and try to overtake traffic vehicles with near misses. Play the game now and enjoy this awesome experiment.

title: DIY Makeup Salon - SPA Makeover Studio
description:
Have you ever dreamt of becoming a fashionable DIY make-up stylist in the beauty makeup artist’s salon?

Welcome to the DIY Makeup Salon: SPA Makeover- a fascinating beauty salon game, where you can create fun-filled makeovers for pretty girls! You can showcase your skills as a make-up stylist in our salon. Make use of various tools and facial cleansers to give your model a refreshing skin makeover. There are numerous dress up designs to explore for a flawless make up look!

title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
description:
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. 

Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level!

title: ASMR Tattoo Treatment
description: Treat a cool rocker in your ASMR clinic! Heal their sore piercing with gentle tools, retouch their fading star tattoo, and enjoy relaxing sounds with every step. Make them smile with your careful care and earn rewards for a perfect treatment!

title: Fruit Sort Logic
description: Fruit Sort Logic is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you sort colorful fruit juices on shelves. Move the juices around and match three of the same kind to clear a shelf. Space is limited, so each move matters. Clear all shelves to finish the level and unlock new ones. With smooth controls, bright visuals, and endless levels, the game is easy to play and satisfying to master. Perfect for a calm but clever puzzle experience.

title: Sheep N Sheep
description:
Everyone is playing the elimination game. It is said that only 0.1% of people can clear the second level of the daily challenge! A challenge before going to bed, you can't stop!
In addition to daily challenges, we also have a classic level mode, which is easy and decompressed, and casual elimination. Play a game anytime, anywhere, and have a brainstorming competition!

title: Guess the Kitty
description: Click on the right Kitty answer or else....... your cat will suffer from the consequences. Guess the Kitty is a fun, sadistic, quiz game. Unlock all the 10 endings by getting further into the game. Make sure not to go game-over!!

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description: Step into the world of ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang, where you take on the role of an adorable mukbang streamer! Get ready to indulge in delicious food, satisfy your cravings, and share the experience with your viewers in a cozy, interactive livestream. The more you eat and engage, the more you earn!

title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
description:
Choose your national team and enter the excitement of the World Cup! 
Play as your favorite heroes like Cristiano Ronald, Lionel Messi or Kylian Mbappe and jump into fast-paced 1v1 soccer battles to claim the cup! 
Defend your goal, watch for the perfect opening, and strike to score!
Challenge the CPU or compete against friends, sharpen your skills, and climb your way to the top. Victory is just a goal away!

title: Papa Cherry Saga
description:
Do you want to play a sweet little game? Then Papa Cherry Saga is the right one for a real sweet tooth. The main character - chef Papa Cherry will always help you to win a level. Taste the sweetness of the new fascinating match-3 game! 

Switch and match cookies in this tasty puzzle adventure to progress to the next level for that sweet winning feeling. Solve puzzles with quick thinking and smart moves, and be rewarded with delicious cascades and tasty combos!
Plan your moves by matching 3 or more cookies in a row. Match four or more cookies to create power-ups. Use boosters if you are stuck. Can’t win the level? Use five extra moves at the end of the game! Blast through the chocolate blocks and marshmallows to collect cookies across dozens of levels, guaranteed to have you craving more!

title: The Sorting Mart
description: The Sorting Mart is a store sorting puzzle game that lets you experience the fun of shopping in a store. Rearrange items between shelves to match three identical ones on a shelf, clearing it and letting the upper shelves drop down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves and keep matching before time runs out. If you get stuck, use the shuffle button to mix up the shelves and find matches more easily. Challenge your sorting skills as levels become more difficult!

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Get ready for intense action in Turbo Race 3D! Upgrade your car’s speed, acceleration, grip, and brakes to dominate the competition. Use shields and boosters to gain an edge, and customize your ride with decals and colors. Race through 3 exciting worlds—city, desert, and snow—while evading traffic and outpacing opponents on thrilling highways. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate racer?

title: Grill It All
description: Grill it all is a cooking-themed match-3 puzzle game. Play as a grill expert, matching identical skewers to complete orders. Strategically arrange ingredients like fish, leeks, and meatballs on grills. Test your observation and speed while using upgrade tools for strategic depth!

title: 2 Player Battle
description: Seeking an exciting way to spend time with friends and family is most significant. Look no further than Party Battle, the ultimate 2-4 player game! With 30 different games, this exciting collection has something for everyone.

title: Mahjong Sweet Easter
description: Easter eggs and candies, what could be better? Celebrate easter with our new game! Match as many tiles as you can before time is up and try to deal with "gravity"!

title: Match Masters
description: Match Masters is a real-time multiplayer match-3 puzzle game where players compete head-to-head on the same board. Each move requires strategic thinking, as it can benefit both you and your opponent. Utilize unique boosters, participate in tournaments, and climb the global leaderboards in this dynamic and engaging game.

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!

title: JailBreak : Escape from Prison
description: Experience the thrill of jailbreak escape, find a way out to freedom in our adventure filled jailbreak games! In this exciting jailbreak escape journey, you’ll take on the role of a character trapped behind jail bars, where every level presents unique challenges and exciting mini games, leading to the final goal of prison escape. Your goal in this prison games? Outsmart the system, solve clever puzzles, and find a way out in this immersive jailbreak escape adventure.

title: Jewel Blocks
description: Train your brain in this addictive logical arcade challenge with classic block shapes! Play endlessly to beat your high score and collect rewards! Easy to learn and fun to master. Also with lots of skins available.

title: Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight
description:
The zombie apocalypse has begun today!

Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight is an epic stick fighting game with cool effects and combos in the platformer genre.

The most epic battles and fights await you in a cube world similar to minecraft, where the red stick fights against zombies, skeleton archers, withers and even Noob!

The game is similar to Stick War, Stickman vs Zombies and Stickman Warriors. Hordes of zombies attacked the red stick and his friends!

title: Dynamons 10
description: Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 10! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Gold Temple world and the bonus cave. Encounter Tyrexar, Tyceratox, Cobragora, Pterodanox, Knightanyx and the diamond Guardian and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Shape-Shifting
description: Choose different vehicles to adapt to various terrains, allowing yourself to navigate through the terrain faster and become the first in the race.

title: Real Driving City Car Simulator
description: Your job is drive through city and avoid your car from crash. The main theme is to drive safely and reached the target position.

title: Hexa
description: Hexa is the latest version of the popular puzzle game Hexa Fever. In this strategic addictive game, you have to fill the lines of the hexagon with blocks to remove the whole line and gain gems. Enjoy the challenge and fun of this summer-themed puzzle adventure.

title: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY
description: ? Welcome to Paper Doll Diary: Doll DressUp, where the timeless charm of DIY paper dolls meets the exhilarating world of fashion dress up! Step into a realm of creativity and style where you become the master stylist of your enchanting paper doll dress up. With an expansive wardrobe featuring over 1000 fashion items, including the latest in trendy attire, distinctive accessories, diverse hairstyles, and soothing ASMR makeup touches, your creative potential is limitless.

title: The Chess
description:
'The Chess : A Clash of Kings' consists of traditional classic mode and special mode to break the chessboard randomly.
You can play a game, changing a board and piece at your preference.
Enjoy a game by changing it with any image you want.

title: Traffic Tap Survival
description: Traffic Tap Survival is a fast-paced traffic puzzle game where every tap matters. Control busy intersections, avoid crashes, and guide cars through dangerous roads filled with obstacles and tight turns. With simple controls, challenging levels, and intense survival gameplay, this addictive traffic management game will test your timing and reflexes. Perfect for fans of car puzzle games, traffic control games, and casual brain challenges.

title: WordMix
description:
WordMix is a game where words hide their connections, and you uncover them.
The board is filled with word cards. Some of them share a theme, meaning, or association. Your task is to sense the link and bring the words of one group into a single row.
Sometimes the answer is obvious. Sometimes you have to think. And finding the right link feels great.
Play hundreds of levels and endless mode!

title: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier
description:
Step into the world of retail and build the supermarket of your dreams! 

Manage customers, run the cash register, stock shelves, and keep your store thriving. From scanning groceries to cart-surfing adventures, every task brings your bustling market to life.

Take charge as the supermarket cashier, master time management, and turn your small store into a thriving grocery empire.

title: Merge Beasts
description: A fun and addictive merge game where you combine cute and quirky beasts to create stronger and rarer creatures. Each merge brings you closer to discovering powerful evolutions and unlocking new surprises. Collect coins, upgrade your beasts, and watch your monster city grow!

title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack
description: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack is a fun and challenging game where you shoot candy bubbles to match three or more on a rotating wheel. Use power-ups like the Bomb to blast nearby candies and the Stopwatch to freeze time for unlimited moves. Earn coins by clearing levels and use them to unlock more exciting levels. With increasing difficulty and sweet rewards, this game promises endless fun. Spin, aim, and conquer the candy wheel!

title: Racing Go
description:
This is a Highway or lanes racing game, speed into Traffic jam Lane splitting to get more points. navigate your way in a straight highway between cars and trucks

Racing Go is a new endless arcade racing game that takes you to another level of smooth driving simulations and high graphics quality, designed for the traffic racer fans with advanced features make this racing game the leading cars games for free.

title: Sum Master
description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.

title: 4 Hexa
description: 4 Hexa is a fun, colorful online puzzle game! Merge same-number blocks to reach higher scores in this addictive math trivia challenge. Perfect for fans of block match games and brain teasers! Play now and test your skills!

title: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake
description: Whip up layers of color and sweetness in Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake! Mix, bake, and frost your way to the perfect rainbow treat, then finish with cute decorations that make your cake sparkle with charm.

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: Champions FC
description: Champions FC is a fast-paced, bite-size soccer match where you dribble, pass, and time your kicks to break through defenders and score. Play two quick halves, react to turnovers, and keep the ball in bounds. Nail the perfect moment, hear the whistle, and become Champion.

title: Blox Fruits
description: Embark on an epic adventure across the seas in Blox Fruits, a Roblox MMORPG inspired by the world of One Piece. Choose your path as a Pirate or Marine, master powerful abilities granted by mystical Blox Fruits, and strive to become the strongest player in the game

title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
description: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker is a fast, satisfying idle clicker built around one of the internet’s newest chaotic obsessions: the “Goo Goo Gaga” meme. Goo Goo Gaga Clicker takes the addictive, dopamine-fueled mechanics of Brainrot Clicker and gives them a surreal makeover.  What starts as a simple tap session quickly turns into a full-on collection grind where every click pushes you closer to the next weird, iconic form!

title: Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered
description: Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered is a fun and calming puzzle game where you sort colorful bubbles into matching tubes. Just move the bubbles around, stack 3 to 10 of the same color together, and watch them pop away! With endless levels and relaxing gameplay, it’s the perfect brain teaser to unwind anytime, anywhere.

title: VEX Challenges
description:
Put your skills to the test in Vex Challenges, the newest online Vex game where the timer counts down instead of up. Try to get to the finish within the allotted time, and don’t forget to pick up the stars on the way!

Vex Challenges is just as gripping and thrilling as before, but includes a brand new way to play. The game includes 75 custom levels, a hidden Challenge Mode, new skins and a soundtrack that evolves as you progress. It’s Vex like you’ve never seen before!

title: World Soccer
description:
There are four objects, pull the object you want and fire it.
The object moves and pushes the other object or ball away
If you push the ball into the net before the opponent, you win!

title: Football Duel
description: Step into the arena in Football Duel! Take turns shooting and goalkeeping in this thrilling 3D penalty showdown. Swipe to score or defend — the first to 5 goals claims victory!

title: Snake Puzzle Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced puzzle experience where your goal is to wiggle the snake through each grid while avoiding obstacles and other snakes. With simple controls and a variety of challenging levels, this is the perfect game for quick play during your free time.

title: Police Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome police cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Luxury Highway Cars!

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck. But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

title: Parkour Block 2
description:
Skill game, classic mode from your favorite games right in the browser on your computer and phone!
More levels, more mechanics and more hardcore await you

title: Teacher Simulator Christmas Exam
description: Welcome to the funniest and busiest Christmas classroom ever! Teacher Simulator: Christmas Exam is a charming and playful teacher class simulator where you act as a holiday teacher. Manage orders, hand out exam papers, grade tests, etc. Different classes are scheduled on different days of the week, such as art class, geography class, math class, and so on.

title: Brainrot Clicker
description:
Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious and chaotic idle clicker game that plunges you into a bizarre world of meme-fueled madness. Your mission is simple: tap the screen to earn “Italian Brainrot Points” and unlock increasingly ridiculous AI-generated characters from the internet’s wildest corners.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

title: Hospital Surgeon Doctor Game
description: Run a multi-specialty hospital and treat patients through fun, guided mini-surgeries. Diagnose illnesses, use medical tools, and perform heart, dental, eye, ENT, and orthopedic procedures by tapping and dragging instruments to the correct areas. Complete each treatment step in sequence, unlock new cases, and help patients recover. The game features simple touch controls, colorful visuals, and casual doctor-simulation gameplay for all ages.

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: KrisMas Tiles
description: Collect presents in Krismas Tiles! In this Christmas Tiles game you must click on groups of tiles to blast them away. Stuck playing this christmas cards game? Then use a Krismas Bomb!

title: Palm Island Solitaire
description:
Palm Island Solitaire – Your Tropical Card Challenge! ☀️

Catch the island breeze with Palm Island Solitaire, a fresh twist on Golf Solitaire that blends strategy with sunny vibes.

Score low, reshuffle when needed, and enjoy every move with playful golf lingo and island flair.

Ready to relax, play smart, and swing into fun?  Let the adventure begin!

title: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong
description: Enjoy Daily Mahjong with a sparkling jewels twist! Play a unique layout every day, match dazzling gem tiles, and keep your streak alive to earn boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, and Torch. Track your longest streak and collect daily rewards as you match your way through beautiful designs. Miss a day? There’s a rare chance to recover it. Relax, match, and dive into the timeless charm of Daily Mahjong with a brilliant jewels theme!

title: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle
description: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle presents a fresh take on the classic word puzzle genre. With an array of unique gameplay mechanics, hints, and events, players are immersed in an engaging experience. The game's USP is its diverse content, offering a wide range of quotes across various themes, from inspirational to literary and beyond.

title: Steal Car Duel
description:
Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades!

Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

title: Stylish Nail Art
description: Do you love nail art and cute fashion styles? Stylish Nail art is the perfect game for you! Create your own beautiful nail designs with colorful nail polish, adorable stickers, and stylish accessories. Try different themes to make every nails look unique and trendy! Mix and match colors, patterns, and decorations to show your creativity and fashion sense. After finishing your nail art, choose a pretty background to complete your masterpiece. Simple, relaxing, and full of fun!

title: Snake 2048.io
description: Cubes are all around the arena and it is time to collect these cubes and merge them to have a longer 2048 cube snake! A great 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: Delicious Emilys New Beginning Valentines Edition
description: "Delicious Emily's New Beginning Valentine's Edition" invites players to experience heartfelt moments in the culinary world. Join Emily as she embarks on a romantic journey, balancing love and career. This special edition celebrates Valentine's Day with captivating storylines, delectable challenges, and festive visuals. Engage in time management gameplay, serve delicious dishes, and witness the magic of love unfold. With its charming narrative and festive atmosphere.

title: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat
description: Ever wanted to experience life as a mischievous cat? In Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat, you take on the role of a playful yet naughty kitty, causing absolute mayhem inside Grandma’s house—all from a first-person perspective! This exciting 3D simulation game lets you see through the eyes of a troublemaking feline as you knock over furniture, scratch walls, and do everything in your power to drive Grandma crazy! Are you ready to embrace the chaos?

title: Brainrot Mega Parkour
description: Step into the wildest parkour adventure yet. Brainrot Mega Parkour brings together four intense modes, forty handcrafted levels, and a cast of hilarious characters in a single high-speed package. Whether you’re climbing an endless tower, racing across a platform full of traps, escaping a rolling lava ball, or surviving a lava flood, every level pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit.

title: Home Pin 2
description:
Welcome to chapter 2 of the Home Pin. Start your adventure of the pin world in the secret manor!

You want to protect the family? You want to create your own manor and restore the beautiful manor to its former glory? Play Home Pin 2: Family Adventure now - a unique pull pin game with a family storyline you can’t ignore. No more fake ads, this is the game you are looking for!

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Click Click Clicker
description: Click Click Clicker is a single-player, idle clicker game where you earn money by clicking the button on the screen. Unlock various buttons, cursor styles, themes, and music.

title: Formula Racers
description: Formula Racers is the ultimate HTML5 browser top-down arcade racing game - no download required! Race on any device across 10 thrilling tracks, tackle dynamic lap tracking and real-time placement, and earn coins to unlock and upgrade cars (engine, gearbox, steering, brakes). This online racing game features HD graphics, responsive design, immersive SFX & music - perfect for mobile & desktop gamers seeking fast-paced, addictive arcade action!

title: SpelunKing
description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive underground, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Upgrade buildings and unlock new facilities as you match deeper! Reach the bottom of the mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: NSR Street Car Racing
description:
Hit the Streets & Dominate the Race! 
Jump into heart-pounding street racing action! Customize powerful cars, master drifts, unleash nitro boosts, and challenge real players in multiplayer races and intense 1v1 duels. Become a street-racing legend!

Ready, Set, Drift!

title: Bubble Trouble
description:
Avoid and pop the bubbles! Shoot the bubbles with your harpoon and split them in smaller bubbles, until eventually they disappear.
The classic arcade game from 2002, remastered.
Bubble Trouble (later Bubble Struggle) has been played hundreds of millions of times, labeled 'one of the top 10 online games'.

22 unique levels, for 1 or 2 players (on the same keyboard).
Final boss level.
Challenge other player's scores.

title: Balls and Bricks
description: If you're looking for a simple and no frills fun, then you're in the right place. Bricks vs. Balls is a relaxing game where you just aim and watch as everything gets destroyed. That is, if your aim is on point, but that's about the only catch. Are your ready to try your aim and have lots of fun? Then jump in and play!

title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
description:
ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a smart, direction-based puzzle game where every move counts. Your mission is to guide the arrow through intricate mazes and lead it to the exit.

Rotate tiles, shift paths, and think several steps ahead to build the perfect route. Each decision shapes the outcome, rewarding careful planning and shap logic.

title: Knit Rescue
description:
Knit Rescue is an engaging and original puzzle game where you untangle a knitted dragon to save a frightened kitten.

But it’s not enough to simply tap the right spools. You must unlock the correct spools and move them in the right direction to stop the dragon in time.

Plan your moves, follow the arrows, and solve each level using logic and strategy. Knit Rescue is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of brain games, logic puzzles, and strategy games.

title: Burger Chef Restaurant
description: Become the best chef of burgers cook and serve delicious hamburgers in your own burger restaurant. Manage your restaurant in one of the most dynamic and interesting cooking games! 180 levels, big burger chef championship, time attack are waiting you here!

title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
description:
Various kinds of butterflies sitting on leaves.
Shy butterflies can only fly next to friends of the same kind.
Bring its friends to one leaf and fly them together~

title: Match Find 3D
description:
Are you a master player of finding games?Do you enjoy matching puzzle games?Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game - Match Find 3D!
Unique gameplay, a combination of collecting and matching, and well-designed levels that will keep you entertained.

title: Hexa Tap Away
description: Hexa Tap Away is a sleek one-direction hex puzzle. Drag tiles to move them in the only direction they can travel, create space, and clear the board. Each level adds trickier layouts, blockers, and tight corridors that demand planning ahead. Short, snackable stages, smooth controls, and a clean look make it easy to start and hard to stop. Stuck? Try a hint or rethink your route and there’s always a smarter move!

title: Mahjong Linker  Kyodai Game
description: In this Kyodai game you must link Mahjong tiles with  lines maximumThis free game is a good mix of puzzle game and speed You must think wisely but you have to be fast because you have limited time to finish each level

title: Mega Makeup - Seasons Best
description: Mega Makeup Seasons Best is the ultimate makeup game where creativity knows no bounds! Design stunning looks for each month of the year with vibrant eyeshadows, bold lipsticks, sparkling gems, and stylish accessories. Choose between Pro Mode for precision or Freestyle Mode for endless color combinations. Complete your seasonal masterpiece with matching jewelry and hair accessories. Perfect for makeup enthusiasts, this game is your go-to for all things beauty and style! Play now!

title: Tap Arrow Away
description: Tap Arrow Away is an addictive puzzle game that combines tap-away gameplay, hidden picture discovery, and satisfying pixel art reveals. Remove arrow blocks in the correct order, solve clever brain puzzles, and uncover cute animals, colorful objects, and secret pixel images hidden beneath every level. This relaxing puzzle adventure offers hundreds of levels, rewarding progression, and endless fun for fans of logic games, brain teasers, and hidden picture puzzles.

title: Real Flight Simulator 3D
description: The invention of planes finally led to the getting rid of the invisible mighty string of gravity. We can explore the sky and the outer space at last! Although the chances are given to the selected few, this game might give you a glimpse of what it looks like to fly a plane over the mountains and rivers.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: 2048 Match Balls
description: With super simple rules and addictive gameplay, this logic game offers endless fun while challenging your brain. Merge balls and level up. Each merge increases the value of the balls while also changing their color and size. Be smart and dive into a vibrant world of numbers!

title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
description: Welcome to Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary – the place where your style dreams come to life! Step into the shoes of a talented fashion designer, build your own boutique, and create stunning outfits that dazzle the world. From fabric to final look, you’re in charge of every stitch!

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Yoga Master
description:
Yoga is a great way to improve your quality of life. It is also a great way to entertain yourself in this game: Yoga Master.

Yoga Master is an addictive 3D running game with different levels that will challenge even the fastest reflex.

title: Molang Match'n Munch
description:
Join Molang and Piu Piu in a heartwarming match-3 adventure! Travel the world, collect rare ingredients, and solve sweet puzzles to save the lost recipes in the Great Book of Flavors before they vanish forever!
Travel through the world's greatest real and imaginary cities, collect rare ingredients, and solve delicious match-3 puzzles to advance and save these culinary treasures!

title: Bubble Shooter Candy 3
description: Bubble Shooter Candy 3 is the long-awaited third installment of the sweetest Bubble Shooter game ever made. The brand new set of sweet candies will make you fall in love with this game from the very first moment you start popping them! The game boasts a brand new ‘Candy Swap’ feature that enables you to swap the current candy in your shooter with the incoming one. Now you can play even more strategically!  Enjoy the brand new soundtrack and crush more candies than ever before!

title: Stick Man Battle Fighting
description: Enter the world of Stick Man Battle Fighting and every move matters! This casual fighting game lets you unleash your skills in dynamic stickman battles against enemies. Master various fighting styles and begin exciting single-mode combat. Choose a weapon and customize your hero.

title: Spider Solitaire
description: Get ready to dive into the timeless classic Spider Solitaire, reimagined for mobile with sleek design and intuitive gameplay! Perfect for players of all skill levels, this game offers a relaxing yet challenging card puzzle experience anytime, anywhere.

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Tasty Jewel
description: This box of sweets contains precious jewel candies! Match and combine them to craft exploding ones! It can help you crush through blocks standing in your way. The classic turn based match-3 arcade with lots of challenging levels and modes awaits you!

title: Vex Try To Fly
description: Vex Try To Fly is a fast-paced launch adventure where your goal is simple: send Vex as far as possible! Blast out of a cannon, collect powerful boosts like jump potions, jetpacks, and portals, and use bounce platforms and wind to keep Vex in the air. Avoid dangerous obstacles, upgrade everything, and improve every run. Master the slam ability, fly farther than ever before, and discover how far Vex can go!

title: World Solitaire -Tripeaks-
description:
It is TriPeaks, one of the most famous solitaires in the world.
Take a step to go up and test your brain and luck
How far can I clean it?

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Screw Spin
description:
Screw Spin is a satisfying logic puzzle where you unscrew colorful bolts and sort them into matching boxes. It’s relaxing yet challenging, combining planning, logic, and a touch of strategy.

Each level introduces a new layout with bolts of different colors. Your goal is to clear the entire panel by removing all the bolts, carefully managing your limited storage slots and placing each bolt in the correct container.

title: Match Tile 3D
description: Match Tile 3D is an addictive puzzle, not only connect your brain to logical thinking but also is a fun triple matching game which is easy for everyone to play!

title: Sushi Puzzle
description: Welcome to a tasty brain teaser where every move counts! But be careful—space is limited ?️, so you’ll need to calculate each tap and plan your moves wisely.

title: Dynamons 7
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 7! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Tall Pines world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Crocynos, Huango, Cybeenyx, Aragonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: My Tiny Market
description: In My Tiny Market, you're the boss of your very own supermarket. Manage your time and resources well to find the perfect balance between all your tasks: restock shelves, serve customers and keep everything running at full speed!

title: Dog Escape
description: Welcome to Dog Escape, the hide-and-seek puzzle where saving a dog is only the beginning. Guide a lost canine through traps and guards, then bring it home to cuddle, feed, and style! If you adore puppy-care, dress-up, and dog games with heart, this is your new daily ritual. Rescue your puppies now!

title: Giant Sushi Merge Master Game
description:
Giant Sushi is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge sushi!
Sounds easy, doesn't it? Take the challenge and become the new sushi master!

title: Foot Hospital
description: HELP! Doctor, I hurt my feet, ouch! It is so painful!Could you please help me to cure my feet? I know you have the best medical tools here!

title: Bubble Shooter Pop
description: Get ready for a nostalgic blast from the past with Bubble Shooter Pop - Blast Fun, the ultimate classic bubble shooter game! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant bubbles, addictive gameplay, and endless excitement.

title: Lumber Factory Simulator
description:
Welcome to "Lumber Mill Simulator"! This is an exciting game where you own a sawmill.
Your success depends on your ability to make informed decisions, effectively manage resources and grow your business. Are you ready to become a great lumber tycoon?

title: Coin Stack Up
description:
Coin Stack Up is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where strategy meets stacking fun!
Connect and stack coins of the same color to create powerful combinations and clear the board.
To make a valid move, you must connect at least 3 coins of the same color. The bigger the stack, the better the results! Each level comes with specific goals shown at the top of the screen - plan your moves carefully to complete them before you run out of moves.

title: Block Wood Puzzle 2
description:
Drag and drop the wooden blocks to fill the gap. 

Complete a row to score points. Complete 2 rows or more to score bonus points.

How high can you score?

title: Zuma Boom
description:
Enjoy the classic match-3 arcade marble shooter!

Shoot colored balls to create matches of three or more of the same color and clear the chain.

Do not let the balls reach the finish hole. 

Create chain reactions to earn bonus points and achieve higher scores.

title: Crystal Connect
description: Discover the enchanting world of Crystal Connect, a captivating game with breathtaking graphics! Join a pair of dwarves on an epic quest to collect precious crystals and navigate through dozens of challenging levels in this immersive connect-style adventure game. Connect pairs of gems, create powerful combinations and pave your way to victory. Dive into the adventure today and discover the magic of Crystal Connect

title: Geometry Stars
description: Enjoy the Geometry Stars world with a brand new adventure! New levels, new music, new monsters, new everything!. Flex your clicky finger as you jump, fly and flip your way through dark caves and spiky obstacles. Collect many stars as you can to upgrade your famous characters and find the secrets of this Rhythm-based adventure.

title: Draw Climber
description:
Funniest race you ever played ! Draw your legs to win the race!
Any drawing will make you run !
When you are stuck you can draw another shape to pass!

title: 3Dash
description: 3Dash is a fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash—dash, jump, and flip through dizzying, rotating tracks while keeping perfect time. Tackle six hand-crafted levels, then build your own with the level editor for endless replay

title: Epic Racing - Descent on Cars
description:
To tear yourself and your neighbor to shreds, but to reach the finish line first is an "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars"!

Epic collisions, a serious fight to the finish line and a million ways to bend and twist metal - that's what awaits you in the game "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars".

Burn rubber and tear metal - the game begins!

title: Merge Fruit
description: Grapes are combined to become cherry! Cherries are combined to become tangerine! Tangerines are combined to....? Which fruit will come out next? Try to make the biggest golden watermelon!

title: Solitaire Daily
description: Your favorite dose of daily solitaire is here! Come back everyday to sit back, relax and play a game of cards! Do you have what it takes to become an absolute Solitaire master? Try it now.

title: Mojicon Love Connect
description: 2Million Games presents Mojicon Love Connect: the biggest Mojicon game to date! Match sweets, beat challenging levels and discover sweet moments in the animal kingdom!

title: Frogtastic
description:
Frogtastic is a HTML5 puzzle game freely inspired to Zuma gameplay. 
Enjoy this premium game with 13 levels of increasing difficulty. 
Make combo and destroy all the balls before they reach the dip!

title: Charger City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle car through an expansive night city map! Customize and upgrade your muscle car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 4 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Burger Here
description: From a small restaurant to a burger empire! Serve customers, clean tables, hire the best staff and deliver orders on time. Make each burger a masterpiece that everyone will crave. Expand to 4 restaurants and attract more customers.

title: Bubble Game 3D
description: Get ready for bubble-popping fun in Bubble Game 3D, a super cool version of the original classic Bubble Shooter game, now with amazing 3D graphics. Aim, match, and pop colorful bubbles in a world that looks like it’s coming right out of the screen. This is Bubble Shooter 3D like you’ve never seen before!

title: Murder Mystery
description: Murder Mystery – A fast-paced social deduction game. One player is the killer, another the sheriff, the rest are innocents. Use logic, stealth, and quick decisions to survive or expose the murderer. Perfect for high engagement and multiplayer retention.

title: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa
description: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa is a relaxing style game where you guide a charming girl through a soothing Japanese hair spa filled with calming treatments and revitalizing masks. Once refreshed, dress her in elegant kimonos, choose delicate accessories, and personalize her look with stunning hairstyles, makeup, and shoes. It's your peaceful retreat into beauty, fashion, and creative expression.

title: Pool 8 Ball Mania
description: The classic eight-ball pool for your phone! Play against a computer controlled opponent or against a friend. Enjoy realistic ball physics and dynamic gameplay. Focus and use the aiming help to shoot the most precise shots.

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps
description: Welcome to one of the funniest and coolest skill games - Geometry Dash Maze map. Here, you will dive into the fun and amazing world of geometric shapes. Your character will become a cool glowing square with a big smile. In the game, you will help the square overcome all obstacles. To do this, you will need all your dexterity and cunning, because a difficult path awaits you ahead. Be careful and try to click quickly to make the jump in time. Think over all actions and prepare for the next jump,

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Jigsolitaire is a game you’ll want to return to every day: it helps you unwind, disconnect from stress, and enjoy a small moment of calm just for yourself. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: Butterfly Match Mastery
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical forest in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Free the butterflies by finding identical pairs of wings!

Butterfly Match Mastery is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure. Free butterflies in an enchanted magical forest by connecting pairs of identical wings and enjoy their flight! But don't forget about the time, when it runs out - you will lose.

title: Tunnel Road
description: Tunnel Road is an adrenaline-filled arcade game that requires quick reflexes, sharp focus and a great visual reaction! Keep up with the speed, avoid obstacles and cover the longest distance while advancing in a colorful and dynamic tunnel!

title: Summer Onet Connect
description: Welcome to Summer Onet Connect, the ultimate tile-matching puzzle game that brings the perfect sunny vacation vibes straight to your screen! Escape to a beautiful, sun-drenched beach where matching pairs, clear horizons, and high-score triumphs await.

title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
description: Experience thrilling car crashes with realistic physics and intense destruction! Smash, wreck, and demolish vehicles in crash tests, demolition derbies, and sandbox modes. Dive into authentic impact mechanics and explore the ultimate crash simulator for car destruction fans!

title: Flower Sort
description:
Sort Flowers is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you sort flowers by type!
Combine three identical flowers in one pot to grow a lush, beautiful bush.
Plan your moves, create satisfying merge chains, and enjoy the colorful and cozy atmosphere.
Each level brings new combinations, vibrant colors, and delightful visual effects.

title: Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam
description:
Slide the blocks, beat the clock, and master the puzzle jam!

Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam – Slide, Match, and Clear the Grid!

Get ready to train your brain in the most colorful way possible! In Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam, your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive—slide the colorful blocks to their matching exits and clear the board before time runs out.

title: Draw Bridge: Brain Game
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle - Draw Game is an exciting and challenging brain game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car!

title: Mine Sweeper
description:
A perfect puzzle game with skill + luck + simple rules.
The return of the most popular game in the world!
Enjoy the minesweeper, the classic brainstorming game.

title: Word Connect Puzzle
description: Word Connect Puzzle is a relaxing yet brain-boosting word game. Swipe letters to form hidden words, unlock new packs, and watch the difficulty rise as your vocabulary grows. Earn stars, complete daily challenges, and use hints when you’re stuck. Play offline anytime, enjoy clean visuals and smooth controls, and chase streak bonuses for higher scores. Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle runs—smart, simple, and satisfying for all ages.

title: Garden Block Puzzle
description: A neglected garden, overrun by weeds and dried flowers… it can't stay like this! Test your wits, place the bricks strategically, complete each level and bring your garden back to life. Have fun playing and create the perfect space to relax.

title: Shelf Shift Match
description: Test your strategy and speed in Shelf Shift Match! Shift items on the shelves to create perfect matches of three, clearing the way to reveal hidden shadowed items. But beware—unwise moves can block your shelves, leaving no space to shift and leading to game over! If you're stuck, use the shuffle button to mix things up and find new matches.

title: Winter Hexa Stack
description: Winter Hexa Stack is a cozy and addictive winter-themed puzzle game where you clear the board by stacking three matching hex tiles. Tap a tile to place it in an empty spot or on top of a similar tile. When you match three identical tiles, they disappear and free up valuable space. Be careful—if your holding slots fill up or the timer runs out, the level ends. Plan your moves, stay organized, and enjoy a relaxing winter atmosphere.

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower 2 brings back the magic in a fun, family-friendly way! Pop colorful bubbles, unlock cozy enchanted rooms, and help the Witch Tower shine again. Meet adorable familiars, enjoy charming details, and celebrate the magic of every season — even a touch of Halloween spookiness! Easy to play for all ages, with plenty of bubble-shooting fun to enjoy anytime.

title: Toy Match
description: Toy Match is a delightful match-three game with charming graphics that appeal to all ages.

title: Domino Solitaire
description: Experience the free online Domino Solitaire challenge with 90 engaging levels! Match domino tiles to clear the board and sharpen your mind in this addictive puzzle game. With sleek graphics, intuitive controls, and unlimited play, Domino Solitaire offers hours of brain-teasing fun. Use strategy to connect matching ends, tap the closed pile for new tiles, and unleash wild domino power-ups when you’re stuck. Perfect for desktop and mobile, this single-player game tests your matching skills.

title: Papas Burger Cook
description:
Cook and travel through amazing burger restaurants, discover delicious recipes, prepare tasty meals, and serve hungry customers in the best burger shop.
This is a crazy cooking game full of fast kitchen action, burger fever, and food madness. Papas Burger Cook - fun cooking simulation game.
Become the ultimate burger chef, master every recipe, and reach the highest rank in this exciting food cooking adventure.

title: Farm Fun
description: Farm Fun is an interesting and addictive puzzle board game. It’s more than just puzzle - it's a fun tile game experience that'll take you to another level!

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Moto Road Rash 3D 2
description: Rev up your engines and feel the thrill of the open road in Moto Road rash 3D 2! This high-octane motorcycle game immerses you in a heart-pounding racing experience where agility and precision are your best allies. Zoom through a dynamic, ever-changing cityscape, weaving between lanes, dodging traffic, and mastering daring stunts.

title: Beat The Zombies
description: Beat the Zombies is a vertical action RPG blending strategy and adventure. Explore a dangerous plant-zombie world, fight through stages, and defeat all plant zombies in your way!

title: Rescue Hero
description: The hero begins his journey for treasure and save princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to pull the pins in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save princess away from dragon, wolf and monster safely.

title: Bubble Burst
description: Burst your way through space in Bubble Burst! Shoot all bubbles of a kind and fill your burst meter. Play this amazing bubbleshooter now!

title: Block Puzzle Sudoku
description:
Easy to play but challenging puzzle game!
Easy to play, but difficult to be a master. The more blocks crush, the more score you will get. Try it and you will love this block puzzle game.
Features of the Block Puzzle Sudoku:
Hours of fun, exciting play.
Innovation of classic brick game.
No time limits.
You can play anytime and anywhere! We really hope you enjoy it!

title: Squishy: Taba Paw ASMR
description: A cute collection of relaxing taba paws and other squishes on your smartphone! Relax by sipping squishes in different directions and enjoy sound of squishing!

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

title: Put the fruit together!
description: A game in the genre of "Connect the Balls" and "2048". Stack identical fruits to combine them into a new larger fruit! The game has incredibly beautiful and cute graphics, nice music accompaniment and addictive gameplay!

title: Golden Frontier
description: This simulation game takes you on a Wild West adventure. Mine and manage resources, grow crops and craft goods as you aim to build a thriving city in the frontier lands. Invite friends to become your neighbors to trade and co-op, and progress quicker. Hunt for gold, unlock new locations, and discover secrets as the story unfolds. Meet a colorful cast of characters, including trappers, Indians and criminals.

title: i8 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning supercar through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Emergency Jam
description: As you progress, encounter cars in 8 different colors, adding complexity to your strategy. Use powerful boosters to line up characters by color or shuffle vehicles, clearing the way more efficiently. Test your logic, think fast, and rescue passengers.

title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
description: Sweet Triple Mahjong is a relaxing yet challenging tile-matching puzzle game with a delicious candy theme. Match three identical tiles that are free on the left or right to collect them and clear the board. Each level introduces new tile layouts that test your observation and strategy skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Sweet Triple Mahjong offers smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and satisfying progression across multiple levels.

title: Royal Jewels Match
description: Matching jewels has never been so much fun! Unlock unique levels, participate in special events and take on surprising challenges. Collect coins with your matches and show off your decorating skills. Earn crowns as you progress and become a true master of the game!

title: Kick Lucky Boxes Online
description: Kick Lucky Boxes Online is a fast-paced progression game where players launch lucky blocks across dangerous arenas to discover rare Brainrots and valuable rewards. Upgrade kick power, improve speed, and return safely before tsunamis flood the map. The game features online solo play with chat and room invites, local 2-player gameplay, character customization, rebirth progression, and more than 75 collectible Brainrots across 14 rarity classes.

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Nine Cards Of Winter
description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Nine Cards of Winter, a fun and relaxing tile-matching game!
Pick up to 9 Christmas tiles and match 3 of the same to clear them. Watch out — if your stack fills up, the game is over!
Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles, solve tricky puzzles, and enjoy cute holiday designs.It’s easy to play, relaxing to enjoy, and full of winter charm!

title: Hotfoot Baseball
description:
Simple baseball game with fun, cartoony players and easy one-click controls. It’s fast to learn and fun to play!

Unlike other baseball games, the action doesn’t stop after you hit the ball. You need to decide when to run, move to the next base, and try to score runs. It’s all about timing and quick decisions.

Pick one of the best baseball countries and try to win the championship. The game keeps the excitement of baseball but with simple rules, so anyone can enjoy it.

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.

title: Block TNT Blast
description: Block TNT Blast is an exciting sandbox simulation game that will ignite your imagination and strategic skills. In this game, players are tasked with strategically placing bombs to demolish various objects and earn diamonds. These diamonds are then used to unlock a wide range of powerful bombs, adding to the explosive mayhem. With its captivating gameplay and stunning graphics, Block TNT Blast offers endless hours of entertainment for players of all ages.

title: Spaceflight Simulator
description: Do you have a space dream? Spaceflight Simulator is a challenging spaceflight simulation game suitable for boys who love to build and launch rockets. The game has real-life conditions in space.

title: Sudoblock Daily
description: Play this addictive combination between Sudoku and Blocks, Sudoblock! This will keep you busy for hours, test it yourself! Come back everyday for new unique challenges!

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Fast Ball Jump
description: Let’s prepare yourself to feel happy and relaxed by playing going balls. Roll, spin, jump and don’t lose lives because unexpected obstacles lie ahead. Get ready & participate in an epic roll ball race in a different environment. You will have a lot of fun in your spare time by playing green ball run 2048 and journey ball sky.

title: Cat Escape
description: Play Cat Escape, the viral cat puzzle hide-and-seek game now free online! Sneak past guards, dodge traps, and guide your kitty to safety across hundreds of stealth levels. Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com

title: Jewel Christmas Story
description: The most anticipated holiday of the year is here! Christmas is just around the corner and lots of holiday fun full of gifts and sweets is waiting for you in this new match3 game. Collect game currency, achieve combos, and use boosters in various missions.

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Avenger Guard
description: Dark forces have destroyed your homeland—rise as the Avenger Guard! Merge heroes to unlock power, fortify defenses, and take vengeance. Lead your legendary squad to repel waves of enemies, upgrade through fusion, and reclaim what’s yours. Will you be the last line of defense?

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Dynamons 9
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 9! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Halloween world and the bonus cave.

Encounter Tholanyx, Scarykin, Anubolt, Sauryx in frankenstein skin, Zonysus in Dracula skin and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: sprunki character maker OC
description: The Sprunki Character Maker OC is an interactive tool that allows users to create their own unique characters within the Sprunki universe. Featuring a wide range of customization options, assets, and design tools, it empowers players to craft characters that match the game’s distinctive art style and themes. This experience encourages creativity, self-expression, and deeper engagement with the Sprunki community

title: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat!
description: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat is an exciting and relaxing puzzle game that will test your strategic thinking and planning skills!

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: 10x10
description: 10x10 game is a challenging Tetris-inspired puzzle game. The game's field size is 10x10 and you can place the assigned blocks into it. Once you successfully formed a line, it will disappear. Place blocks in the correct positions to keep forming lines.

title: Shanghai Town
description:
Mahjong matching game!
If you select the same mahjong block, it will be removed.
Please remove the last block!
Match the tiles to create a cool building!
Collect the buildings and create a cool city!

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: Steal Brainrot Arena
description: Steal Brainrot Arena is a fast-paced collection and heist game where every match turns into a battle of wallets, wits, and sneaky steals. Play solo in 1 Player mode or team up and compete in 2 Player mode as you build the ultimate Brainrot lineup. With over 45+ brainrot characters to discover, your goal is simple: buy better Brainrots, earn more, and create the most stacked collection in the arena.

title: Metro Escape
description: On Metro escape you must search the room for items that will help you escape. Search for itens in the metro and use them to solve the puzzles. Look carefully at the various patterns around the metro and solve the riddles. Good luck to search for your way to escape!

title: Monster Escape
description: Monster Escape is a thrilling puzzle platformer where you rotate the entire level to help a little green monster grab the key and escape the dark dungeon. Each stage is packed with tricky obstacles — spikes, falling crates, and narrow passages that put your timing and planning skills to the test. The unique mechanic — rotate the world, find the path, unlock the door — creates plenty of satisfying moments as you advance.

title: Tag Run
description: Tag Run is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer action parkour game where 1–4 local players race to ditch the bomb and be the last standing! Tag opponents, use teleport pads and jump springs, and survive thrilling matches with 6 players. Explore six dynamic maps: Pixel, Winter, Lava, Jungle, Candy, and Night, and packed with creative power-ups. Test your reflexes, strategy, and parkour skills in this fast-paced, chaotic playground challenge.

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Geometry Missile
description: Navigate your missile through challenging geometric obstacle courses! Control a triangular missile that automatically flies forward while you tap to guide it up and down. Avoid collisions with various shapes like triangles, rectangles, and spikes to reach the gate at each level's end. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade adventure!

title: Jewel Miner Quest
description: The dazzling world of gems awaits! Participate in thrilling events within limited moves or time. Solve captivating puzzles, complete fun tasks, and enjoy daily bonuses. Discover many terrific surprises with every move and see how far you can go.

title: Block Pixels
description:
Block Pixels is a vibrant puzzle game where classic block-clearing action meets the creative joy of pixel art discovery.

Your main goal is to strategically place colorful pieces to clear lines on the board. But the real magic lies in what you clear. Each block you eliminate contributes to a larger masterpiece. Clearing specific colors helps you build and reveal dozens of charming hidden images, from cute animals to fun objects.

title: Traffic Parking
description: Traffic Parking is a car puzzle game to park the car into the garage of the house, the car is on the road looking for a way to go home by avoiding other cars. Sometimes there are rocks on the road that must be removed so that the car can pass through. You also need tricks at certain levels to make the road passable for cars.

title: Sandwich Runner
description: Sandwich Runner is a fun game. Collect ingredients on the way to the goal, how high will it reach? The diner is very hungry and he can't wait to eat. Collect steaks, chicken thighs, fried eggs, and sushi. Be careful to avoid bad food like mold and rot or it will make the diner sick! Red peppers will make the diner spitfire! Can you keep the diner happy and pass the level? Good luck!

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Mahjong Four Rivers
description: Discover the engaging world of Mahjong Four Rivers – a fresh take on the classic puzzle game. With its traditional charm and modern gameplay, it’s perfect for sharpening your observation and strategy skills. Enjoy beautifully designed tiles and the rewarding challenge of clearing the board. Play for free on your phone or computer, wherever you are.

title: Foot Doctor
description:
Foot Doctor features:
- amazing graphics
- multiple character skins

title: Pet Salon Simulator
description: It's a very busy day at the pet salon! Jump in and give our furry friends the full treatment. Wash, groom, and style them to look even more charming and adorable. Show off your grooming skills and create picture-perfect transformations that will make every pet leave feeling proud and confident!

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Jewel Link
description:
Connect matching jewels and clear the board! In Jewel Link, a Connect2 game inspired by Bejeweled, your goal is simple: find two identical jewels and link them together to make them disappear. 

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and trickier. Placements will test your ability to think ahead and spot Connect-2 connections quickly. It’s not just about what you see - it’s about how you navigate the board to match the jewels.

title: Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2
description: Welcome to Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2, the sequel everyone has been craving! Dive into 150+ exciting layouts and conquer them using powerful boosters like Shuffle, Torch or Undo. With two distinctive tile skins, the challenge intensifies. Can you beat your previous high score? Try it now you have 8 minutes to complete each layout! Play the sweetest Mahjong adventure now and become the best Mahjong player there is!

title: Bubble Farm
description:
Bubble Farm is a fun and Addictive shooting bubble buster game.

Complete a level to unlock the next level, each level have a different difficulty and challenge

title: Interior Designer - Decor Life
description: Interior Designer: Unpacking House is a delightful and relaxing casual game that allows you to explore your creativity through interior design. Whether you’re tackling specific challenges or letting your imagination run wild, this game offers an immersive experience where you can design beautiful spaces and create captivating aesthetics.

title: Obby Survive Parkour
description:
Obby Survivor Parkour is a fast-paced 3D parkour and escape game designed for players who trust their reflexes. You will test both your speed and balance skills while trying to survive in the obstacle filled course!

Each section is full of new traps and platforms that will challenge you even more. Try to survive tsunami waves, obstacle courses, lava attacks, snowball storms and red light green light game and reach the finish line.  Can you be one of the few who can reach the end of the course?

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade.
