Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Ice Cream Inc.
description:
Ice Cream Simulator is a satisfying casual game where you step into the shoes of a master ice cream artist. Your goal is to run the most popular shop in town by creating the ice cream of your dreams!

From classic Vanilla and Dark Chocolate to fruity Mango and Juicy Strawberry, you have all the ingredients needed to create the perfect frozen treat. Whether your customers want a soft-serve cone, ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, or traditional Gelato, it’s up to you to serve them with a smile.

title: Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24
description: In this Real Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24 you will experience the piloting of an aircraft. This free airplane game will let you involve in navigating the aircraft through a series of obstacles, such as sea, mountains, buildings, and other aircraft while avoiding crashes and collisions and maintaining the plane's height and speed. It would be best if you also had to manage the airplane fuel, speed, altitude, and other flying physics.

title: Rope Color Sort 3D
description: Rope Color Sort 3D is a creative puzzle game where players need to skillfully sort colorful ropes into their corresponding tubes. The game features beautiful 3D graphics and smooth physics effects, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of "Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution"! This free online game is perfect for children and teenagers. Develop your logic and strategic thinking while taking part in epic battles with monsters. You will control an army of fire, water, earth and air elementals in an exciting battle to liberate their worlds.

title: Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour
description: Step into the absurd universe of Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour, where chaos, memes, and tricky obstacle runs collide! Pick your favorite Brainrot characters, master wild parkour tracks, and survive each hilarious stage with your reflexes and timing.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Epic
description: Relax, enjoy and train your brain with Jigsaw Puzzle Epic, a classic jigsaw puzzle game with more then 2000's of high quality picture puzzles in variety of different collections suitable for both adults and children.

title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
description: Welcome to the second instalment of the popular Mahjong game that combines Solitaire Mahjong gameplay with the beautiful theme of the legendary Garden Tales match 3 game. Garden Tales Mahjong 2 features incredible 250+ puzzle layouts, 'Quick Play' mode for instant action, 'Chapters Mode' to unlock new puzzles. The more puzzles you complete the more puzzles you unlock. Enjoy this captivating journey and start your Garden Tales Mahjong adventure today!

title: Number Place Travel
description:
Fill the grid with numbers 1–9 so that no same number appears in any row, column, or 3×3 block!
Tap a cell and choose a number to place it.
You can make up to 3 mistakes. Fill in everything correctly to clear the puzzle!

title: Drop Animals
description:
Drop Animals: Merge, Match & Play Your Way Through Adorable Levels! ??

Step into the cheerful world of Drop Animals, where cute critters, colorful blocks, and satisfying merge mechanics come together in a delightful puzzle adventure! Drop vibrant animal blocks, merge matching colors, and create exciting chain reactions as you enjoy a relaxing yet strategic gameplay experience. ???✨

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: Lost Puppy Rescue and Care
description: Welcome to Lost Puppy Rescue and Care. A small pup is lost in the rain, cold and alone. He’s not sure who to trust—but with your care, that starts to change. Gently clean him up, feed him, and help him feel safe again. This calm, story-like game is all about kindness, connection, and giving one little dog a second chance.

title: Zombie Survival Shooter
description: Ready for an all-out apocalypse escape? Zombie Survival Shooter throws you straight into a world overrun by zombies. Zombies attack from every direction. Keep moving, dodge smartly, and never stop running. Shoot the digital doors to gain more helpers or boost your attack speed, etc. Use your strategy to choose which digital door to go through.

title: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance
description: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance is an exhilarating adventure game that merges the thrill of intricate prison escape challenges with the dynamic agility required in parkour. Assume the role of a resourceful rat striving to escape the strict surveillance of a heavily fortified prison. Find your way through elaborate mazes and overcome diverse, challenging obstacles as you plot your daring prison escape.

title: Word Deck Solitaire
description: WordDeck: Solitaire is a relaxing browser-based word puzzle game that combines solitaire-style card interaction with logical word associations. Clear the board by finding groups of related words and sorting them into hidden categories. Each level challenges you to identify connections between words based on themes, objects, properties, or concepts. As you progress, puzzles become more complex with larger word sets and subtler relationships.

title: Idle Trade Isle
description: Idle Trade Isle is a casual simulation game. Let's go on an island adventure on the sea! You are a captain, driving a boat to the mysterious island group. Each island has different natural resources that need to be collected. After collecting them, go back to your own island to build and upgrade them.  Enjoy!

title: ZUMAR DELUXE
description: As an explorer in the Zumar Deluxe , is only one going to be blocked by the marbles and your mission is shooting to blast all them. You have to complete all the levels in challenge mode, help frog marble defense in jungle marble and try to get three stars in each level.

title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: Color Water Puzzle
description:
Color Water Puzzle is a fun and addictive puzzle game! The goal is simple yet challenging: try to sort the colored water in the glasses until all colors are in the same glass.

It’s not just a game; it's a great way to relieve stress and exercise your logic. With vibrant colors and smooth pouring effects, this is the best choice to kill time and relax your mind.

Are you smart enough to solve all the levels? Download now and find out!

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Gear Wars
description: Do you have the strategic skill to build a flawless factory, producing Brutes, Archers, and Grunts? Manage your budget wisely, crush every enemy, and claim victory! Get those gears spinning... it's time to WIN!

title: Fish Eat Grow Mega
description: The mega grow is beginning with the mega fishes in the huge ocean on a great exciting adventure! New types of fish and a huge ocean are waiting for you in this chapter. Swimming in the more dangerous places of the ocean must be exciting. Pick your fish and embark on this adventure with your friend in 2 player game mode. Grow as much as you can and become the king fish of the ocean!

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Candy Crusher
description: Crush down the candy to become king of candies. Match 3 or more of the same candies together to remove them from play. Match 4 or 5 candies together to unlock bonus candies. Try to score as many points as possible within the limited amount of moves given. Level up to unlock additional board space in this fun online Candy Crush game.

title: 2048 Number Match
description: Indulge your brain and enjoy puzzle-solving and number-matching. Achieve the highest possible score and boast about your brain-power!

title: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City
description: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City throws you into a thrilling sandbox of chaos and destruction. Explore a vast, deserted city where every street is your testing ground. Drive, crash, and experiment with powerful vehicles while mastering realistic physics and dynamic crash effects. Whether you’re speeding down empty highways or performing daring stunts, this game lets you push every car — and your reflexes — to the limit.

title: Zumble Ocean
description: Get better at one of the most popular puzzle games. Shoot gems and try to complete all the levels with three stars in each level. This gem game is easy to play and addicting at the same time.

title: That's my seat!
description: That's My Seat! is a fun and engaging logic puzzle game where you must place characters in the correct seats by analyzing clues. Each level presents a new seating challenge with unique rules and relationships between the characters. Study the hints, think carefully, and figure out where everyone belongs. Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, deduction games, and casual puzzle games that test your thinking skills.

title: Marble Run - Ultimate Race!
description:
Race, roll, and clash in Marble Run, the ultimate marble racing game! Guide your marble through physics-based tracks, dodge obstacles, knock rivals off the edge, and aim for the finish line. 

With fast-paced races, competitive knockout rounds, and fun marble skins, it’s the most addictive 3D marble runner you’ll play!

title: Ship Out
description: The harbor’s a mess! Ships of all sizes and colors are stuck in a massive jam. Pay attention to their direction, plan your moves, and clear the chaos! Need help? Use special power-ups to sail through tougher levels.

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
description: Bubble shooter ultimate is a classic bubble shooter game with a modern twist. Each level-up you get to chose a power up like a change to get a bomb or rainbow bubble and more. Create combinations of three or more matching bubbles by launching bubbles of the same color at them. The more bubbles you pop in a single shot, the higher your score. If you miss a match 5 times, the playing field moves down by one row. The objective is to score as many points as possible while clearing all the bubbles!

title: Daily Sudoku
description: Daily Sudoku provides a thought-provoking journey that will keep you engrossed until every puzzle box is filled. If you enjoy challenging your intellect and sharpening your problem-solving skills, then you've come to the perfect spot.

title: Crazy Fruit Merge
description: Looking for the perfect relaxing game? Sometimes all you need is a fun puzzle. Merge fruits, challenge your mind and use power-ups to keep the game flowing. Progress further and aim for the highest score!

title: Organize It
description: Organize It is a decompression and organizing game for all players. Aren't you tired of all the clutter and chaos? Don't you just find peace when everything is in its right place and in harmony? Everything is scattered in total chaos. Only a hero can fight against all this chaos. This is your chance to organize it! Solve ingenious puzzles and organize everything to find harmony at every level. Organize, profit and become the best of the best!

title: Wood & Screw Puzzle
description: Welcome to the Wood & Screw Puzzle, where the world of puzzles meets the thrill of fasteners! Embark on a thrilling adventure where bolts, nuts, and wooden puzzles collide in a mind-bending challenge. Dive into a world filled with conundrums, where every turn reveals a new twist in the game.

title: Mojicon Fruit Connect
description:
Match. Collect. Get Inspired! Dive into Mojicon Fruit Connect, the vibrant puzzle game where every match brings you closer to a new discovery. Connect colorful emoji tiles to clear the board, but watch out for shifting gravity and frozen that tiles will keep you on your toes!

Complete levels to fill your Album with cute characters. Reveal meaningful quotes and daily inspiration with every unlock. Return to your Fruit Farm later to claim a basket full of free rewards. 

Play anywhere you like!

title: Ships 3D IO
description: Ships 3D is an IO game, multiplayer sailing ship simulator. The game is played in 'first person' where you control the sailor and move around the ship; interacting with the helm, sails and cannons. Sink enemy ships and shoot other players to score points.

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Halloween Fruit Slice is a high-energy arcade action game set in a spooky Halloween world. Vivid fruits and devious traps streak across the screen in an instant. Your task is to slice as many fruits as possible with lightning speed, chaining spectacular combos and racking up points while dodging explosive bombs. Rich visuals, splashy juice effects, and eerie backdrops create a thrilling, immersive atmosphere. The tempo keeps rising, so every moment tests your reflexes and precision.

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Solitaire Deluxe Edition
description:
Everyone's favorite classic card game is back. And this time, it's even more fancy and awesome!

Feast your eyes on the classic game that has been upgraded to look even better than before. Try your hand once again and see if you can beat it like you used to.

Is it all skill or does luck have some say in the matter? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
description: Join Tung Tung Sahur, the wooden drum-carrying dawn caller, as he bounces and flips through a neon cityscape just before sunrise! Dodge spikes, leap over traps, and time your jumps to the beat of his signature “tung-tung!” calls. In this Geometry Dash–inspired challenge, the streets are alive with glowing gates, speed pads, and tricky gravity flips. Can you drum your way to the end without missing a beat?

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Jewel Garden Story
description: Enter a dazzling realm where sparkling jewels await your matching skills. Challenge yourself to achieve high scores and enjoy the visually stunning jewel combinations. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless entertainment.

title: Pogo Masters
description: Bounce into action in Pogo Masters! Race against rivals in chaotic, physics-based platform battles where balance is everything. Compete online against players worldwide or challenge a friend locally on the same PC. Unlock dozens of unique characters, stylish pogo sticks, and eye-catching trail effects as you climb the global leaderboard. Fast-paced, competitive, and endlessly fun — become the ultimate pogo champion!

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Steal Brainrot Eggs
description: Steal Brainrot Eggs is a competitive action game playable in both 1 Player and 2 Player modes. Players buy eggs from a central conveyor, carry them to their Base, and hatch random Brainrot characters based on egg rarity. Characters generate coins over time, allowing access to higher-tier eggs. Defend your Base from thieves or steal eggs and characters from rivals, customize your character, raise evolving pets, and take part in timed events across the map.

title: Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition
description: Challenge your brain with Math Crossword, the perfect mix of logic puzzles and number games! Solve clever math equations in a crossword-style grid by placing the correct numbers into the right spots. Each level sharpens your brain with fun and rewarding challenges that test your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division skills.

title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game
description: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game lets you become the ultimate nail artist! Step into your very own nail salon where creativity has no limits. Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

title: Screw Match
description: Screw Match is a colorful puzzle game that tests your logic and coordination. Match screws of different colors to their corresponding glass nut boxes. The rules are simple, but the challenge grows with every level.

title: Frogtastic Marble Adventure
description:
Get ready to dive into a world of colors and adrenaline with Frogtastic, the puzzle game that will keep you glued to the screen! Jump into the adventure and save your world from the invasion of colorful spheres by combining strategy and lightning-fast reflexes!

Endless fun! Whether you have a few minutes for a quick game or want to dive into long gaming sessions, Frogtastic is perfect for you.

Play now and experience a puzzle game you won’t forget!

title: Shelf Sweep
description:
Get ready to tidy up the shelves in Shelf Sweep!
Dive into a fun and addictive sorting puzzle game where your goal is to clean up messy shelves layer by layer. Only the outermost layer of items is visible—clear them by matching three identical items, and reveal the hidden treasures beneath!

title: Screw Puzzle
description: In the game, players need to perform screw-driving challenges according to the level scenes. You need to choose different screw-driving skills according to different levels. There are many interesting gameplays for players to experience. Friends who like it, please come and play!

title: Block Puzzle 3D
description:
Block 3D Puzzle is a colorful logic game where you need to place 3D blocks on the board in the right order. Every move turns into a bright visual effect — when you place a figure and complete a line, the entire line lights up with that block’s color!
Plan your moves carefully, fill the lines, and clear space for new blocks. The game combines relaxing gameplay, smooth animations, and stylish 3D graphics, making every puzzle a true visual delight.

title: Mojicon Spring Connect
description:
The 5th Mojicon game is here! Relax and enjoy the peaceful Spring season. Guided by your cheerful and cheeky Bunny companion, embark on a soothing puzzle journey to bring a barren landscape back to life. Match tactile spring tiles to clear the board and earn rewards!

Restore the Meadow: Follow a heartwarming story.
Collect Cards: Find 34 beautiful "Spring Wisdoms".
Relax: Enjoy classic tile-matching mechanics.
Achievements: Go for 100% completion!

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Solitaire Mahjong
description: This is Solitaire Mahjong at its best, offering a classic and elegant mahjong experience without any need to rush. Known as one of the top mahjong games, it features a beautifully traditional layout that fans of mahjong puzzles will love. With polished graphics, a soothing soundtrack, and no timer, Solitaire Mahjong invites you to enjoy each move at a relaxed pace, focusing purely on the pleasure of the game.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Jewel Dress Up
description: Each puzzle brings you closer to unlocking fabulous fashionable combinations. Use power-ups to overcome challenges and to express your style, all while enjoying a relaxing and engaging gameplay. Can you create the perfect look?

title: Rope Stitch Puzzle
description:
CONNECT THE DOTS: Rope Stitch Puzzle Edition!

When life’s got you down and you’re feeling stressed out, what better way to make things right than to reach for your favorite cozy relaxing knitting puzzle and partake in a few puzzle solving game levels? 

Rope Stitch Puzzle is a satisfying ASMR game where you connect dots with rope to form colors and shapes that will come together and reveal a hidden puzzle.

title: Funny Angela Haircut
description: Give Angela the best hairstyle ever! Enjoy tons of professional tools like curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, magic hair growing spray, and so much more! Dye her hair in any variety of colors. Complete the makeover with stylish outfit, mix and match cute clothes and dress up Angela to become more fashionable!

title: Woodoku Block Puzzle
description: Welcome to experience the Woodoku Block Puzzle! This is a super fun casual puzzle game, especially for relaxing in your free time. The gameplay is very simple and very challenging! There are four modes you can choose from.

title: SUV Traffic Racer
description: In SUV Traffic Racer, you will be playing SUVs through stunning endless highways. Skim through the highway traffic and make the highest score by going as far as you can, Unlock more than 6 SUVs to make the ultimate SUV garage. Upgrade your SUV with 4 awesome upgrades and get the most out of those roaring engines. Enjoy the picturesque highways and conquer it with your driving skills. Are you ready to show if you're the finest highway racer out there?

title: Snake 2048
description: Start as a small cube in this thrilling online game! Eat smaller snakes, dodge stronger ones, and grow into a giant. Enjoy endless challenges, competitive leaderboards, and exciting gameplay. Play now and dominate the arena!

title: Xmasjong
description: Find a couple of identical tiles to remove them from the playing field. If you collect all the tiles underneath, you will find one item that will automatically be placed on or under the Christmas tree.

title: Traffic Racing
description: Traffic Racing is a fast-paced driving game that throws you into intense highway action where every second counts. Weave through heavy traffic at high speeds as you compete in Career Mode or test your skills against others in Racing League Online.

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Super Hero Tycoon
description: Build your superhero empire and dominate the battlefield! In Super Hero Tycoon, choose from iconic heroes like Iron Man, Spider-Man, or The Hulk, and construct your base to generate income, unlock powerful gear, and engage in thrilling PvP combat. With over 2 billion visits, this game offers an immersive experience for fans of superheroes and tycoon-style gameplay.

title: Color Strings
description: Looking for a simple way to exercise your brain every day? Try Color Strings! This game features straightforward rules and fun, challenging gameplay. In this puzzle game, you need to rearrange the strings on the dots to match the given pattern. With various puzzle levels, you'll keep your brain sharp in just a few minutes each day.

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: 3 Tiles
description:
Cutely shaped picture tiles are mixed and stacked. 
Find the tiles in the same picture from the top and group them together. 
Clear the stages by removing tiles from all fields!

title: Funny Doctor Emergency
description: Do you want to be a doctor? In Funny Doctor Emergency, you treat patients in cute and funny emergencies. Patients come in many ages and situations. Every patient needs a different treatment. Choose the correct tool from the options to treat each problem. Follow simple steps to help patients recover and smile again. Watch them feel better after treatment. This game is playful and easy to enjoy.

title: Traffic Cop 3D
description: Traffic Cop 3D is a casual game where you play as a police officer enforcing the law of the road. Scan nearby drivers and use intel from the police database to decide whether you should pull them over, or let them go, all while progressing through the story and increasing your duties as a cop.

title: Capybara Xmas Merge
description:
Capybara Xmas Merge is a cute and cozy holiday game where you combine adorable Christmas capybaras!
Drop festive capybaras into the box, watch them roll and bump into each other, and merge into bigger, funnier holiday characters.
Create giant capybaras, score points, and enjoy the warm winter atmosphere.

title: Pet Tile Master
description: Enjoy a fun pet-themed tile-matching challenge in Pet Tile Master! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring adorable pets and match three identical ones to clear them. Be careful—if the stack fills up with 9 tiles, the game is over! Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles and complete each level. Have fun with cute animals, relaxing gameplay, and tricky puzzles!

title: Animal Link
description: Animal Link is a puzzle game, the goal is to remove all the squares by eliminating the same pattern. The rules of the game are simple and require a certain amount of observation and quick reaction ability.

title: Bone Doctor Shoulder Case
description: Oouch, our cheerleader took a tumble and hurt her shoulder. Help fix her up with a quick shoulder surgery by following the right steps to ensure she recovers fully. Once she healed, give her a make over with some stylish outfits and accessories from our collection, so she can return to the squad looking better than ever!

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: Connect Balls New Year Puzzles!
description: ● This New Year's game is more difficult than it might seem ?! You have a playing field? on which you need to throw balls and connect the same ones??! Until you get the biggest and most beautiful one?! Save up points?! Compete with friends and colleagues to become the best?! Enjoy your game?!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Fortune's Deck Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Fortune's Deck Solitaire, where ancient Tarot magic meets the timeless thrill of Tripeaks!

Three enchanted towers of fate await your touch - draw from the mystical deck and begin your journey through the arcana.

Inspired by the classic Tripeaks Solitaire, this magical twist invites you to clear the cards, trust your intuition, and let the deck reveal your fortune.

Will you find insight, mystery… or unexpected luck?

title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel
description: This is a special bubble shooter game in which you will find a rotating wheel of candies. To complete the game you need to collect all the candies on the wheel. Shoot the candies towards the wheel to make the group of at least three candies of the same color. Your points are reducing with the time, so finish the game early to save more points.

title: Sea Rush
description: Use your imagination and discover what the ocean holds. Rescue all the fishes that are scattered in the levels and see all of their beautifull colors.

title: Snowball.io
description: Make a snowball bigger and bump it to opponents to flick them off the play field. You can make one giant snowball or a number of small balls and you can bump it directly to the opponent or snipe them with it. It is totally up to you. Click mouse button to make snowballs.

title: Chiron City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports car through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: Challenger City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Dino Game
description: Play Dino Game online! An offline-style dinosaur run for 1–3 players. Jump cacti, dodge flyers, unlock dinos, and race for high scores. Dino Game brings the classic offline dinosaur run to life with fast, responsive gameplay and local multiplayer. Dash across an endless desert, jump over cacti, and duck under swooping dinos as the speed steadily climbs. Play solo to beat your personal best, or switch to 2-player and 3-player modes to race friends on the same device.

title: Merge Smith
description:
If you combine the same items, a higher level of items will be created.
Make legendary items and become the best blacksmith.

title: Luxury Highway Cars
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning luxury cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Luxury Highway Cars!

title: 1010 Jungle Blocks
description: 1010 Jungle Blocks is a very interesting block puzzle game. In this game you need to pick and drop the set of blocks on the board. After dropping the set,  if a horizontal or vertical line of 10 blocks is formed, the blocks will be removed from the board. The more number of blocks you remove at once, more score you will get. Don’t let the board crowded with the blocks. You can play till you are able to fit the existing block sets .

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: x Ultimate
description: Colorful tiles are crowding the board Your task is to move them around to form lines to make them disappear Better think twice how you move them because position is what matters You dont want to waste your boosters like undo or move anywhere do you Build combos but watch out for overfilling Master the x board

title: GT Cars City Racing
description: GT Cars City Racing is a driving game with a fantastic open world, epic stunts and magnificent super stylized cars! The game, which brings many innovations and game-play to its previous series GT Cars Mega Ramps, has different surprises waiting for you in its 2nd series. The open world, which is especially demanded by the players, was designed as a Toy City. Incredible shows in the Toy City offer a dazzling game-play experience and never-ending action!

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Max Mixed Cocktails
description: Do you want to become a master mixologist? Create cocktails by blending ingredients at the bar. Choose your ingredients, mix them skillfully, and sample the concoction. You'll reach a delightful conclusion by discovering the perfect recipe. Utilize clues in the collections to unlock different endings.

title: Sort Parking
description: Sort cars by type. You cannot park in a full parking lot. Cars cannot be placed in front of different types. You can increase the number of car models with coins available in the game. If you clear many stages, you will get pieces for the background. When pieces of the same type are matched, the background is completed and the background can be changed.

title: Jewel Magic Xmas
description: Already in Christmas mood The classic turn based triplet matching arcade with Christmas decorations awaits you Match triplets while solving puzzles in lots of different challenging levels Also you can spin the lucky wheel daily to get boosters to help you Have a jolly time Merry matching Christmas with jolly jewels

title: Find It - Find The Differences
description: Find It is an engaging puzzle game that tests your observation skills as you search for subtle differences between two nearly identical images. With colorful visuals and beautifully designed scenes, each level presents a fresh challenge. Whether you're spotting tiny details or uncovering hidden objects, Find It will keep you entertained and focused. Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: Gold Strike Icy Cave
description: "Gold Strike Icy Cave" is a winter-themed twist on the beloved casual puzzle game, "Gold Strike." Set in a frosty cave, players face sparkling challenges as they mine through icy blocks, aiming to clear colorful clusters of frozen gems. With the familiar gameplay mechanics of its predecessor, this chilly rendition brings a refreshing winter vibe to the strategic and addictive fun, offering a frosty yet exhilarating experience for puzzle enthusiasts.

title: Bloom Within: A life simulator
description:
The simulator of a pregnant mother allows you to fully experience the whole process of pregnancy.
In this anime game you have to play the role of a girl who has a loving husband and a child under her heart, who is waiting for her birth. Take care of yourself, give birth, take care of your baby and raise a healthy baby.

title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
description: In the chaotic world of Merge Plant Zombie War, arm your garden with strategic merges to fend off relentless zombie hordes! Master upgrades, deploy special abilities, and outsmart waves of undead foes in this addictive merge-tower defense adventure. Will your botanical army prevail in the ultimate war for survival? Dive in and merge your way to victory!

title: Shanghai Chef
description:
A fun and fast-paced matching game where you need to find and connect the same blocks! 
Test your reflexes and observation skills as you quickly spot matching pairs. 
Can your hands move faster than your eyes can track? 
Pay close attention to which blocks can be linked together and clear the board as fast as possible!

title: Worm Escape
description:
Worm Escape is a fun puzzle game that tests your logic and decision-making skills. Move worms in the correct order to clear each level. A single right move can solve the puzzle, while a wrong one can block your progress.

As you advance, levels become more complex with tighter spaces and more worms. Analyze carefully and choose the right sequence to succeed.

Simple tap controls make it easy to play, but mastering each level requires planning and strategy.

title: Digital Circus IO
description:
Grim AI gathered amazing creatures at the circus arena and offered them the chance to compete for life here!
Pick your character and get as much territory as you can! Run from your starting territory and return to add a chunk of space. Evade other characters or defeat them by stepping on their trail.

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description:
Become a legendary kunai master in this thrilling combination of dynamic gameplay and classic ninja action. Play offline and enjoy the freedom to dive into the adventure whenever you want. Slice through foes, overcome obstacles, and set out on an epic ninja quest without boundaries.

Will you seize the blade and claim your place as the ultimate ninja warrior?

title: Word Rivers
description: Play Word Rivers - an exciting word game where you can enjoy a sea of words and fantastic crosswords. Find words from letters and discover the wonders of the world and words right now!

title: Lipuzz Water Sort Puzzle
description: You will think a lot and have a lot of fun while playing the Lipuzz game. A great game to exercise memory. The aim of the game is to collect liquids of the same color in a container by transferring the liquids in the containers to each other. The most important rule in the game is that the container you want to pour the liquid into must either be empty or the other container must have the same color liquid. If you can't pass the level in the game, you can get another container from the top menu.

title: Home Design - Match 3
description: Enjoy a perfect blend of home design and match-3 fun! Solve colorful puzzles, create your ideal home, and activate powerful boosters. Take on rewarding challenges, collect prizes, and personalize your interiors. Play anytime, anywhere!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: Bus Jam Escape
description: Bus Jam Escape brings addictive color-matching puzzle action straight to your browser. In this free online game, you’ll guide waiting passengers into buses by matching their colors - no download required. Ideal for fans of casual puzzle and sorting games, Bus Jam Escape delivers crisp graphics, instant play and intuitive click-and-drag controls. Jump into this vibrant web game for quick brain teasers or marathon sessions - every tap pushes you closer to a high-score win.

title: Fit Cats
description:
Cats love boxes! Launch cats of different sizes into the box. If two cats of the same size touch each other, they merge into one larger cat. 
If the cat falls outside the box, the game ends.height/width at which your game is optimized at. Please note that the size will be available in the catalog for publishers to see.
In the game, you can also use the mouse to drive any cat out of the box. Also, from time to time you can catch mice that give this opportunity.
Try to unlock all the cats.

title: Brilliant Jewels
description: Brilliant Jewels is a Match 3 game where you can either play against the time or try to pass levels with limited amount of moves. If you are feeling confident, you can also challenge the hard mode on the time attack mode. This game doesn't lack any sparkle!

title: Tung Tung Sahur: Obby Challenge
description: Jump into the viral madness of Tung Tung Sahur: Obby Challenge — a hilarious meme-based platformer where you dodge traps, jump across chaos, and try to survive with style. Inspired by trending TikTok memes, especially the absurd world of Italian Brainrot Animals. Play as the one and only meme legend, Tung Tung Sahur, and conquer chaotic Obby parkour levels like never before.

title: Bubble Mania Shooter
description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: Capybara Jump
description: Bounce into a cute stacking challenge with Capybara Jump! Time your taps to leap as wooden blocks slide in from both sides, building a towering platform under your capybara. Land perfectly to chain combos, trigger sparkles, and push your score higher before a mistimed jump sends you tumbling down.

title: FaceChart
description: Do you dream of creating wild, fabulous looks like your favorite artists on social media? Dive into the enchanting realm of Face Chart! Wondering what a face chart is? It's your chic canvas to plan the next jaw-dropping, glamorous look. Grab a piece of paper and let it be your pocket-sized playground—experiment with new colors you hesitated to wear, pick and mix diverse designs for an endless array of possibilities.

title: Nonogram Picture Cross
description:
Discover the mystery of picture cross number puzzles! Solve the nonogram puzzles with simple rules and challenging solutions to uncover the picture! Exercise your logic with a picture cross game and become a real Nonogram master!  
  
Nonograms are addictive number puzzles that combine logic with pixel art. Reveal hidden pictures on the puzzle pages based on the numbers lined up in both directions! To solve the picture cross puzzle, follow the clues that will help you color the squares to complete the line and choose which of them have to stay empty. If you fill in all the right squares in this pic cross puzzle, you will uncover a lovely pixel art picture! This is the main point of the picture cross quiz.

title: Crunch Locked
description: Crunch Locked is a satisfying puzzle game where every move brings the pieces closer together. Tap available segments to snap them into place and gradually build complete shapes. As the structure collapses into a single remaining piece, the final segment crunches away and clears the level. With locked parts, blocked paths, and increasingly clever layouts, every puzzle requires careful planning and the right sequence of moves.

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Discover a new genre in the world of puzzles! This game intertwines block puzzles with a thrilling adventure on tropical islands! Complete levels to earn stars, unlock new territories and unique relaxation areas. From snow-white beaches to dense jungles – each location is filled with unique challenges. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

title: Space Blast
description: Space Blast is a 2D game full of action arcade game where your piloting skills and strategic thinking are key to navigating relentless waves of meteors. Command a powerful spaceship equipped with advanced weapons and take on the challenge of protecting the galaxy from incoming threats.

title: Mart Puzzle Shopping Sort
description: Mart Puzzle - Shopping Sort is a fun blend of simulation and brain-teasing management, where you get to run your very own mini-mart! As a store manager, you will be responsible for sorting out goods and processing orders.

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Emoji Drop Themes
description: Dive into the addictive fun of Emoji Drop, a delightful physics puzzle game where strategy meets chain reactions! Drop a variety of charming items, from classic emojis and juicy fruits to wild animals into the container. The magic happens when two matching items touch, merging into something new and bigger. With a challenging Adventure Mode and a relaxing Classic Mode, can you master the merge and discover the final, ultimate item?

title: Mahjong At Home - Xmas Edition
description: Experience the holiday spirit with 'Mahjong at Home: Christmas Edition'! Dive into this high-quality Mahjong game featuring festive themes and cozy, winter-inspired designs.

title: Super Sprunki Clicker
description: Enjoy the Sprunki World in this clicker idle game. Immerse yourself in the beats and music simulation, create the band, and use the rewards to buy new upgrades and features. Break the screen touching the sprunkis, hire automatic clickers, social media features, instruments, and everything to become the Sprunki King.

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Jump Master
description:
You can jump further if you press down on the marker.
Press and release the timing so that it doesn't fall between the footrest and the footrest!
Why don't you compete with your friends for points with the sharing function?

title: Aliens Hunter
description: You are an alien hunter and your mission is to use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards. Each round has different aliens hiding in different locations. You have to accurately choose, aim and shoot to complete the level mission.

title: Candy Pop
description: Score as many points as you can in unlimited time Candy pop is just for fun game You can play it while you are in queue or waiting someone to hang out One more beautiful than the other candies are waiting for you to crush them

title: Square World 3D
description: Square World 3D invites you into a completely open and huge craft world. In this world, you can use dozens of items / mines to design most of the things you can imagine and take actions in a world of your own. For example, first design, then fly over your unique design using the flying mode! This wonderful simulation game may become addictive for you. It is possible to design a completely different world in every game.

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: City Drift Racing
description: "City Drift Racing" is an atmospheric racing arcade game where crazy competitions await you on the streets of the metropolis.

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Chicken Scream Race
description: Get ready for a wacky and challenging voice-controlled adventure in Chicken Scream Race! This unique game brings a hilarious twist to platform racing by letting you control your character with both taps and your voice. Whether you’re clucking quietly or screaming loudly, your chicken responds to the intensity of your sound, making each race a chaotic yet exciting experience.

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Merge Pixel
description:
Attractive characters in dot, pixel style!
Combining the same characters creates a higher level of characters.
Repeat Merge to create a legendary character.

title: Bubble Pop Adventures
description: Mama mushroom needs your help Rescue trapped baby mushrooms by matching the correct bubbles Features Solve bubble sets using a variety of tactics Score combo points for using elegant solutions Play with different colored bubbles and special bubbles  challenging levels Fun and uplifting theme suitable for families

title: Hangman
description:
The classic Hangman game is released. Learn new words while improving your guessing skills.

How high can you score? Earn points and diamonds for each word guessed correctly.

Prevent the stick man from being hanged.

Features:

- Find the words too hard to guess? Use diamonds in exchange for hints.
- Challenging puzzles to beat. Hang with the best.
- Linear progression of difficulty.

title: Aventador Vice Crime City
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning morning city graphics, transforming the city into a spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Aventador Vice Crime City offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.
